        const effectiveType = resolveEngineType(dbTypeVal);
        if (effectiveType === 'bigquery') {
          return `\`${database}.${schemaName || 'public'}.${tableName}\``;
        }
        // For CloudSQL with different databases, prefix with database
        if (database !== baseDatabase) {
          return schemaName && schemaName !== 'public'
            ? `${database}.${schemaName}.${tableName}`
            : `${database}.${tableName}`;
        }
      }
      // Same database or single-db mode — just schema.table
      return schemaName && schemaName !== 'public' ? `${schemaName}.${tableName}` : tableName;
    };

    const parts = [];

    // SELECT
    let selectPart = 'SELECT';
    if (distinct) selectPart += ' DISTINCT';

    if (selectedColumns.length === 0) {
      selectPart += ' *';
    } else {
      const colParts = selectedColumns.map(c => {
        let expr = colRef(c.table, c.column);
        if (c.agg) expr = `${c.agg}(${expr})`;
        if (c.alias) expr += ` AS ${c.alias}`;
        return expr;
      });
      selectPart += '\n  ' + colParts.join(',\n  ');
    }
    parts.push(selectPart);

    // FROM
    let fromPart = `FROM ${qualifyTable(baseTable, baseSchema, baseDatabase, baseDbType)}`;
    if (baseAlias) fromPart += ` ${baseAlias}`;
    parts.push(fromPart);

    // JOINs
    joins.forEach(j => {
      if (!j.table) return;
      const qualifiedJoinTable = qualifyTable(j.table, j.schema, j.database, j.dbType);
      let joinStr = `${j.type} JOIN ${qualifiedJoinTable}`;
      if (j.alias) joinStr += ` ${j.alias}`;
      if (j.sourceCol && j.targetCol && j.type !== 'CROSS') {
        const srcRef = baseAlias || baseTable;
        const tgtRef = j.alias || j.table;
        joinStr += ` ON ${srcRef}.${j.sourceCol} = ${tgtRef}.${j.targetCol}`;
      }
      parts.push(joinStr);
    });

    // WHERE
    if (conditions.length > 0) {
      const condParts = conditions.filter(c => c.column || c.operator === 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY').map((c, i) => {
        let expr = c.column;
        const op = c.operator;
        if (op === 'IS NULL' || op === 'IS NOT NULL') {
          expr += ` ${op}`;
        } else if (op === 'IN' || op === 'NOT IN') {
          const vals = c.value.split(',').map(v => `'${v.trim()}'`).join(', ');
          expr += ` ${op} (${vals})`;
        } else if (op === 'BETWEEN') {
          const vals = c.value.split(',').map(v => v.trim());
          expr += ` BETWEEN ${vals[0] || '?'} AND ${vals[1] || '?'}`;
        } else if (op === 'IN_SUBQUERY' || op === 'NOT_IN_SUBQUERY') {
          const sq = c.subquery || {};
          const sqOp = op === 'IN_SUBQUERY' ? 'IN' : 'NOT IN';
          const subSchema = sq.schema && sq.schema !== 'public' ? sq.schema + '.' : '';
          let subSql = `SELECT ${sq.column || '*'} FROM ${subSchema}${sq.table || '?'}`;
          if (sq.where_col && sq.where_val) {
            const needsQ = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(sq.where_val);
            subSql += ` WHERE ${sq.where_col} ${sq.where_op || '='} ${needsQ ? `'${sq.where_val}'` : sq.where_val}`;
          }
          expr += ` ${sqOp} (${subSql})`;
        } else if (op === 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY') {
          const sq = c.subquery || {};
          const subSchema = sq.schema && sq.schema !== 'public' ? sq.schema + '.' : '';
          let subSql = `SELECT 1 FROM ${subSchema}${sq.table || '?'}`;
          if (sq.where_col && sq.where_val) {
            const needsQ = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(sq.where_val);
            subSql += ` WHERE ${sq.where_col} ${sq.where_op || '='} ${needsQ ? `'${sq.where_val}'` : sq.where_val}`;
          }
          expr = `EXISTS (${subSql})`;
        } else {
          const needsQuotes = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(c.value) && c.value.toLowerCase() !== 'true' && c.value.toLowerCase() !== 'false';
          expr += ` ${op} ${needsQuotes ? `'${c.value}'` : c.value}`;
        }
        return i > 0 ? `${c.connector || 'AND'} ${expr}` : expr;
      });
      if (condParts.length > 0) {
        parts.push('WHERE ' + condParts.join('\n  '));
      }
    }

    // GROUP BY
    if (groupByColumns.length > 0) {
      const groupParts = groupByColumns.map(g => colRef(g.table, g.column));
      parts.push('GROUP BY ' + groupParts.join(', '));
    }

    // HAVING
    if (havingConditions.length > 0 && groupByColumns.length > 0) {
      const havParts = havingConditions.filter(h => h.column).map((h, i) => {
        let expr = h.agg ? `${h.agg}(${h.column})` : h.column;
        const op = h.operator;
        if (op === 'IS NULL' || op === 'IS NOT NULL') {
          expr += ` ${op}`;
        } else {
          const needsQuotes = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(h.value) && h.value.toLowerCase() !== 'true' && h.value.toLowerCase() !== 'false';
          expr += ` ${op} ${needsQuotes ? `'${h.value}'` : h.value}`;
        }
        return i > 0 ? `${h.connector || 'AND'} ${expr}` : expr;
      });
      if (havParts.length > 0) {
        parts.push('HAVING ' + havParts.join('\n  '));
      }
    }

    // ORDER BY
    if (orderByColumns.length > 0) {
      const orderParts = orderByColumns.filter(o => o.column).map(o => `${o.column} ${o.direction}`);
      if (orderParts.length > 0) parts.push('ORDER BY ' + orderParts.join(', '));
    }

    // LIMIT / OFFSET — use TOP for MSSQL
    const engineType = resolveEngineType(baseDbType);
    if (limitValue > 0) {
      if (engineType === 'mssql') {
        // For MSSQL, inject TOP N after SELECT in the first part
        if (parts.length > 0 && parts[0].startsWith('SELECT')) {
          parts[0] = parts[0].replace(/^SELECT/i, `SELECT TOP ${limitValue}`);
        }
      } else {
        parts.push(`LIMIT ${limitValue}`);
      }
    }
    if (offsetValue > 0) {
      if (engineType === 'mssql') {
        // MSSQL uses OFFSET/FETCH (requires ORDER BY)
        if (orderByColumns.length > 0) {
          parts.push(`OFFSET ${offsetValue} ROWS`);
        }
      } else {
        parts.push(`OFFSET ${offsetValue}`);
      }
    }

    // UNION / INTERSECT / EXCEPT
    unionBlocks.forEach(block => {
      if (!block.table) return;
      const qualifiedUnionTable = qualifyTable(block.table, block.schema, block.database, block.dbType);
      let blockSql = `\n${block.operator}\n\nSELECT ${block.columns || '*'}\nFROM ${qualifiedUnionTable}`;
      if (block.where_col && block.where_val) {
        const needsQ = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(block.where_val);
        blockSql += `\nWHERE ${block.where_col} ${block.where_op || '='} ${needsQ ? `'${block.where_val}'` : block.where_val}`;
      }
      parts.push(blockSql);
    });

    return parts.join('\n');
  }, [baseTable, baseSchema, baseDatabase, baseDbType, baseAlias, selectedColumns, joins, conditions, groupByColumns, havingConditions, orderByColumns, limitValue, offsetValue, distinct, colRef, unionBlocks, isMultiDb]);

  // ── Actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleUseQuery = () => {
    if (onUseQuery) onUseQuery(generatedSQL);
    toast.success('Query applied to editor!');
  };

  const handleCopySQL = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatedSQL);
    toast.success('SQL copied to clipboard!');
  };

  // ── Run query directly ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleRunQuery = async () => {
    if (!baseTable || (!baseDatabase && !db)) return;
    setIsRunning(true);
    setQueryError('');
    setQueryResults(null);
    setResultsPage(0);
    try {
      const execDb = baseDatabase || db;
      const execDbType = baseDbType || databaseType || 'cloudsql';
      const actualType = execDbType.startsWith('server:') ? execDbType : execDbType;
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeQuery(execDb, generatedSQL, actualType);
      const result = res.data;
      if (result.success) {
        setQueryResults(result);
        toast.success(`Query returned ${result.row_count} row${result.row_count !== 1 ? 's' : ''} in ${result.execution_time_ms}ms`);
      } else {
        setQueryError(result.message || 'Query failed');
        toast.error(result.message || 'Query failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Execution failed';
      setQueryError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    }
    setIsRunning(false);
  };

  const handleDownloadCSV = () => {
    if (!queryResults?.data?.length) return;
    const cols = queryResults.columns;
    const rows = queryResults.data;
    const csvLines = [cols.join(',')];
    rows.forEach(row => {
      csvLines.push(cols.map(c => {
        const val = row[c];
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
        const s = String(val);
        return s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n') ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
      }).join(','));
    });
    const blob = new Blob([csvLines.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `vqb_results_${Date.now()}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast.success('CSV downloaded!');
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setBaseTable('');
    setBaseSchema('public');
    setBaseDatabase('');
    setBaseDbType('');
    setBaseAlias('');
    setSelectedColumns([]);
    setJoins([]);
    setConditions([]);
    setGroupByColumns([]);
    setHavingConditions([]);
    setOrderByColumns([]);
    setLimitValue(100);
    setOffsetValue(0);
    setDistinct(false);
    setUnionBlocks([]);
  };

  // ── Import SQL → VQB (Reverse Parse) ──────────────────────────────
  const [showImportModal, setShowImportModal] = useState(false);
  const [importSQL, setImportSQL] = useState('');
  const [importLoading, setImportLoading] = useState(false);

  // ── Drag-and-drop column reordering ────────────────────────────────
  const [dragColIdx, setDragColIdx] = useState(null);

  const handleColDragStart = (idx) => (e) => {
    setDragColIdx(idx);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', idx.toString());
  };

  const handleColDragOver = (idx) => (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
  };

  const handleColDrop = (dropIdx) => (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (dragColIdx === null || dragColIdx === dropIdx) { setDragColIdx(null); return; }
    setSelectedColumns(prev => {
      const next = [...prev];
      const [moved] = next.splice(dragColIdx, 1);
      next.splice(dropIdx, 0, moved);
      return next;
    });
    setDragColIdx(null);
  };

  const handleColDragEnd = () => setDragColIdx(null);

  const handleImportSQL = async () => {
    if (!importSQL.trim()) { toast.error('Enter a SQL query to import'); return; }
    setImportLoading(true);
    try {
      const dbType = selectedServer ? `server:${selectedServer.id}` : databaseType || 'cloudsql';
      const effectiveType = dbType.startsWith('server:') ? (selectedServer?.db_type || 'cloudsql') : dbType;
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.parseQuery(db, importSQL.trim(), effectiveType);
      const parsed = res.data;
      if (!parsed.success || !parsed.table_name) {
        toast.error(parsed.error || 'Could not parse SQL — no table found');
        setImportLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Reset first
      handleReset();

      // Set base table
      setBaseTable(parsed.table_name);
      setBaseSchema(parsed.schema_name || 'public');
      if (parsed.base_table_alias) setBaseAlias(parsed.base_table_alias);

      // Fetch columns for the base table
      await fetchColumns(parsed.table_name, parsed.schema_name || 'public');

      // Populate joins
      if (parsed.joins && parsed.joins.length > 0) {
        const mappedJoins = parsed.joins.map((j, i) => {
          // Fetch columns for joined tables too
          fetchColumns(j.target_table, parsed.schema_name || 'public');
          return {
            id: Date.now() + i,
            type: (j.join_type || 'INNER').replace(' JOIN', '').replace(' OUTER', '').trim(),
            table: j.target_table,
            schema: parsed.schema_name || 'public',
            alias: j.alias || '',
            sourceCol: j.source_column || '',
            targetCol: j.target_column || '',
          };
        });
        setJoins(mappedJoins);
        setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, joins: true }));
      }

      // Populate selected columns
      if (parsed.columns_used && parsed.columns_used.length > 0) {
        const cols = parsed.columns_used.map(col => {
          const aliasEntry = (parsed.select_column_aliases || []).find(a => a.expr === col);
          return {
            table: col.includes('.') ? col.split('.')[0] : parsed.table_name,
            schema: parsed.schema_name || 'public',
            column: col.includes('.') ? col.split('.').slice(1).join('.') : col,
            alias: aliasEntry ? aliasEntry.output_alias : '',
            agg: '',
            checked: true,
          };
        });
        setSelectedColumns(cols);
      }

      // Populate WHERE conditions
      if (parsed.where_conditions && parsed.where_conditions.length > 0) {
        const conds = parsed.where_conditions.map((wc, i) => ({
          id: Date.now().toString(36) + i,
          column: wc.column,
          operator: wc.operator === 'RAW' ? '=' : wc.operator,
          value: wc.value || '',
          connector: i > 0 ? 'AND' : '',
          subquery: { table: '', schema: 'public', column: '', where_col: '', where_op: '=', where_val: '' },
        }));
        setConditions(conds);
        setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, where: true }));
      }

      setShowImportModal(false);
      setImportSQL('');
      toast.success(`Imported: ${parsed.table_name}${parsed.joins?.length ? ` + ${parsed.joins.length} join(s)` : ''}${parsed.where_conditions?.length ? ` + ${parsed.where_conditions.length} condition(s)` : ''}`, { duration: 4000 });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Parse failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'));
    }
    setImportLoading(false);
  };

  // ── Column list for dropdowns (fully qualified) ────────────────────
  const columnDropdownOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return allAvailableColumns.map(c => ({
      value: colRef(c.table, c.column),
      label: joins.length > 0 ? `${c.alias || c.table}.${c.column}` : c.column,
      dataType: c.dataType,
    }));
  }, [allAvailableColumns, colRef, joins]);

  // ── Get columns for a specific table ───────────────────────────────
  const getTableColumns = useCallback((tableName, schemaName = 'public') => {
    const key = `${schemaName}.${tableName}`;
    return tableColumns[key] || [];
  }, [tableColumns]);

  // ── Section header component ───────────────────────────────────────
  const SectionHeader = ({ section, icon: Icon, label, count, action, actionIcon: ActionIcon, actionLabel }) => (
    <div className="vqb-section-header" onClick={() => toggleSection(section)}>
      <div className="vqb-section-title">
        {expandedSections[section] ? <ChevronDown size={14} /> : <ChevronRight size={14} />}
        <Icon size={15} />
        <span>{label}</span>
        {count > 0 && <span className="vqb-badge">{count}</span>}
      </div>
      {action && (
        <button className="vqb-section-action" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); action(); }} title={actionLabel}>
          <ActionIcon size={13} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="vqb-container">
      {/* ── Left Panel: Builder Controls ─────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vqb-panel vqb-controls">
        <div className="vqb-controls-header">
          <div className="vqb-controls-title">
            <Layers size={16} />
            <span>Visual Query Builder</span>
          </div>
          <div className="vqb-controls-actions">
            <button className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowImportModal(true)} title="Import SQL → VQB">
              <Download size={13} /> Import
            </button>
            <button className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost" onClick={handleReset} title="Reset all">
              <RefreshCw size={13} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="vqb-controls-body">
          {/* ── 0. Data Sources ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader section="dataSources" icon={Database} label="Data Sources" count={dataSources.length} action={() => { setShowAddSource(true); loadAddSourceDbs(addSourceType); }} actionIcon={Plus} actionLabel="Add Database" />
          {expandedSections.dataSources && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {dataSources.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  <Database size={16} />
                  <span>No databases added</span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="vqb-source-list">
                  {dataSources.map(s => (
                    <div key={s.id} className="vqb-source-item">
                      <Database size={12} />
                      <span className="vqb-source-name">{s.database}</span>
                      <span className="vqb-source-type" style={{
                        background: s.dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'rgba(66,133,244,0.12)' : 'rgba(52,168,83,0.12)',
                        color: s.dbType === 'bigquery' ? '#4285f4' : '#34a853',
                      }}>
                        {s.dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'BQ' : s.dbType.startsWith('server:') ? 'Server' : 'CloudSQL'}
                      </span>
                      {s.id !== 'default' && (
                        <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeDataSource(s.id)} title="Remove source">
                          <X size={11} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 1. Table Selection ──────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader section="tables" icon={Table2} label="Base Table" count={baseTable ? 1 : 0} />
          {expandedSections.tables && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {dataSources.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  <Database size={16} />
                  <span>Add a data source first</span>
                </div>
              ) : loadingTables ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty"><RefreshCw size={14} className="vqb-spin" /> Loading tables...</div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="vqb-search">
                    <Search size={13} />
                    <input placeholder="Search tables..." value={tableSearch} onChange={e => setTableSearch(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="vqb-table-list">
                    {filteredTables.map(t => (
                      <button
                        key={`${t.database}.${t.schema}.${t.name}`}
                        className={`vqb-table-item ${baseTable === t.name && baseSchema === (t.schema || 'public') && baseDatabase === t.database ? 'active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => handleSelectBaseTable(t)}
                      >
                        <Table2 size={13} />
                        <span className="vqb-table-name">{t.name}</span>
                        {t.schema && t.schema !== 'public' && <span className="vqb-table-schema">{t.schema}</span>}
                        {isMultiDb && t.database && (
                          <span className="vqb-table-db" style={{
                            fontSize: '0.6rem', padding: '1px 5px', borderRadius: 4, marginLeft: 'auto',
                            background: t.dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'rgba(66,133,244,0.1)' : 'rgba(52,168,83,0.1)',
                            color: t.dbType === 'bigquery' ? '#4285f4' : '#34a853',
                          }}>{t.database}</span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                    {filteredTables.length === 0 && <div className="vqb-empty">No tables found</div>}
                  </div>
                  {baseTable && (
                    <div className="vqb-alias-row">
                      <label>Alias:</label>
                      <input
                        placeholder="e.g. t1"
                        value={baseAlias}
                        onChange={e => setBaseAlias(e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-input-sm"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 2. Column Selection ────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="columns"
            icon={Columns}
            label="Columns"
            count={selectedColumns.length}
          />
          {expandedSections.columns && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {!baseTable ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">Select a base table first</div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="vqb-column-actions-bar">
                    <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={selectAllColumns}>
                      {selectedColumns.length === allAvailableColumns.length ? <EyeOff size={12} /> : <Eye size={12} />}
                      {selectedColumns.length === allAvailableColumns.length ? 'Deselect All' : 'Select All'}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className={`vqb-btn-xs ${distinct ? 'active' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => setDistinct(!distinct)}
                      title="Toggle DISTINCT"
                    >
                      <ToggleRight size={12} /> DISTINCT
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="vqb-search">
                    <Search size={13} />
                    <input placeholder="Search columns..." value={columnSearch} onChange={e => setColumnSearch(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="vqb-column-list">
                    {allAvailableColumns
                      .filter(c => !columnSearch || c.column.toLowerCase().includes(columnSearch.toLowerCase()))
                      .map((col, i) => {
                        const selected = isColumnSelected(col);
                        const selIdx = selectedColumns.findIndex(s => s.table === col.table && s.column === col.column && s.schema === col.schema);
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={`${col.table}.${col.column}.${i}`}
                            className={`vqb-column-item ${selected ? 'selected' : ''} ${dragColIdx === selIdx && selected ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
                            draggable={selected}
                            onDragStart={selected ? handleColDragStart(selIdx) : undefined}
                            onDragOver={selected ? handleColDragOver(selIdx) : undefined}
                            onDrop={selected ? handleColDrop(selIdx) : undefined}
                            onDragEnd={selected ? handleColDragEnd : undefined}
                          >
                            <div className="vqb-column-main" onClick={() => toggleColumn(col)}>
                              {selected && (
                                <span style={{ cursor: 'grab', opacity: 0.4, marginRight: 2, display: 'flex' }} title="Drag to reorder">
                                  <GripVertical size={12} />
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <input type="checkbox" checked={selected} readOnly />
                              <span className="vqb-col-name">{col.column}</span>
                              <span className="vqb-col-type">{col.dataType}</span>
                              {joins.length > 0 && <span className="vqb-col-table">{col.alias || col.table}</span>}
                            </div>
                            {selected && (
                              <div className="vqb-column-config">
                                <select
                                  value={selectedColumns[selIdx]?.agg || ''}
                                  onChange={e => updateColumnConfig(selIdx, 'agg', e.target.value)}
                                  className="vqb-select-xs"
                                  title="Aggregate function"
                                >
                                  {AGG_FUNCTIONS.map(f => <option key={f} value={f}>{f || 'No Agg'}</option>)}
                                </select>
                                <input
                                  placeholder="Alias"
                                  value={selectedColumns[selIdx]?.alias || ''}
                                  onChange={e => updateColumnConfig(selIdx, 'alias', e.target.value)}
                                  className="vqb-input-xs"
                                  title="Output alias"
                                />
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 3. JOINs ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="joins"
            icon={Link2}
            label="Joins"
            count={joins.length}
            action={baseTable ? addJoin : null}
            actionIcon={Plus}
            actionLabel="Add JOIN"
          />
          {expandedSections.joins && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {joins.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  {baseTable ? (
                    <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={addJoin}><Plus size={12} /> Add a JOIN</button>
                  ) : 'Select a base table first'}
                </div>
              ) : (
                joins.map((j, idx) => (
                  <div key={j.id} className="vqb-join-card">
                    <div className="vqb-join-header">
                      <select value={j.type} onChange={e => updateJoin(idx, 'type', e.target.value)} className="vqb-select-sm">
                        {JOIN_TYPES.map(jt => <option key={jt} value={jt}>{jt} JOIN</option>)}
                      </select>
                      <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeJoin(idx)} title="Remove JOIN">
                        <Trash2 size={12} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="vqb-join-body">
                      <div className="vqb-join-row">
                        <label>Table:</label>
                        <select
                          value={j.table ? `${j.database || ''}::${j.schema || 'public'}.${j.table}` : ''}
                          onChange={e => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            if (!val) { updateJoin(idx, 'table', ''); return; }
                            const [dbPart, rest] = val.split('::');
                            const [sch, ...tParts] = rest.split('.');
                            const tName = tParts.join('.');
                            const matchedTable = tables.find(t => t.name === tName && (t.schema || 'public') === sch && (t.database || '') === dbPart);
                            updateJoin(idx, 'table', tName);
                            updateJoin(idx, 'schema', sch);
                            updateJoin(idx, 'database', matchedTable?.database || dbPart);
                            updateJoin(idx, 'dbType', matchedTable?.dbType || '');
                          }}
                          className="vqb-select-sm"
                        >
                          <option value="">Select table...</option>
                          {tables.filter(t => t.name !== baseTable || (t.schema || 'public') !== baseSchema || (t.database || '') !== baseDatabase).map(t => (
                            <option key={`${t.database}.${t.schema}.${t.name}`} value={`${t.database || ''}::${t.schema || 'public'}.${t.name}`}>
                              {t.name}{t.schema && t.schema !== 'public' ? ` (${t.schema})` : ''}{isMultiDb && t.database ? ` [${t.database}]` : ''}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </div>
                      <div className="vqb-join-row">
                        <label>Alias:</label>
                        <input
                          placeholder="e.g. j1"
                          value={j.alias}
                          onChange={e => updateJoin(idx, 'alias', e.target.value)}
                          className="vqb-input-sm"
                        />
                      </div>
                      {j.type !== 'CROSS' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="vqb-join-row">
                            <label>Source ({baseAlias || baseTable}):</label>
                            <select value={j.sourceCol} onChange={e => updateJoin(idx, 'sourceCol', e.target.value)} className="vqb-select-sm">
                              <option value="">Select column...</option>
                              {getTableColumns(baseTable, baseSchema).map(c => (
                                <option key={c.column_name || c.name} value={c.column_name || c.name}>
                                  {c.column_name || c.name} ({c.data_type || c.type || ''})
                                </option>
                              ))}
                            </select>
                          </div>
                          <div className="vqb-join-on-icon"><ArrowRight size={14} /></div>
                          <div className="vqb-join-row">
                            <label>Target ({j.alias || j.table || '?'}):</label>
                            <select value={j.targetCol} onChange={e => updateJoin(idx, 'targetCol', e.target.value)} className="vqb-select-sm">
                              <option value="">Select column...</option>
                              {j.table && getTableColumns(j.table, j.schema || 'public').map(c => (
                                <option key={c.column_name || c.name} value={c.column_name || c.name}>
                                  {c.column_name || c.name} ({c.data_type || c.type || ''})
                                </option>
                              ))}
                            </select>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 4. WHERE Conditions ────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="where"
            icon={Filter}
            label="Where"
            count={conditions.length}
            action={baseTable ? addCondition : null}
            actionIcon={Plus}
            actionLabel="Add condition"
          />
          {expandedSections.where && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {conditions.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  {baseTable ? (
                    <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={addCondition}><Plus size={12} /> Add a condition</button>
                  ) : 'Select a base table first'}
                </div>
              ) : (
                conditions.map((cond, idx) => (
                  <div key={cond.id} className="vqb-condition-card">
                    {idx > 0 && (
                      <select
                        value={cond.connector}
                        onChange={e => updateCondition(idx, 'connector', e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-connector-select"
                      >
                        <option value="AND">AND</option>
                        <option value="OR">OR</option>
                      </select>
                    )}
                    <div className="vqb-condition-body">
                      {cond.operator !== 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY' && (
                        <select
                          value={cond.column}
                          onChange={e => updateCondition(idx, 'column', e.target.value)}
                          className="vqb-select-sm vqb-col-select"
                        >
                          <option value="">Column...</option>
                          {columnDropdownOptions.map(o => (
                            <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      )}
                      <select
                        value={cond.operator}
                        onChange={e => updateCondition(idx, 'operator', e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-select-sm vqb-op-select"
                      >
                        {OPERATORS.map(o => <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>)}
                      </select>
                      {!['IS NULL','IS NOT NULL','IN_SUBQUERY','NOT_IN_SUBQUERY','EXISTS_SUBQUERY'].includes(cond.operator) && (
                        <input
                          value={cond.value}
                          onChange={e => updateCondition(idx, 'value', e.target.value)}
                          placeholder={cond.operator === 'IN' || cond.operator === 'NOT IN' ? 'val1, val2' : cond.operator === 'BETWEEN' ? 'min, max' : 'Value'}
                          className="vqb-input-sm vqb-val-input"
                        />
                      )}
                      <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeCondition(idx)} title="Remove">
                        <Trash2 size={12} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    {['IN_SUBQUERY','NOT_IN_SUBQUERY','EXISTS_SUBQUERY'].includes(cond.operator) && (
                      <div className="vqb-subquery-builder" style={{
                        marginTop: 6, padding: '8px 10px', background: 'rgba(99,102,241,0.06)',
                        borderRadius: 6, border: '1px dashed rgba(99,102,241,0.3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 5,
                      }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#6366f1', marginBottom: 2 }}>
                          ▸ Subquery: SELECT {cond.operator === 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY' ? '1' : (cond.subquery?.column || '*')} FROM ...
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                          <select
                            value={cond.subquery?.table ? `${cond.subquery.schema || 'public'}.${cond.subquery.table}` : ''}
                            onChange={e => {
                              const val = e.target.value;
                              if (!val) { updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'table', ''); return; }
                              const [sch, ...rest] = val.split('.');
                              const tName = rest.join('.');
                              updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'table', tName);
                              updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'schema', sch);
                              // Fetch columns for the subquery table — find its source DB
                              const matchedSqTable = tables.find(t => t.name === tName && (t.schema || 'public') === sch);
                              fetchColumns(tName, sch, matchedSqTable?.database, matchedSqTable?.dbType);
                            }}
                            className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 130 }}
                          >
                            <option value="">Subquery table...</option>
                            {tables.map(t => (
                              <option key={`sq-${t.database}.${t.schema}.${t.name}`} value={`${t.schema || 'public'}.${t.name}`}>
                                {t.name}{t.schema && t.schema !== 'public' ? ` (${t.schema})` : ''}{isMultiDb && t.database ? ` [${t.database}]` : ''}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          {cond.operator !== 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY' && (
                            <select
                              value={cond.subquery?.column || ''}
                              onChange={e => updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'column', e.target.value)}
                              className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 110 }}
                            >
                              <option value="">SELECT column...</option>
                              {cond.subquery?.table && getTableColumns(cond.subquery.table, cond.subquery.schema || 'public').map(c => (
                                <option key={c.column_name || c.name} value={c.column_name || c.name}>
                                  {c.column_name || c.name}
                                </option>
                              ))}
                            </select>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>
                          <span style={{ color: '#888' }}>WHERE (optional):</span>
                          <select
                            value={cond.subquery?.where_col || ''}
                            onChange={e => updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'where_col', e.target.value)}
                            className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}
                          >
                            <option value="">Column...</option>
                            {cond.subquery?.table && getTableColumns(cond.subquery.table, cond.subquery.schema || 'public').map(c => (
                              <option key={c.column_name || c.name} value={c.column_name || c.name}>
                                {c.column_name || c.name}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          <select
                            value={cond.subquery?.where_op || '='}
                            onChange={e => updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'where_op', e.target.value)}
                            className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ width: 60 }}
                          >
                            {['=','!=','>','<','>=','<=','LIKE','IS NULL','IS NOT NULL'].map(o => (
                              <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          {!['IS NULL','IS NOT NULL'].includes(cond.subquery?.where_op) && (
                            <input
                              value={cond.subquery?.where_val || ''}
                              onChange={e => updateConditionSubquery(idx, 'where_val', e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="Value..."
                              className="vqb-input-sm" style={{ width: 80 }}
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 5. GROUP BY ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader section="groupBy" icon={Group} label="Group By" count={groupByColumns.length} />
          {expandedSections.groupBy && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {!baseTable ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">Select a base table first</div>
              ) : (
                <div className="vqb-groupby-list">
                  {allAvailableColumns
                    .filter(c => !columnSearch || c.column.toLowerCase().includes(columnSearch.toLowerCase()))
                    .map((col, i) => (
                      <label key={`gb-${col.table}.${col.column}.${i}`} className="vqb-groupby-item">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isGroupBySelected(col)}
                          onChange={() => toggleGroupBy(col)}
                        />
                        <span>{joins.length > 0 ? `${col.alias || col.table}.` : ''}{col.column}</span>
                      </label>
                    ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 5b. HAVING ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="having"
            icon={Layers}
            label="Having"
            count={havingConditions.length}
            action={baseTable && groupByColumns.length > 0 ? addHavingCondition : null}
            actionIcon={Plus}
            actionLabel="Add having"
          />
          {expandedSections.having && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {groupByColumns.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">Add GROUP BY columns first to use HAVING</div>
              ) : havingConditions.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={addHavingCondition}><Plus size={12} /> Add having condition</button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                havingConditions.map((h, idx) => (
                  <div key={h.id} className="vqb-condition-row">
                    {idx > 0 && (
                      <select
                        value={h.connector}
                        onChange={e => updateHavingCondition(h.id, 'connector', e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-select-sm"
                        style={{ width: 70 }}
                      >
                        <option value="AND">AND</option>
                        <option value="OR">OR</option>
                      </select>
                    )}
                    <select
                      value={h.agg}
                      onChange={e => updateHavingCondition(h.id, 'agg', e.target.value)}
                      className="vqb-select-sm"
                      style={{ width: 90 }}
                    >
                      {AGG_FUNCTIONS.filter(a => a).map(a => <option key={a} value={a}>{a}</option>)}
                    </select>
                    <select
                      value={h.column}
                      onChange={e => updateHavingCondition(h.id, 'column', e.target.value)}
                      className="vqb-select-sm"
                      style={{ flex: 1 }}
                    >
                      <option value="*">*</option>
                      {columnDropdownOptions.map(opt => (
                        <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                    <select
                      value={h.operator}
                      onChange={e => updateHavingCondition(h.id, 'operator', e.target.value)}
                      className="vqb-select-sm"
                      style={{ width: 70 }}
                    >
                      {OPERATORS.filter(op => !['LIKE','NOT LIKE','ILIKE','IN','NOT IN','BETWEEN'].includes(op.value)).map(op => (
                        <option key={op.value} value={op.value}>{op.value}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                    {!['IS NULL','IS NOT NULL'].includes(h.operator) && (
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={h.value}
                        onChange={e => updateHavingCondition(h.id, 'value', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Value..."
                        className="vqb-input-sm"
                        style={{ width: 80 }}
                      />
                    )}
                    <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeHavingCondition(h.id)}>
                      <Trash2 size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 6. ORDER BY ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="orderBy"
            icon={ArrowUpDown}
            label="Order By"
            count={orderByColumns.length}
            action={baseTable ? addOrderBy : null}
            actionIcon={Plus}
            actionLabel="Add sort"
          />
          {expandedSections.orderBy && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {orderByColumns.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  {baseTable ? (
                    <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={addOrderBy}><Plus size={12} /> Add sort column</button>
                  ) : 'Select a base table first'}
                </div>
              ) : (
                orderByColumns.map((o, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="vqb-orderby-row">
                    <select
                      value={o.column}
                      onChange={e => updateOrderBy(idx, 'column', e.target.value)}
                      className="vqb-select-sm"
                      style={{ flex: 1 }}
                    >
                      <option value="">Column...</option>
                      {columnDropdownOptions.map(opt => (
                        <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                    <select
                      value={o.direction}
                      onChange={e => updateOrderBy(idx, 'direction', e.target.value)}
                      className="vqb-select-sm"
                      style={{ width: 80 }}
                    >
                      {SORT_DIRS.map(d => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
                    </select>
                    <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeOrderBy(idx)}>
                      <Trash2 size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 7. LIMIT / OFFSET ──────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader section="limit" icon={Hash} label="Limit & Offset" />
          {expandedSections.limit && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              <div className="vqb-limit-row">
                <label>Limit:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={limitValue}
                  onChange={e => setLimitValue(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  className="vqb-input-sm"
                  min={0}
                  max={100000}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="vqb-limit-row">
                <label>Offset:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={offsetValue}
                  onChange={e => setOffsetValue(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  className="vqb-input-sm"
                  min={0}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 8. UNION / INTERSECT / EXCEPT ──────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="setOps"
            icon={Layers}
            label="Set Operations"
            count={unionBlocks.length}
            action={baseTable ? addUnionBlock : null}
            actionIcon={Plus}
            actionLabel="Add block"
          />
          {expandedSections.setOps && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {unionBlocks.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  {baseTable ? (
                    <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={addUnionBlock}><Plus size={12} /> Add UNION / INTERSECT / EXCEPT</button>
                  ) : 'Select a base table first'}
                </div>
              ) : (
                unionBlocks.map((block) => (
                  <div key={block.id} style={{
                    padding: '8px 10px', background: 'rgba(99,102,241,0.05)', borderRadius: 6,
                    border: '1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.15)', marginBottom: 6, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 5,
                  }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <select
                        value={block.operator}
                        onChange={e => updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'operator', e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ width: 130, fontWeight: 600 }}
                      >
                        <option value="UNION">UNION</option>
                        <option value="UNION ALL">UNION ALL</option>
                        <option value="INTERSECT">INTERSECT</option>
                        <option value="INTERSECT ALL">INTERSECT ALL</option>
                        <option value="EXCEPT">EXCEPT</option>
                        <option value="EXCEPT ALL">EXCEPT ALL</option>
                      </select>
                      <select
                        value={block.table ? `${block.database || ''}::${block.schema || 'public'}.${block.table}` : ''}
                        onChange={e => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          if (!val) { updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'table', ''); return; }
                          const [dbPart, rest] = val.split('::');
                          const [sch, ...tParts] = rest.split('.');
                          const tName = tParts.join('.');
                          const matchedTable = tables.find(t => t.name === tName && (t.schema || 'public') === sch && (t.database || '') === dbPart);
                          updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'table', tName);
                          updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'schema', sch);
                          updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'database', matchedTable?.database || dbPart);
                          updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'dbType', matchedTable?.dbType || '');
                          fetchColumns(tName, sch, matchedTable?.database, matchedTable?.dbType);
                        }}
                        className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ flex: 1 }}
                      >
                        <option value="">Table...</option>
                        {tables.map(t => (
                          <option key={`u-${t.database}.${t.schema}.${t.name}`} value={`${t.database || ''}::${t.schema || 'public'}.${t.name}`}>
                            {t.name}{t.schema && t.schema !== 'public' ? ` (${t.schema})` : ''}{isMultiDb && t.database ? ` [${t.database}]` : ''}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeUnionBlock(block.id)}>
                        <Trash2 size={12} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#888', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>SELECT:</span>
                      <input
                        value={block.columns}
                        onChange={e => updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'columns', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="* or col1, col2, col3"
                        className="vqb-input-sm" style={{ flex: 1 }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#888', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>WHERE:</span>
                      <select
                        value={block.where_col}
                        onChange={e => updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'where_col', e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 90 }}
                      >
                        <option value="">(none)</option>
                        {block.table && getTableColumns(block.table, block.schema || 'public').map(c => (
                          <option key={c.column_name || c.name} value={c.column_name || c.name}>
                            {c.column_name || c.name}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      <select
                        value={block.where_op}
                        onChange={e => updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'where_op', e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-select-sm" style={{ width: 55 }}
                      >
                        {['=','!=','>','<','>=','<=','LIKE'].map(o => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}
                      </select>
                      <input
                        value={block.where_val}
                        onChange={e => updateUnionBlock(block.id, 'where_val', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Value..."
                        className="vqb-input-sm" style={{ width: 70 }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Right Panel: SQL Preview + Results ────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vqb-panel vqb-preview">
        <div className="vqb-preview-header">
          <div className="vqb-preview-title">
            <Code2 size={15} />
            <span>Generated SQL</span>
          </div>
          <div className="vqb-preview-actions">
            <button className="vqb-btn-sm" onClick={handleCopySQL} title="Copy SQL">
              <Copy size={13} /> Copy
            </button>
            <button
              className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-run"
              onClick={handleRunQuery}
              disabled={!baseTable || isRunning}
              title="Run query and show results here"
            >
              {isRunning ? <Loader size={13} className="vqb-spin" /> : <Play size={13} />}
              {isRunning ? 'Running...' : 'Run Query'}
            </button>
            <button
              className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-primary"
              onClick={handleUseQuery}
              disabled={!baseTable}
              title="Send to Query Editor"
            >
              <ArrowRight size={13} /> Use Query
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="vqb-preview-body">
          <pre className="vqb-sql-preview">{generatedSQL}</pre>
        </div>
        {baseTable && (
          <div className="vqb-preview-footer">
            <span className="vqb-preview-info">
              <Database size={12} /> {baseDatabase || db}
              {isMultiDb && <> + {dataSources.length - 1} source{dataSources.length - 1 !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</>}
              {' · '}<Table2 size={12} /> {baseTable}
              {joins.length > 0 && <> + {joins.length} join{joins.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</>}
              {selectedColumns.length > 0 && <> · {selectedColumns.length} col{selectedColumns.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</>}
              {conditions.length > 0 && <> · {conditions.length} filter{conditions.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</>}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── Query Results Panel ──────────────────────────────────── */}
        {(queryResults || queryError || isRunning) && (
          <div className="vqb-results-panel">
            <div className="vqb-results-header">
              <div className="vqb-results-title">
                <Table2 size={14} />
                <span>Results</span>
                {queryResults && (
                  <span className="vqb-results-meta">
                    {queryResults.row_count} row{queryResults.row_count !== 1 ? 's' : ''} · {queryResults.execution_time_ms}ms
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="vqb-results-actions">
                {queryResults?.data?.length > 0 && (
                  <button className="vqb-btn-sm" onClick={handleDownloadCSV} title="Download CSV">
                    <Download size={13} /> CSV
                  </button>
                )}
                <button className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost" onClick={() => { setQueryResults(null); setQueryError(''); }} title="Close results">
                  <X size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {isRunning && (
              <div className="vqb-results-loading">
                <Loader size={20} className="vqb-spin" />
                <span>Executing query...</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {queryError && (
              <div className="vqb-results-error">
                <AlertCircle size={14} />
                <span>{queryError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {queryResults?.data && queryResults.data.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <div className="vqb-results-table-wrap">
                  <table className="vqb-results-table">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th className="vqb-row-num">#</th>
                        {queryResults.columns.map(col => <th key={col}>{col}</th>)}
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {queryResults.data
                        .slice(resultsPage * RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE, (resultsPage + 1) * RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE)
                        .map((row, rIdx) => (
                          <tr key={rIdx}>
                            <td className="vqb-row-num">{resultsPage * RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE + rIdx + 1}</td>
                            {queryResults.columns.map(col => (
                              <td key={col} title={row[col] === null ? 'NULL' : String(row[col])}>
                                {row[col] === null ? <span className="vqb-null">NULL</span> : String(row[col])}
                              </td>
                            ))}
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
                {queryResults.data.length > RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE && (
                  <div className="vqb-results-pagination">
                    <button
                      className="vqb-btn-sm"
                      disabled={resultsPage === 0}
                      onClick={() => setResultsPage(0)}
                      title="First page"
                    >
                      <ChevronsLeft size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="vqb-btn-sm"
                      disabled={resultsPage === 0}
                      onClick={() => setResultsPage(p => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
                      title="Previous page"
                    >
                      <ChevronLeft size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <span className="vqb-page-info">
                      Page {resultsPage + 1} of {Math.ceil(queryResults.data.length / RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE)}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      className="vqb-btn-sm"
                      disabled={(resultsPage + 1) * RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE >= queryResults.data.length}
                      onClick={() => setResultsPage(p => p + 1)}
                      title="Next page"
                    >
                      <ChevronRight size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="vqb-btn-sm"
                      disabled={(resultsPage + 1) * RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE >= queryResults.data.length}
                      onClick={() => setResultsPage(Math.ceil(queryResults.data.length / RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE) - 1)}
                      title="Last page"
                    >
                      <ChevronsRight size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}

            {queryResults?.data && queryResults.data.length === 0 && !queryError && (
              <div className="vqb-results-empty">
                <Check size={14} />
                <span>Query executed successfully — 0 rows returned</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── Add Data Source Modal ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showAddSource && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
          background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', zIndex: 9999,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        }} onClick={() => setShowAddSource(false)}>
          <div style={{
            background: 'var(--bg-primary, #1e1e2e)', borderRadius: 12,
            padding: 24, width: 440, maxWidth: '90vw', maxHeight: '70vh',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
            boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
            display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12,
          }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <Database size={16} /> Add Data Source
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
              {['cloudsql', 'bigquery'].map(type => (
                <button
                  key={type}
                  onClick={() => { setAddSourceType(type); loadAddSourceDbs(type); }}
                  style={{
                    flex: 1, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600,
                    border: addSourceType === type ? '2px solid #3b82f6' : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
                    background: addSourceType === type ? 'rgba(59,130,246,0.15)' : 'transparent',
                    color: addSourceType === type ? '#3b82f6' : 'inherit',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {type === 'cloudsql' ? 'CloudSQL' : 'BigQuery'}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <Search size={13} style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} />
              <input
                placeholder="Search databases..."
                value={addSourceSearch}
                onChange={e => setAddSourceSearch(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  flex: 1, padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6,
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
                  color: 'inherit', fontSize: '0.8rem',
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div style={{
              maxHeight: 280, overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3,
            }}>
              {loadingAddDbs ? (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, opacity: 0.5 }}>
                  <RefreshCw size={16} className="vqb-spin" /> Loading databases...
                </div>
              ) : filteredAddDbs.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, opacity: 0.5, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>No databases found</div>
              ) : (
                filteredAddDbs.map((d, i) => {
                  const name = getDbNameFromObj(d);
                  const alreadyAdded = dataSources.some(s => s.database === name && s.dbType === addSourceType);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={i}
                      onClick={() => !alreadyAdded && addDataSource(name)}
                      disabled={alreadyAdded}
                      style={{
                        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
                        padding: '7px 12px', borderRadius: 6, border: 'none',
                        background: alreadyAdded ? 'rgba(59,130,246,0.08)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
                        color: alreadyAdded ? '#64748b' : 'inherit',
                        cursor: alreadyAdded ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                        textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.8rem', width: '100%',
                      }}
                    >
                      <Database size={13} />
                      <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{name}</span>
                      {alreadyAdded && <Check size={13} style={{ color: '#3b82f6' }} />}
                    </button>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowAddSource(false)}>Close</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Import SQL Modal ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showImportModal && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
          background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', zIndex: 9999,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        }} onClick={() => setShowImportModal(false)}>
          <div style={{
            background: 'var(--bg-primary, #1e1e2e)', borderRadius: 12,
            padding: 24, width: 520, maxWidth: '90vw', maxHeight: '70vh',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
            boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
          }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 12px', fontSize: '1rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <Download size={16} /> Import SQL → Visual Query Builder
            </h3>
            <p style={{ margin: '0 0 12px', fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#888' }}>
              Paste a SELECT query below. The parser will extract the table, columns, JOINs, and WHERE conditions into the VQB.
            </p>
            <textarea
              value={importSQL}
              onChange={e => setImportSQL(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="SELECT col1, col2 FROM my_table WHERE ..."
              style={{
                width: '100%', height: 150, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8,
                border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', resize: 'vertical',
                background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', color: 'inherit',
                fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.82rem',
              }}
              autoFocus
            />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 12, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button
                className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost"
                onClick={() => { setShowImportModal(false); setImportSQL(''); }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-primary"
                onClick={handleImportSQL}
                disabled={importLoading || !importSQL.trim()}
              >
                {importLoading ? <><Loader size={13} className="vqb-spin" /> Parsing...</> : <><Download size={13} /> Import</>}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/TableSelector.jsx

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Table, Loader, AlertCircle, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Columns, Key } from 'lucide-react';
import { useDatabaseOperations } from '../hooks/useDatabase';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';

export const TableSelector = ({ database, onTableSelect, databaseType = 'cloudsql', searchTerm = '' }) => {
  const { fetchTables, fetchTableSchema } = useDatabaseOperations();
  const { tables, loadingTables, selectedTable, error, tableSchemas, loadingSchema } = useQueryStore();
  const [expandedTables, setExpandedTables] = React.useState(new Set());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (database) {
      fetchTables(database, databaseType, searchTerm);
    }
  }, [database, databaseType, searchTerm]);

  const toggleTableExpand = (tableName) => {
    const newExpanded = new Set(expandedTables);
    if (newExpanded.has(tableName)) {
      newExpanded.delete(tableName);
    } else {
      newExpanded.add(tableName);
      // Only fetch if not already cached
      if (!tableSchemas[tableName]) {
        fetchTableSchema(database, tableName, databaseType);
      }
    }
    setExpandedTables(newExpanded);
  };

  const handleSelectTable = (tableName) => {
    if (onTableSelect) {
      onTableSelect(tableName);
    }
  };

  // Filter tables based on search term
  const filteredTables = searchTerm
    ? tables.filter(t => t.table_name && t.table_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()))
    : tables;

  const getDataTypeBadgeColor = (dataType) => {
    const t = (dataType || '').toLowerCase();
    if (t.includes('int') || t.includes('numeric') || t.includes('decimal') || t.includes('float') || t.includes('double')) return '#34d399';
    if (t.includes('char') || t.includes('text') || t.includes('string')) return '#818cf8';
    if (t.includes('date') || t.includes('time') || t.includes('timestamp')) return '#fbbf24';
    if (t.includes('bool')) return '#f472b6';
    if (t.includes('json') || t.includes('array') || t.includes('record') || t.includes('struct')) return '#fb923c';
    return '#94a3b8';
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col">
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <Table size={20} className="text-blue-600 mr-2" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg text-gray-800">Tables</h3>
        </div>
        {database && <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">{database}</p>}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="m-4 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded flex items-start">
          <AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600 mr-2 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-sm text-red-700">{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        {!database ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">
            <p>Select a {databaseType === 'bigquery' ? 'dataset' : 'database'} first</p>
          </div>
        ) : loadingTables ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
            <Loader className="animate-spin text-blue-600" size={24} />
          </div>
        ) : filteredTables.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">
            <p>No tables found</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-1 p-4">
            {filteredTables.map((table) => (
              <div key={`${table.table_schema || table.schema}.${table.table_name}`}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => toggleTableExpand(table.table_name)}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded transition"
                  >
                    {expandedTables.has(table.table_name) ? (
                      <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-gray-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-gray-600" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleSelectTable(table.table_name)}
                    className={`flex-1 text-left p-2 rounded transition text-sm ${
                      selectedTable === table.table_name
                        ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-900'
                        : 'hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="font-medium">{table.table_name}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{table.size || 'N/A'}</div>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {expandedTables.has(table.table_name) && (
                  <div className="ml-6 mt-1 mb-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
                    {/* Header */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 border-b border-gray-200">
                      <Columns size={14} className="text-blue-600" />
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wide">Columns</span>
                      {tableSchemas[table.table_name] && (
                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-auto">{tableSchemas[table.table_name].length} cols</span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Column list */}
                    {!tableSchemas[table.table_name] && loadingSchema ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-4">
                        <Loader className="animate-spin text-blue-500" size={16} />
                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-2">Loading columns...</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : tableSchemas[table.table_name] && tableSchemas[table.table_name].length > 0 ? (
                      <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                        {tableSchemas[table.table_name].map((col) => (
                          <div
                            key={col.column_name}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-blue-50 transition text-xs"
                          >
                            {col.is_nullable === 'NO' ? (
                              <Key size={12} className="text-amber-500 flex-shrink-0" title="NOT NULL" />
                            ) : (
                              <span className="w-3 flex-shrink-0" />
                            )}
                            <span className="font-medium text-gray-800 flex-1 truncate" title={col.column_name}>
                              {col.column_name}
                            </span>
                            <span
                              className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide"
                              style={{
                                color: getDataTypeBadgeColor(col.data_type),
                                backgroundColor: getDataTypeBadgeColor(col.data_type) + '18',
                              }}
                              title={col.data_type}
                            >
                              {col.data_type}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-gray-400 text-center">No columns found</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TableSelector;


src/components/TableSchema.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { Code2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';

export const TableSchema = ({ database, table }) => {
  const { tableSchema, loadingSchema } = useQueryStore();

  if (!database || !table) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-4 text-center text-gray-500">
        <p>Select a table to view its schema</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loadingSchema) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-4 text-center">
        <p className="text-gray-500">Loading schema...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!tableSchema || tableSchema.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-4 text-center text-gray-500">
        <p>No schema information available</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded overflow-hidden">
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Code2 size={20} className="text-blue-600" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">
            {table} <span className="text-gray-500 font-normal text-sm">Schema</span>
          </h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead className="bg-gray-100 border-b border-gray-300">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-gray-700">Column Name</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-gray-700">Data Type</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-gray-700">Nullable</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-gray-700">Default</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {tableSchema.map((col, idx) => (
              <tr key={idx} className="border-b border-gray-200 hover:bg-blue-50 transition">
                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-gray-900">{col.column_name}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-700">
                  <span className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium">
                    {col.data_type}
                    {col.character_maximum_length && ` (${col.character_maximum_length})`}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                      col.is_nullable === 'YES'
                        ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800'
                        : 'bg-green-100 text-green-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {col.is_nullable === 'YES' ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-600 font-mono text-xs">
                  {col.column_default || '-'}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TableSchema;

// ── Step type definitions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const STEP_TYPES = [
