// ── Generate a short step id ──────────────────────────────────────────
function genId() {
  return 's' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6);
}

// ── Step type picker modal ────────────────────────────────────────────
function StepTypePicker({ onSelect, onClose }) {
  return (
    <div className="lfb-step-picker-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="lfb-step-picker" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="lfb-step-picker-title">
          Choose Step Type
          <button className="lfb-icon-btn" onClick={onClose} type="button">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-step-picker-grid">
          {STEP_TYPES.map(({ type, label, description, Icon, iconColor }) => (
            <button
              key={type}
              className="lfb-step-type-option"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                onSelect(type);
                onClose();
              }}
            >
              <div className="lfb-step-type-option-icon">
                <Icon size={18} color={iconColor} />
              </div>
              <div className="lfb-step-type-option-text">
                <strong>{label}</strong>
                <span>{description}</span>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── AddStepButton ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AddStepButton({ onAddStep }) {
  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);

  function handleSelect(type) {
    onAddStep(type);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button
        className="lfb-add-step-btn"
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setPickerOpen(true)}
      >
        <Plus size={13} />
        Add Step
      </button>

      {pickerOpen && (
        <StepTypePicker
          onSelect={handleSelect}
          onClose={() => setPickerOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

// ── StepSequencer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props:
//   steps    – array of step objects
//   onChange – fn(newSteps)
//   depth    – nesting depth (default 0)
export default function StepSequencer({ steps = [], onChange, depth = 0 }) {
  function addStep(type, insertAfterIndex = steps.length - 1) {
    const meta = STEP_TYPES.find((t) => t.type === type);
    if (!meta) return;

    const newStep = {
      id: genId(),
      type,
      name: meta.label,
      config: { ...meta.defaultConfig },
      on_error: 'stop',
    };

    const next = [...steps];
    next.splice(insertAfterIndex + 1, 0, newStep);
    onChange(next);
  }

  function updateStep(index, updated) {
    onChange(steps.map((s, i) => (i === index ? updated : s)));
  }

  function deleteStep(index) {
    onChange(steps.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  function moveStep(index, direction) {
    const target = index + direction;
    if (target < 0 || target >= steps.length) return;
    const next = [...steps];
    [next[index], next[target]] = [next[target], next[index]];
    onChange(next);
  }

  if (steps.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="lfb-sequencer" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <div className="lfb-empty-state">
          <Plus size={32} />
          <h3>No steps yet</h3>
          <p>Click the button below to add your first step.</p>
        </div>
        <AddStepButton onAddStep={(type) => addStep(type, -1)} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="lfb-sequencer">
      {/* Add step before the first */}
      <AddStepButton onAddStep={(type) => addStep(type, -1)} />

      {steps.map((step, index) => (
        <React.Fragment key={step.id || index}>
          <StepCard
            step={step}
            onChange={(updated) => updateStep(index, updated)}
            onDelete={() => deleteStep(index)}
            onMoveUp={() => moveStep(index, -1)}
            onMoveDown={() => moveStep(index, 1)}
            isFirst={index === 0}
            isLast={index === steps.length - 1}
            depth={depth}
          />

          {/* Add step after each card */}
          <AddStepButton onAddStep={(type) => addStep(type, index)} />
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}




src/components/StepCard.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  GripVertical, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, ChevronUp, Trash2,
  Database, GitBranch, Shuffle, RefreshCw, Globe, Variable,
  ArrowRight, AlertTriangle, Merge,
} from 'lucide-react';

import SQLQueryStep    from './steps/SQLQueryStep';
import ConditionStep   from './steps/ConditionStep';
import TransformStep   from './steps/TransformStep';
import LoopStep        from './steps/LoopStep';
import HTTPCallStep    from './steps/HTTPCallStep';
import SetVariableStep from './steps/SetVariableStep';
import ReturnStep      from './steps/ReturnStep';
import ErrorHandlerStep from './steps/ErrorHandlerStep';
import MergeStep       from './steps/MergeStep';

// ── Step type metadata ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STEP_META = {
  sql_query:     { label: 'SQL Query',         Icon: Database,      component: SQLQueryStep },
  condition:     { label: 'Condition',          Icon: GitBranch,     component: ConditionStep },
  transform:     { label: 'Transform',          Icon: Shuffle,       component: TransformStep },
  loop:          { label: 'Loop',               Icon: RefreshCw,     component: LoopStep },
  http_call:     { label: 'HTTP Call',          Icon: Globe,         component: HTTPCallStep },
  set_variable:  { label: 'Set Variable',       Icon: Variable,      component: SetVariableStep },
  return:        { label: 'Return',             Icon: ArrowRight,    component: ReturnStep },
  error_handler: { label: 'Error Handler',      Icon: AlertTriangle, component: ErrorHandlerStep },
  merge:         { label: 'Merge',              Icon: Merge,         component: MergeStep },
};

// ── StepCard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props:
//   step        – step object { id, type, name, config, on_error, ... }
//   onChange    – fn(updatedStep)
//   onDelete    – fn()
//   onMoveUp    – fn()
//   onMoveDown  – fn()
//   isFirst     – bool
//   isLast      – bool
//   depth       – nesting depth (0 = top)
export default function StepCard({
  step,
  onChange,
  onDelete,
  onMoveUp,
  onMoveDown,
  isFirst = false,
  isLast = false,
  depth = 0,
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  const meta = STEP_META[step.type] || { label: step.type, Icon: Database, component: null };
  const { Icon, component: ConfigComponent } = meta;

  function handleNameChange(e) {
    onChange({ ...step, name: e.target.value });
  }

  function handleConfigChange(newConfig) {
    onChange({ ...step, config: newConfig });
  }

  function handleOnErrorChange(e) {
    onChange({ ...step, on_error: e.target.value });
  }

  function stopPropagation(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
  }

  return (
    <div className={`lfb-step-card type-${step.type}`}>
      {/* ── Header ── */}
      <div
        className="lfb-step-header"
        onClick={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}
      >
        {/* Drag handle */}
        <span className="lfb-drag-handle" title="Drag to reorder">
          <GripVertical size={14} />
        </span>

        {/* Type badge */}
        <span className={`lfb-step-type-badge type-${step.type}`}>
          <Icon size={10} />
          {meta.label}
        </span>

        {/* Step name (editable inline) */}
        <input
          className="lfb-step-name-input"
          value={step.name || ''}
          onChange={handleNameChange}
          onClick={stopPropagation}
          placeholder={meta.label}
          maxLength={80}
        />

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="lfb-step-header-actions" onClick={stopPropagation}>
          <button
            className="lfb-icon-btn"
            title="Move up"
            disabled={isFirst}
            onClick={onMoveUp}
            type="button"
          >
            <ChevronUp size={13} />
          </button>
          <button
            className="lfb-icon-btn"
            title="Move down"
            disabled={isLast}
            onClick={onMoveDown}
            type="button"
          >
            <ChevronDown size={13} />
          </button>
          <button
            className="lfb-icon-btn danger"
            title="Delete step"
            onClick={onDelete}
            type="button"
          >
            <Trash2 size={12} />
          </button>
          <button
            className="lfb-icon-btn"
            title={expanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}
            onClick={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}
            type="button"
          >
            {expanded ? <ChevronDown size={13} /> : <ChevronRight size={13} />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Config body ── */}
      {expanded && ConfigComponent && (
        <div className="lfb-step-body">
          <ConfigComponent
            config={step.config || {}}
            onChange={handleConfigChange}
            depth={depth}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Footer: on_error selector ── */}
      {expanded && (
        <div className="lfb-step-footer">
          <span className="lfb-on-error-label">On error:</span>
          <select
            className="lfb-on-error-select"
            value={step.on_error || 'stop'}
            onChange={handleOnErrorChange}
          >
            <option value="stop">Stop flow</option>
            <option value="continue">Continue</option>
            <option value="retry">Retry (1x)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}





src/components/Sidebar.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Database, Code2, BarChart3, Server, Plus, ChevronDown,
  Wifi, WifiOff, RefreshCw, Loader, Settings, Trash2, X, PlusCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import DatabaseTypeSelector from './DatabaseTypeSelector';
import DatabaseSelector from './DatabaseSelector';
import TableSelector from './TableSelector';
import TableSchema from './TableSchema';
import QueryHistory from './QueryHistory';
import SavedQueries from './SavedQueries';
import ServerManager from './ServerManager';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './ServerManager.css';

export const Sidebar = ({ onQueryInsert, onDatabaseSelect, onTableSelect }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('database');
  const {
    databaseType, selectedDatabase, setSelectedDatabase,
    databaseSearch, setDatabaseSearch,
    tableSearch, setTableSearch,
    selectedServer, setSelectedServer,
    servers, setServers, setLoadingServers,
    updateServerInList,
  } = useQueryStore();

  const [showServerManager, setShowServerManager] = useState(false);
  const [serverManagerMode, setServerManagerMode] = useState('add'); // 'add' | 'edit'
  const [editingServer, setEditingServer] = useState(null);

  // Server-specific browsing state
  const [serverDbSearch, setServerDbSearch] = useState('');
  const [serverTableSearch, setServerTableSearch] = useState('');
  const [serverDatabases, setServerDatabases] = useState([]);
  const [loadingServerDbs, setLoadingServerDbs] = useState(false);
  const [serverSelectedDb, setServerSelectedDb] = useState(null);
  const [serverTables, setServerTables] = useState([]);
  const [loadingServerTables, setLoadingServerTables] = useState(false);
  const [serverTableSchemas, setServerTableSchemas] = useState({});
  const [loadingServerSchema, setLoadingServerSchema] = useState(false);
  const [expandedServerTables, setExpandedServerTables] = useState(new Set());
  const [reconnecting, setReconnecting] = useState(null);

  // Create Database modal state
  const [showCreateDb, setShowCreateDb] = useState(false);
  const [newDbName, setNewDbName] = useState('');
  const [creatingDb, setCreatingDb] = useState(false);
  const [dbRefreshKey, setDbRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  // Fetch servers on mount
  useEffect(() => { fetchServers(); }, []);

  const fetchServers = async () => {
    setLoadingServers(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServers();
      setServers(res.data.servers || []);
    } catch (err) { /* silent */ }
    finally { setLoadingServers(false); }
  };

  // When a custom server is selected, auto-connect and load its databases
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedServer && !selectedServer.is_default) {
      handleAutoConnect(selectedServer);
    }
  }, [selectedServer?.id]);

  const handleAutoConnect = async (srv) => {
    setServerSelectedDb(null);
    setServerTables([]);
    setServerTableSchemas({});
    setExpandedServerTables(new Set());

    // Try to reconnect / test connection first, then load databases
    setReconnecting(srv.id);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.reconnectServer(srv.id);
      if (res.data.success) {
        updateServerInList(srv.id, { connected: true });
        // Now load databases
        fetchServerDatabases(srv.id);
      } else {
        updateServerInList(srv.id, { connected: false });
        toast.error(`Cannot connect to ${srv.name}: ${res.data.message}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      updateServerInList(srv.id, { connected: false });
      toast.error(`Connection failed for ${srv.name}`);
    } finally {
      setReconnecting(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReconnect = async (srv, e) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    setReconnecting(srv.id);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.reconnectServer(srv.id);
      if (res.data.success) {
        updateServerInList(srv.id, { connected: true });
        toast.success(`Reconnected to ${srv.name}`);
        if (selectedServer?.id === srv.id) {
          fetchServerDatabases(srv.id);
        }
      } else {
        updateServerInList(srv.id, { connected: false });
        toast.error(res.data.message || 'Reconnect failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      updateServerInList(srv.id, { connected: false });
      toast.error('Reconnect failed');
    } finally {
      setReconnecting(null);
    }
  };

  const fetchServerDatabases = async (serverId, search = '') => {
    const sid = serverId || selectedServer?.id;
    if (!sid) return;
    setLoadingServerDbs(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServerDatabases(sid, search);
      setServerDatabases(res.data.databases || []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load databases');
      setServerDatabases([]);
    } finally { setLoadingServerDbs(false); }
  };

  const fetchServerTables = async (database, search = '') => {
    if (!selectedServer) return;
    setLoadingServerTables(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServerTables(selectedServer.id, database, search);
      setServerTables(res.data.tables || []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load tables');
      setServerTables([]);
    } finally { setLoadingServerTables(false); }
  };

  const fetchServerTableSchema = async (database, tableName) => {
    if (!selectedServer) return;
    setLoadingServerSchema(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getServerTableSchema(selectedServer.id, database, tableName);
      setServerTableSchemas(prev => ({ ...prev, [tableName]: res.data.columns }));
    } catch (err) { toast.error('Failed to load schema'); }
    finally { setLoadingServerSchema(false); }
  };

  // ── Create Database Handler ──────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCreateDatabase = async () => {
    const name = newDbName.trim();
    if (!name) { toast.error('Please enter a database name'); return; }
    setCreatingDb(true);
    try {
      if (isCustomServer) {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.createServerDatabase(selectedServer.id, name);
        if (res.data.success) {
          toast.success(res.data.message || `Database '${name}' created`);
          fetchServerDatabases(selectedServer.id);
        } else {
          toast.error(res.data.message || 'Failed to create database');
        }
      } else {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.createDatabase(name, databaseType);
        if (res.data.success) {
          toast.success(res.data.message || `Database '${name}' created`);
          // Force DatabaseSelector to re-fetch
          setDbRefreshKey(k => k + 1);
        } else {
          toast.error(res.data.message || 'Failed to create database');
        }
      }
      setNewDbName('');
      setShowCreateDb(false);
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Failed to create database';
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setCreatingDb(false);
    }
  };

  const handleServerClick = (srv) => {
    if (selectedServer?.id === srv.id) return; // already selected
    setSelectedServer(srv);
  };

  const handleServerDbSelect = (dbName) => {
    setServerSelectedDb(dbName);
    setSelectedDatabase(dbName);
    onDatabaseSelect(dbName);
    fetchServerTables(dbName);
    setExpandedServerTables(new Set());
  };

  const handleServerTableSelect = (tableName) => { onTableSelect(tableName); };

  const toggleServerTableExpand = (tableName) => {
    const next = new Set(expandedServerTables);
    if (next.has(tableName)) { next.delete(tableName); }
    else {
      next.add(tableName);
      if (!serverTableSchemas[tableName] && serverSelectedDb) {
        fetchServerTableSchema(serverSelectedDb, tableName);
      }
    }
    setExpandedServerTables(next);
  };

  const handleDatabaseSelect = (database) => {
    setSelectedDatabase(database);
    onDatabaseSelect(database);
  };

  const handleBackToDefault = () => {
    const defaultSrv = servers.find(s => s.is_default);
    if (defaultSrv) setSelectedServer(defaultSrv);
    else setSelectedServer(null);
    setServerSelectedDb(null);
    setServerDatabases([]);
    setServerTables([]);
    setServerTableSchemas({});
  };

  const openAddServer = () => {
    setServerManagerMode('add');
    setEditingServer(null);
    setShowServerManager(true);
  };

  const openEditServer = (srv, e) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    setServerManagerMode('edit');
    setEditingServer(srv);
    setShowServerManager(true);
  };

  const isCustomServer = selectedServer && !selectedServer.is_default;

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'database', label: 'Database', icon: Database },
    { id: 'schema', label: 'Schema', icon: Code2 },
    { id: 'saved', label: 'Saved', icon: BarChart3 },
  ];

  const filteredServerDbs = serverDbSearch
    ? serverDatabases.filter(d => d.name.toLowerCase().includes(serverDbSearch.toLowerCase()))
    : serverDatabases;

  const filteredServerTables = serverTableSearch
    ? serverTables.filter(t => t.table_name.toLowerCase().includes(serverTableSearch.toLowerCase()))
    : serverTables;

  const getDataTypeBadgeColor = (dataType) => {
    const t = (dataType || '').toLowerCase();
    if (t.includes('int') || t.includes('numeric') || t.includes('decimal') || t.includes('float') || t.includes('double')) return '#34d399';
    if (t.includes('char') || t.includes('text') || t.includes('string')) return '#818cf8';
    if (t.includes('date') || t.includes('time') || t.includes('timestamp')) return '#fbbf24';
    if (t.includes('bool')) return '#f472b6';
    if (t.includes('json') || t.includes('array') || t.includes('record') || t.includes('struct')) return '#fb923c';
    return '#94a3b8';
  };

  /* ── Create Database Modal ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderCreateDbModal = () => {
    if (!showCreateDb) return null;
    const label = isCustomServer
      ? `Create Database on ${selectedServer?.name || 'Server'}`
      : databaseType === 'bigquery'
      ? 'Create BigQuery Dataset'
      : 'Create Database';
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed', inset: 0, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 9999,
      }} onClick={() => { setShowCreateDb(false); setNewDbName(''); }}>
        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#fff', borderRadius: 12, padding: 24, width: 380,
            boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
          }}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>{label}</h3>
            <button onClick={() => { setShowCreateDb(false); setNewDbName(''); }}
              style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}>
              <X size={18} color="#64748b" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <input
            autoFocus
            type="text"
            placeholder={databaseType === 'bigquery' && !isCustomServer ? 'dataset_name' : 'database_name'}
            value={newDbName}
            onChange={(e) => setNewDbName(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleCreateDatabase(); }}
            style={{
              width: '100%', padding: '10px 12px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db',
              borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 14, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
              marginBottom: 8,
            }}
          />
          <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', margin: '0 0 16px 0' }}>
            Letters, digits, underscores, hyphens. Must start with a letter or underscore.
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setShowCreateDb(false); setNewDbName(''); }}
              style={{
                padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #d1d5db',
                background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 13, color: '#64748b',
              }}
            >Cancel</button>
            <button
              onClick={handleCreateDatabase}
              disabled={creatingDb || !newDbName.trim()}
              style={{
                padding: '8px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
                background: creatingDb || !newDbName.trim() ? '#93c5fd' : '#2563eb',
                color: '#fff', cursor: creatingDb ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
              }}
            >
              {creatingDb && <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin" />}
              {creatingDb ? 'Creating…' : 'Create'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderTabs = () => (
    <div className="flex border-b border-gray-300 bg-white">
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const Icon = tab.icon;
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
            className={`flex-1 px-3 py-3 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${
              activeTab === tab.id
                ? 'border-blue-600 text-blue-600 bg-blue-50'
                : 'border-transparent text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon size={16} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">{tab.label}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );

  /* ── Server Type Selector (inline tabs like DatabaseTypeSelector) ── */
  const renderServerTypeSelector = () => (
    <div className="server-type-selector">
      <div className="server-type-header">
        <label className="server-type-label">Server Type</label>
        <button className="server-add-btn" onClick={openAddServer} title="Add new server">
          <Plus size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="server-type-pills">
        {servers.map(srv => {
          const isActive = selectedServer?.id === srv.id;
          const isConnecting = reconnecting === srv.id;
          return (
            <div
              key={srv.id}
              className={`server-type-pill ${isActive ? 'active' : ''} ${!srv.connected && !isActive ? 'disconnected' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => handleServerClick(srv)}
              style={isActive ? { borderColor: srv.color, backgroundColor: srv.color } : {}}
            >
              <div
                className="server-pill-dot"
                style={{ backgroundColor: isActive ? '#fff' : srv.color }}
              />
              <span className="server-pill-name">{srv.name}</span>
              {isConnecting ? (
                <Loader size={12} className="animate-spin server-pill-status" />
              ) : srv.connected ? (
                <Wifi size={12} className="server-pill-status connected" />
              ) : (
                <WifiOff size={12} className="server-pill-status disconnected" />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Active server info bar */}
      {isCustomServer && (
        <div className="server-active-bar">
          <div className="server-active-info">
            <div className="server-active-dot" style={{ backgroundColor: selectedServer.color }} />
            <span className="server-active-name">{selectedServer.name}</span>
            <span className="server-active-host">{selectedServer.host}:{selectedServer.port}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="server-active-actions">
            {!selectedServer.connected && (
              <button
                className="server-action-btn reconnect"
                onClick={(e) => handleReconnect(selectedServer, e)}
                disabled={reconnecting === selectedServer.id}
                title="Reconnect"
              >
                {reconnecting === selectedServer.id ? (
                  <Loader size={12} className="animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <RefreshCw size={12} />
                )}
              </button>
            )}
            {!selectedServer.is_default && (
              <button
                className="server-action-btn edit"
                onClick={(e) => openEditServer(selectedServer, e)}
                title="Edit server"
              >
                <Settings size={12} />
              </button>
            )}
            {!selectedServer.is_default && (
              <button
                className="server-action-btn back"
                onClick={handleBackToDefault}
                title="Back to default"
              >
                &#x2190;
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const renderServerDatabaseBrowser = () => (
    <>
      {/* Disconnected banner with reconnect */}
      {selectedServer && !selectedServer.connected && (
        <div className="server-disconnected-banner">
          <WifiOff size={16} />
          <span>Disconnected from {selectedServer.name}</span>
          <button
            className="server-reconnect-btn"
            onClick={(e) => handleReconnect(selectedServer, e)}
            disabled={reconnecting === selectedServer.id}
          >
            {reconnecting === selectedServer.id ? (
              <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <RefreshCw size={14} />
            )}
            Reconnect
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="p-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white">
        <input
          type="text" placeholder="Search databases..."
          value={serverDbSearch}
          onChange={(e) => { setServerDbSearch(e.target.value); fetchServerDatabases(null, e.target.value); }}
          className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Database size={20} className="text-blue-600 mr-2" />
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg text-gray-800">Databases</h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-2">({filteredServerDbs.length})</span>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowCreateDb(true)}
              title="Create Database"
              className="ml-auto p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 transition"
            >
              <PlusCircle size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {loadingServerDbs ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
            <Loader size={24} className="animate-spin text-blue-600" />
          </div>
        ) : filteredServerDbs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-sm">No databases found</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2 p-4">
            {filteredServerDbs.map((db) => (
              <button
                key={db.name}
                onClick={() => handleServerDbSelect(db.name)}
                className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded transition ${
                  serverSelectedDb === db.name
                    ? 'bg-blue-100 border border-blue-400 text-blue-900'
                    : 'bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="font-medium text-sm">{db.name}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Size: {db.size || 'N/A'}</div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {serverSelectedDb && (
        <>
          <div className="p-3 border-t border-b border-gray-200 bg-white">
            <input
              type="text" placeholder="Search tables..."
              value={serverTableSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setServerTableSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="border-t border-gray-300 flex-1 overflow-auto">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200">
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <Server size={18} className="text-blue-600 mr-2" />
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-800">Tables</h3>
                <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-2">({serverSelectedDb})</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {loadingServerTables ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6">
                <Loader size={20} className="animate-spin text-blue-600" />
              </div>
            ) : filteredServerTables.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-sm">No tables found</div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-1 p-4">
                {filteredServerTables.map((table) => (
                  <div key={`${table.table_schema || 'public'}.${table.table_name}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => toggleServerTableExpand(table.table_name)}
                        className="p-1 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded transition"
                      >
                        {expandedServerTables.has(table.table_name) ? (
                          <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-gray-600" />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-block w-[18px] text-center text-gray-400">{'\u203A'}</span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleServerTableSelect(table.table_name)}
                        className="flex-1 text-left p-2 rounded transition text-sm hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700"
                      >
                        <div className="font-medium">{table.table_name}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{table.size || 'N/A'}</div>
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {expandedServerTables.has(table.table_name) && (
                      <div className="ml-6 mt-1 mb-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 border-b border-gray-200">
                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wide">Columns</span>
                          {serverTableSchemas[table.table_name] && (
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-auto">
                              {serverTableSchemas[table.table_name].length} cols
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {!serverTableSchemas[table.table_name] && loadingServerSchema ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-4">
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">Loading columns...</span>
                          </div>
                        ) : serverTableSchemas[table.table_name]?.length > 0 ? (
                          <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                            {serverTableSchemas[table.table_name].map((col) => (
                              <div
                                key={col.column_name}
                                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-blue-50 transition text-xs"
                              >
                                <span className="font-medium text-gray-800 flex-1 truncate">{col.column_name}</span>
                                <span
                                  className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide"
                                  style={{
                                    color: getDataTypeBadgeColor(col.data_type),
                                    backgroundColor: getDataTypeBadgeColor(col.data_type) + '18',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  {col.data_type}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-gray-400 text-center">No columns found</div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col bg-gray-50 border-r border-gray-300">
      {/* Server Type Selector - inline tabs */}
      {renderServerTypeSelector()}

      {isCustomServer ? (
        <>
          {renderTabs()}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
            {activeTab === 'database' && renderServerDatabaseBrowser()}
            {activeTab === 'schema' && (
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-4">
                <TableSchema database={serverSelectedDb} table={serverSelectedDb} />
              </div>
            )}
            {activeTab === 'saved' && (
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto space-y-4 p-4">
                <QueryHistory onSelectQuery={onQueryInsert} />
                <SavedQueries onSelectQuery={onQueryInsert} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <DatabaseTypeSelector />
          {renderTabs()}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
            {activeTab === 'database' && (
              <>
                <div className="p-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="text" placeholder="Search databases..."
                      value={databaseSearch}
                      onChange={(e) => setDatabaseSearch(e.target.value)}
                      className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                    />
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowCreateDb(true)}
                      title={databaseType === 'bigquery' ? 'Create Dataset' : 'Create Database'}
                      className="p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 transition flex-shrink-0"
                    >
                      <PlusCircle size={18} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
                  <DatabaseSelector
                    key={dbRefreshKey}
                    onDatabaseSelect={handleDatabaseSelect}
                    databaseType={databaseType}
                    searchTerm={databaseSearch}
                  />
                </div>
                {selectedDatabase && (
                  <>
                    <div className="p-3 border-t border-b border-gray-200 bg-white">
                      <input
                        type="text" placeholder="Search tables..."
                        value={tableSearch}
                        onChange={(e) => setTableSearch(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="border-t border-gray-300 flex-1 overflow-auto">
                      <TableSelector
                        database={selectedDatabase}
                        onTableSelect={onTableSelect}
                        databaseType={databaseType}
                        searchTerm={tableSearch}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </>
            )}
            {activeTab === 'schema' && (
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-4">
                <TableSchema database={selectedDatabase} table={selectedDatabase} />
              </div>
            )}
            {activeTab === 'saved' && (
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto space-y-4 p-4">
                <QueryHistory onSelectQuery={onQueryInsert} />
                <SavedQueries onSelectQuery={onQueryInsert} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {showServerManager && (
        <ServerManager
          mode={serverManagerMode}
          editingServer={editingServer}
          onClose={() => { setShowServerManager(false); fetchServers(); }}
        />
      )}

      {renderCreateDbModal()}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;




src/components/ServerManager.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Server, Trash2, Pencil, X, Check, AlertCircle,
  Loader, Database, Zap
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './ServerManager.css';

const SERVER_COLORS = [
  '#3b82f6', '#ef4444', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#8b5cf6',
  '#ec4899', '#06b6d4', '#f97316', '#6366f1', '#14b8a6',
];

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  name: '',
  host: '',
  port: 5432,
  username: '',
  password: '',
  database: '',
  db_type: 'cloudsql',
  color: '#3b82f6',
  ssl_mode: 'prefer',
};

function ServerManager({ onClose, mode = 'add', editingServer = null }) {
  const { servers, setServers, setLoadingServers, removeServerFromList } = useQueryStore();

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ ...EMPTY_FORM });
  const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [showDeleteConfirm, setShowDeleteConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  // Initialize form for edit mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === 'edit' && editingServer) {
      setForm({
        name: editingServer.name || '',
        host: editingServer.host || '',
        port: editingServer.port || 5432,
        username: editingServer.username || '',
        password: '', // don't show masked password
        database: editingServer.database || '',
        db_type: editingServer.db_type || 'cloudsql',
        color: editingServer.color || '#3b82f6',
        ssl_mode: editingServer.ssl_mode || 'prefer',
      });
    } else {
      setForm({ ...EMPTY_FORM });
    }
    setTestResult(null);
  }, [mode, editingServer?.id]);

  const handleFormChange = (field, value) => {
    setForm(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev, [field]: value };
      // Auto-switch port when db_type changes
      if (field === 'db_type') {
        if (value === 'mssql' && (prev.port === 5432 || !prev.port)) next.port = 1433;
        if (value === 'cloudsql' && (prev.port === 1433 || !prev.port)) next.port = 5432;
      }
      return next;
    });
    setTestResult(null);
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async () => {
    if (!form.host || !form.username) {
      toast.error('Host and Username are required');
      return;
    }
    setTesting(true);
    setTestResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.testConnectionDirect({
        name: form.name || 'Test',
        host: form.host,
        port: parseInt(form.port) || (form.db_type === 'mssql' ? 1433 : 5432),
        username: form.username,
        password: form.password,
        database: form.database || (form.db_type === 'mssql' ? 'master' : 'postgres'),
        db_type: form.db_type || 'cloudsql',
      });
      setTestResult(res.data);
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success('Connection successful!');
      } else {
        toast.error(res.data.message || 'Connection failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.detail || err.message;
      setTestResult({ success: false, message: msg });
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setTesting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.name || !form.host || !form.username) {
      toast.error('Name, Host, and Username are required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = { ...form, port: parseInt(form.port) || (form.db_type === 'mssql' ? 1433 : 5432) };
      if (mode === 'edit' && editingServer) {
        // If password is empty, don't send it (keep existing)
        if (!payload.password) {
          delete payload.password;
        }
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateServer(editingServer.id, payload);
        toast.success('Server updated');
      } else {
        await sqlEditorAPI.addServer(payload);
        toast.success('Server added successfully! Click on it in the sidebar to connect.');
      }
      if (onClose) onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to save server');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!editingServer) return;
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteServer(editingServer.id);
      removeServerFromList(editingServer.id);
      toast.success('Server deleted');
      if (onClose) onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setShowDeleteConfirm(false);
    }
  };

  const isEditMode = mode === 'edit' && editingServer;
  const title = isEditMode ? `Edit: ${editingServer.name}` : 'Add New Server';

  return (
    <div className="server-manager-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="server-manager-modal compact" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="sm-header">
          <div className="sm-header-left">
            <Server size={20} />
            <h2>{title}</h2>
          </div>
          <button className="sm-close-btn" onClick={onClose}><X size={18} /></button>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <div className="sm-form-section">
          <div className="sm-form-grid">
            <div className="sm-field sm-field-full">
              <label>Server Type *</label>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                {[
                  { value: 'cloudsql', label: 'PostgreSQL', color: '#3b82f6' },
                  { value: 'mssql', label: 'MS SQL Server', color: '#e04e2a' },
                ].map(opt => (
                  <button
                    key={opt.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleFormChange('db_type', opt.value)}
                    style={{
                      flex: 1, padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
                      cursor: 'pointer', transition: 'all 0.15s', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6,
                      border: form.db_type === opt.value ? `2px solid ${opt.color}` : '2px solid #e2e8f0',
                      background: form.db_type === opt.value ? `${opt.color}10` : '#fff',
                      color: form.db_type === opt.value ? opt.color : '#64748b',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Database size={14} /> {opt.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field">
              <label>Server Name *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. Production DB"
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(e) => handleFormChange('name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field">
              <label>Host / IP *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. 192.168.1.100"
                value={form.host}
                onChange={(e) => handleFormChange('host', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field sm-field-half">
              <label>Port</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={form.port}
                onChange={(e) => handleFormChange('port', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field sm-field-half">
              <label>Database</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={form.db_type === 'mssql' ? 'master' : 'postgres'}
                value={form.database}
                onChange={(e) => handleFormChange('database', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field">
              <label>Username *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="postgres"
                value={form.username}
                onChange={(e) => handleFormChange('username', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field">
              <label>Password {isEditMode ? '(leave blank to keep existing)' : '*'}</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={form.password}
                onChange={(e) => handleFormChange('password', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm-field sm-field-full">
              <label>Color</label>
              <div className="sm-color-picker">
                {SERVER_COLORS.map(c => (
                  <button
                    key={c}
                    className={`sm-color-dot ${form.color === c ? 'active' : ''}`}
                    style={{ backgroundColor: c }}
                    onClick={() => handleFormChange('color', c)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Test Result */}
          {testResult && (
            <div className={`sm-test-result ${testResult.success ? 'success' : 'error'}`}>
              {testResult.success ? <Check size={16} /> : <AlertCircle size={16} />}
              <span>{testResult.message}</span>
              {testResult.version && (
                <span className="sm-test-version">{testResult.version}</span>
              )}
              {testResult.latency_ms && (
                <span className="sm-test-latency">{testResult.latency_ms}ms</span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="sm-form-actions">
            {isEditMode && !editingServer.is_default && (
              showDeleteConfirm ? (
                <div className="sm-delete-confirm">
                  <span className="sm-delete-text">Delete this server?</span>
                  <button className="sm-btn sm-btn-danger sm-btn-sm" onClick={handleDelete} disabled={deleting}>
                    {deleting ? <Loader size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 size={12} />}
                    Yes, Delete
                  </button>
                  <button className="sm-btn sm-btn-ghost sm-btn-sm" onClick={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(false)}>
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <button className="sm-btn sm-btn-danger sm-btn-sm" onClick={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(true)}>
                  <Trash2 size={14} /> Delete
                </button>
              )
            )}

            <div className="sm-form-actions-right">
              <button className="sm-btn sm-btn-ghost" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button className="sm-btn sm-btn-outline" onClick={handleTestConnection} disabled={testing}>
                {testing ? <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Zap size={14} />}
                Test Connection
              </button>
              <button className="sm-btn sm-btn-primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
                {saving ? <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Check size={14} />}
                {isEditMode ? 'Update' : 'Save & Add'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ServerManager;

src/components/SearchableDropdown.jsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Search, X, Loader } from 'lucide-react';

/**
 * A searchable dropdown with dynamic filtering.
 *
 * Props:
 *  - value        : string  – current selected value
 *  - onChange      : (val) => void
 *  - options       : string[]  – all available options
 *  - placeholder   : string
 *  - label         : string (optional)
 *  - loading       : bool
 *  - disabled      : bool
 *  - onSearchChange: (term) => void  – called when user types (for server-side search)
 *  - allowFreeText : bool  – if true, lets user type a value not in the list
 */
export default function SearchableDropdown({
  value = '',
  onChange,
  options = [],
  placeholder = 'Select...',
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  onSearchChange,
  allowFreeText = false,
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  // Close on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler);
  }, []);

  // When the dropdown opens, focus the search input
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    const term = e.target.value;
    setSearch(term);
    if (allowFreeText) {
      onChange(term);
    }
    if (onSearchChange) {
      onSearchChange(term);
    }
  };

  const handleSelect = (opt) => {
    onChange(opt);
    setSearch('');
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleClear = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onChange('');
    setSearch('');
  };

  const filtered = search
    ? options.filter((o) => o.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
    : options;

  return (
    <div className="searchable-dropdown" ref={containerRef}>
      {/* Selected value / trigger */}
      <div
        className={`sd-trigger ${open ? 'sd-open' : ''} ${disabled ? 'sd-disabled' : ''}`}
        onClick={() => { if (!disabled) setOpen(!open); }}
      >
        {open ? (
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            className="sd-search-input"
            value={search || (allowFreeText ? value : '')}
            onChange={handleSearchChange}
            placeholder={value || placeholder}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          />
        ) : (
          <span className={`sd-value ${!value ? 'sd-placeholder' : ''}`}>
            {value || placeholder}
          </span>
        )}
        <div className="sd-icons">
          {value && !disabled && (
            <button className="sd-clear" onClick={handleClear} title="Clear">
              <X size={12} />
            </button>
          )}
          {loading ? (
            <Loader size={14} className="sd-spin" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronDown size={14} className={`sd-chevron ${open ? 'sd-chevron-up' : ''}`} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dropdown list */}
      {open && (
        <div className="sd-menu">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="sd-loading">
              <Loader size={14} className="sd-spin" />
              <span>Loading...</span>
            </div>
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="sd-empty">
              {search ? `No match for "${search}"` : 'No options available'}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="sd-list">
              {filtered.map((opt) => (
                <div
                  key={opt}
                  className={`sd-option ${opt === value ? 'sd-selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(opt)}
                >
                  {opt}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/SchemaExplorer.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Database, Table2, Key, RefreshCw, Search, ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Maximize2, Columns,
  ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Minimize2, Move, Eye, ArrowRight, X, Info, Link2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import './SchemaExplorer.css';

/* ── Color palette for table headers ───────────────────────────── */
const TABLE_COLORS = [
  '#3b82f6', '#8b5cf6', '#ec4899', '#f59e0b', '#10b981',
  '#06b6d4', '#6366f1', '#ef4444', '#14b8a6', '#f97316',
];

export default function SchemaExplorer() {
  const [databases, setDatabases] = useState([]);
  const [dbType, setDbType] = useState('cloudsql');
  const [selectedDb, setSelectedDb] = useState('');
  const [dbSearch, setDbSearch] = useState('');

  const [tables, setTables] = useState([]);
  const [relationships, setRelationships] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // ERD canvas state
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [pan, setPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(null); // { type: 'canvas' | 'table', id?, startX, startY, origX, origY }
  const [tablePositions, setTablePositions] = useState({});
  const [expandedTables, setExpandedTables] = useState(new Set());
  const [selectedTable, setSelectedTable] = useState(null);
  const [showSidebar, setShowSidebar] = useState(true);

  const canvasRef = useRef(null);

  // ── Load databases ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadDatabases = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases(dbType);
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setDatabases(body.databases || []);
    } catch { setDatabases([]); }
  }, [dbType]);

  useEffect(() => { loadDatabases(); }, [loadDatabases]);

  const filteredDbs = useMemo(() => {
    if (!dbSearch) return databases;
    const s = dbSearch.toLowerCase();
    return databases.filter(d => {
      const name = typeof d === 'string' ? d : (d.database_name || d.name || d.dataset_id || '');
      return name.toLowerCase().includes(s);
    });
  }, [databases, dbSearch]);

  const getDbName = (d) => typeof d === 'string' ? d : (d.database_name || d.name || d.dataset_id || '');

  // ── Load ERD data ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadERD = useCallback(async (db) => {
    if (!db) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSelectedTable(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getErdData(db, dbType);
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setTables(body.tables || []);
      setRelationships(body.relationships || []);

      // Auto-layout tables in a grid with dynamic row heights
      const tbs = body.tables || [];
      const cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(tbs.length));
      const GAP_X = 40;      // horizontal gap between tables
      const GAP_Y = 40;      // vertical gap between rows
      const TABLE_W = 280;
      const HEADER_H = 36;
      const ROW_H = 24;
      const MARGIN = 40;     // initial offset

      // Pre-compute each table's height
      const tableHeights = tbs.map(t => HEADER_H + t.columns.length * ROW_H);

      // For each grid row, find the tallest table in that row
      const numRows = Math.ceil(tbs.length / cols);
      const rowMaxHeights = Array(numRows).fill(0);
      tbs.forEach((t, i) => {
        const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
        rowMaxHeights[row] = Math.max(rowMaxHeights[row], tableHeights[i]);
      });

      // Compute cumulative Y offsets per row
      const rowYOffsets = [MARGIN];
      for (let r = 1; r < numRows; r++) {
        rowYOffsets.push(rowYOffsets[r - 1] + rowMaxHeights[r - 1] + GAP_Y);
      }

      const positions = {};
      tbs.forEach((t, i) => {
        const col = i % cols;
        const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
        const key = `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}`;
        positions[key] = { x: MARGIN + col * (TABLE_W + GAP_X), y: rowYOffsets[row] };
      });
      setTablePositions(positions);
      setExpandedTables(new Set(tbs.map(t => `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}`)));
      setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
      setZoom(1);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || e.message || 'Failed to load schema');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [dbType]);

  const selectDatabase = (db) => {
    const name = getDbName(db);
    setSelectedDb(name);
    loadERD(name);
  };

  // ── Drag handling ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleMouseDown = (e, type, tableKey) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (type === 'table') {
      const pos = tablePositions[tableKey] || { x: 0, y: 0 };
      setDragging({ type: 'table', id: tableKey, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, origX: pos.x, origY: pos.y });
    } else {
      setDragging({ type: 'canvas', startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, origX: pan.x, origY: pan.y });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const handleMove = (e) => {
      const dx = (e.clientX - dragging.startX) / zoom;
      const dy = (e.clientY - dragging.startY) / zoom;
      if (dragging.type === 'table') {
        setTablePositions(prev => ({ ...prev, [dragging.id]: { x: dragging.origX + dx, y: dragging.origY + dy } }));
      } else {
        setPan({ x: dragging.origX + dx, y: dragging.origY + dy });
      }
    };
    const handleUp = () => setDragging(null);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleUp);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMove); window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleUp); };
  }, [dragging, zoom]);

  // Zoom
  const handleWheel = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setZoom(z => Math.max(0.2, Math.min(3, z + (e.deltaY > 0 ? -0.1 : 0.1))));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = canvasRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
    return () => el.removeEventListener('wheel', handleWheel);
  }, []);

  // Toggle expand
  const toggleExpand = (key) => {
    setExpandedTables(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(key) ? next.delete(key) : next.add(key);
      return next;
    });
  };

  // ── Compute relationship lines ─────────────────────────────────
  const relationshipLines = useMemo(() => {
    const headerH = 36;
    const rowH = 24;
    const tableW = 280;
    const CURVE_OFFSET = 60; // control-point offset for curves

    return relationships.map((rel, i) => {
      const srcKey = `${rel.source_schema}.${rel.source_table}`;
      const tgtKey = `${rel.target_schema}.${rel.target_table}`;
      const srcPos = tablePositions[srcKey];
      const tgtPos = tablePositions[tgtKey];
      if (!srcPos || !tgtPos) return null;

      // Find column index for Y placement
      const srcTable = tables.find(t => `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}` === srcKey);
      const tgtTable = tables.find(t => `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}` === tgtKey);
      const srcColIdx = srcTable ? srcTable.columns.findIndex(c => c.column_name === rel.source_column) : 0;
      const tgtColIdx = tgtTable ? tgtTable.columns.findIndex(c => c.column_name === rel.target_column) : 0;
      const srcExpanded = expandedTables.has(srcKey);
      const tgtExpanded = expandedTables.has(tgtKey);

      // Y positions based on column index (or header center if collapsed)
      const sy = srcPos.y + headerH + (srcExpanded && srcColIdx >= 0 ? (srcColIdx + 0.5) * rowH : 0);
      const ty = tgtPos.y + headerH + (tgtExpanded && tgtColIdx >= 0 ? (tgtColIdx + 0.5) * rowH : 0);

      // Determine sides: source exits right/left, target enters left/right
      const srcRight = srcPos.x + tableW;
      const tgtRight = tgtPos.x + tableW;
      const srcCenterX = srcPos.x + tableW / 2;
      const tgtCenterX = tgtPos.x + tableW / 2;

      let sx, tx, scx, tcx;

      // Source is clearly left of target
      if (srcRight + 20 < tgtPos.x) {
        sx = srcRight;
        tx = tgtPos.x;
        scx = sx + CURVE_OFFSET;
        tcx = tx - CURVE_OFFSET;
      }
      // Target is clearly left of source
      else if (tgtRight + 20 < srcPos.x) {
        sx = srcPos.x;
        tx = tgtRight;
        scx = sx - CURVE_OFFSET;
        tcx = tx + CURVE_OFFSET;
      }
      // Tables overlap horizontally — route around via the side with more space
      else {
        // Both exit from the same side (left or right), with an S-curve
        if (srcCenterX <= tgtCenterX) {
          // Source exits left, target exits left (route around left)
          sx = srcPos.x;
          tx = tgtPos.x;
          const minX = Math.min(sx, tx) - CURVE_OFFSET - 30;
          scx = minX;
          tcx = minX;
        } else {
          // Source exits right, target exits right (route around right)
          sx = srcRight;
          tx = tgtRight;
          const maxX = Math.max(sx, tx) + CURVE_OFFSET + 30;
          scx = maxX;
          tcx = maxX;
        }
      }

      // Build cubic Bezier path
      const d = `M ${sx} ${sy} C ${scx} ${sy}, ${tcx} ${ty}, ${tx} ${ty}`;

      return {
        key: `rel-${i}`,
        d,
        sx, sy, tx, ty, // connection points for circles
        label: `${rel.source_column} → ${rel.target_column}`,
        constraint: rel.constraint_name,
      };
    }).filter(Boolean);
  }, [relationships, tablePositions, tables, expandedTables]);

  // Fit all
  const fitAll = () => {
    setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    if (tables.length === 0) { setZoom(1); return; }
    const vals = Object.values(tablePositions);
    if (vals.length === 0) { setZoom(1); return; }
    // Find actual max extent using table positions + individual table heights
    let maxX = 0, maxY = 0;
    tables.forEach(t => {
      const key = `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}`;
      const pos = tablePositions[key];
      if (!pos) return;
      const tH = 36 + t.columns.length * 24;
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, pos.x + 320);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, pos.y + tH + 40);
    });
    if (maxX === 0) maxX = 800;
    if (maxY === 0) maxY = 600;
    const el = canvasRef.current;
    if (!el) { setZoom(1); return; }
    const zx = el.clientWidth / maxX;
    const zy = el.clientHeight / maxY;
    setZoom(Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, Math.min(zx, zy) * 0.9)));
  };

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div className="se-container">
      {/* Sidebar */}
      {showSidebar && (
        <div className="se-sidebar">
          <div className="se-sidebar-header">
            <h3><Database size={16} /> Databases</h3>
            <button className="se-icon-btn" onClick={() => setShowSidebar(false)} title="Hide sidebar"><Minimize2 size={14} /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="se-db-type">
            <button className={`se-type-btn ${dbType === 'cloudsql' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setDbType('cloudsql')}>CloudSQL</button>
            <button className={`se-type-btn ${dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setDbType('bigquery')}>BigQuery</button>
            <button className={`se-type-btn ${dbType === 'mssql' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setDbType('mssql')}>MSSQL</button>
          </div>
          <div className="se-db-search">
            <Search size={13} />
            <input placeholder="Search databases…" value={dbSearch} onChange={e => setDbSearch(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div className="se-db-list">
            {filteredDbs.map((d, i) => {
              const name = getDbName(d);
              return (
                <button key={i} className={`se-db-item ${selectedDb === name ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => selectDatabase(d)}>
                  <Database size={13} /> {name}
                </button>
              );
            })}
            {filteredDbs.length === 0 && <div className="se-empty-db">No databases found</div>}
          </div>

          {/* Table list */}
          {tables.length > 0 && (
            <div className="se-table-list">
              <h4><Table2 size={14} /> Tables ({tables.length})</h4>
              {tables.map((t, i) => {
                const key = `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}`;
                return (
                  <button key={key} className={`se-table-item ${selectedTable === key ? 'active' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => { setSelectedTable(key); const pos = tablePositions[key]; if (pos) setPan({ x: -pos.x + 200, y: -pos.y + 150 }); }}>
                    <span className="se-table-dot" style={{ background: TABLE_COLORS[i % TABLE_COLORS.length] }} />
                    {t.table_name}
                    <span className="se-col-count">{t.columns.length} cols</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Relationships */}
          {relationships.length > 0 && (
            <div className="se-rel-list">
              <h4><Link2 size={14} /> Relationships ({relationships.length})</h4>
              {relationships.map((r, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="se-rel-item">
                  <span className="se-rel-src">{r.source_table}.{r.source_column}</span>
                  <ArrowRight size={11} />
                  <span className="se-rel-tgt">{r.target_table}.{r.target_column}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main ERD Canvas */}
      <div className="se-main">
        {/* Toolbar */}
        <div className="se-toolbar">
          {!showSidebar && (
            <button className="se-icon-btn" onClick={() => setShowSidebar(true)} title="Show sidebar"><Maximize2 size={14} /></button>
          )}
          <span className="se-toolbar-title">{selectedDb ? `${selectedDb} — ${tables.length} tables` : 'Select a database'}</span>
          <div className="se-toolbar-right">
            <button className="se-icon-btn" onClick={() => setZoom(z => Math.min(3, z + 0.2))} title="Zoom in"><ZoomIn size={14} /></button>
            <span className="se-zoom-label">{Math.round(zoom * 100)}%</span>
            <button className="se-icon-btn" onClick={() => setZoom(z => Math.max(0.2, z - 0.2))} title="Zoom out"><ZoomOut size={14} /></button>
            <button className="se-icon-btn" onClick={fitAll} title="Fit all"><Maximize2 size={14} /></button>
            <button className="se-icon-btn" onClick={() => loadERD(selectedDb)} disabled={!selectedDb || loading} title="Refresh">
              <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? 'spin' : ''} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="se-error">{error}</div>}

        {/* Canvas */}
        <div
          ref={canvasRef}
          className="se-canvas"
          onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget || e.target.closest('.se-canvas-inner')) handleMouseDown(e, 'canvas'); }}
          style={{ cursor: dragging?.type === 'canvas' ? 'grabbing' : 'grab' }}
        >
          {loading && <div className="se-canvas-loading"><RefreshCw size={24} className="spin" /> Loading schema…</div>}
          {!loading && tables.length === 0 && !error && (
            <div className="se-canvas-empty">
              <Database size={48} />
              <h3>Schema Explorer</h3>
              <p>Select a database from the sidebar to visualize its entity-relationship diagram.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          <svg className="se-canvas-inner" style={{ transform: `scale(${zoom}) translate(${pan.x}px, ${pan.y}px)`, transformOrigin: '0 0', width: '5000px', height: '5000px' }}>
            {/* Relationship lines */}
            <defs>
              <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#94a3b8" />
              </marker>
            </defs>
            {relationshipLines.map(line => (
              <g key={line.key}>
                <path d={line.d} fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeDasharray="5,3" markerEnd="url(#arrowhead)" />
                {/* Connection point circles */}
                <circle cx={line.sx} cy={line.sy} r="3.5" fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1" />
                <circle cx={line.tx} cy={line.ty} r="3.5" fill="#8b5cf6" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1" />
                {/* hover title */}
                <title>{line.label} ({line.constraint})</title>
              </g>
            ))}

            {/* Tables */}
            {tables.map((t, i) => {
              const key = `${t.table_schema}.${t.table_name}`;
              const pos = tablePositions[key] || { x: 0, y: 0 };
              const expanded = expandedTables.has(key);
              const color = TABLE_COLORS[i % TABLE_COLORS.length];
              const isSelected = selectedTable === key;
              const headerH = 36;
              const rowH = 24;
              const bodyH = expanded ? t.columns.length * rowH : 0;
              const totalH = headerH + bodyH;

              return (
                <g key={key} transform={`translate(${pos.x}, ${pos.y})`}>
                  {/* Shadow */}
                  <rect x="2" y="2" width="280" height={totalH} rx="8" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" />
                  {/* Card bg */}
                  <rect width="280" height={totalH} rx="8"
                    fill="#fff" stroke={isSelected ? color : '#e2e8f0'} strokeWidth={isSelected ? 2 : 1}
                  />
                  {/* Header */}
                  <rect width="280" height={headerH} rx="8" fill={color} />
                  <rect y={headerH - 8} width="280" height="8" fill={color} />
                  {/* Table name */}
                  <text x="12" y="23" fill="#fff" fontSize="12" fontWeight="600" fontFamily="system-ui">{t.table_name}</text>
                  <text x="268" y="23" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" fontSize="10" fontFamily="system-ui" textAnchor="end">
                    {t.columns.length} cols
                  </text>
                  {/* Draggable hit area */}
                  <rect width="280" height={headerH} fill="transparent" style={{ cursor: 'move' }}
                    onMouseDown={e => { e.stopPropagation(); handleMouseDown(e, 'table', key); }}
                    onClick={() => toggleExpand(key)}
                  />

                  {/* Columns */}
                  {expanded && t.columns.map((col, ci) => {
                    const cy = headerH + ci * rowH;
                    const isPK = col.is_primary;
                    const isFK = relationships.some(r =>
                      (r.source_table === t.table_name && r.source_column === col.column_name) ||
                      (r.target_table === t.table_name && r.target_column === col.column_name)
                    );
                    return (
                      <g key={col.column_name} transform={`translate(0, ${cy})`}>
                        <rect width="280" height={rowH} fill={ci % 2 === 0 ? '#f8fafc' : '#fff'} />
                        {/* PK/FK icon */}
                        <text x="10" y="16" fontSize="10" fill={isPK ? '#f59e0b' : isFK ? '#8b5cf6' : '#cbd5e1'} fontFamily="system-ui">
                          {isPK ? '🔑' : isFK ? '🔗' : '  ○'}
                        </text>
                        <text x="30" y="16" fontSize="11" fill="#1e293b" fontFamily="system-ui, monospace">{col.column_name}</text>
                        <text x="268" y="16" fontSize="9" fill="#94a3b8" fontFamily="system-ui" textAnchor="end">
                          {col.data_type}{col.is_nullable === 'NO' ? ' NN' : ''}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  })}
                  {/* Bottom border */}
                  {expanded && <rect y={totalH - 1} width="280" height="1" fill="#e2e8f0" rx="8" />}
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* Legend */}
        {tables.length > 0 && (
          <div className="se-legend">
            <span className="se-legend-item"><span className="se-legend-icon pk">🔑</span> Primary Key</span>
            <span className="se-legend-item"><span className="se-legend-icon fk">🔗</span> Foreign Key</span>
            <span className="se-legend-item"><span className="se-legend-icon">○</span> Column</span>
            <span className="se-legend-item"><span className="se-legend-line">- - -</span> Relationship</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/SchedulerBuilder.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

/* ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const uid = () => Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5);

const STEP_TYPES = [

  { type: 'email_trigger',     label: 'Email Trigger',     icon: Mail,           color: '#f59e0b', desc: 'Send conditional emails' },
  { type: 'gcs_operation',     label: 'GCS Operation',     icon: HardDrive,      color: '#10b981', desc: 'GCS bucket operations' },

  { type: 'conditional',       label: 'Conditional',       icon: GitMerge,       color: '#6366f1', desc: 'IF/ELSE branching based on conditions' },
  { type: 'sql_script',        label: 'SQL Script',        icon: FileCode2,      color: '#7c3aed', desc: 'Execute multi-statement SQL with transactions' },
];

const OPERATORS = [
  { value: 'eq',        label: '==' },

  { value: 'gt',        label: '>' },

const TRANSFORMATION_TYPES = [
  { type: 'filter_rows',       label: 'Filter Rows',       icon: Filter,  desc: 'Keep or remove rows based on conditions' },
  { type: 'add_column',        label: 'Add Column',        icon: Plus,    desc: 'Add a computed column' },

  { type: 'type_cast',         label: 'Type Cast',         icon: Hash,    desc: 'Convert column data types' },
  { type: 'deduplicate',       label: 'Deduplicate',       icon: Layers,  desc: 'Remove duplicate rows' },
