                    <input value={m.source_field || ''} onChange={e => {
                      const arr = [...step.config.mapping]; arr[mi] = { ...arr[mi], source_field: e.target.value }; updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', arr);
                    }} placeholder="CSV column name" />
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ margin: '0 6px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>→</span>
                  <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                    <input value={m.target_column || ''} onChange={e => {
                      const arr = [...step.config.mapping]; arr[mi] = { ...arr[mi], target_column: e.target.value }; updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', arr);
                    }} placeholder="DB column name" />
                  </div>
                  <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" style={{ color: '#ef4444' }} onClick={() => {
                    const arr = step.config.mapping.filter((_, i) => i !== mi); updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', arr);
                  }}><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {step.config.file_type === 'sql' && (
          <div className="scheduler-template-hint" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            SQL file mode: Each statement (separated by <code>;</code>) will be executed against this database. No table/schema needed.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );

  /* ── SQL Script Step config ──────────────────────────────── */
  const renderSqlScriptConfig = (step, idx) => {
    const stmts = step.config.statements || [];
    const vars = step.config.variables || {};
    const varEntries = Object.entries(vars);

    const addStatement = () => {
      const s = [...stmts, { id: uid(), name: '', sql: '', enabled: true, capture_result: false,
        validation: { enabled: false, type: 'row_count', operator: 'gte', value: 0, fail_action: 'abort' } }];
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const removeStatement = (si) => updateCfg(idx, 'statements', stmts.filter((_, i) => i !== si));
    const updateStmt = (si, key, val) => {
      const s = [...stmts];
      s[si] = { ...s[si], [key]: val };
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const updateStmtValidation = (si, key, val) => {
      const s = [...stmts];
      s[si] = { ...s[si], validation: { ...s[si].validation, [key]: val } };
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const moveStmt = (si, dir) => {
      const ni = si + dir;
      if (ni < 0 || ni >= stmts.length) return;
      const s = [...stmts];
      [s[si], s[ni]] = [s[ni], s[si]];
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const setVar = (key, val) => updateCfg(idx, 'variables', { ...vars, [key]: val });
    const removeVar = (key) => {
      const v = { ...vars };
      delete v[key];
      updateCfg(idx, 'variables', v);
    };
    const addVar = () => {
      const key = `var_${Object.keys(vars).length + 1}`;
      setVar(key, '');
    };
    const renameVar = (oldKey, newKey) => {
      if (oldKey === newKey || !newKey.trim()) return;
      const v = {};
      for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(vars)) {
        v[k === oldKey ? newKey : k] = val;
      }
      updateCfg(idx, 'variables', v);
    };

    return (
      <>
        {/* ── Database Connection ────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#f5f3ff', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #ddd6fe', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <Database size={14} style={{ color: '#7c3aed' }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#5b21b6' }}>Database Connection</span>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
              <label>DB Type</label>
              <select value={step.config.db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'db_type', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL (PostgreSQL)</option>
                <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                {servers.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Database</label>
              <input value={step.config.database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
            </div>
            {step.config.db_type !== 'bigquery' && (
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
                <label>Schema</label>
                <input value={step.config.schema_name || 'public'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'schema_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="public" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ── Transaction & Error Settings ──────────────── */}
          <div className="scheduler-form-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={step.config.transaction_mode !== false} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'transaction_mode', e.target.checked)} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#5b21b6' }}>Wrap in transaction (BEGIN / COMMIT / ROLLBACK)</span>
            </label>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 160 }}>
              <label>On Error</label>
              <select value={step.config.on_error || 'rollback'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'on_error', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="rollback">Rollback all</option>
                <option value="continue">Continue (skip failed)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Variables ──────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#fefce8', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #fde68a', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <Settings size={14} style={{ color: '#a16207' }} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#92400e' }}>Template Variables</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#a1a1aa' }}>({varEntries.length})</span>
            </div>
            <button type="button" className="scheduler-btn-sm" onClick={addVar} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              <Plus size={12} /> Add Variable
            </button>
          </div>
          {varEntries.length === 0 && (
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              Add variables to use in SQL as {'{{var_name}}'} — supports dynamic expressions like $today-1d
            </div>
          )}
          {varEntries.map(([k, v], vi) => (
            <div key={vi} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginBottom: 4, alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <input style={{ flex: '0 0 140px', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12 }} value={k}
                onChange={e => renameVar(k, e.target.value)} placeholder="variable_name" />
              <input style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12 }} value={v}
                onChange={e => setVar(k, e.target.value)} placeholder="value or $today-1d" />
              <button type="button" className="scheduler-btn-sm" style={{ color: '#ef4444', padding: '2px 6px' }}
                onClick={() => removeVar(k)}><Trash2 size={12} /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* ── Statements ─────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151' }}>SQL Statements ({stmts.length})</span>
            <button type="button" className="scheduler-btn-sm" onClick={addStatement} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              <Plus size={12} /> Add Statement
            </button>
          </div>

          {stmts.map((stmt, si) => (
            <div key={stmt.id || si} style={{ padding: 10, background: '#fafafa', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #e5e7eb', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              {/* Statement header */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#7c3aed', minWidth: 18 }}>#{si + 1}</span>
                <input style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12 }} value={stmt.name} placeholder={`Statement ${si + 1} name`}
                  onChange={e => updateStmt(si, 'name', e.target.value)} />
                <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 11, color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={stmt.enabled !== false} onChange={e => updateStmt(si, 'enabled', e.target.checked)} />
                  On
                </label>
                <button type="button" className="scheduler-btn-sm" style={{ padding: '2px 4px' }} disabled={si === 0}
                  onClick={() => moveStmt(si, -1)}><ArrowUp size={12} /></button>
                <button type="button" className="scheduler-btn-sm" style={{ padding: '2px 4px' }} disabled={si === stmts.length - 1}
                  onClick={() => moveStmt(si, 1)}><ArrowDown size={12} /></button>
                <button type="button" className="scheduler-btn-sm" style={{ color: '#ef4444', padding: '2px 6px' }}
                  onClick={() => removeStatement(si)}><Trash2 size={12} /></button>
              </div>

              {/* SQL textarea */}
              <textarea
                rows={8}
                style={{ width: '100%', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12, padding: 8, borderRadius: 4,
                  border: '1px solid #d1d5db', resize: 'vertical', background: '#1e1e2e', color: '#cdd6f4' }}
                value={stmt.sql}
                onChange={e => updateStmt(si, 'sql', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="DELETE FROM table WHERE ...;&#10;INSERT INTO table (...) SELECT ...;&#10;UPDATE table SET ...;"
                spellCheck={false}
              />
              <div className="scheduler-template-hint" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                Supports {'{{$today:YYYY-MM-DD}}'}, {'{{$now-1d}}'}, {'{{var_name}}'}, {'{{steps.prev_step.data}}'}
              </div>

              {/* Options row */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, marginTop: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 11, color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={stmt.capture_result || false} onChange={e => updateStmt(si, 'capture_result', e.target.checked)} />
                  Capture result (store rows/affected count in context)
                </label>
                <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 11, color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={stmt.validation?.enabled || false}
                    onChange={e => updateStmtValidation(si, 'enabled', e.target.checked)} />
                  Validate result
                </label>
              </div>

              {/* Validation config (expanded when enabled) */}
              {stmt.validation?.enabled && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginTop: 6, padding: 8, background: '#f0fdf4', borderRadius: 4, border: '1px solid #bbf7d0', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
                  <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
                    <label style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Affected rows</label>
                    <select value={stmt.validation.operator || 'gte'} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}
                      onChange={e => updateStmtValidation(si, 'operator', e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="eq">== equals</option>
                      <option value="neq">!= not equal</option>
                      <option value="gt">&gt; greater than</option>
                      <option value="gte">&gt;= at least</option>
                      <option value="lt">&lt; less than</option>
                      <option value="lte">&lt;= at most</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 80 }}>
                    <label style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Value</label>
                    <input type="number" value={stmt.validation.value || 0} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}
                      onChange={e => updateStmtValidation(si, 'value', parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
                    <label style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>On fail</label>
                    <select value={stmt.validation.fail_action || 'abort'} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}
                      onChange={e => updateStmtValidation(si, 'fail_action', e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="abort">Abort &amp; rollback</option>
                      <option value="warn">Warn &amp; continue</option>
                      <option value="continue">Ignore</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </>
    );
  };

  /* ── Conditional Step config ─────────────────────────────── */
  const renderConditionalConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#eef2ff', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #c7d2fe', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <GitMerge size={14} style={{ color: '#6366f1' }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#4338ca' }}>IF Condition</span>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Field (dot path)</label>
            <input
              value={step.config.condition_field || ''}
              onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'condition_field', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="steps.prev_step.data.status"
            />
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Reference a previous step result using dot notation</div>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
            <label>Operator</label>
            <select value={step.config.condition_operator || 'eq'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'condition_operator', e.target.value)}>
              {OPERATORS.map(op => <option key={op.value} value={op.value}>{op.label}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          {!['not_empty', 'is_empty', 'exists'].includes(step.config.condition_operator) && (
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Value</label>
              <input
                value={step.config.condition_value || ''}
                onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'condition_value', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="expected_value"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
        {/* THEN branch */}
        <div style={{ padding: 10, background: '#f0fdf4', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #bbf7d0' }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#16a34a', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 6, display: 'block' }}>
            ✓ THEN (condition met)
          </label>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <label>Action</label>
            <select value={step.config.then_action || 'continue'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'then_action', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="continue">Continue to next step</option>
              <option value="skip_next">Skip next step</option>
              <option value="stop_success">Stop pipeline (success)</option>
              <option value="log">Log message only</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Message (optional)</label>
            <input
              value={step.config.then_message || ''}
              onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'then_message', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Condition passed, continuing..."
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ELSE branch */}
        <div style={{ padding: 10, background: '#fef2f2', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #fecaca' }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#dc2626', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 6, display: 'block' }}>
            ✗ ELSE (condition not met)
          </label>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <label>Action</label>
            <select value={step.config.else_action || 'skip'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'else_action', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="skip">Skip remaining steps</option>
              <option value="continue">Continue anyway</option>
              <option value="stop_failure">Stop pipeline (failure)</option>
              <option value="log">Log message only</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Message (optional)</label>
            <input
              value={step.config.else_message || ''}
              onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'else_message', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Condition failed, stopping..."
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );

  /* ── Conditions block ────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderConditions = (step, idx) => (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 12, background: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
        <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
          <AlertCircle size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Conditions (all must pass)
        </label>
        <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => addCond(idx)}><Plus size={12} /> Add</button>
      </div>
      {step.conditions.map((c, ci) => (
        <div className="scheduler-condition-row" key={ci}>
          <input placeholder="steps.step_name.field" value={c.field} onChange={e => updCond(idx, ci, 'field', e.target.value)} />
          <select value={c.operator} onChange={e => updCond(idx, ci, 'operator', e.target.value)}>
            {OPERATORS.map(op => <option key={op.value} value={op.value}>{op.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          {!['not_empty', 'is_empty', 'exists'].includes(c.operator) && (
            <input placeholder="value" value={c.value} onChange={e => updCond(idx, ci, 'value', e.target.value)} />
          )}
          <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" onClick={() => rmCond(idx, ci)}><X size={12} /></button>
        </div>
      ))}
      {step.conditions.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No conditions — step always runs</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  /* ── Step Card ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderStepCard = (step, idx) => {
    const meta = STEP_TYPES.find(t => t.type === step.type) || STEP_TYPES[0];
    const Icon = meta.icon;
    const open = expandedStep === idx;

    return (
      <div className="scheduler-step-card" key={step.id || idx}>
        <div className="scheduler-step-header" onClick={() => setExpandedStep(open ? null : idx)}>
          <div className="scheduler-step-header-left">
            <span className="scheduler-step-order">{idx + 1}</span>
            <div className={`scheduler-step-icon ${step.type}`}><Icon size={14} /></div>
            <span className="scheduler-step-name">{step.name || `${meta.label} Step`}</span>
            <span className="scheduler-step-type-badge">{meta.label}</span>
            {step.conditions?.length > 0 && (
              <span className="scheduler-step-type-badge" style={{ background: '#fef3c7', color: '#d97706' }}>
                {step.conditions.length} condition{step.conditions.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-step-header-right">
            <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title="Move Up" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); moveStep(idx, -1); }} disabled={idx === 0}><ArrowUp size={12} /></button>
            <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title="Move Down" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); moveStep(idx, 1); }} disabled={idx === form.steps.length - 1}><ArrowDown size={12} /></button>
            <label className="scheduler-toggle" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={step.enabled} onChange={e => updateField(idx, 'enabled', e.target.checked)} />
              <span className="scheduler-toggle-slider" />
            </label>
            <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" title="Remove" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); removeStep(idx); }}><Trash2 size={12} /></button>
            {open ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
          </div>
        </div>

        {open && (
          <div className="scheduler-step-body">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <label>Step Name</label>
              <input value={step.name} onChange={e => updateField(idx, 'name', e.target.value)} placeholder={`${meta.label} step name (used in templates)`} />
              <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Reference this step&apos;s output as: {'{{steps.'}{step.name || 'step_name'}{'.data}}'}</div>
            </div>
            {step.type === 'api_call'        && renderApiCallConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'api_call_upsert' && renderApiCallUpsertConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'db_transfer'     && renderDbTransferConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'db_mapping'    && renderDbMappingConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'email_trigger' && renderEmailTriggerConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'gcs_operation' && renderGcsOperationConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'truncate_table' && renderTruncateTableConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'file_import'   && renderFileImportConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'sql_script'    && renderSqlScriptConfig(step, idx)}
            {step.type === 'conditional'   && renderConditionalConfig(step, idx)}
            {renderConditions(step, idx)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PAGE-LEVEL RENDERS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  /* ── Job List ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderJobList = () => (
    <div className="scheduler-content">
      {jobs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="scheduler-empty">
          <div className="scheduler-empty-icon"><Clock size={48} /></div>
          <h4>No Scheduler Jobs</h4>
          <p>Create your first job to automate API calls, DB updates, emails &amp; GCS operations</p>
          <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-primary" onClick={openNewJob} style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
            <Plus size={14} /> Create Job
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        jobs.map(j => (
          <div className="scheduler-run-card" key={j.id} style={{ cursor: 'default' }}>
            <div className="scheduler-run-header">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>{j.name}</span>
                <span className={`scheduler-job-card-status ${j.enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}`}>
                  {j.enabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled'}
                </span>
                {j.last_run_status && <span className={`scheduler-run-status ${j.last_run_status}`}>{j.last_run_status}</span>}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title="Edit"    onClick={() => openEditJob(j)}><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title="Run Now" onClick={() => runJob(j.id)} disabled={running}>
                  {running ? <Loader size={14} className="scheduler-spinner" /> : <Play size={14} />}
                </button>
                <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title="History" onClick={() => viewHistory(j.id)}><Eye size={14} /></button>
                <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title={j.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'} onClick={() => toggleJob(j.id)}>
                  {j.enabled ? <X size={14} /> : <Check size={14} />}
                </button>
                <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" title="Delete" onClick={() => deleteJob(j.id)}><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 16, marginTop: 6 }}>
              <span className="scheduler-job-card-meta">
                <Clock size={10} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
                {j.schedule_type === 'manual' ? 'Manual' : j.schedule_type === 'interval' ? `Every ${j.schedule_config?.interval_minutes || '?'} min` : 'Cron'}
              </span>
              <span className="scheduler-job-card-meta">
                {(j.steps || []).length} step{(j.steps || []).length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </span>
              {j.execution_mode === 'cloud_job' && (
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: '#0891b2', background: '#ecfeff', padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, border: '1px solid #a5f3fc' }}>
                  <Cloud size={9} style={{ marginRight: 3, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />Cloud Run
                </span>
              )}
              {(j.dependencies || []).length > 0 && (
                <span className="scheduler-job-card-meta" style={{ color: '#6366f1' }}>
                  <GitBranch size={10} style={{ marginRight: 3, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
                  {(j.dependencies || []).length} dep{(j.dependencies || []).length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </span>
              )}
              {j.last_run_at && <span className="scheduler-job-card-meta">Last: {new Date(j.last_run_at).toLocaleString()}</span>}
            </div>
            {j.description && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 6 }}>{j.description}</div>}
          </div>
        ))
      )}
    </div>
  );

  /* ── Schedule Config Section ─────────────────────────────── */
  const renderScheduleConfig = () => {
    // CRON presets
    const CRON_PRESETS = [
      { label: 'Every hour', config: { minute: 0, hour: '*', days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] } },
      { label: 'Every 6 hours', config: { minute: 0, hour: '*/6', days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] } },
      { label: 'Daily at midnight', config: { minute: 0, hour: 0, days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] } },
      { label: 'Daily at 8 AM', config: { minute: 0, hour: 8, days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] } },
      { label: 'Weekdays at 9 AM', config: { minute: 0, hour: 9, days_of_week: [1,2,3,4,5] } },
      { label: 'Weekly Monday 6 AM', config: { minute: 0, hour: 6, days_of_week: [1] } },
    ];

    const applyCronPreset = (preset) => {
      setForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule_config: { ...f.schedule_config, ...preset.config } }));
      toast.success(`Applied: ${preset.label}`);
    };

    // Generate human-readable cron description
    const describeCron = () => {
      if (form.schedule_type !== 'cron') return '';
      const cfg = form.schedule_config;
      const h = cfg.hour ?? '*';
      const m = cfg.minute ?? 0;
      const days = cfg.days_of_week || [];
      const dayNames = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
      let desc = `At ${String(m).padStart(2,'0')} minutes past `;
      if (h === '*' || h === '') desc += 'every hour';
      else if (String(h).includes('/')) desc += `every ${h.replace('*/','')} hours`;
      else desc += `hour ${h}`;
      if (days.length === 7 || days.length === 0) desc += ', every day';
      else desc += `, on ${days.sort().map(d => dayNames[d]).join(', ')}`;
      return desc;
    };

    // Generate next 5 run times
    const getNextRuns = () => {
      if (form.schedule_type !== 'cron') return [];
      const cfg = form.schedule_config;
      const hour = cfg.hour ?? 0;
      const minute = cfg.minute ?? 0;
      const days = cfg.days_of_week || [0,1,2,3,4,5,6];
      if (days.length === 0) return [];
      const runs = [];
      const now = new Date();
      const d = new Date(now);
      let safety = 0;
      while (runs.length < 5 && safety < 365) {
        d.setDate(d.getDate() + (safety === 0 ? 0 : 1));
        if (days.includes(d.getDay())) {
          const hVal = typeof hour === 'string' && hour.includes('/') ? parseInt(hour.replace('*/','')) : (hour === '*' ? null : parseInt(hour));
          if (hVal === null || String(hour).includes('/')) {
            // Every hour or every N hours
            const step = hVal || 1;
            for (let hh = 0; hh < 24 && runs.length < 5; hh += step) {
              const run = new Date(d);
              run.setHours(hh, minute, 0, 0);
              if (run > now) runs.push(run);
            }
          } else {
            const run = new Date(d);
            run.setHours(hVal, minute, 0, 0);
            if (run > now) runs.push(run);
          }
        }
        safety++;
      }
      return runs;
    };

    return (
    <div className="scheduler-section">
      <div className="scheduler-section-header">
        <span><Clock size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Schedule</span>
      </div>
      <div className="scheduler-section-body">
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label>Type</label>
            <select value={form.schedule_type} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule_type: e.target.value, schedule_config: {} }))}>
              <option value="manual">Manual Only</option>
              <option value="interval">Interval (Minutes)</option>
              <option value="cron">Cron Schedule</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          {form.schedule_type === 'interval' && (
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
              <label>Interval (min)</label>
              <input type="number" min={1} value={form.schedule_config.interval_minutes || ''} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule_config: { ...f.schedule_config, interval_minutes: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 } }))} placeholder="e.g. 60" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {form.schedule_type === 'cron' && (
          <>
            {/* Cron Presets */}
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 6, display: 'block' }}>Quick Presets</label>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {CRON_PRESETS.map((p, i) => (
                  <button key={i} type="button" className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => applyCronPreset(p)} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                    {p.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="scheduler-form-row" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
                <label>Hour (0-23 or */N)</label>
                <input value={form.schedule_config.hour ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule_config: { ...f.schedule_config, hour: e.target.value } }))} placeholder="e.g. 8 or */6" />
              </div>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
                <label>Minute (0-59)</label>
                <input type="number" min={0} max={59} value={form.schedule_config.minute ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule_config: { ...f.schedule_config, minute: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 } }))} />
              </div>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                <label>Days</label>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  {CRON_DAYS.map(d => {
                    const days = form.schedule_config.days_of_week || [];
                    const on = days.includes(d.value);
                    return (
                      <button key={d.value} type="button"
                        className={`scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm ${on ? 'scheduler-btn-primary' : 'scheduler-btn-outline'}`}
                        onClick={() => setForm(f => ({
                          ...f,
                          schedule_config: {
                            ...f.schedule_config,
                            days_of_week: on ? days.filter(x => x !== d.value) : [...days, d.value],
                          },
                        }))}>
                        {d.label}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Cron Description */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: 10, padding: '8px 12px', background: '#f0f9ff', border: '1px solid #bae6fd', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 12, color: '#0369a1', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <Clock size={13} />
              <span><strong>Schedule:</strong> {describeCron()}</span>
            </div>

            {/* Next Runs Preview */}
            {(() => {
              const nextRuns = getNextRuns();
              if (nextRuns.length === 0) return null;
              return (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                  <label style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 4, display: 'block' }}>Next Runs</label>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    {nextRuns.map((r, i) => (
                      <span key={i} style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '3px 8px', background: '#f1f5f9', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 4, color: '#475569', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        {r.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
    );
  };

  /* ── Job Editor ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderJobEditor = () => (
    <div className="scheduler-content">
      {/* Details */}
      <div className="scheduler-section">
        <div className="scheduler-section-header">
          <span><Settings size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Job Details</span>
          <label className="scheduler-toggle">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={form.enabled} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, enabled: e.target.checked }))} />
            <span className="scheduler-toggle-slider" />
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-section-body">
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Job Name</label>
              <input value={form.name} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="My Scheduler Job" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Description</label>
            <textarea rows={2} value={form.description} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, description: e.target.value }))} placeholder="What does this job do?" style={{ minHeight: 50 }} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {renderScheduleConfig()}

      {/* Execution Mode */}
      <div className="scheduler-section">
        <div className="scheduler-section-header">
          <span><Cloud size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Execution Mode</span>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-section-body">
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 280 }}>
              <label>Run Mode</label>
              <select value={form.execution_mode || 'in_app'} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, execution_mode: e.target.value }))}>
                <option value="in_app">In-App (background thread)</option>
                <option value="cloud_job">Cloud Run Job (isolated container)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          {form.execution_mode === 'cloud_job' && (<>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#0891b2', background: '#ecfeff', padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 4, border: '1px solid #a5f3fc', marginBottom: 10 }}>
              This job will run as an isolated Cloud Run Job container. It will not be affected by Cloud Run scale-to-zero events or request timeouts.
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-row">
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label>Cloud Run Job Name</label>
                <input type="text" placeholder={`scheduler-${form.id || 'auto'}`}
                  value={form.cloud_job_config?.cloud_job_name || ''}
                  onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, cloud_job_config: { ...f.cloud_job_config, cloud_job_name: e.target.value }}))} />
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: 2 }}>
                  Custom name for the Cloud Run Job. Leave empty to auto-generate. Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-row">
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
                <label>CPU</label>
                <select value={form.cloud_job_config?.cpu || '2'} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, cloud_job_config: { ...f.cloud_job_config, cpu: e.target.value }}))}>
                  <option value="1">1 vCPU</option>
                  <option value="2">2 vCPU</option>
                  <option value="4">4 vCPU</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}>
                <label>Memory</label>
                <select value={form.cloud_job_config?.memory || '2Gi'} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, cloud_job_config: { ...f.cloud_job_config, memory: e.target.value }}))}>
                  <option value="512Mi">512 MB</option>
                  <option value="1Gi">1 GB</option>
                  <option value="2Gi">2 GB</option>
                  <option value="4Gi">4 GB</option>
                  <option value="8Gi">8 GB</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 160 }}>
                <label>Timeout (seconds)</label>
                <input type="number" min={60} max={86400} value={form.cloud_job_config?.timeout || 3600}
                  onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, cloud_job_config: { ...f.cloud_job_config, timeout: parseInt(e.target.value) || 3600 }}))} />
              </div>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
                <label>Max Retries</label>
                <input type="number" min={0} max={10} value={form.cloud_job_config?.max_retries || 0}
                  onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, cloud_job_config: { ...f.cloud_job_config, max_retries: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 }}))} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </>)}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dependencies */}
      <div className="scheduler-section">
        <div className="scheduler-section-header">
          <span><GitBranch size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Dependencies</span>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-section-body">
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginBottom: 10 }}>
            Select jobs that must complete successfully before this job can run. If any dependency job has not succeeded, this job will fail with a dependency error.
          </div>
          {(() => {
            // Get other jobs (exclude current job being edited)
            const otherJobs = jobs.filter(j => j.id !== selectedJobId);
            if (otherJobs.length === 0) {
              return <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No other jobs available to set as dependencies.</div>;
            }
            return (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                {otherJobs.map(j => {
                  const checked = (form.dependencies || []).includes(j.id);
                  const statusColor = j.last_run_status === 'success' ? '#10b981' : j.last_run_status === 'failed' ? '#ef4444' : '#94a3b8';
                  return (
                    <label key={j.id} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: 'pointer', padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6, background: checked ? '#eff6ff' : '#f8fafc', border: `1px solid ${checked ? '#93c5fd' : '#e2e8f0'}`, transition: 'all 0.15s' }}>
                      <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} onChange={() => {
                        setForm(f => ({
                          ...f,
                          dependencies: checked
                            ? (f.dependencies || []).filter(d => d !== j.id)
                            : [...(f.dependencies || []), j.id],
                        }));
                      }} />
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500, color: '#1e293b' }}>{j.name}</span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8' }}>({j.schedule_type})</span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: statusColor, marginLeft: 'auto', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                        {j.last_run_status || 'never run'}
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            );
          })()}
          {(form.dependencies || []).length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: '8px 12px', background: '#fef3c7', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #fde68a', fontSize: 12, color: '#92400e', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <AlertCircle size={14} />
              <span><strong>{form.dependencies.length}</strong> dependency job{form.dependencies.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} must succeed before this job runs.</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Steps */}
      <div className="scheduler-section">
        <div className="scheduler-section-header">
          <span>Steps ({form.steps.length})</span>
          <div ref={addMenuRef} className="scheduler-add-step-menu">
            <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowAddMenu(!showAddMenu)}>
              <Plus size={12} /> Add Step <ChevronDown size={12} />
            </button>
            {showAddMenu && (
              <div className="scheduler-add-step-dropdown">
                {STEP_TYPES.map(t => (
                  <div className="scheduler-add-step-item" key={t.type} onClick={() => addStep(t.type)}>
                    <div className="scheduler-add-step-item-icon" style={{ background: t.color }}>
                      <t.icon size={14} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="scheduler-add-step-item-text">
                      <h5>{t.label}</h5>
                      <p>{t.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-section-body">
          {form.steps.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '30px 0', color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>
              No steps yet. Click &quot;Add Step&quot; to build your automation pipeline.
            </div>
          ) : (
            form.steps.map((step, idx) => renderStepCard(step, idx))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  /* ── Run History ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderRunHistory = () => {
    const job = jobs.find(j => j.id === selectedJobId);
    return (
      <div className="scheduler-content">
        <div className="scheduler-section">
          <div className="scheduler-section-header">
            <span>
              <Eye size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
              Run History {job ? `– ${job.name}` : ''}
            </span>
            <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => viewHistory(selectedJobId)}>
              <RefreshCw size={12} /> Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-section-body">
            {history.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '30px 0', color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>
                No runs recorded yet for this job.
              </div>
            ) : (
              history.map((run, ri) => (
                <div className="scheduler-run-card" key={run.run_id || ri}>
                  <div className="scheduler-run-header" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => setExpandedRun(expandedRun === ri ? null : ri)}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                      <span className={`scheduler-run-status ${run.status}`}>{run.status}</span>
                      <span className="scheduler-run-time">{new Date(run.started_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                      {run.duration_ms != null && (
                        <span className="scheduler-run-time">({(run.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s)</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {expandedRun === ri ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
                  </div>
                  {expandedRun === ri && (
                    <div className="scheduler-run-steps">
                      {(run.steps_log || run.step_results || []).map((sr, si) => (
                        <div key={si} className="scheduler-run-step">
                          <div className={`scheduler-run-step-icon ${sr.status}`}>
                            {sr.status === 'success' ? <Check size={10} /> : sr.status === 'failed' ? <X size={10} /> : <span>–</span>}
                          </div>
                          <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{sr.name || sr.step_name || `Step ${si + 1}`}</span>
                          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>({sr.type || sr.step_type})</span>
                          {sr.duration_ms != null && <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{(sr.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(2)}s</span>}
                          {sr.message && <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>— {sr.message}</span>}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      {run.error && (
                        <div className="scheduler-run-log" style={{ color: '#dc2626' }}>Error: {run.error}</div>
                      )}
                      {(run.steps_log || run.step_results || []).some(sr => sr.error) && (
                        <div className="scheduler-run-log">
                          {(run.steps_log || run.step_results || []).filter(sr => sr.error).map((sr, i) => (
                            <div key={i}><strong>{sr.name || sr.step_name}:</strong> {sr.error}</div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  /* ── Execution Dashboard ──────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderDashboard = () => {
    const successCount = allHistory.filter(r => r.status === 'success').length;
    const failedCount = allHistory.filter(r => r.status === 'failed').length;
    const totalCount = allHistory.length;
    const avgDuration = totalCount > 0
      ? (allHistory.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.duration_ms || 0), 0) / totalCount / 1000).toFixed(1)
      : 0;

    // Group by job for breakdown
    const byJob = {};
    allHistory.forEach(r => {
      if (!byJob[r.job_name]) byJob[r.job_name] = { success: 0, failed: 0, total: 0 };
      byJob[r.job_name].total++;
      if (r.status === 'success') byJob[r.job_name].success++;
      if (r.status === 'failed') byJob[r.job_name].failed++;
    });

    // Recent runs (last 20)
    const recentRuns = allHistory.slice(0, 20);

    // Daily aggregation for last 7 days
    const dailyStats = {};
    const now = new Date();
    for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      dailyStats[key] = { date: key, success: 0, failed: 0 };
    }
    allHistory.forEach(r => {
      if (!r.started_at) return;
      const key = new Date(r.started_at).toISOString().split('T')[0];
      if (dailyStats[key]) {
        if (r.status === 'success') dailyStats[key].success++;
        if (r.status === 'failed') dailyStats[key].failed++;
      }
    });

    return (
      <div className="scheduler-content">
        {loadingDashboard ? (
          <div className="scheduler-loading"><Loader size={16} className="scheduler-spinner" /> Loading dashboard...</div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Summary Cards */}
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, background: '#f0f9ff', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #bae6fd', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#0284c7' }}>{totalCount}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#0369a1', fontWeight: 500 }}>Total Runs</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, background: '#f0fdf4', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #bbf7d0', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#16a34a' }}>{successCount}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#15803d', fontWeight: 500 }}>Successful</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, background: '#fef2f2', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #fecaca', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#dc2626' }}>{failedCount}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#b91c1c', fontWeight: 500 }}>Failed</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, background: '#faf5ff', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #e9d5ff', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#7c3aed' }}>{avgDuration}s</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#6d28d9', fontWeight: 500 }}>Avg Duration</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Daily Overview Bar Chart (simple CSS) */}
            <div className="scheduler-section" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <div className="scheduler-section-header"><span>Last 7 Days</span></div>
              <div className="scheduler-section-body">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', height: 100 }}>
                  {Object.values(dailyStats).map(day => {
                    const total = day.success + day.failed;
                    const maxH = 80;
                    const h = total > 0 ? Math.max(8, (total / Math.max(...Object.values(dailyStats).map(d => d.success + d.failed), 1)) * maxH) : 4;
                    const successPct = total > 0 ? (day.success / total) * 100 : 0;
                    return (
                      <div key={day.date} style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                        <div style={{ width: '100%', height: h, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                          <div style={{ flex: successPct, background: '#22c55e', minHeight: total > 0 ? 2 : 0 }} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 100 - successPct, background: total > 0 ? '#ef4444' : '#e2e8f0', minHeight: total > 0 ? 0 : 4 }} />
                        </div>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 9, color: '#94a3b8' }}>{day.date.slice(5)}</span>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 9, color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 500 }}>{total}</span>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginTop: 8, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                    <span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 2, background: '#22c55e', display: 'inline-block' }} /> Success
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                    <span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 2, background: '#ef4444', display: 'inline-block' }} /> Failed
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Per-Job Breakdown */}
            <div className="scheduler-section" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <div className="scheduler-section-header"><span>Job Breakdown</span></div>
              <div className="scheduler-section-body">
                {Object.entries(byJob).length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>No execution data yet</div>
                ) : (
                  <table style={{ width: '100%', fontSize: 12, borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
                    <thead>
                      <tr style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
                        <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '6px 8px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569' }}>Job</th>
                        <th style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 8px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569' }}>Runs</th>
                        <th style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 8px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#16a34a' }}>Success</th>
                        <th style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 8px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>Failed</th>
                        <th style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 8px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569' }}>Rate</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {Object.entries(byJob).map(([name, stats]) => (
                        <tr key={name} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9' }}>
                          <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', fontWeight: 500 }}>{name}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'center' }}>{stats.total}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#16a34a' }}>{stats.success}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#dc2626' }}>{stats.failed}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                            <span style={{
                              padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
                              background: stats.total > 0 && stats.success / stats.total >= 0.8 ? '#dcfce7' : '#fef2f2',
                              color: stats.total > 0 && stats.success / stats.total >= 0.8 ? '#16a34a' : '#dc2626',
                            }}>
                              {stats.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.success / stats.total) * 100) : 0}%
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Recent Runs Timeline */}
            <div className="scheduler-section">
              <div className="scheduler-section-header"><span>Recent Runs</span></div>
              <div className="scheduler-section-body">
                {recentRuns.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>No runs recorded yet</div>
                ) : (
                  recentRuns.map((run, ri) => (
                    <div className="scheduler-run-card" key={run.run_id || ri} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
                      <div className="scheduler-run-header">
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                          <span className={`scheduler-run-status ${run.status}`}>{run.status}</span>
                          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, color: '#1e293b' }}>{run.job_name}</span>
                          <span className="scheduler-run-time">{new Date(run.started_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                          {run.duration_ms != null && <span className="scheduler-run-time">({(run.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s)</span>}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {run.error && (
                        <div style={{ padding: '4px 12px 8px', fontSize: 11, color: '#dc2626' }}>Error: {run.error}</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     MAIN RETURN
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  return (
    <div className="scheduler-container" style={{ flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      {/* ── Top Sub-Tab Switcher ──────────────────────────── */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0, borderBottom: '2px solid #e2e8f0', background: '#f8fafc', padding: '0 16px', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <button
          onClick={() => setTopTab('jobs')}
          style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '10px 20px', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
            border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', background: 'transparent',
            borderBottom: topTab === 'jobs' ? '2px solid #3b82f6' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: topTab === 'jobs' ? '#3b82f6' : '#64748b', marginBottom: -2,
            transition: 'all 0.15s',
          }}
        >
          <Clock size={14} /> Scheduler Jobs
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setTopTab('pipelines')}
          style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '10px 20px', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
            border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', background: 'transparent',
            borderBottom: topTab === 'pipelines' ? '2px solid #3b82f6' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: topTab === 'pipelines' ? '#3b82f6' : '#64748b', marginBottom: -2,
            transition: 'all 0.15s',
          }}
        >
          <Workflow size={14} /> Pipelines
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => { setTopTab('cloudJobs'); loadCloudJobs(); }}
          style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '10px 20px', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
            border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', background: 'transparent',
            borderBottom: topTab === 'cloudJobs' ? '2px solid #3b82f6' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: topTab === 'cloudJobs' ? '#3b82f6' : '#64748b', marginBottom: -2,
            transition: 'all 0.15s',
          }}
        >
          <Cloud size={14} /> Cloud Jobs
        </button>
      </div>

      {topTab === 'cloudJobs' ? (
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', padding: 20 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700 }}>Cloud Run Jobs</h3>
            <button onClick={loadCloudJobs} disabled={loadingCloudJobs}
              style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 6, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <RefreshCw size={12} className={loadingCloudJobs ? 'spin' : ''} /> Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
          {loadingCloudJobs && <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 40, color: '#94a3b8' }}><Loader size={20} className="spin" /></div>}
          {!loadingCloudJobs && cloudJobs.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 40, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>
              No Cloud Run Jobs found. Create a scheduler job with "Cloud Run Job" execution mode to see jobs here.
            </div>
          )}
          {cloudJobs.map(cj => {
            const cfg = cj.config || {};
            const lastExec = cj.last_execution;
            const isEditing = editingCloudJob === cj.name;
            const edits = cloudJobEdits[cj.name] || {};
            return (
            <div key={cj.name} style={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e5e7eb', borderRadius: 8, padding: 14, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <Cloud size={14} style={{ color: '#3b82f6' }} />
                    <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14 }}>{cj.name}</span>
                    {lastExec && (
                      <span style={{
                        fontSize: 10, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 10, fontWeight: 600,
                        background: lastExec.succeeded > 0 ? '#dcfce7' : lastExec.failed > 0 ? '#fef2f2' : '#fef9c3',
                        color: lastExec.succeeded > 0 ? '#16a34a' : lastExec.failed > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#ca8a04',
                      }}>
                        {lastExec.succeeded > 0 ? 'Last: Succeeded' : lastExec.failed > 0 ? 'Last: Failed' : 'Last: Running'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {cj.scheduler_job_id && <span>Scheduler Job: <b>{cj.scheduler_job_id}</b> | </span>}
                    Created: {cj.create_time ? new Date(cj.create_time).toLocaleString() : 'N/A'} | Executions: {cj.execution_count || 0}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginTop: 6, fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' }}>
                    <span>CPU: <b>{cfg.cpu || '—'}</b></span>
                    <span>Memory: <b>{cfg.memory || '—'}</b></span>
                    <span>Timeout: <b>{cfg.timeout ? `${cfg.timeout}s` : '—'}</b></span>
                    <span>Retries: <b>{cfg.max_retries ?? '—'}</b></span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  <button onClick={async () => {
                    if (!confirm(`Run Cloud Job "${cj.name}" now?`)) return;
                    try { await sqlEditorAPI.runCloudJob(cj.name); toast.success('Cloud Job triggered'); loadCloudJobs(); }
                    catch (e) { toast.error('Run failed: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message)); }
                  }} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px', border: '1px solid #86efac', borderRadius: 4, background: '#f0fdf4', color: '#16a34a', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                    <Play size={11} /> Run
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => {
                    if (isEditing) { setEditingCloudJob(null); return; }
                    setCloudJobEdits(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: { cpu: cfg.cpu || '1', memory: cfg.memory || '512Mi', timeout: cfg.timeout || 3600, max_retries: cfg.max_retries || 0 } }));
                    setEditingCloudJob(cj.name);
                  }} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600, color: isEditing ? '#3b82f6' : '#374151' }}>
                    <Pencil size={11} /> Edit
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={async () => {
                    if (expandedCloudJob === cj.name) { setExpandedCloudJob(null); return; }
                    try {
                      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getCloudJobExecutions(cj.name);
                      setCloudJobExecs(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: res.data.executions || [] }));
                      setExpandedCloudJob(cj.name);
                    } catch { setExpandedCloudJob(cj.name); }
                  }} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    {expandedCloudJob === cj.name ? <ChevronUp size={11} /> : <ChevronDown size={11} />} History
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={async () => {
                    if (cloudJobLogsFor === cj.name) { setCloudJobLogsFor(null); return; }
                    setLoadingLogs(true);
                    try {
                      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getCloudJobLogs(cj.name);
                      setCloudJobLogs(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: res.data.logs || [] }));
                      setCloudJobLogsFor(cj.name);
                    } catch (e) { toast.error('Failed to load logs: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message)); }
                    finally { setLoadingLogs(false); }
                  }} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, background: cloudJobLogsFor === cj.name ? '#eff6ff' : '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', color: cloudJobLogsFor === cj.name ? '#3b82f6' : '#374151' }}>
                    <Eye size={11} /> Logs
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={async () => {
                    if (!confirm(`Delete Cloud Run Job "${cj.name}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
                    try { await sqlEditorAPI.deleteCloudJob(cj.name); toast.success('Cloud Job deleted'); loadCloudJobs(); }
                    catch (e) { toast.error('Delete failed: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message)); }
                  }} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px', border: '1px solid #fca5a5', borderRadius: 4, background: '#fef2f2', color: '#dc2626', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    <Trash2 size={11} /> Delete
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ── Edit Panel ── */}
              {isEditing && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 12, background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 6 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 10 }}>Edit Configuration</div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                    <div>
                      <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', display: 'block', marginBottom: 3 }}>CPU</label>
                      <select value={edits.cpu || '1'} onChange={e => setCloudJobEdits(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: { ...prev[cj.name], cpu: e.target.value } }))}
                        style={{ width: '100%', padding: '5px 8px', fontSize: 12, border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4 }}>
                        <option value="1">1 vCPU</option><option value="2">2 vCPU</option><option value="4">4 vCPU</option><option value="8">8 vCPU</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', display: 'block', marginBottom: 3 }}>Memory</label>
                      <select value={edits.memory || '512Mi'} onChange={e => setCloudJobEdits(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: { ...prev[cj.name], memory: e.target.value } }))}
                        style={{ width: '100%', padding: '5px 8px', fontSize: 12, border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4 }}>
                        <option value="512Mi">512 Mi</option><option value="1Gi">1 Gi</option><option value="2Gi">2 Gi</option><option value="4Gi">4 Gi</option><option value="8Gi">8 Gi</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', display: 'block', marginBottom: 3 }}>Timeout (sec)</label>
                      <input type="number" min={60} max={86400} value={edits.timeout || 3600}
                        onChange={e => setCloudJobEdits(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: { ...prev[cj.name], timeout: parseInt(e.target.value) || 3600 } }))}
                        style={{ width: '100%', padding: '5px 8px', fontSize: 12, border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4 }} />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', display: 'block', marginBottom: 3 }}>Max Retries</label>
                      <input type="number" min={0} max={10} value={edits.max_retries ?? 0}
                        onChange={e => setCloudJobEdits(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: { ...prev[cj.name], max_retries: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 } }))}
                        style={{ width: '100%', padding: '5px 8px', fontSize: 12, border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4 }} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <button onClick={() => setEditingCloudJob(null)}
                      style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '5px 14px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        await sqlEditorAPI.updateCloudJob(cj.name, edits);
                        toast.success('Cloud Job updated');
                        setEditingCloudJob(null);
                        loadCloudJobs();
                      } catch (e) { toast.error('Update failed: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message)); }
                    }} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, padding: '5px 14px', border: 'none', borderRadius: 4, background: '#3b82f6', color: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                      <Save size={11} /> Save Changes
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ── Logs Panel ── */}
              {cloudJobLogsFor === cj.name && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 12, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 6, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px 12px', background: '#1e293b' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, color: '#e2e8f0' }}>Logs</span>
                    <button onClick={async () => {
                      setLoadingLogs(true);
                      try {
                        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getCloudJobLogs(cj.name);
                        setCloudJobLogs(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: res.data.logs || [] }));
                      } catch (e) { toast.error('Refresh failed'); }
                      finally { setLoadingLogs(false); }
                    }} style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '2px 8px', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: 4, background: '#334155', color: '#e2e8f0', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                      <RefreshCw size={10} className={loadingLogs ? 'spin' : ''} /> Refresh
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ maxHeight: 350, overflow: 'auto', background: '#0f172a', padding: '8px 0', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11 }}>
                    {loadingLogs && <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, color: '#94a3b8' }}><Loader size={14} className="spin" /></div>}
                    {!loadingLogs && (cloudJobLogs[cj.name] || []).length === 0 && (
                      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, color: '#64748b', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No logs available yet</div>
                    )}
                    {!loadingLogs && (cloudJobLogs[cj.name] || []).map((log, i) => (
                      <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, padding: '2px 12px', lineHeight: 1.5, borderBottom: '1px solid #1e293b' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: '#64748b', flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 10 }}>
                          {log.timestamp ? new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString() : ''}
                        </span>
                        <span style={{
                          flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 50,
                          color: log.severity === 'ERROR' ? '#ef4444' : log.severity === 'WARNING' ? '#f59e0b' : log.severity === 'INFO' ? '#3b82f6' : '#94a3b8',
                        }}>
                          {log.severity}
                        </span>
                        <span style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>{log.message}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ── Executions Panel ── */}
              {expandedCloudJob === cj.name && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 10, borderTop: '1px solid #e5e7eb', paddingTop: 10 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 8 }}>Execution History</div>
                  {(cloudJobExecs[cj.name] || []).length === 0 && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No executions found</div>
                  )}
                  {(cloudJobExecs[cj.name] || []).map((ex, i) => (
                    <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center', fontSize: 11, padding: '6px 8px', borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9', borderRadius: 4, background: i % 2 === 0 ? '#f8fafc' : '#fff' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10, minWidth: 80 }}>{ex.name}</span>
                      <span style={{
                        padding: '1px 8px', borderRadius: 10, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 10,
                        background: ex.succeeded_count > 0 ? '#dcfce7' : ex.failed_count > 0 ? '#fef2f2' : '#fef9c3',
                        color: ex.succeeded_count > 0 ? '#16a34a' : ex.failed_count > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#ca8a04',
                      }}>
                        {ex.succeeded_count > 0 ? 'Succeeded' : ex.failed_count > 0 ? 'Failed' : 'Running'}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Started: {ex.create_time ? new Date(ex.create_time).toLocaleString() : '—'}</span>
                      {ex.completion_time && <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>Ended: {new Date(ex.completion_time).toLocaleString()}</span>}
                      <button onClick={async (e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setLoadingLogs(true);
                        try {
                          const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getCloudJobLogs(cj.name, ex.name);
                          setCloudJobLogs(prev => ({ ...prev, [cj.name]: res.data.logs || [] }));
                          setCloudJobLogsFor(cj.name);
                        } catch (err) { toast.error('Failed to load logs'); }
                        finally { setLoadingLogs(false); }
                      }} style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 3, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#3b82f6', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                        <Eye size={9} /> Logs
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : topTab === 'pipelines' ? (
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto' }}><PipelineBuilder /></div>
      ) : (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* ── Sidebar ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="scheduler-sidebar">
        <div className="scheduler-sidebar-header">
          <h3>Scheduler Jobs</h3>
          <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-primary" onClick={openNewJob}><Plus size={12} /> New</button>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-job-list">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="scheduler-loading"><Loader size={16} className="scheduler-spinner" /> Loading…</div>
          ) : jobs.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '20px 0', fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8' }}>No jobs yet</div>
          ) : (
            jobs.map(j => (
              <div key={j.id}
                className={`scheduler-job-card ${selectedJobId === j.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => openEditJob(j)}>
                <div className="scheduler-job-card-header">
                  <span className="scheduler-job-card-name">{j.name}</span>
                  <span className={`scheduler-job-card-status ${j.enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}`}>
                    {j.enabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
