                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="scheduler-job-card-meta">
                  {j.schedule_type} · {(j.steps || []).length} steps
                  {(j.dependencies || []).length > 0 && ` · ${(j.dependencies || []).length} dep${(j.dependencies || []).length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`}
                  {j.last_run_status && ` · ${j.last_run_status}`}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Main panel ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="scheduler-main">
        {/* Toolbar */}
        <div className="scheduler-toolbar">
          <div className="scheduler-toolbar-left">
            <button className={`scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm ${view === 'list' ? 'scheduler-btn-primary' : 'scheduler-btn-outline'}`} onClick={() => setView('list')}>
              All Jobs
            </button>
            <button className={`scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm ${view === 'dashboard' ? 'scheduler-btn-primary' : 'scheduler-btn-outline'}`} onClick={loadDashboard}>
              Dashboard
            </button>
            {view === 'edit' && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                {isNew ? '+ New Job' : `Editing: ${form.name || 'Untitled'}`}
              </span>
            )}
            {view === 'history' && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>Run History</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-toolbar-right">
            {view === 'edit' && (
              <>
                {!isNew && selectedJobId && (
                  <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-success" onClick={() => runJob(selectedJobId)} disabled={running}>
                    {running ? <Loader size={12} className="scheduler-spinner" /> : <Play size={12} />} Run Now
                  </button>
                )}
                {!isNew && selectedJobId && (
                  <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => viewHistory(selectedJobId)}>
                    <Eye size={12} /> History
                  </button>
                )}
                <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-primary" onClick={saveJob} disabled={saving}>
                  {saving ? <Loader size={12} className="scheduler-spinner" /> : <Save size={12} />} {isNew ? 'Create' : 'Save'}
                </button>
                <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => setView('list')}>
                  <X size={12} /> Cancel
                </button>
              </>
            )}
            {view === 'history' && (
              <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline"
                onClick={() => { if (selectedJobId) openEditJob(jobs.find(j => j.id === selectedJobId)); else setView('list'); }}>
                <Pencil size={12} /> Edit Job
              </button>
            )}
            <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" title="Refresh" onClick={loadJobs}><RefreshCw size={14} /></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        {view === 'list'      && renderJobList()}
        {view === 'edit'      && renderJobEditor()}
        {view === 'history'   && renderRunHistory()}
        {view === 'dashboard' && renderDashboard()}
      </div>

      {/* Template Picker Modal */}
      {showTemplates && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', zIndex: 1000,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 20,
        }} onClick={() => setShowTemplates(false)}>
          <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{
            background: '#fff', borderRadius: 12, maxWidth: 700, width: '100%', maxHeight: '80vh',
            overflow: 'auto', boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
          }}>
            <div style={{ padding: '20px 24px 12px', borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
              <h3 style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b', margin: 0 }}>Choose a Template</h3>
              <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 4 }}>Select a pre-built template or start from scratch</p>
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: 16, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
              {JOB_TEMPLATES.map((t, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  onClick={() => applyTemplate(t)}
                  style={{
                    padding: 16, borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s', background: '#fff',
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={e => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = '#93c5fd'; e.currentTarget.style.background = '#f0f9ff'; }}
                  onMouseLeave={e => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = '#e2e8f0'; e.currentTarget.style.background = '#fff'; }}
                >
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 28, marginBottom: 8 }}>{t.icon}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b', marginBottom: 4 }}>{t.name}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{t.description}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: 8 }}>
                    {t.steps.length} step{t.steps.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} · {t.schedule_type}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/SavedQueries.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { Heart, Trash2, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { copyToClipboard, truncateString } from '../utils/helpers';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export const SavedQueries = ({ onSelectQuery }) => {
  const { favorites, removeFavorite } = useQueryStore();

  const handleSelectQuery = (query) => {
    if (onSelectQuery) {
      onSelectQuery(query);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFavorite = (e, id) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    removeFavorite(id);
    toast.success('Removed from favorites');
  };

  const handleCopyQuery = (e, query) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    copyToClipboard(query, 'Query copied!');
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
        <Heart size={20} className="text-red-600 fill-current" />
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">Saved Queries</h3>
        <span className="text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700 px-2 py-1 rounded">
          {favorites.length}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
        {favorites.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-8">No saved queries</p>
        ) : (
          favorites.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              onClick={() => handleSelectQuery(item.query)}
              className="group p-3 bg-yellow-50 rounded hover:bg-yellow-100 border border-transparent hover:border-yellow-300 cursor-pointer transition"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 font-mono break-all">
                    {truncateString(item.query, 100)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition flex-shrink-0">
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => handleCopyQuery(e, item.query)}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded"
                    title="Copy query"
                  >
                    <Copy size={16} className="text-blue-600" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => handleRemoveFavorite(e, item.id)}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-red-100 rounded"
                    title="Remove from favorites"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={16} className="text-red-600" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SavedQueries;


src/components/QueryResults.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useCallback, useState as useStateR } from 'react';
import { Download, Copy, Edit3, Save, Trash2, Plus, X, RefreshCw, Zap, BarChart3, Grid3X3, Database } from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { useDataMutation } from '../hooks/useDataMutation';
import { downloadFile, copyToClipboard } from '../utils/helpers';
import ChartView from './ChartView';
import PivotTable from './PivotTable';
import PgVectorModal from './PgVectorModal';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export const QueryResults = ({ onConvertToAPI }) => {
  const {
    queryResult,
    selectedDatabase,
    resultFormat,
    setResultFormat,
    editMode,
    editedCells,
    selectedRows,
    newRows,
    primaryKeys,
    savingData,
    toggleEditMode,
    setCellEdited,
    toggleRowSelection,
    selectAllRows,
    addNewRow,
    updateNewRow,
    removeNewRow,
    clearEdits,
    databaseType,
  } = useQueryStore();

  const [displayedRows, setDisplayedRows] = React.useState(10);
  const [pgvectorOpen, setPgvectorOpen] = useStateR(false);
  const [pgvectorContext, setPgvectorContext] = useStateR({});

  const {
    fetchPrimaryKeys,
    saveAll,
    deleteAndRefresh,
    refreshData,
  } = useDataMutation();

  // When edit mode is toggled ON, fetch primary keys
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editMode && primaryKeys.length === 0) {
      fetchPrimaryKeys();
    }
  }, [editMode]);

  if (!queryResult) {
    return (
      <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 rounded border border-gray-200">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-500 text-lg mb-2">No results yet</p>
          <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Execute a query to see results</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!queryResult.success) {
    return (
      <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-red-50 rounded border border-red-200">
        <div className="text-center max-w-md">
          <p className="text-red-600 font-semibold mb-2">Query Error</p>
          <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{queryResult.message}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const data = queryResult.data || [];
  const columns = queryResult.columns || [];
  const rowsToShow = data.slice(0, displayedRows);
  const hasEdits = Object.keys(editedCells).length > 0 || newRows.length > 0;
  const hasSelections = selectedRows.size > 0;

  // ── Download / Copy handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleDownloadCSV = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await sqlEditorAPI.downloadCSV(queryResult.database, queryResult.query);
      const blob = response.data;
      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      downloadFile(blob, `query_results_${timestamp}.csv`, 'text/csv');
      toast.success('CSV downloaded successfully');
    } catch (error) { toast.error('Failed to download CSV'); }
  };

  const handleDownloadJSON = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await sqlEditorAPI.downloadJSON(queryResult.database, queryResult.query);
      const blob = response.data;
      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      downloadFile(blob, `query_results_${timestamp}.json`, 'application/json');
      toast.success('JSON downloaded successfully');
    } catch (error) { toast.error('Failed to download JSON'); }
  };

  const handleCopyAsJSON = async () => {
    const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
    await copyToClipboard(jsonStr, 'Results copied as JSON');
  };

  const handleCopyAsCSV = async () => {
    if (data.length === 0) return;
    const headers = columns.join(',');
    const rows = data.map((row) =>
      columns.map((col) => {
        const value = row[col];
        if (typeof value === 'string' && (value.includes(',') || value.includes('"'))) {
          return `"${value.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        }
        return value;
      }).join(',')
    );
    const csv = [headers, ...rows].join('\n');
    await copyToClipboard(csv, 'Results copied as CSV');
  };

  // ── Cell value helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const getCellValue = (rowIdx, col) => {
    const key = `${rowIdx}-${col}`;
    if (key in editedCells) return editedCells[key];
    const row = data[rowIdx];
    if (!row) return '';
    const val = row[col];
    return val === null || val === undefined ? '' : typeof val === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(val) : String(val);
  };

  const isCellEdited = (rowIdx, col) => `${rowIdx}-${col}` in editedCells;

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <>
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col gap-4">
      {/* Stats and Actions */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
          {/* Left: stats */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
              <span className="font-semibold text-blue-600">{queryResult.row_count}</span> rows returned
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              Execution time: <span className="font-mono">{queryResult.execution_time_ms}ms</span>
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              Database: <span className="font-semibold">{queryResult.database}</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Right: actions */}
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap items-center">
            {/* Edit mode toggle */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                if (!editMode) fetchPrimaryKeys();
                toggleEditMode();
              }}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 rounded text-sm font-medium transition ${
                editMode
                  ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 ring-2 ring-yellow-400'
                  : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200'
              }`}
              title={editMode ? 'Cancel editing' : 'Enable editing'}
            >
              {editMode ? <X size={16} /> : <Edit3 size={16} />}
              {editMode ? 'Cancel' : 'Edit'}
            </button>

            {/* CRUD buttons (visible only in edit mode) */}
            {editMode && (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={() => addNewRow(columns)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded hover:bg-green-200 transition text-sm"
                  title="Add new row"
                >
                  <Plus size={16} /> Add Row
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={saveAll}
                  disabled={savingData || !hasEdits}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition text-sm"
                  title="Save all changes"
                >
                  <Save size={16} /> {savingData ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => toast.error('⚠️ Delete function is temporarily disabled. Please contact admin for delete operations on Production.')}
                  disabled={true}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition text-sm"
                  title="Delete is disabled in Production — contact admin"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={16} /> Delete (Disabled)
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={refreshData}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded hover:bg-gray-200 transition text-sm"
                  title="Refresh data"
                >
                  <RefreshCw size={16} />
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            {/* View / export controls */}
            <select
              value={resultFormat}
              onChange={(e) => setResultFormat(e.target.value)}
              className="px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
            >
              <option value="table">Table View</option>
              <option value="chart">Chart View</option>
              <option value="pivot">Pivot Table</option>
              <option value="json">JSON View</option>
              <option value="csv">CSV View</option>
            </select>

            <button onClick={handleDownloadCSV} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded hover:bg-green-200 transition text-sm" title="Download as CSV">
              <Download size={16} /> CSV
            </button>

            <button onClick={handleDownloadJSON} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 rounded hover:bg-purple-200 transition text-sm" title="Download as JSON">
              <Download size={16} /> JSON
            </button>

            <button onClick={handleCopyAsJSON} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded hover:bg-blue-200 transition text-sm" title="Copy as JSON">
              <Copy size={16} /> JSON
            </button>

            <button onClick={handleCopyAsCSV} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded hover:bg-blue-200 transition text-sm" title="Copy as CSV">
              <Copy size={16} /> CSV
            </button>

            {/* Convert to API button */}
            {onConvertToAPI && (
              <button
                onClick={() => onConvertToAPI({
                  query: queryResult.query,
                  database: selectedDatabase || queryResult.database,
                  columns: queryResult.columns || [],
                  row_count: queryResult.row_count,
                  databaseType: databaseType || 'cloudsql',
                })}
                // className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white rounded hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-600 transition text-sm font-medium shadow-sm"
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 to-indigo-800 text-white rounded hover:from-blue-800 hover:to-indigo-900 transition text-sm font-medium shadow-sm"
                title="Convert this query to a Custom API"
              >
                <Zap size={16} /> Convert to API
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Convert to PgVector button */}
            {(databaseType === 'cloudsql' || !databaseType) && (
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setPgvectorContext({
                    database: selectedDatabase || queryResult.database,
                    columns: queryResult.columns || [],
                    sourceTable: queryResult.query
                      ? (queryResult.query.match(/\bFROM\s+["']?(\w+)["']?/i) || [])[1] || ''
                      : '',
                  });
                  setPgvectorOpen(true);
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-600 to-purple-700 text-white rounded hover:from-violet-700 hover:to-purple-800 transition text-sm font-medium shadow-sm"
                title="Convert this table/result to a PgVector table for RAG"
              >
                <Database size={16} /> PgVector
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Edit-mode notice */}
        {editMode && (
          <div className="mt-3 p-2 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded text-xs text-yellow-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Edit3 size={14} />
            <span>
              <strong>Edit mode ON</strong> — Click any cell to edit.
              Use checkboxes to select rows for deletion.
              {primaryKeys.length > 0
                ? ` Primary key: ${primaryKeys.join(', ')}`
                : ' ⚠ No primary key detected – updates may not work.'}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Results View */}
      <div className="flex-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded overflow-auto">
        {resultFormat === 'table' && (
          <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
            {data.length === 0 && newRows.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                <p>No data returned from query</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <table className="w-full border-collapse text-sm">
                  <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-gray-100 z-10">
                    <tr className="border-b border-gray-300">
                      {/* Checkbox header */}
                      {editMode && (
                        <th className="px-2 py-3 text-center border-r border-gray-300 w-10">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={selectedRows.size === data.length && data.length > 0}
                            onChange={() => selectAllRows(data.length)}
                            className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600"
                          />
                        </th>
                      )}
                      {columns.map((col) => (
                        <th
                          key={col}
                          className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-gray-700 border-r border-gray-300 last:border-r-0"
                        >
                          {col}
                          {primaryKeys.includes(col) && (
                            <span className="ml-1 text-xs text-blue-500" title="Primary key">🔑</span>
                          )}
                        </th>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody>
                    {/* ─── Existing rows ──────────────────────────────────── */}
                    {rowsToShow.map((row, idx) => (
                      <tr
                        key={idx}
                        className={`border-b border-gray-200 transition ${
                          selectedRows.has(idx)
                            ? 'bg-red-50'
                            : 'hover:bg-blue-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {editMode && (
                          <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center border-r border-gray-200 w-10">
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              checked={selectedRows.has(idx)}
                              onChange={() => toggleRowSelection(idx)}
                              className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600"
                            />
                          </td>
                        )}
                        {columns.map((col) => (
                          <td
                            key={`${idx}-${col}`}
                            className={`px-4 py-2 border-r border-gray-200 last:border-r-0 text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words max-w-xs ${
                              isCellEdited(idx, col) ? 'bg-yellow-100 ring-1 ring-yellow-400' : ''
                            }`}
                          >
                            {editMode && !primaryKeys.includes(col) ? (
                              <input
                                type="text"
                                value={getCellValue(idx, col)}
                                onChange={(e) => setCellEdited(idx, col, e.target.value)}
                                className="w-full bg-transparent border-none outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-sm"
                              />
                            ) : (
                              typeof row[col] === 'object'
                                ? JSON.stringify(row[col])
                                : String(row[col] ?? '')
                            )}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                      </tr>
                    ))}

                    {/* ─── New rows (unsaved) ────────────────────────────── */}
                    {newRows.map((nRow, nIdx) => (
                      <tr
                        key={`new-${nIdx}`}
                        className="border-b border-gray-200 bg-green-50"
                      >
                        {editMode && (
                          <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center border-r border-gray-200 w-10">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => removeNewRow(nIdx)}
                              className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700"
                              title="Remove unsaved row"
                            >
                              <X size={14} />
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        )}
                        {columns.map((col) => (
                          <td
                            key={`new-${nIdx}-${col}`}
                            className="px-4 py-2 border-r border-gray-200 last:border-r-0"
                          >
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={nRow[col] ?? ''}
                              onChange={(e) => updateNewRow(nIdx, col, e.target.value)}
                              placeholder={col}
                              className="w-full bg-transparent border-none outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-sm placeholder:text-gray-300"
                            />
                          </td>
                        ))}
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>

                {displayedRows < data.length && (
                  <div className="p-4 text-center border-t border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setDisplayedRows((prev) => prev + 10)}
                      className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700 transition"
                    >
                      Load More ({displayedRows} of {data.length})
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {resultFormat === 'chart' && (
          <ChartView
            data={data}
            columns={columns}
            onClose={() => setResultFormat('table')}
          />
        )}

        {resultFormat === 'pivot' && (
          <PivotTable
            data={data}
            columns={columns}
            onClose={() => setResultFormat('table')}
          />
        )}

        {resultFormat === 'json' && (
          <div className="p-4">
            <pre className="bg-gray-50 rounded p-4 overflow-auto text-xs font-mono text-gray-800">
              {JSON.stringify(data.slice(0, displayedRows), null, 2)}
            </pre>
            {displayedRows < data.length && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setDisplayedRows((prev) => prev + 10)}
                className="mt-4 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700 transition"
              >
                Load More
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {resultFormat === 'csv' && (
          <div className="p-4">
            <pre className="bg-gray-50 rounded p-4 overflow-auto text-xs font-mono text-gray-800 whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {[
                columns.join(','),
                ...rowsToShow.map((row) =>
                  columns.map((col) => row[col] ?? '').join(',')
                ),
              ].join('\n')}
            </pre>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>

    <PgVectorModal
      isOpen={pgvectorOpen}
      onClose={() => setPgvectorOpen(false)}
      context={pgvectorContext}
    />
    </>
  );
};

export default QueryResults;




src/components/QueryLibrary.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Search, Plus, Heart, Star, MessageCircle, Share2, Copy, Eye, Edit3, Trash2,
  RefreshCw, Filter, Tag, Database, Clock, User, ThumbsUp, BookOpen, X, Send,
  ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Code2, ArrowUpDown, Bookmark
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './QueryLibrary.css';

const SORT_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'recent', label: 'Most Recent' },
  { value: 'popular', label: 'Most Liked' },
  { value: 'most_used', label: 'Most Used' },
];

export default function QueryLibrary() {
  // ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [queries, setQueries] = useState([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('recent');
  const [tagFilter, setTagFilter] = useState('');
  const [allTags, setAllTags] = useState([]);
  const [showMine, setShowMine] = useState(false);
  const [showFavs, setShowFavs] = useState(false);

  // Save modal
  const [showSaveModal, setShowSaveModal] = useState(false);
  const [saveForm, setSaveForm] = useState({ title: '', description: '', query_text: '', database_name: '', db_type: 'cloudsql', tags: '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);

  // Detail / comments
  const [selectedQuery, setSelectedQuery] = useState(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [loadingComments, setLoadingComments] = useState(false);

  // ── Load queries ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadQueries = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getLibraryQueries({ search, sort: sortBy, tag: tagFilter, mine: showMine, favorites_only: showFavs });
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setQueries(body.queries || []);
      setTotal(body.total || 0);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || e.message || 'Failed to load queries');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [search, sortBy, tagFilter, showMine, showFavs]);

  const loadTags = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getLibraryTags();
      setAllTags((res?.data ?? res).tags || []);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadQueries(); }, [loadQueries]);
  useEffect(() => { loadTags(); }, [loadTags]);

  // ── Actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const toggleLike = async (q) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.toggleLibraryLike(q.id);
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setQueries(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === q.id ? { ...p, liked_by_me: body.liked, like_count: body.like_count } : p));
      if (selectedQuery?.id === q.id) setSelectedQuery(s => ({ ...s, liked_by_me: body.liked, like_count: body.like_count }));
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const toggleFav = async (q) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.toggleLibraryFavorite(q.id);
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setQueries(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === q.id ? { ...p, faved_by_me: body.favorited, fav_count: body.fav_count } : p));
      if (selectedQuery?.id === q.id) setSelectedQuery(s => ({ ...s, faved_by_me: body.favorited, fav_count: body.fav_count }));
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const copyQuery = (text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast('SQL copied to clipboard!');
  };

  const shareQuery = async (q) => {
    const shareData = {
      title: q.title,
      text: `${q.title}\n\n${q.description || ''}\n\nSQL:\n${q.query_text}`,
    };
    // Try native Web Share API first (works on mobile + some desktops)
    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share(shareData);
        return;
      } catch { /* user cancelled or not supported — fall through */ }
    }
    // Fallback: copy formatted text to clipboard
    const text = `📋 Query Library — ${q.title}\n${q.description ? q.description + '\n' : ''}\nDatabase: ${q.database_name || 'N/A'} (${q.db_type || 'cloudsql'})\nAuthor: ${q.user_id}\n\n--- SQL ---\n${q.query_text}\n-----------`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast('Query details copied to clipboard for sharing!');
  };

  // ── Save / Update ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const openSaveModal = (q = null) => {
    if (q) {
      setEditingId(q.id);
      setSaveForm({ title: q.title, description: q.description || '', query_text: q.query_text, database_name: q.database_name || '', db_type: q.db_type || 'cloudsql', tags: q.tags || '' });
    } else {
      setEditingId(null);
      setSaveForm({ title: '', description: '', query_text: '', database_name: '', db_type: 'cloudsql', tags: '' });
    }
    setShowSaveModal(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!saveForm.title.trim() || !saveForm.query_text.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (editingId) {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateLibraryQuery(editingId, saveForm);
      } else {
        await sqlEditorAPI.saveLibraryQuery(saveForm);
      }
      setShowSaveModal(false);
      loadQueries();
      loadTags();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this query from the library?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteLibraryQuery(id);
      if (selectedQuery?.id === id) setSelectedQuery(null);
      loadQueries();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  // ── Detail / Comments ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const openDetail = async (q) => {
    setSelectedQuery(q);
    setLoadingComments(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getLibraryComments(q.id);
      setComments((res?.data ?? res).comments || []);
    } catch { setComments([]); }
    finally { setLoadingComments(false); }
  };

  const addComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !selectedQuery) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.addLibraryComment(selectedQuery.id, newComment.trim());
      setNewComment('');
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getLibraryComments(selectedQuery.id);
      setComments((res?.data ?? res).comments || []);
      setQueries(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === selectedQuery.id ? { ...p, comment_count: (p.comment_count || 0) + 1 } : p));
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const deleteComment = async (cid) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteLibraryComment(cid);
      setComments(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== cid));
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  // ── Current user ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const currentUser = useMemo(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sql_editor_user'))?.vzid || ''; } catch { return ''; }
  }, []);

  // ── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div className="ql-container">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="ql-header">
        <div className="ql-title-row">
          <div className="ql-title">
            <BookOpen size={22} />
            <h2>Query Library</h2>
            <span className="ql-count">{total} queries</span>
          </div>
          <button className="ql-btn ql-btn-primary" onClick={() => openSaveModal()}>
            <Plus size={14} /> Share a Query
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="ql-controls">
          <div className="ql-search-box">
            <Search size={14} />
            <input placeholder="Search queries, titles, descriptions…" value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <select className="ql-select" value={sortBy} onChange={e => setSortBy(e.target.value)}>
            {SORT_OPTIONS.map(o => <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select className="ql-select" value={tagFilter} onChange={e => setTagFilter(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">All Tags</option>
            {allTags.map(t => <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
          </select>
          <button className={`ql-toggle ${showMine ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setShowMine(!showMine); setShowFavs(false); }}>
            <User size={13} /> My Queries
          </button>
          <button className={`ql-toggle ${showFavs ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setShowFavs(!showFavs); setShowMine(false); }}>
            <Star size={13} /> Favorites
          </button>
          <button className="ql-btn" onClick={loadQueries} title="Refresh">
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={loading ? 'spin' : ''} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="ql-error">{error} <button onClick={() => setError('')}>✕</button></div>}

      {/* Content area */}
      <div className="ql-body">
        {/* Cards list */}
        <div className={`ql-cards ${selectedQuery ? 'ql-cards-narrow' : ''}`}>
          {loading && queries.length === 0 && <div className="ql-loading">Loading…</div>}
          {!loading && queries.length === 0 && (
            <div className="ql-empty">
              <BookOpen size={40} />
              <h3>No queries found</h3>
              <p>Be the first to share a query with the team!</p>
              <button className="ql-btn ql-btn-primary" onClick={() => openSaveModal()}>
                <Plus size={14} /> Share a Query
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          {queries.map(q => (
            <div key={q.id} className={`ql-card ${selectedQuery?.id === q.id ? 'ql-card-active' : ''}`} onClick={() => openDetail(q)}>
              <div className="ql-card-header">
                <h3 className="ql-card-title">{q.title}</h3>
                <div className="ql-card-meta">
                  <span className="ql-card-user"><User size={11} /> {q.user_id}</span>
                  <span className="ql-card-time"><Clock size={11} /> {new Date(q.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                  {q.database_name && <span className="ql-card-db"><Database size={11} /> {q.database_name}</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
              {q.description && <p className="ql-card-desc">{q.description.slice(0, 120)}{q.description.length > 120 ? '…' : ''}</p>}
              <pre className="ql-card-sql">{q.query_text.slice(0, 200)}{q.query_text.length > 200 ? '…' : ''}</pre>
              {q.tags && (
                <div className="ql-card-tags">
                  {q.tags.split(',').filter(Boolean).map(t => (
                    <span key={t} className="ql-tag" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); setTagFilter(t.trim()); }}>{t.trim()}</span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="ql-card-actions" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <button className={`ql-action-btn ${q.liked_by_me ? 'liked' : ''}`} onClick={() => toggleLike(q)} title="Like">
                  <Heart size={13} fill={q.liked_by_me ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} /> {q.like_count || 0}
                </button>
                <button className={`ql-action-btn ${q.faved_by_me ? 'faved' : ''}`} onClick={() => toggleFav(q)} title="Favorite">
                  <Star size={13} fill={q.faved_by_me ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} /> {q.fav_count || 0}
                </button>
                <button className="ql-action-btn" title="Comments">
                  <MessageCircle size={13} /> {q.comment_count || 0}
                </button>
                <button className="ql-action-btn" onClick={() => copyQuery(q.query_text)} title="Copy SQL">
                  <Copy size={13} />
                </button>
                <button className="ql-action-btn" onClick={() => shareQuery(q)} title="Share">
                  <Share2 size={13} />
                </button>
                {q.user_id === currentUser && (
                  <>
                    <button className="ql-action-btn" onClick={() => openSaveModal(q)} title="Edit">
                      <Edit3 size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button className="ql-action-btn danger" onClick={() => handleDelete(q.id)} title="Delete">
                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Detail panel */}
        {selectedQuery && (
          <div className="ql-detail">
            <div className="ql-detail-header">
              <h3>{selectedQuery.title}</h3>
              <button className="ql-close-btn" onClick={() => setSelectedQuery(null)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="ql-detail-meta">
              <span><User size={12} /> {selectedQuery.user_id}</span>
              <span><Clock size={12} /> {new Date(selectedQuery.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
              {selectedQuery.database_name && <span><Database size={12} /> {selectedQuery.database_name}</span>}
              <span><Eye size={12} /> {selectedQuery.use_count || 0} uses</span>
            </div>
            {selectedQuery.description && <p className="ql-detail-desc">{selectedQuery.description}</p>}
            <div className="ql-detail-sql-wrap">
              <div className="ql-detail-sql-header">
                <span><Code2 size={13} /> SQL</span>
                <button className="ql-btn-sm" onClick={() => copyQuery(selectedQuery.query_text)}><Copy size={12} /> Copy</button>
              </div>
              <pre className="ql-detail-sql">{selectedQuery.query_text}</pre>
            </div>
            <div className="ql-detail-actions">
              <button className={`ql-action-btn ${selectedQuery.liked_by_me ? 'liked' : ''}`} onClick={() => toggleLike(selectedQuery)}>
                <Heart size={14} fill={selectedQuery.liked_by_me ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} /> {selectedQuery.like_count || 0} Likes
              </button>
              <button className={`ql-action-btn ${selectedQuery.faved_by_me ? 'faved' : ''}`} onClick={() => toggleFav(selectedQuery)}>
                <Star size={14} fill={selectedQuery.faved_by_me ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} /> {selectedQuery.fav_count || 0} Favorites
              </button>
              <button className="ql-action-btn" onClick={() => shareQuery(selectedQuery)}>
                <Share2 size={14} /> Share
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Comments */}
            <div className="ql-comments">
              <h4><MessageCircle size={14} /> Comments</h4>
              <div className="ql-comment-input">
                <input placeholder="Add a comment…" value={newComment} onChange={e => setNewComment(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && addComment()} />
                <button onClick={addComment} disabled={!newComment.trim()}><Send size={13} /></button>
              </div>
              {loadingComments && <div className="ql-loading-sm">Loading comments…</div>}
              <div className="ql-comment-list">
                {comments.map(c => (
                  <div key={c.id} className="ql-comment">
                    <div className="ql-comment-header">
                      <span className="ql-comment-user"><User size={11} /> {c.user_id}</span>
                      <span className="ql-comment-time">{new Date(c.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                      {(c.user_id === currentUser) && (
                        <button className="ql-comment-delete" onClick={() => deleteComment(c.id)}><Trash2 size={11} /></button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p>{c.comment}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {!loadingComments && comments.length === 0 && <p className="ql-no-comments">No comments yet</p>}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Save / Edit Modal */}
      {showSaveModal && (
        <div className="ql-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowSaveModal(false)}>
          <div className="ql-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="ql-modal-header">
              <h3>{editingId ? 'Edit Query' : 'Share a Query'}</h3>
              <button className="ql-close-btn" onClick={() => setShowSaveModal(false)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="ql-modal-body">
              <label>Title <span className="ql-required">*</span></label>
              <input className="ql-input" placeholder="e.g. Get top 10 users by revenue" value={saveForm.title} onChange={e => setSaveForm(f => ({ ...f, title: e.target.value }))} />

              <label>Description</label>
              <textarea className="ql-textarea" placeholder="What does this query do? When should someone use it?" rows={3} value={saveForm.description} onChange={e => setSaveForm(f => ({ ...f, description: e.target.value }))} />

              <label>SQL Query <span className="ql-required">*</span></label>
              <textarea className="ql-textarea ql-textarea-sql" placeholder="SELECT ..." rows={6} value={saveForm.query_text} onChange={e => setSaveForm(f => ({ ...f, query_text: e.target.value }))} />

              <div className="ql-form-row">
                <div className="ql-form-group">
                  <label>Database</label>
                  <input className="ql-input" placeholder="Database name" value={saveForm.database_name} onChange={e => setSaveForm(f => ({ ...f, database_name: e.target.value }))} />
                </div>
                <div className="ql-form-group">
                  <label>Type</label>
                  <select className="ql-input" value={saveForm.db_type} onChange={e => setSaveForm(f => ({ ...f, db_type: e.target.value }))}>
                    <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                    <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                    <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <label>Tags <span className="ql-hint">(comma-separated)</span></label>
              <input className="ql-input" placeholder="e.g. analytics, reporting, finance" value={saveForm.tags} onChange={e => setSaveForm(f => ({ ...f, tags: e.target.value }))} />
            </div>
            <div className="ql-modal-footer">
              <button className="ql-btn" onClick={() => setShowSaveModal(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button className="ql-btn ql-btn-primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving || !saveForm.title.trim() || !saveForm.query_text.trim()}>
                {saving ? 'Saving…' : editingId ? 'Update' : 'Share Query'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/QueryHistory.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { History, Trash2, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { formatDate, copyToClipboard, truncateString } from '../utils/helpers';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export const QueryHistory = ({ onSelectQuery }) => {
  const { queryHistory, clearQueryHistory } = useQueryStore();

  const handleSelectQuery = (query) => {
    if (onSelectQuery) {
      onSelectQuery(query);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyQuery = (e, query) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    copyToClipboard(query, 'Query copied!');
  };

  const handleClearHistory = () => {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear all query history?')) {
      clearQueryHistory();
      toast.success('History cleared');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <History size={20} className="text-blue-600" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">Query History</h3>
          <span className="text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 px-2 py-1 rounded">
            {queryHistory.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        {queryHistory.length > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={handleClearHistory}
            className="text-xs px-2 py-1 text-red-600 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 rounded transition"
          >
            Clear
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
        {queryHistory.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-8">No query history</p>
        ) : (
          queryHistory.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              onClick={() => handleSelectQuery(item.query)}
              className="group p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded hover:bg-blue-50 border border-transparent hover:border-blue-200 cursor-pointer transition"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">
                    {formatDate(item.timestamp)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 font-mono break-all">
                    {truncateString(item.query, 100)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={(e) => handleCopyQuery(e, item.query)}
                  className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition flex-shrink-0 p-1 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded"
                  title="Copy query"
                >
                  <Copy size={16} className="text-blue-600" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default QueryHistory;





src/components/QueryForms.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { FileText, Plus, Trash2, Play, Copy, Share2, Edit3, Eye, RefreshCw, X, ChevronLeft, Globe, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './QueryForms.css';

const QueryForms = () => {
  const [forms, setForms] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('list'); // 'list' | 'create' | 'execute'
  const [databases, setDatabases] = useState([]);

  // ── Create / Edit state ──────────────────────────────────────
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '', description: '', query_text: '', database_name: 'postgres', db_type: 'cloudsql', is_public: false, parameters: [],
  });

  // ── Execute state ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [execForm, setExecForm] = useState(null);
  const [execParams, setExecParams] = useState({});
  const [execResult, setExecResult] = useState(null);
  const [executing, setExecuting] = useState(false);

  const loadForms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listQueryForms();
      setForms(res.data?.forms || []);
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load forms');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadDatabases = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases('cloudsql');
      const dbs = (res.data?.databases || []).map(d => typeof d === 'string' ? d : d.name || d.database_name || String(d));
      setDatabases(dbs);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadForms(); loadDatabases(); }, [loadForms, loadDatabases]);

  // ── Auto-parse parameters from query text ────────────────────
  const parseParams = async (queryText) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.parseFormParams(queryText);
      if (res.data?.parameters) {
        setFormData(f => ({ ...f, parameters: res.data.parameters }));
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const handleQueryChange = (val) => {
    setFormData(f => ({ ...f, query_text: val }));
  };

  const handleDetectParams = () => {
    if (formData.query_text) parseParams(formData.query_text);
  };

  // ── Save (create or update) ───────────────────────────────────
  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!formData.name.trim()) { toast.error('Name is required'); return; }
    if (!formData.query_text.trim()) { toast.error('Query is required'); return; }
    try {
      if (editId) {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateQueryForm(editId, formData);
        toast.success('Form updated');
      } else {
        await sqlEditorAPI.createQueryForm(formData);
        toast.success('Form created');
      }
      resetForm();
      setActiveTab('list');
      loadForms();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to save form');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this form?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteQueryForm(id);
      toast.success('Form deleted');
      loadForms();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (form) => {
    setEditId(form.id);
    setFormData({
      name: form.name || '',
      description: form.description || '',
      query_text: form.query_text || '',
      database_name: form.database_name || 'postgres',
      db_type: form.db_type || 'cloudsql',
      is_public: form.is_public || false,
      parameters: form.parameters || [],
    });
    setActiveTab('create');
  };

  const handleExecuteOpen = (form) => {
    setExecForm(form);
    const defaults = {};
    (form.parameters || []).forEach(p => { defaults[p.name] = p.default || ''; });
    setExecParams(defaults);
    setExecResult(null);
    setActiveTab('execute');
  };

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    if (!execForm) return;
    setExecuting(true);
    setExecResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeQueryForm(execForm.id, execParams);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setExecResult(res.data);
        toast.success(`${res.data.row_count || 0} rows returned`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Execution failed');
    } finally {
      setExecuting(false);
    }
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setFormData({ name: '', description: '', query_text: '', database_name: 'postgres', db_type: 'cloudsql', is_public: false, parameters: [] });
  };

  const copyShareLink = (form) => {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/forms/public/${form.share_token}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => toast.success('Share link copied!')).catch(() => toast.error('Copy failed'));
  };

  // ── Remove / add parameter rows ──────────────────────────────
  const addParam = () => {
    setFormData(f => ({ ...f, parameters: [...f.parameters, { name: '', label: '', type: 'text', default: '', required: true }] }));
  };
  const removeParam = (idx) => {
    setFormData(f => ({ ...f, parameters: f.parameters.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) }));
  };
  const updateParam = (idx, key, val) => {
    setFormData(f => ({
      ...f,
      parameters: f.parameters.map((p, i) => i === idx ? { ...p, [key]: val } : p),
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="query-forms">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="qf-header">
        <h2>Query Forms</h2>
        <p>Turn queries into shareable forms with input fields — non-technical users fill in parameters and get results</p>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="qf-toolbar">
        <div className="qf-tabs">
          <button className={`qf-tab ${activeTab === 'list' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setActiveTab('list'); resetForm(); }}>
            My Forms
          </button>
          <button className={`qf-tab ${activeTab === 'create' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setActiveTab('create'); if (editId) resetForm(); }}>
            {editId ? 'Edit Form' : 'Create New'}
          </button>
          {execForm && (
            <button className={`qf-tab ${activeTab === 'execute' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setActiveTab('execute')}>
              Run: {execForm.name}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
          {forms.length} form{forms.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div className="qf-body">
        {/* ── LIST VIEW ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {activeTab === 'list' && (
          loading ? (
            <div className="qf-empty"><p>Loading...</p></div>
          ) : forms.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="qf-empty">
              <FileText size={48} />
              <p>No query forms yet. Create one from any parameterized SQL query.</p>
              <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-primary" style={{ marginTop: 16 }} onClick={() => setActiveTab('create')}>
                <Plus size={15} /> Create Form
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="qf-grid">
              {forms.map(f => (
                <div key={f.id} className="qf-card">
                  <div className="qf-card-head">
                    <h4>{f.name}</h4>
                    <span className={`qf-badge ${f.is_public ? 'green' : 'gray'}`}>
                      {f.is_public ? <><Globe size={10} /> Public</> : <><Lock size={10} /> Private</>}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {f.description && <div className="qf-card-desc">{f.description}</div>}
                  <div className="qf-card-meta">
                    <span className="qf-badge blue">{f.database_name}</span>
                    <span className="qf-badge purple">{(f.parameters || []).length} params</span>
                    <span className="qf-badge amber">{f.executions || 0} runs</span>
                    <span className="qf-badge gray">{f.db_type}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="qf-card-actions">
                    <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-success qf-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleExecuteOpen(f)}>
                      <Play size={13} /> Run
                    </button>
                    <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-ghost qf-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleEdit(f)}>
                      <Edit3 size={13} /> Edit
                    </button>
                    {f.is_public && (
                      <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-ghost qf-btn-sm" onClick={() => copyShareLink(f)}>
                        <Share2 size={13} /> Share
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-danger qf-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleDelete(f.id)} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )
        )}

        {/* ── CREATE / EDIT VIEW ─────────────────────────────────── */}
        {activeTab === 'create' && (
          <div style={{ maxWidth: 700 }}>
            <div className="qf-field">
              <label>Form Name *</label>
              <input value={formData.name} onChange={e => setFormData(f => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g., Sales Report" />
            </div>
            <div className="qf-field" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <label>Description</label>
              <input value={formData.description} onChange={e => setFormData(f => ({ ...f, description: e.target.value }))} placeholder="What does this form do?" />
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12, marginTop: 12 }}>
              <div className="qf-field">
                <label>Database</label>
                <select value={formData.database_name} onChange={e => setFormData(f => ({ ...f, database_name: e.target.value }))}>
                  {databases.map(d => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="qf-field">
                <label>DB Type</label>
                <select value={formData.db_type} onChange={e => setFormData(f => ({ ...f, db_type: e.target.value }))}>
                  <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                  <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                  <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="qf-field" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <label>SQL Query (use {'{{param_name}}'} for parameters) *</label>
              <textarea
                rows={5}
                value={formData.query_text}
                onChange={e => handleQueryChange(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={"SELECT * FROM users WHERE department = {{department}} AND hire_date > {{start_date}}"}
              />
              <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-ghost qf-btn-sm" style={{ marginTop: 6 }} onClick={handleDetectParams}>
                Auto-Detect Parameters
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Parameters editor */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <label style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#475569' }}>Parameters ({formData.parameters.length})</label>
                <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-ghost qf-btn-sm" onClick={addParam}><Plus size={13} /> Add</button>
              </div>
              {formData.parameters.length > 0 && (
                <div className="qf-params-list">
                  <div className="qf-param-row" style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                    <span>Name</span><span>Label</span><span>Type</span><span>Required</span><span></span>
                  </div>
                  {formData.parameters.map((p, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="qf-param-row">
                      <input value={p.name} onChange={e => updateParam(i, 'name', e.target.value)} placeholder="param_name" />
                      <input value={p.label} onChange={e => updateParam(i, 'label', e.target.value)} placeholder="Label" />
                      <select value={p.type} onChange={e => updateParam(i, 'type', e.target.value)}>
                        <option value="text">Text</option>
                        <option value="number">Number</option>
                        <option value="date">Date</option>
                        <option value="select">Select</option>
                      </select>
                      <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                        <input type="checkbox" checked={p.required} onChange={e => updateParam(i, 'required', e.target.checked)} />
                        Req
                      </label>
                      <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-danger qf-btn-sm" style={{ padding: '2px 6px' }} onClick={() => removeParam(i)}>
                        <X size={12} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Public toggle */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: 16, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569' }}>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={formData.is_public} onChange={e => setFormData(f => ({ ...f, is_public: e.target.checked }))} />
                Make form publicly shareable
              </label>
            </div>

            {/* Actions */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: 20, display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
              <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-primary" onClick={handleSave}>
                {editId ? 'Update Form' : 'Create Form'}
              </button>
              <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-ghost" onClick={() => { resetForm(); setActiveTab('list'); }}>Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── EXECUTE VIEW ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {activeTab === 'execute' && execForm && (
          <div>
            <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-ghost qf-btn-sm" onClick={() => { setActiveTab('list'); setExecForm(null); setExecResult(null); }} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <ChevronLeft size={14} /> Back to Forms
            </button>
            <div className="qf-execute-panel">
              <h3>{execForm.name}</h3>
              {execForm.description && <div className="desc">{execForm.description}</div>}

              <div className="qf-execute-fields">
                {(execForm.parameters || []).map(p => (
                  <div key={p.name} className="qf-execute-field">
                    <label>
                      {p.label || p.name}
                      {p.required && <span className="req">*</span>}
                    </label>
                    {p.type === 'date' ? (
                      <input type="date" value={execParams[p.name] || ''} onChange={e => setExecParams(ep => ({ ...ep, [p.name]: e.target.value }))} />
                    ) : p.type === 'number' ? (
                      <input type="number" value={execParams[p.name] || ''} onChange={e => setExecParams(ep => ({ ...ep, [p.name]: e.target.value }))} />
                    ) : (
                      <input type="text" value={execParams[p.name] || ''} onChange={e => setExecParams(ep => ({ ...ep, [p.name]: e.target.value }))} placeholder={p.default || ''} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-success" onClick={handleExecute} disabled={executing}>
                <Play size={15} /> {executing ? 'Running...' : 'Run Query'}
              </button>

              {execForm.is_public && execForm.share_token && (
                <div className="qf-share-box">
                  <Share2 size={15} color="#3b82f6" />
                  <input readOnly value={`${window.location.origin}/forms/public/${execForm.share_token}`} />
                  <button className="qf-btn qf-btn-primary qf-btn-sm" onClick={() => copyShareLink(execForm)}>
                    <Copy size={12} /> Copy
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Results */}
              {execResult && (
                <div className="qf-results">
                  <h4>Results ({execResult.row_count || 0} rows)</h4>
                  {execResult.message && <p style={{ color: '#22c55e', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>{execResult.message}</p>}
                  {execResult.columns?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="qf-results-wrap">
                      <table className="qf-results-table">
                        <thead>
                          <tr>{execResult.columns.map(c => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}</tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {execResult.rows.map((row, ri) => (
                            <tr key={ri}>
                              {execResult.columns.map(c => (
                                <td key={c}>{row[c] != null ? String(row[c]) : <span style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>NULL</span>}</td>
                              ))}
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default QueryForms;

src/components/QueryEditor.jsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import Editor from '@monaco-editor/react';
import { Play, Copy, Star, Trash2, Wand2, Sparkles, Lightbulb, FileQuestion, X, Check, RefreshCw, Loader2, AlertTriangle, ShieldAlert, MessageCircle, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { useQueryOperations } from '../hooks/useDatabase';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import * as chatbotService from '../services/chatbot';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './QueryEditor.css';

// ── SQL keywords dictionary ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const SQL_KEYWORDS = [
  'SELECT', 'FROM', 'WHERE', 'AND', 'OR', 'NOT', 'IN', 'BETWEEN', 'LIKE',
  'IS', 'NULL', 'AS', 'ON', 'JOIN', 'INNER', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT', 'OUTER',
