import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import {
  Plus, Save, Play, Trash2, RefreshCw, X, ChevronRight,
  Database, Filter, ArrowRightLeft, FileDown, Clock,
  Layers, Loader, History, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2,
  ArrowRight, Workflow, Minimize2, Maximize2, Settings,
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './PipelineBuilder.css';

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Helpers
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const uid = () => 'n_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5);

const NODE_TYPES = [
  { type: 'source',      label: 'Source',       icon: Database,       color: '#2563eb', desc: 'Extract data from database' },
  { type: 'transform',   label: 'Transform',    icon: Filter,         color: '#7c3aed', desc: 'Filter, aggregate, sort data' },
  { type: 'destination', label: 'Destination',  icon: FileDown,       color: '#16a34a', desc: 'Load data to target' },
];

const TRANSFORM_TYPES = [
  { value: 'filter',         label: 'Filter Rows' },
  { value: 'aggregate',      label: 'Aggregate (Group By)' },
  { value: 'sort',           label: 'Sort' },
  { value: 'limit',          label: 'Limit' },
  { value: 'select_columns', label: 'Select Columns' },
  { value: 'rename',         label: 'Rename Columns' },
  { value: 'deduplicate',    label: 'Deduplicate' },
  { value: 'add_column',     label: 'Add Column' },
];

const DEST_TYPES = [
  { value: 'table', label: 'Database Table' },
  { value: 'gcs',   label: 'GCS Bucket (CSV)' },
];

const makeNode = (type, x, y) => ({
  id: uid(),
  type: 'custom',
  position: { x, y },
  data: {
    nodeType: type,
    label: NODE_TYPES.find(t => t.type === type)?.label || type,
    config: type === 'source'
      ? { database: '', dbType: 'cloudsql', query: '' }
      : type === 'transform'
      ? { transformType: 'filter', column: '', operator: '=', value: '', groupBy: '', aggColumn: '', aggFunction: 'COUNT', sortColumn: '', sortDirection: 'ASC', limit: 100, columns: '', renameMap: {}, columnName: '', expression: '' }
      : { destType: 'table', database: '', dbType: 'cloudsql', tableName: '', writeMode: 'append', bucket: '', filePath: '' },
  },
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PipelineBuilder Component
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export default function PipelineBuilder() {
  // Pipeline list
  const [pipelines, setPipelines] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(null);

  // Current pipeline
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges] = useState([]);
  const [scheduleType, setScheduleType] = useState('manual');
  const [scheduleConfig, setScheduleConfig] = useState({});
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(true);

  // UI state
  const [selectedNode, setSelectedNode] = useState(null);
  const [draggingNode, setDraggingNode] = useState(null);
  const [connectingFrom, setConnectingFrom] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [runResult, setRunResult] = useState(null);
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState([]);
  const [showConfigPanel, setShowConfigPanel] = useState(true);

  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const dragOffset = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  /* ── Load pipelines ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  const loadPipelines = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.listPipelines();
      setPipelines(data.pipelines || []);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error('Failed to load pipelines');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadPipelines(); }, [loadPipelines]);

  /* ── Select pipeline ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  const selectPipeline = useCallback(async (id) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.getPipeline(id);
      const p = data.pipeline;
      setSelectedId(p.id);
      setName(p.name);
      setDescription(p.description);
      setNodes(p.nodes || []);
      setEdges(p.edges || []);
      setScheduleType(p.schedule_type || 'manual');
      setScheduleConfig(p.schedule_config || {});
      setEnabled(p.enabled);
      setSelectedNode(null);
      setRunResult(null);
      setShowHistory(false);
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load pipeline');
    }
  }, []);

  /* ── New pipeline ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const newPipeline = () => {
    setSelectedId(null);
    setName('New Pipeline');
    setDescription('');
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
    setScheduleType('manual');
    setScheduleConfig({});
    setEnabled(true);
    setSelectedNode(null);
    setRunResult(null);
  };

  /* ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const savePipeline = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) { toast.error('Pipeline name is required'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const body = { name, description, nodes, edges, schedule_type: scheduleType, schedule_config: scheduleConfig, enabled };
      if (selectedId) {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updatePipeline(selectedId, body);
        toast.success('Pipeline updated');
      } else {
        const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.createPipeline(body);
        setSelectedId(data.id);
        toast.success('Pipeline created');
      }
      loadPipelines();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Save failed');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  /* ── Delete ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const deletePipeline = async () => {
    if (!selectedId) return;
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this pipeline?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deletePipeline(selectedId);
      toast.success('Deleted');
      newPipeline();
      loadPipelines();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Delete failed');
    }
  };

  /* ── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const runPipeline = async () => {
    if (!selectedId) { toast.error('Save pipeline first'); return; }
    setRunning(true);
    setRunResult(null);
    try {
      await savePipeline();
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.runPipeline(selectedId);
      setRunResult(data);
      if (data.status === 'success') toast.success(`Pipeline completed in ${data.duration_ms}ms — ${data.rows_processed} rows`);
      else toast.error(`Pipeline failed: ${data.error}`);
      loadPipelines();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error('Run failed: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message));
    } finally {
      setRunning(false);
    }
  };

  /* ── History ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const loadHistory = async () => {
    if (!selectedId) return;
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.getPipelineRuns(selectedId);
      setRuns(data.runs || []);
      setShowHistory(true);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed loading history'); }
  };

  /* ── Node operations ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  const addNode = (type) => {
    const x = 80 + (nodes.filter(n => n.data.nodeType === type).length * 30);
    const y = type === 'source' ? 60 : type === 'transform' ? 220 : 380;
    const n = makeNode(type, x + Math.random() * 60, y + Math.random() * 40);
    setNodes(prev => [...prev, n]);
    setSelectedNode(n.id);
  };

  const removeNode = (id) => {
    setNodes(prev => prev.filter(n => n.id !== id));
    setEdges(prev => prev.filter(e => e.source !== id && e.target !== id));
    if (selectedNode === id) setSelectedNode(null);
  };

  const updateNodeConfig = (id, key, value) => {
    setNodes(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, data: { ...n.data, config: { ...n.data.config, [key]: value } } } : n));
  };

  const updateNodeLabel = (id, label) => {
    setNodes(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, data: { ...n.data, label } } : n));
  };

  /* ── Dragging nodes ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  const onNodeMouseDown = (e, nodeId) => {
    if (e.target.classList.contains('port')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === nodeId);
    if (!node) return;
    const rect = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffset.current = {
      x: e.clientX - (rect?.left || 0) - node.position.x,
      y: e.clientY - (rect?.top || 0) - node.position.y,
    };
    setDraggingNode(nodeId);
    setSelectedNode(nodeId);
  };

  const onCanvasMouseMove = useCallback((e) => {
    if (!draggingNode || !canvasRef.current) return;
    const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = Math.max(0, e.clientX - rect.left - dragOffset.current.x);
    const y = Math.max(0, e.clientY - rect.top - dragOffset.current.y);
    setNodes(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === draggingNode ? { ...n, position: { x, y } } : n));
  }, [draggingNode]);

  const onCanvasMouseUp = useCallback(() => {
    setDraggingNode(null);
    setConnectingFrom(null);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (draggingNode) {
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onCanvasMouseMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onCanvasMouseUp);
    }
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onCanvasMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onCanvasMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggingNode, onCanvasMouseMove, onCanvasMouseUp]);

  /* ── Edge operations ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  const startConnection = (nodeId) => { setConnectingFrom(nodeId); };
  const endConnection = (nodeId) => {
    if (connectingFrom && connectingFrom !== nodeId) {
      const exists = edges.some(e => e.source === connectingFrom && e.target === nodeId);
      if (!exists) {
        setEdges(prev => [...prev, { id: `e_${connectingFrom}_${nodeId}`, source: connectingFrom, target: nodeId }]);
      }
    }
    setConnectingFrom(null);
  };

  const removeEdge = (edgeId) => {
    setEdges(prev => prev.filter(e => e.id !== edgeId));
  };

  /* ── Render edge SVG path ─────────────────────────────────── */
  const getEdgePath = (edge) => {
    const src = nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.source);
    const tgt = nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.target);
    if (!src || !tgt) return '';
    const sx = src.position.x + 200;
    const sy = src.position.y + 40;
    const tx = tgt.position.x;
    const ty = tgt.position.y + 40;
    const mx = (sx + tx) / 2;
    return `M${sx},${sy} C${mx},${sy} ${mx},${ty} ${tx},${ty}`;
  };

  /* ── Selected node data ───────────────────────────────────── */
  const selNode = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNode);
  const selType = selNode?.data?.nodeType || '';
  const selConfig = selNode?.data?.config || {};

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Render
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  return (
    <div className="pipeline-root">
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="pipe-toolbar">
        <Workflow size={22} style={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
        <h2>Data Pipeline Builder</h2>
        <div className="pipe-actions">
          <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-ghost" onClick={newPipeline}><Plus size={14} /> New</button>
          <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-primary" onClick={savePipeline} disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? <span className="pipe-spinner" /> : <Save size={14} />} Save
          </button>
          <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-success" onClick={runPipeline} disabled={running || !selectedId}>
            {running ? <span className="pipe-spinner" /> : <Play size={14} />} Run
          </button>
          {selectedId && (
            <>
              <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-ghost" onClick={loadHistory}><History size={14} /> History</button>
              <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-danger" onClick={deletePipeline}><Trash2 size={14} /> Delete</button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pipe-body">
        {/* ── Left: Pipeline List ─────────────────────────────── */}
        <div className="pipe-list-panel">
          <div className="pipe-list-header">
            <span>Pipelines ({pipelines.length})</span>
            <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-ghost" style={{ padding: '4px 8px' }} onClick={loadPipelines}><RefreshCw size={13} /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="pipe-list-items">
            {loading ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20 }}><Loader size={20} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }} /></div>
            ) : pipelines.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>No pipelines yet</div>
            ) : pipelines.map(p => (
              <div key={p.id} className={`pipe-list-item ${selectedId === p.id ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => selectPipeline(p.id)}>
                <div className="item-name">{p.name}</div>
                <div className="item-meta">
                  <span className={`pipe-status-dot ${p.last_run_status || p.status || 'draft'}`} />
                  <span>{p.schedule_type}</span>
                  <span>{p.nodes?.length || 0} nodes</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Center: Canvas ──────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div className="pipe-canvas-wrapper">
          {/* Node palette */}
          <div className="pipe-canvas-toolbar">
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', marginRight: 6 }}>Add Node:</span>
            <div className="node-palette">
              {NODE_TYPES.map(t => (
                <button key={t.type} className="palette-btn" onClick={() => addNode(t.type)}>
                  <span className="dot" style={{ background: t.color }} />
                  {t.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
              {/* Pipeline name inline */}
              <input
                value={name}
                onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Pipeline name…"
                style={{ border: 'none', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b', width: 200, background: 'transparent', outline: 'none' }}
              />
              <button className="pipe-btn pipe-btn-ghost" style={{ padding: '4px 8px' }} onClick={() => setShowConfigPanel(!showConfigPanel)} title="Toggle config panel">
                <Settings size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Canvas */}
          <div
            className="pipe-canvas"
            ref={canvasRef}
            onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === canvasRef.current || e.target.tagName === 'svg') setSelectedNode(null); }}
          >
            {/* Edge SVGs */}
            <svg className="edges-layer">
              <defs>
                <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                  <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#94a3b8" />
                </marker>
              </defs>
              {edges.map(edge => (
                <g key={edge.id}>
                  <path
                    d={getEdgePath(edge)}
                    stroke="#94a3b8"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    fill="none"
                    markerEnd="url(#arrowhead)"
                  />
                  {/* Invisible fat path for click */}
                  <path
                    d={getEdgePath(edge)}
                    stroke="transparent"
                    strokeWidth={14}
                    fill="none"
                    style={{ pointerEvents: 'stroke', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Remove this connection?')) removeEdge(edge.id); }}
                  />
                </g>
              ))}
            </svg>

            {/* Nodes */}
            {nodes.map(node => {
              const nt = NODE_TYPES.find(t => t.type === node.data.nodeType) || NODE_TYPES[0];
              const Icon = nt.icon;
              return (
                <div
                  key={node.id}
                  className={`pipe-node ${selectedNode === node.id ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  style={{ left: node.position.x, top: node.position.y }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => onNodeMouseDown(e, node.id)}
                >
                  {/* In port */}
                  {node.data.nodeType !== 'source' && (
                    <div className="port port-in" onMouseUp={() => endConnection(node.id)} />
                  )}
                  {/* Out port */}
                  {node.data.nodeType !== 'destination' && (
                    <div className="port port-out" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); startConnection(node.id); }} />
                  )}

                  <div className="pipe-node-header" style={{ background: nt.color }}>
                    <Icon size={14} />
                    <span>{nt.label}</span>
                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); removeNode(node.id); }}
                      style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.2)', border: 'none', borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 4px', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#fff', display: 'flex' }}
                    >
                      <X size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="pipe-node-body">
                    <div className="node-label">{node.data.label}</div>
                    <div className="node-desc">
                      {node.data.nodeType === 'source' && (node.data.config.database || 'No database')}
                      {node.data.nodeType === 'transform' && (node.data.config.transformType || 'filter')}
                      {node.data.nodeType === 'destination' && (node.data.config.destType === 'gcs' ? 'GCS Export' : (node.data.config.tableName || 'No table'))}
                    </div>
                    {/* Show run result badge */}
                    {runResult?.node_results?.[node.id] && (
                      <div style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                        <span className={`rn-status ${runResult.node_results[node.id].status}`}>
                          {runResult.node_results[node.id].status} — {runResult.node_results[node.id].count} rows
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {nodes.length === 0 && (
              <div className="pipe-empty">
                <Workflow size={48} />
                <p>Add source, transform, and destination nodes to build your pipeline</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>Click the buttons above or drag to create connections</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Run result summary */}
          {runResult && (
            <div className="pipe-run-panel">
              <h4>
                {runResult.status === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 size={14} style={{ color: '#16a34a', marginRight: 6 }} /> : <AlertCircle size={14} style={{ color: '#ef4444', marginRight: 6 }} />}
                Last Run: {runResult.status} — {runResult.duration_ms}ms — {runResult.rows_processed} rows
              </h4>
              {runResult.node_results && Object.entries(runResult.node_results).map(([nid, r]) => (
                <div key={nid} className="run-node-result">
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, minWidth: 80 }}>{nodes.find(n => n.id === nid)?.data?.label || nid}</span>
                  <span className={`rn-status ${r.status}`}>{r.status}</span>
                  <span>{r.count} rows</span>
                  {r.message && <span style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>— {r.message}</span>}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Run history */}
          {showHistory && (
            <div className="pipe-run-panel">
              <h4>
                <History size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Run History
                <button onClick={() => setShowHistory(false)} style={{ float: 'right', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#94a3b8' }}><X size={14} /></button>
              </h4>
              <div className="pipe-history-list">
                {runs.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ padding: 12, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>No runs yet</div>
                ) : runs.map(r => (
                  <div key={r.id} className="pipe-history-row">
                    <span className={`pipe-status-dot ${r.status}`} />
                    <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{r.status}</span>
                    <span>{r.duration_ms}ms</span>
                    <span>{r.rows_processed} rows</span>
                    <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>{r.started_at}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Config Panel ──────────────────────────────── */}
        {showConfigPanel && (
          <div className="pipe-config-panel">
            {selNode ? (
              <>
                <div className="pipe-config-header">
                  <h3>Node Config</h3>
                  <button onClick={() => setSelectedNode(null)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#94a3b8' }}><X size={16} /></button>
                </div>
                <div className="pipe-config-body">
                  {/* Label */}
                  <div className="cfg-group">
                    <label className="cfg-label">Node Label</label>
                    <input className="cfg-input" value={selNode.data.label} onChange={e => updateNodeLabel(selNode.id, e.target.value)} />
                  </div>

                  {/* ── SOURCE config ────────────────────────── */}
                  {selType === 'source' && (
                    <>
                      <div className="cfg-group">
                        <label className="cfg-label">DB Type</label>
                        <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.dbType || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'dbType', e.target.value)}>
                          <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                          <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                          <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>
                      <div className="cfg-group">
                        <label className="cfg-label">Database / Dataset</label>
                        <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.database || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'database', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. my_database" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="cfg-group">
                        <label className="cfg-label">SQL Query</label>
                        <textarea className="cfg-textarea" rows={4} value={selConfig.query || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'query', e.target.value)} placeholder="SELECT * FROM ..." />
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}

                  {/* ── TRANSFORM config ─────────────────────── */}
                  {selType === 'transform' && (
                    <>
                      <div className="cfg-group">
                        <label className="cfg-label">Transform Type</label>
                        <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.transformType || 'filter'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'transformType', e.target.value)}>
                          {TRANSFORM_TYPES.map(t => <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</option>)}
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'filter' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Column</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.column || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'column', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Operator</label>
                            <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.operator || '='} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'operator', e.target.value)}>
                              {['=', '!=', '>', '<', 'contains', 'not_null'].map(o => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}
                            </select>
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Value</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.value || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'value', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'aggregate' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Group By Column</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.groupBy || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'groupBy', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Aggregate Column</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.aggColumn || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'aggColumn', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Function</label>
                            <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.aggFunction || 'COUNT'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'aggFunction', e.target.value)}>
                              {['COUNT', 'SUM', 'AVG', 'MIN', 'MAX'].map(f => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
                            </select>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'sort' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Sort Column</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.sortColumn || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'sortColumn', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Direction</label>
                            <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.sortDirection || 'ASC'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'sortDirection', e.target.value)}>
                              <option value="ASC">Ascending</option>
                              <option value="DESC">Descending</option>
                            </select>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'limit' && (
                        <div className="cfg-group">
                          <label className="cfg-label">Row Limit</label>
                          <input className="cfg-input" type="number" value={selConfig.limit || 100} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'limit', e.target.value)} />
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'select_columns' && (
                        <div className="cfg-group">
                          <label className="cfg-label">Columns (comma-separated)</label>
                          <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.columns || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'columns', e.target.value)} placeholder="col1, col2, col3" />
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'rename' && (
                        <div className="cfg-group">
                          <label className="cfg-label">Rename Map (JSON)</label>
                          <textarea className="cfg-textarea" rows={3} value={typeof selConfig.renameMap === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(selConfig.renameMap, null, 2) : selConfig.renameMap || '{}'} onChange={e => { try { updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'renameMap', JSON.parse(e.target.value)); } catch {} }} placeholder='{"old_name": "new_name"}' />
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'deduplicate' && (
                        <div className="cfg-group">
                          <label className="cfg-label">Deduplicate Column (blank = full row)</label>
                          <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.column || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'column', e.target.value)} />
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.transformType === 'add_column' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Column Name</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.columnName || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'columnName', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Expression / Value</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.expression || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'expression', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}

                  {/* ── DESTINATION config ───────────────────── */}
                  {selType === 'destination' && (
                    <>
                      <div className="cfg-group">
                        <label className="cfg-label">Destination Type</label>
                        <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.destType || 'table'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'destType', e.target.value)}>
                          {DEST_TYPES.map(d => <option key={d.value} value={d.value}>{d.label}</option>)}
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      {selConfig.destType === 'table' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">DB Type</label>
                            <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.dbType || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'dbType', e.target.value)}>
                              <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                              <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                              <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
                            </select>
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Database / Dataset</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.database || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'database', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Table Name</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.tableName || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'tableName', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">Write Mode</label>
                            <select className="cfg-select" value={selConfig.writeMode || 'append'} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'writeMode', e.target.value)}>
                              <option value="append">Append</option>
                              <option value="replace">Replace (Truncate + Insert)</option>
                            </select>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}

                      {selConfig.destType === 'gcs' && (
                        <>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">GCS Bucket</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.bucket || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'bucket', e.target.value)} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="cfg-group">
                            <label className="cfg-label">File Path</label>
                            <input className="cfg-input" value={selConfig.filePath || ''} onChange={e => updateNodeConfig(selNode.id, 'filePath', e.target.value)} placeholder="path/output.csv" />
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              /* ── Pipeline settings when no node selected ───── */
              <>
                <div className="pipe-config-header">
                  <h3>Pipeline Settings</h3>
                </div>
                <div className="pipe-config-body">
                  <div className="cfg-group">
                    <label className="cfg-label">Name</label>
                    <input className="cfg-input" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="cfg-group">
                    <label className="cfg-label">Description</label>
                    <textarea className="cfg-textarea" rows={3} value={description} onChange={e => setDescription(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="cfg-group">
                    <label className="cfg-label">Schedule</label>
                    <select className="cfg-select" value={scheduleType} onChange={e => setScheduleType(e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="manual">Manual</option>
                      <option value="interval">Interval</option>
                      <option value="cron">CRON</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  {scheduleType === 'interval' && (
                    <div className="cfg-group">
                      <label className="cfg-label">Interval (minutes)</label>
                      <input className="cfg-input" type="number" value={scheduleConfig.interval_minutes || 60}
                        onChange={e => setScheduleConfig({ ...scheduleConfig, interval_minutes: parseInt(e.target.value) || 60 })} />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {scheduleType === 'cron' && (
                    <div className="cfg-group">
                      <label className="cfg-label">CRON Expression</label>
                      <input className="cfg-input" value={scheduleConfig.cron || ''} onChange={e => setScheduleConfig({ ...scheduleConfig, cron: e.target.value })} placeholder="0 * * * *" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="cfg-group" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={enabled} onChange={e => setEnabled(e.target.checked)} id="pipe-enabled" />
                    <label htmlFor="pipe-enabled" style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#334155', fontWeight: 600 }}>Enabled</label>
                  </div>

                  {/* Stats */}
                  <div style={{ marginTop: 20, padding: 12, background: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b' }}>
                    <div><strong>Nodes:</strong> {nodes.length}</div>
                    <div><strong>Edges:</strong> {edges.length}</div>
                    <div><strong>Sources:</strong> {nodes.filter(n => n.data.nodeType === 'source').length}</div>
                    <div><strong>Transforms:</strong> {nodes.filter(n => n.data.nodeType === 'transform').length}</div>
                    <div><strong>Destinations:</strong> {nodes.filter(n => n.data.nodeType === 'destination').length}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
