// ── ParamsEditor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Inline sub-component for editing flow input parameters
function ParamsEditor({ params = [], onChange }) {
  function addParam() {
    onChange([
      ...params,
      { name: '', type: 'string', required: false, default: '', description: '' },
    ]);
  }

  function updateParam(index, field, value) {
    onChange(params.map((p, i) => (i === index ? { ...p, [field]: value } : p)));
  }

  function removeParam(index) {
    onChange(params.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Column headers */}
      {params.length > 0 && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 70px 30px',
            gap: 4,
            padding: '4px 14px',
            background: '#0f1729',
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em', color: '#475569' }}>Name</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em', color: '#475569' }}>Type</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em', color: '#475569', textAlign: 'center' }}>Req</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {params.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', fontSize: 12, color: '#475569' }}>
          No params yet. Add input parameters that callers can pass to this flow.
        </div>
      )}

      {params.map((p, index) => (
        <div key={index} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #263247' }}>
          {/* Main row */}
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 70px 30px 20px',
              gap: 4,
              padding: '5px 8px 5px 14px',
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <input
              className="lfb-input"
              placeholder="param_name"
              value={p.name || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateParam(index, 'name', e.target.value)}
              style={{ fontSize: 11 }}
            />
            <select
              className="lfb-select"
              value={p.type || 'string'}
              onChange={(e) => updateParam(index, 'type', e.target.value)}
              style={{ fontSize: 11, width: '100%' }}
            >
              <option value="string">string</option>
              <option value="number">number</option>
              <option value="boolean">boolean</option>
              <option value="array">array</option>
              <option value="object">object</option>
            </select>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="lfb-param-required-check"
                checked={!!p.required}
                onChange={(e) => updateParam(index, 'required', e.target.checked)}
                title="Required"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              className="lfb-icon-btn danger"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => removeParam(index)}
              title="Remove param"
              style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }}
            >
              <X size={11} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Sub-row: default + description */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, padding: '0 8px 6px 14px' }}>
            <input
              className="lfb-input"
              placeholder="Default value"
              value={p.default || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateParam(index, 'default', e.target.value)}
              style={{ fontSize: 10, flex: 1 }}
            />
            <input
              className="lfb-input"
              placeholder="Description"
              value={p.description || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateParam(index, 'description', e.target.value)}
              style={{ fontSize: 10, flex: 2 }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      <div style={{ padding: '8px 14px' }}>
        <button className="lfb-kv-add-btn" type="button" onClick={addParam}>
          <Plus size={12} />
          Add Parameter
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── RunPanel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Inline sub-component for testing / running the flow
function RunPanel({ flowId, params = [], onRun, lastResult, prefillParams = {} }) {
  const [inputValues, setInputValues] = useState({});
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);

  // Initialise from prefill
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prefillParams && Object.keys(prefillParams).length > 0) {
      setInputValues(prefillParams);
    }
  }, [prefillParams]);

  function setInput(name, value) {
    setInputValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  }

  async function handleRun() {
    if (!flowId) {
      toast.error('Save the flow before running it');
      return;
    }
    setRunning(true);
    try {
      await onRun(inputValues);
    } finally {
      setRunning(false);
    }
  }

  const execTime = lastResult?.execution_time_ms != null
    ? `${(lastResult.execution_time_ms / 1000).toFixed(3)}s`
    : null;

  return (
    <div className="lfb-run-panel">
      <div className="lfb-run-panel-header">
        <Play size={13} color="#22c55e" />
        <span className="lfb-run-panel-title">Test Run</span>
        {execTime && (
          <span className="lfb-exec-time">
            Last: {execTime}
          </span>
        )}
        {lastResult?.status === 'error' && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#ef4444', marginLeft: 4 }}>
            <AlertTriangle size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 3 }} />
            Error
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="lfb-run-panel-body">
        {/* Params inputs */}
        <div className="lfb-run-params-col">
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', marginBottom: 6, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em' }}>
            Input Params
          </div>
          {params.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569' }}>No params defined.</div>
          )}
          {params.map((p) => (
            <div key={p.name} className="lfb-field-group" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
              <label className="lfb-label">
                {p.name}
                {p.required && <span style={{ color: '#ef4444', marginLeft: 2 }}>*</span>}
                <span style={{ color: '#475569', fontWeight: 400, marginLeft: 4 }}>{p.type}</span>
              </label>
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder={p.default ? `default: ${p.default}` : p.description || p.name}
                value={inputValues[p.name] != null ? inputValues[p.name] : ''}
                onChange={(e) => setInput(p.name, e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          ))}

          <button
            className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-success"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRun}
            disabled={running || !flowId}
            style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
          >
            {running ? (
              <>
                <span className="lfb-spinner" />
                Running...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Play size={12} />
                Run Flow
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Result */}
        <div className="lfb-run-result-col">
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', marginBottom: 6, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em' }}>
            Result
            {lastResult && (
              <span style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontWeight: 400, textTransform: 'none', color: lastResult.status === 'error' ? '#ef4444' : '#22c55e' }}>
                {lastResult.status}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {!lastResult && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569', flex: 1 }}>
              No result yet. Run the flow to see output here.
            </div>
          )}

          {lastResult && (
            <div className="lfb-result-box">
              {JSON.stringify(lastResult, null, 2)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── DBBrowser ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shows databases → tables tree. Clicking table inserts SELECT into steps.
function DBBrowser({ onInsertTable }) {
  const [dbType, setDbType]       = useState('cloudsql');
  const [databases, setDatabases] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading]     = useState(false);
  const [selectedDb, setSelectedDb] = useState(null);
  const [tables, setTables]       = useState([]);
  const [loadingTbls, setLoadingTbls] = useState(false);
  const [servers, setServers]     = useState([]);
  const [serverId, setServerId]   = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    apiClient.get('/api/servers').then((r) => setServers(r.data.servers || [])).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  async function loadDatabases() {
    setLoading(true); setDatabases([]); setSelectedDb(null); setTables([]);
    try {
      let dbs = [];
      if (dbType === 'mssql' && serverId) {
        const r = await apiClient.get(`/api/servers/${serverId}/databases`);
        dbs = (r.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name || d);
      } else {
        const r = await apiClient.get('/api/databases', { params: { type: dbType } });
        dbs = (r.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name || d);
      }
      setDatabases(dbs);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load databases'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }

  async function selectDb(db) {
    setSelectedDb(db); setTables([]); setLoadingTbls(true);
    try {
      let tbls = [];
      if (dbType === 'mssql' && serverId) {
        const r = await apiClient.get(`/api/servers/${serverId}/databases/${db}/tables`);
        tbls = (r.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name || t);
      } else {
        const r = await apiClient.get('/api/tables', { params: { database: db, type: dbType } });
        tbls = (r.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name || t);
      }
      setTables(tbls);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load tables'); }
    finally { setLoadingTbls(false); }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '10px 0' }}>
      {/* DB Type row */}
      <div style={{ padding: '0 12px 8px', display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <select className="lfb-select" value={dbType} onChange={(e) => { setDbType(e.target.value); setDatabases([]); setTables([]); setSelectedDb(null); }}
          style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 11 }}>
          <option value="cloudsql">Cloud SQL</option>
          <option value="mssql">MS SQL Server</option>
        </select>
        <button className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost" style={{ padding: '3px 8px', fontSize: 11 }}
          onClick={loadDatabases} title="Load databases">
          {loading ? <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 10, height: 10 }} /> : <RefreshCw size={11} />}
        </button>
      </div>
      {/* Server picker for mssql */}
      {dbType === 'mssql' && servers.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: '0 12px 8px' }}>
          <select className="lfb-select" value={serverId} onChange={(e) => setServerId(e.target.value)} style={{ width: '100%', fontSize: 11 }}>
            <option value="">— select server —</option>
            {servers.map((s) => <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name || s.host}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* DB list */}
      {databases.length === 0 && !loading && (
        <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 11, color: '#475569' }}>Click refresh to load databases.</div>
      )}
      {databases.map((db) => (
        <div key={db}>
          <div
            className="lfb-browser-item"
            style={{ paddingLeft: 12, background: selectedDb === db ? '#1e2d47' : undefined }}
            onClick={() => selectDb(db)}
          >
            <Database size={12} style={{ marginRight: 6, color: '#60a5fa', flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{db}</span>
            <ChevronRight size={11} style={{ color: '#475569', transform: selectedDb === db ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'none', transition: 'transform 0.15s' }} />
          </div>
          {selectedDb === db && (
            <div style={{ background: '#0a0f1e' }}>
              {loadingTbls && (
                <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px 6px 28px', fontSize: 11, color: '#475569', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                  <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 10, height: 10 }} /> Loading tables…
                </div>
              )}
              {!loadingTbls && tables.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px 6px 28px', fontSize: 11, color: '#475569' }}>No tables found</div>
              )}
              {tables.map((tbl) => (
                <div key={tbl} className="lfb-browser-item" style={{ paddingLeft: 28 }}
                  onClick={() => onInsertTable(db, tbl, dbType)}>
                  <Table2 size={11} style={{ marginRight: 6, color: '#94a3b8', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                  <span style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', fontSize: 11 }}>{tbl}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#3b82f6', marginLeft: 4 }}>+ SELECT</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── TemplatesBrowser ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function TemplatesBrowser({ onUse }) {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading]     = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch]       = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    apiClient.get('/api/flows/templates')
      .then((r) => setTemplates(r.data.templates || []))
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const filtered = templates.filter((t) => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return !q || (t.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (t.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });

  if (loading) return <div style={{ padding: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}><span className="lfb-spinner" /></div>;

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '8px 0' }}>
      <div style={{ padding: '0 10px 8px' }}>
        <input className="lfb-input" placeholder="Search templates…" value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} style={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
      </div>
      {filtered.map((t, i) => (
        <div key={t.id || i} className="lfb-browser-template-card">
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 2 }}>{t.name}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b', marginBottom: 6, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{t.description}</div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {(t.tags || []).slice(0, 3).map((tag) => (
              <span key={tag} className="lfb-template-tag">{tag}</span>
            ))}
            <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
              {(t.steps || []).length} steps
            </span>
          </div>
          <button className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-primary" type="button"
            style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11 }}
            onClick={() => { onUse(t); toast.success(`Template "${t.name}" applied!`); }}>
            <LayoutTemplate size={11} /> Use This Template
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
      {filtered.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 11, color: '#475569' }}>No templates match</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── SavedFlowsBrowser ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SavedFlowsBrowser({ currentFlowId, onOpen }) {
  const [flows, setFlows]   = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    apiClient.get('/api/flows')
      .then((r) => setFlows(r.data.flows || []))
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const filtered = flows.filter((f) => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return !q || (f.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });

  if (loading) return <div style={{ padding: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}><span className="lfb-spinner" /></div>;

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '8px 0' }}>
      <div style={{ padding: '0 10px 8px' }}>
        <input className="lfb-input" placeholder="Search flows…" value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} style={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
      </div>
      {filtered.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 11, color: '#475569' }}>
          No saved flows yet.
        </div>
      )}
      {filtered.map((f) => (
        <div key={f.id} className="lfb-browser-item"
          style={{ padding: '7px 12px', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start', background: f.id === currentFlowId ? '#1e2d47' : undefined }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', width: '100%', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <GitBranch size={11} style={{ marginRight: 6, color: '#60a5fa', flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#e2e8f0', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{f.name}</span>
            {f.id !== currentFlowId && (
              <button className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost" style={{ padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 10 }}
                onClick={() => onOpen(f.id)}>
                Open <ExternalLink size={9} style={{ display: 'inline' }} />
              </button>
            )}
            {f.id === currentFlowId && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#22c55e' }}>current</span>
            )}
          </div>
          {f.description && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', marginTop: 2, marginLeft: 17 }}>{f.description}</div>
          )}
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#334155', marginTop: 2, marginLeft: 17 }}>
            {f.step_count ?? '?'} steps · {f.updated_at ? new Date(f.updated_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── APIsBrowser ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function APIsBrowser() {
  const [apis, setApis]     = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiClient.get('/api/builder/apis')
      .then((r) => setApis(r.data.apis || r.data || []))
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  async function copyEndpoint(api) {
    const base = 'https://sqleditorapi.verizon.com';
    const endpoint = `${base}/api/builder/apis/${api.id}/execute`;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(endpoint); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setCopied(api.id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 2000);
    toast.success('Endpoint URL copied!');
  }

  const filtered = apis.filter((a) => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return !q || (a.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (a.alias || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });

  if (loading) return <div style={{ padding: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}><span className="lfb-spinner" /></div>;

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '8px 0' }}>
      <div style={{ padding: '0 10px 8px' }}>
        <input className="lfb-input" placeholder="Search APIs…" value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} style={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
      </div>
      {filtered.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 11, color: '#475569' }}>
          No custom APIs found. Build some in the API Builder tab.
        </div>
      )}
      {filtered.map((api) => (
        <div key={api.id} className="lfb-browser-item"
          style={{ padding: '7px 12px', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', width: '100%', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <Globe size={11} style={{ marginRight: 6, color: '#a78bfa', flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#e2e8f0', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{api.name}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 5px', borderRadius: 3, background: api.method === 'GET' ? '#0c2a1a' : '#1a1a2e',
              color: api.method === 'GET' ? '#22c55e' : '#a78bfa', marginLeft: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
              {api.method || 'GET'}
            </span>
          </div>
          {api.alias && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', marginTop: 2, marginLeft: 17, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>/api/data/{api.alias}</div>
          )}
          <button className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost" style={{ marginTop: 4, marginLeft: 17, padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 10 }}
            onClick={() => copyEndpoint(api)}>
            {copied === api.id ? <Check size={10} /> : <Layers size={10} />}
            {copied === api.id ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy Endpoint'}
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Sidebar tab definitions ───────────────────────────────────────────
const SIDEBAR_TABS = [
  { id: 'params',    icon: Layers,         title: 'Input Parameters' },
  { id: 'db',        icon: Database,       title: 'DB & Tables' },
  { id: 'templates', icon: LayoutTemplate, title: 'Templates' },
  { id: 'flows',     icon: FolderOpen,     title: 'Saved Flows' },
  { id: 'apis',      icon: Globe,          title: 'Existing APIs' },
];

// ── LogicFlowBuilder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props:
//   flowId       – optional, for editing existing flow
//   prefillFlow  – optional initial flow data
//   onSaved      – fn(flow) called after successful save
export default function LogicFlowBuilder({ flowId: initialFlowId, prefillFlow, onSaved }) {
  // ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [flowId, setFlowId] = useState(initialFlowId || null);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState([]);
  const [params, setParams] = useState([]);

  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);

  const [showAI, setShowAI] = useState(false);
  const [showRunPanel, setShowRunPanel] = useState(false);
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarTab, setSidebarTab] = useState('params');

  const [lastResult, setLastResult] = useState(null);
  const [lastRunError, setLastRunError] = useState(null);
  const [lastRunLogs, setLastRunLogs] = useState([]);
  const [rerunPrefillParams, setRerunPrefillParams] = useState({});

  const didLoadRef = useRef(false);

  // ── Load existing flow ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (didLoadRef.current) return;

    if (prefillFlow) {
      didLoadRef.current = true;
      applyFlowData(prefillFlow);
      return;
    }

    if (initialFlowId) {
      didLoadRef.current = true;
      loadFlow(initialFlowId);
    }
  }, [initialFlowId, prefillFlow]);

  async function loadFlow(id) {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/api/flows/${id}`);
      applyFlowData(res.data);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load flow: ' + (err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    }
  }

  function applyFlowData(flow) {
    setName(flow.name || '');
    setDescription(flow.description || '');
    setSteps(flow.steps || []);
    setParams(flow.params || flow.parameters || []);
    if (flow.id) setFlowId(flow.id);
    setIsDirty(false);
  }

  // ── Mark dirty on changes ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function handleStepsChange(newSteps) {
    setSteps(newSteps);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  function handleParamsChange(newParams) {
    setParams(newParams);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  function handleNameChange(e) {
    setName(e.target.value);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  function handleDescChange(e) {
    setDescription(e.target.value);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  // ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleSave() {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast.error('Please enter a flow name');
      return;
    }
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = { name, description, steps, params };
      let res;
      if (flowId) {
        res = await apiClient.put(`/api/flows/${flowId}`, payload);
      } else {
        res = await apiClient.post('/api/flows', payload);
      }
      const saved = res.data.flow || res.data;
      if (saved.id && !flowId) setFlowId(saved.id);
      setIsDirty(false);
      toast.success('Flow saved!');
      if (onSaved) onSaved(saved);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Save failed: ' + (err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleRun(inputParams) {
    if (!flowId) {
      toast.error('Save the flow before running');
      return;
    }
    setIsRunning(true);
    setLastResult(null);
    setLastRunError(null);
    setLastRunLogs([]);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(`/api/flows/${flowId}/execute`, { params: inputParams });
      const data = res.data;
      setLastResult(data);
      setLastRunLogs(data.step_logs || []);
      if (data.status === 'error') {
        setLastRunError(data.error || data.message || 'Unknown error');
        toast.error('Flow execution failed');
      } else {
        toast.success('Flow executed successfully!');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Execution failed';
      setLastRunError(msg);
      toast.error('Run failed: ' + msg);
    } finally {
      setIsRunning(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Insert table from DB browser ─────────────────────────────────────
  // Appends a pre-filled SQL Query step using the clicked table
  function handleInsertTable(database, tableName, dbType) {
    const newStep = {
      id: 's' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6),
      type: 'sql_query',
      name: `Query ${tableName}`,
      config: {
        database,
        db_type: dbType,
        query: `SELECT * FROM ${tableName} LIMIT 100`,
        bind_result_to: tableName.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/gi, '_').toLowerCase(),
      },
      on_error: 'stop',
    };
    setSteps((prev) => [...prev, newStep]);
    setIsDirty(true);
    toast.success(`SQL Query step added for ${tableName}`);
  }

  // ── Open a different saved flow ───────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleOpenFlow(id) {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/api/flows/${id}`);
      applyFlowData(res.data.flow || res.data);
      toast.success('Flow loaded');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load flow: ' + (err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    }
  }

  // ── AI handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function handleFlowGenerated(flow) {
    if (flow.name) setName(flow.name);
    if (flow.description) setDescription(flow.description);
    if (flow.steps) setSteps(flow.steps);
    if (flow.params || flow.parameters) setParams(flow.params || flow.parameters);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  function handleStepSuggested(step) {
    const newStep = {
      id: 's' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6),
      type: step.type,
      name: step.name || step.type,
      config: step.config || {},
      on_error: 'stop',
    };
    setSteps((prev) => [...prev, newStep]);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  function handleTemplateSelected(template) {
    if (template.steps) setSteps(template.steps);
    if (template.params || template.parameters) setParams(template.params || template.parameters);
    if (template.name && !name) setName(template.name);
    setIsDirty(true);
  }

  // ── Status indicator ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const statusClass = isSaving ? 'saving' : isDirty ? 'unsaved' : 'saved';
  const statusLabel = isSaving ? 'Saving…' : isDirty ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'Saved';

  return (
    <div className="lfb-container">
      {/* ── Header ── */}
      <div className="lfb-header">
        <div className="lfb-header-title-group">
          <input
            className="lfb-flow-name-input"
            placeholder="Untitled Flow"
            value={name}
            onChange={handleNameChange}
          />
          <input
            className="lfb-flow-desc-input"
            placeholder="Add a description…"
            value={description}
            onChange={handleDescChange}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-header-actions">
          {/* Status */}
          <span className="lfb-status-label">{statusLabel}</span>
          <span className={`lfb-status-dot ${statusClass}`} />

          {/* Save */}
          <button
            className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-primary"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={isSaving || !isDirty}
            title="Save flow"
          >
            {isSaving ? (
              <>
                <span className="lfb-spinner" />
                Saving…
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Save size={13} />
                Save
              </>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Run */}
          <button
            className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-success"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setShowRunPanel((v) => !v);
              setShowHistory(false);
            }}
            disabled={isRunning}
            title="Test run"
          >
            <Play size={13} />
            Run
          </button>

          {/* History toggle */}
          <button
            className={`lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost${showHistory ? ' active' : ''}`}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setShowHistory((v) => !v);
              setShowRunPanel(false);
            }}
            title="Run history"
          >
            <History size={13} />
            History
          </button>

          {/* AI Copilot toggle */}
          <button
            className={`lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost${showAI ? ' active' : ''}`}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowAI((v) => !v)}
            title="AI Copilot"
          >
            <Sparkles size={13} />
            AI
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Body ── */}
      <div className="lfb-body">
        {/* Left: Tabbed sidebar */}
        <div className="lfb-sidebar" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
          {/* Sidebar tab icons */}
          <div className="lfb-sidebar-tabs">
            {SIDEBAR_TABS.map(({ id, icon: Icon, title }) => (
              <button key={id} className={`lfb-sidebar-tab-btn${sidebarTab === id ? ' active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setSidebarTab(id)} title={title} type="button">
                <Icon size={14} />
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Sidebar tab label */}
          <div className="lfb-sidebar-tab-title">
            {SIDEBAR_TABS.find((t) => t.id === sidebarTab)?.title}
          </div>

          {/* Sidebar tab body */}
          <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
            {sidebarTab === 'params' && (
              <>
                <ParamsEditor params={params} onChange={handleParamsChange} />
                {/* Quick reference */}
                <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderTop: '1px solid #1e2d47', marginTop: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em', color: '#475569', marginBottom: 6 }}>
                    Variable Syntax
                  </div>
                  {[
                    ['{{params.name}}', 'input param value'],
                    ['{{result}}', 'last SQL result rows'],
                    ['{{result.length}}', 'row count'],
                    ['{{item}}', 'current loop item'],
                    ['{{item.field}}', 'field of loop item'],
                    ['{{error.message}}', 'error text'],
                  ].map(([syntax, desc]) => (
                    <div key={syntax} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10, color: '#60a5fa' }}>{syntax}</span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', marginLeft: 6 }}>{desc}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {sidebarTab === 'db' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b', borderBottom: '1px solid #1e2d47' }}>
                  Click a table to add a SQL Query step instantly.
                </div>
                <DBBrowser onInsertTable={handleInsertTable} />
              </>
            )}

            {sidebarTab === 'templates' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b', borderBottom: '1px solid #1e2d47' }}>
                  Start from a built-in template — edit the steps to fit your needs.
                </div>
                <TemplatesBrowser onUse={handleTemplateSelected} />
              </>
            )}

            {sidebarTab === 'flows' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b', borderBottom: '1px solid #1e2d47' }}>
                  Your saved flows. Click Open to load one for editing.
                </div>
                <SavedFlowsBrowser currentFlowId={flowId} onOpen={handleOpenFlow} />
              </>
            )}

            {sidebarTab === 'apis' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b', borderBottom: '1px solid #1e2d47' }}>
                  Reference your existing custom APIs. Copy endpoints to use in HTTP Call steps.
                </div>
                <APIsBrowser />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Step Sequencer */}
        <div className="lfb-main">
          {steps.length === 0 && !isDirty ? (
            <div className="lfb-empty-state" style={{ paddingTop: 40 }}>
              <Play size={36} />
              <h3>Build your API flow</h3>
              <p>Add steps below to define what this API does — query data, transform it, loop, branch, and return results.</p>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <StepSequencer steps={steps} onChange={handleStepsChange} depth={0} />
        </div>

        {/* Right: AI Copilot */}
        {showAI && (
          <div className="lfb-ai-panel">
            <FlowAICopilot
              steps={steps}
              params={params}
              flowName={name}
              lastRunError={lastRunError}
              lastRunLogs={lastRunLogs}
              onFlowGenerated={handleFlowGenerated}
              onStepSuggested={handleStepSuggested}
              onTemplateSelected={handleTemplateSelected}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Right: Run History (replaces AI panel slot) */}
        {showHistory && !showAI && (
          <div className="lfb-ai-panel">
            <FlowRunHistory
              flowId={flowId}
              onRerun={(rerunParams) => {
                setRerunPrefillParams(rerunParams);
                setShowRunPanel(true);
                setShowHistory(false);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom: Run Panel */}
      {showRunPanel && (
        <RunPanel
          flowId={flowId}
          params={params}
          onRun={handleRun}
          lastResult={lastResult}
          prefillParams={rerunPrefillParams}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/FlowRunHistory.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, RefreshCw, Clock, User, CheckCircle, XCircle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import apiClient from '../services/api';

// ── Status helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  return (
    <span className={`lfb-log-status-badge status-${status || 'unknown'}`}>
      {status || 'unknown'}
    </span>
  );
}

function StatusIcon({ status }) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'completed': return <CheckCircle size={14} color="#22c55e" />;
    case 'error':     return <XCircle size={14} color="#ef4444" />;
    case 'running':   return <RefreshCw size={14} color="#fbbf24" style={{ animation: 'lfb-spin 1s linear infinite' }} />;
    default:          return <AlertCircle size={14} color="#64748b" />;
  }
}

// ── Format timestamp ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function formatTs(ts) {
  if (!ts) return '—';
  try {
    const d = new Date(ts);
    return d.toLocaleString(undefined, {
      month: 'short',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
    });
  } catch {
    return String(ts);
  }
}

function formatDuration(ms) {
  if (ms == null) return '—';
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)}s`;
}

// ── Step log timeline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StepLogTimeline({ logs = [] }) {
  if (logs.length === 0) {
    return <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569', padding: '8px 0' }}>No step logs available.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
      {logs.map((log, i) => (
        <div key={log.step_id || i} className={`lfb-log-entry status-${log.status || 'unknown'}`}>
          <StatusIcon status={log.status} />
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <span className="lfb-log-step-name">{log.step_name || log.step_id || `Step ${i + 1}`}</span>
              <StatusBadge status={log.status} />
              {log.step_type && (
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569' }}>[{log.step_type}]</span>
              )}
            </div>
            {log.output_preview && (
              <div
                style={{
                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 10,
                  color: '#64748b',
                  marginTop: 3,
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  maxWidth: '100%',
                }}
                title={typeof log.output_preview === 'string' ? log.output_preview : JSON.stringify(log.output_preview)}
              >
                {typeof log.output_preview === 'string'
                  ? log.output_preview
                  : JSON.stringify(log.output_preview)}
              </div>
            )}
            {log.error && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#f87171', marginTop: 3, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                {log.error}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <span className="lfb-log-duration">{formatDuration(log.duration_ms)}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Single run row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RunItem({ run, onRerun }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="lfb-run-item">
      <div
        className="lfb-run-item-header"
        onClick={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}
      >
        <StatusIcon status={run.status} />
        <StatusBadge status={run.status} />

        <span className="lfb-run-timestamp">
          <Clock size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 3 }} />
          {formatTs(run.started_at || run.created_at)}
        </span>

        {run.executed_by && (
          <span className="lfb-run-by">
            <User size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 3 }} />
            {run.executed_by}
          </span>
        )}

        <span className="lfb-run-exec-time">{formatDuration(run.duration_ms)}</span>

        <button
          className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onRerun(run.input_params || {});
          }}
          style={{ padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11 }}
          title="Re-run with same params"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={11} />
          Re-run
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#475569', marginLeft: 4 }}>
          {expanded ? <ChevronDown size={13} /> : <ChevronRight size={13} />}
        </span>
      </div>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="lfb-run-item-logs">
          <StepLogTimeline logs={run.step_logs || []} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── FlowRunHistory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props:
//   flowId   – ID of the flow to show runs for
//   onRerun  – fn(inputParams) – called when user clicks Re-run
export default function FlowRunHistory({ flowId, onRerun }) {
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const loadRuns = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!flowId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/api/flows/${flowId}/runs`);
      setRuns(res.data.runs || res.data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Failed to load run history';
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [flowId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRuns();
  }, [loadRuns]);

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '10px 16px', borderBottom: '1px solid #334155', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <Clock size={14} color="#60a5fa" />
        <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#e2e8f0', flex: 1 }}>Run History</span>
        <button
          className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
          type="button"
          onClick={loadRuns}
          disabled={loading || !flowId}
          style={{ padding: '3px 8px', fontSize: 11 }}
          title="Refresh"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={11} style={loading ? { animation: 'lfb-spin 1s linear infinite' } : {}} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        {!flowId && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 24, fontSize: 12, color: '#475569' }}>
            Save the flow first to view run history.
          </div>
        )}

        {flowId && loading && runs.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24 }}>
            <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} />
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div className="lfb-warning" style={{ margin: 12 }}>
            <AlertCircle size={13} />
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {flowId && !loading && runs.length === 0 && !error && (
          <div className="lfb-empty-state">
            <Clock size={28} />
            <h3>No runs yet</h3>
            <p>Run the flow to see execution history here.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="lfb-run-history">
          {runs.map((run, i) => (
            <RunItem key={run.id || i} run={run} onRerun={onRerun} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}





src/components/FlowAICopilot.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Sparkles, ChevronRight, Copy, Check, AlertTriangle,
  Wand2, MessageSquare, BookOpen, Bug, LayoutTemplate,
  Search, Plus, Database, Table2, RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import apiClient from '../services/api';

// ── Tab definitions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const TABS = [
  { id: 'generate', label: 'Generate', Icon: Wand2 },
  { id: 'suggest',  label: 'Suggest',  Icon: Sparkles },
  { id: 'explain',  label: 'Explain',  Icon: MessageSquare },
  { id: 'debug',    label: 'Debug',    Icon: Bug },
  { id: 'templates', label: 'Templates', Icon: LayoutTemplate },
];

// ── Generate Tab ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function GenerateTab({ steps, params, flowName, onFlowGenerated }) {
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [database, setDatabase]       = useState('');
  const [databases, setDatabases]     = useState([]);
  const [tables, setTables]           = useState([]);        // loaded from API
  const [selectedTables, setSelectedTables] = useState([]); // user-picked tables
  const [loadingDbs, setLoadingDbs]   = useState(false);
  const [loadingTbls, setLoadingTbls] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading]         = useState(false);
  const [error, setError]             = useState(null);

  // Load databases on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    setLoadingDbs(true);
    apiClient.get('/api/databases', { params: { type: 'cloudsql' } })
      .then((r) => setDatabases((r.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name || d)))
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoadingDbs(false));
  }, []);

  // Load tables when database selected
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!database || database.startsWith('{{')) { setTables([]); return; }
    setLoadingTbls(true);
    setTables([]); setSelectedTables([]);
    apiClient.get('/api/tables', { params: { database, type: 'cloudsql' } })
      .then((r) => setTables((r.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name || t)))
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoadingTbls(false));
  }, [database]);

  function toggleTable(tbl) {
    setSelectedTables((prev) =>
      prev.includes(tbl) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== tbl) : [...prev, tbl]
    );
  }

  async function handleGenerate() {
    if (!description.trim()) {
      toast.error('Please describe what your API should do');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/ai/generate-flow', {
        description,
        database: database || undefined,
        available_tables: selectedTables.length > 0 ? selectedTables : (tables.length > 0 ? tables : undefined),
        existing_params: params,
      });
      const flow = res.data.flow || res.data;
      onFlowGenerated(flow);
      toast.success('Flow generated successfully!');
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Generation failed';
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      <div className="lfb-ai-message ai">
        <strong>AI Flow Generator</strong>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0' }}>
          Describe your API in plain English — I'll generate the complete flow with steps, conditions, and params.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Describe your API</label>
        <textarea
          className="lfb-textarea"
          rows={4}
          placeholder="e.g. Get all active orders from the orders table filtered by status param. If empty return 404. Otherwise join with customers table and return paginated."
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Database picker — live dropdown */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">
          <Database size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 4 }} />
          Database
          {loadingDbs && <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 10, height: 10, marginLeft: 6 }} />}
        </label>
        {databases.length > 0 ? (
          <select className="lfb-select" value={database} onChange={(e) => setDatabase(e.target.value)} style={{ width: '100%' }}>
            <option value="">— select database (optional) —</option>
            {databases.map((db) => <option key={db} value={db}>{db}</option>)}
          </select>
        ) : (
          <input className="lfb-input" placeholder="my_database (optional)" value={database}
            onChange={(e) => setDatabase(e.target.value)} />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Table picker — checkboxes */}
      {database && !database.startsWith('{{') && (
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">
            <Table2 size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 4 }} />
            Tables to use
            {loadingTbls && <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 10, height: 10, marginLeft: 6 }} />}
            {tables.length > 0 && !loadingTbls && (
              <span style={{ color: '#475569', fontWeight: 400, marginLeft: 6 }}>
                ({selectedTables.length > 0 ? `${selectedTables.length} selected` : 'all'})
              </span>
            )}
          </label>
          {tables.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ maxHeight: 120, overflowY: 'auto', background: '#0a0f1e', border: '1px solid #1e3a5f', borderRadius: 6, padding: '4px 0' }}>
              {tables.map((tbl) => (
                <label key={tbl} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '4px 10px', cursor: 'pointer',
                  background: selectedTables.includes(tbl) ? '#1e2d47' : 'transparent' }}>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={selectedTables.includes(tbl)} onChange={() => toggleTable(tbl)}
                    style={{ accentColor: '#3b82f6' }} />
                  <Table2 size={10} style={{ color: '#475569' }} />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{tbl}</span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {!loadingTbls && tables.length === 0 && database && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#475569' }}>No tables found in this database.</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="lfb-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={13} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <button
        className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-primary"
        type="button"
        onClick={handleGenerate}
        disabled={loading || !description.trim()}
        style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <>
            <span className="lfb-spinner" />
            Generating...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Wand2 size={13} />
            Generate Flow
          </>
        )}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Suggest Tab ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SuggestTab({ steps, onStepSuggested }) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  async function handleSuggest() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/ai/suggest-steps', { steps });
      setSuggestions(res.data.suggestions || []);
      if ((res.data.suggestions || []).length === 0) {
        toast('No suggestions returned', { icon: 'ℹ️' });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Suggestion failed';
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      <div className="lfb-ai-message ai">
        <strong>Next Step Suggestions</strong>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0' }}>
          Based on your current {steps.length} step{steps.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}, I'll suggest what to add next.
        </p>
      </div>

      <button
        className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-primary"
        type="button"
        onClick={handleSuggest}
        disabled={loading}
        style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <>
            <span className="lfb-spinner" />
            Analyzing...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Sparkles size={13} />
            Suggest Next Step
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="lfb-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={13} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {suggestions.map((s, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="lfb-suggestion-card">
          <div className="lfb-suggestion-card-title">{s.title || s.type}</div>
          <div className="lfb-suggestion-card-desc">{s.description || s.reason}</div>
          {s.step && (
            <div style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10, color: '#64748b', background: '#0f172a', padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 4 }}>
              type: {s.step.type}
            </div>
          )}
          <button
            className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onStepSuggested(s.step || { type: s.type, name: s.title, config: {} });
              toast.success('Step added!');
            }}
            style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
          >
            <Plus size={12} />
            Add This Step
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Explain Tab ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ExplainTab({ steps, flowName }) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [explanation, setExplanation] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  async function handleExplain() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/ai/explain-flow', { steps, flow_name: flowName });
      setExplanation(res.data.explanation || '');
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Explanation failed';
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleCopy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(explanation);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
      toast.success('Copied to clipboard!');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to copy');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      <div className="lfb-ai-message ai">
        <strong>Flow Explanation</strong>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0' }}>
          Get a plain-English explanation of what this flow does — great for documentation.
        </p>
      </div>

      <button
        className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-primary"
        type="button"
        onClick={handleExplain}
        disabled={loading || steps.length === 0}
        style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <>
            <span className="lfb-spinner" />
            Analyzing flow...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <BookOpen size={13} />
            Explain This Flow
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="lfb-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={13} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {explanation && (
        <>
          <div
            style={{
              background: '#0f172a',
              border: '1px solid #334155',
              borderRadius: 8,
              padding: '12px 14px',
              fontSize: 12,
              color: '#cbd5e1',
              lineHeight: 1.7,
              whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
              wordBreak: 'break-word',
            }}
          >
            {explanation}
          </div>
          <button
            className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCopy}
          >
            {copied ? <Check size={12} /> : <Copy size={12} />}
            {copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy as Docs'}
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Debug Tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DebugTab({ steps, lastRunError, lastRunLogs, onFlowGenerated }) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  async function handleDebug() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/ai/debug-flow', {
        steps,
        error: lastRunError,
        logs: lastRunLogs,
      });
      setResult(res.data);
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Debug failed';
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function handleApplyFix() {
    if (result?.fixed_steps) {
      onFlowGenerated({ steps: result.fixed_steps });
      toast.success('Fix applied to flow!');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      {lastRunError ? (
        <div className="lfb-ai-message" style={{ background: '#450a0a', border: '1px solid #7f1d1d', color: '#fca5a5' }}>
          <strong>Last Run Error</strong>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11 }}>{lastRunError}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="lfb-ai-message ai">
          <strong>Flow Debugger</strong>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0' }}>
            Run the flow first to capture an error, then debug it here.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <button
        className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-danger"
        type="button"
        onClick={handleDebug}
        disabled={loading || !lastRunError}
        style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <>
            <span className="lfb-spinner" />
            Debugging...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Bug size={13} />
            Debug This Error
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="lfb-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={13} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {result && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          {result.root_cause && (
            <div className="lfb-ai-message ai">
              <strong>Root Cause</strong>
              <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0' }}>{result.root_cause}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {result.failed_step && (
            <div style={{ background: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: 6, padding: '8px 12px', fontSize: 12 }}>
              <span style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Failed Step: </span>
              <span style={{ color: '#f87171', fontWeight: 600 }}>{result.failed_step}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {result.fix_description && (
            <div className="lfb-ai-message ai">
              <strong>Suggested Fix</strong>
              <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0' }}>{result.fix_description}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {result.fixed_steps && (
            <button
              className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-success"
              type="button"
              onClick={handleApplyFix}
              style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
            >
              <Check size={13} />
              Apply Fix
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Templates Tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function TemplatesTab({ onTemplateSelected }) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get('/api/flows/templates');
        setTemplates(res.data.templates || res.data || []);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Failed to load templates');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    load();
  }, []);

  const filtered = templates.filter((t) => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return (
      !q ||
      (t.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (t.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (t.tags || []).some((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  });

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24 }}>
        <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <Search size={13} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 8, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', color: '#475569' }} />
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="Search templates..."
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          style={{ paddingLeft: 28 }}
        />
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="lfb-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={13} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {filtered.length === 0 && !loading && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#475569', fontSize: 12, padding: 20 }}>
          No templates found.
        </div>
      )}

      {filtered.map((t, i) => (
        <div key={t.id || i} className="lfb-template-card" style={{ cursor: 'default' }}>
          <div className="lfb-template-card-name">{t.name}</div>
          {t.description && <div className="lfb-template-card-desc">{t.description}</div>}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 4 }}>
            {(t.tags || []).map((tag) => (
              <span key={tag} className="lfb-template-tag">{tag}</span>
            ))}
            {t.step_count != null && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569' }}>{t.step_count} steps</span>
            )}
            <button
              className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                onTemplateSelected(t);
                toast.success(`Template "${t.name}" applied!`);
              }}
              style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', padding: '3px 10px', fontSize: 11 }}
            >
              Use Template
              <ChevronRight size={11} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── FlowAICopilot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props:
//   steps, params, flowName, lastRunError, lastRunLogs
//   onFlowGenerated(flow), onStepSuggested(step), onTemplateSelected(template)
export default function FlowAICopilot({
  steps = [],
  params = [],
  flowName = '',
  lastRunError = null,
  lastRunLogs = [],
  onFlowGenerated,
  onStepSuggested,
  onTemplateSelected,
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('generate');

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderBottom: '1px solid #334155', flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
        <Sparkles size={14} color="#60a5fa" />
        <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#e2e8f0' }}>AI Copilot</span>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="lfb-ai-tabs">
        {TABS.map(({ id, label, Icon }) => (
          <button
            key={id}
            className={`lfb-ai-tab${activeTab === id ? ' active' : ''}`}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(id)}
          >
            <Icon size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 3, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab body */}
      <div className="lfb-ai-panel-body">
        {activeTab === 'generate' && (
          <GenerateTab
            steps={steps}
            params={params}
            flowName={flowName}
            onFlowGenerated={onFlowGenerated}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'suggest' && (
          <SuggestTab steps={steps} onStepSuggested={onStepSuggested} />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'explain' && (
          <ExplainTab steps={steps} flowName={flowName} />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'debug' && (
          <DebugTab
            steps={steps}
            lastRunError={lastRunError}
            lastRunLogs={lastRunLogs}
            onFlowGenerated={onFlowGenerated}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'templates' && (
          <TemplatesTab onTemplateSelected={onTemplateSelected} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}




src/components/FloatingChatbot.jsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MessageCircle, X, Send, Copy, Play, Zap, RefreshCw, Sparkles, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, Database, Loader2, History, ChevronDown, Table2, BarChart3, ChevronUp, Maximize2, Minimize2, BookOpen, Lightbulb, ShieldAlert, Check, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { BarChart, Bar, LineChart, Line, PieChart, Pie, Cell, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import * as chatbotService from '../services/chatbot';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './FloatingChatbot.css';

const CHART_COLORS = ['#3b82f6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#8b5cf6', '#ec4899', '#06b6d4', '#84cc16', '#f97316', '#6366f1'];

export default function FloatingChatbot() {
  const {
    chatbotOpen,
    chatMessages,
    chatLoading,
    selectedDatabase,
    selectedTable,
    queryHistory,
    databaseType,
    selectedServer,
    toggleChatbot,
    addChatMessage,
    clearChatMessages,
    setChatLoading,
    setPendingQuery,
    setCopilotOrigin,
  } = useQueryStore();

  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  const [selectedQueryText, setSelectedQueryText] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('copilot'); // 'chat' | 'copilot'

  // ── AI Copilot State ──
  const [copilotInput, setCopilotInput] = useState('');
  const [copilotLoading, setCopilotLoading] = useState(false);
  const [copilotMessages, setCopilotMessages] = useState([]);
  const [catalogReady, setCatalogReady] = useState(false);
  const [catalogRefreshing, setCatalogRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [catalogInfo, setCatalogInfo] = useState(null);
  const [copilotHistory, setCopilotHistory] = useState([]);
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const [expandedMsg, setExpandedMsg] = useState(null); // msg id for expanded modal
  const copilotEndRef = useRef(null);

  // Auto-suggest & explain state
  const [suggestedQuestions, setSuggestedQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [suggestLoading, setSuggestLoading] = useState(false);
  const [explainLoading, setExplainLoading] = useState(null); // msg id being explained

  // Action Mode state
  const [actionMode, setActionMode] = useState(false);

  // Auto-scroll to bottom of messages
  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  // ── AI Copilot Effects ──
  useEffect(() => {
    copilotEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [copilotMessages]);

  // Check catalog whenever selected database changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDatabase && activeTab === 'copilot') {
      checkCatalog();
    }
  }, [selectedDatabase, selectedServer, activeTab]);

  const getServerId = () => {
    if (selectedServer?.id) return selectedServer.id;
    if (databaseType === 'bigquery') return 'bigquery';
    return 'default';
  };

  const getDbType = () => {
    if (selectedServer) return selectedServer.db_type || 'cloudsql';
    return databaseType || 'cloudsql';
  };

  const checkCatalog = async () => {
    if (!selectedDatabase) return;
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getAICatalog(selectedDatabase, getServerId());
      const data = res.data;
      setCatalogReady(data.has_catalog);
      setCatalogInfo(data.has_catalog ? { tables: data.count } : null);
    } catch {
      setCatalogReady(false);
      setCatalogInfo(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRefreshCatalog = async () => {
    if (!selectedDatabase) {
      toast.error('Please select a database first');
      return;
    }
    setCatalogRefreshing(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.refreshAICatalog({
        database: selectedDatabase,
        db_type: getDbType(),
        server_id: getServerId(),
        auto_describe: true,
      });
      const data = res.data;
      if (data.success) {
        setCatalogReady(true);
        setCatalogInfo({ tables: data.tables_indexed, descriptions: data.descriptions_generated });
        toast.success(`Indexed ${data.tables_indexed} tables, ${data.columns_indexed} columns`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to refresh catalog: ' + (err.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    } finally {
      setCatalogRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopilotSend = async () => {
    const question = copilotInput.trim();
    if (!question) return;
    if (!selectedDatabase) {
      toast.error('Please select a database from the sidebar first');
      return;
    }
    setCopilotInput('');
    const userMsg = { role: 'user', content: question, id: Date.now() };
    setCopilotMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setCopilotLoading(true);

    // Build conversation history from existing messages for context
    const convHistory = copilotMessages.slice(-10).map(m => {
      if (m.role === 'user') return { role: 'user', content: m.content };
      return { role: 'assistant', sql: m.sql || '', tables_used: m.tables_used || [], result_summary: m.summary || '' };
    });
    // Add the current question
    convHistory.push({ role: 'user', content: question });

    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.generateSQL({
        question,
        database: selectedDatabase,
        db_type: getDbType(),
        server_id: getServerId(),
        auto_execute: true,
        action_mode: actionMode,
        conversation_history: convHistory,
      });
      const data = res.data;

      // Action Mode: mutation detected — needs user review
      if (data.action_mode && data.is_mutation && !data.blocked) {
        // Fetch preview (current data before change)
        let previewData = null;
        try {
          const previewRes = await sqlEditorAPI.actionPreview({
            sql: data.sql,
            database: selectedDatabase,
            db_type: getDbType(),
            server_id: getServerId(),
          });
          if (previewRes.data?.success) {
            previewData = previewRes.data.preview;
          }
        } catch { /* preview failed, still show SQL */ }

        setCopilotMessages(prev => [...prev, {
          role: 'assistant',
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          question,
          sql: data.sql,
          tables_used: data.tables_used || [],
          error: data.error,
          dialect: data.dialect,
          execution: null,
          summary: null,
          chart_config: null,
          feedback: null,
          showTable: true,
          showChart: false,
          resultView: 'table',
          sqlExpanded: false,
          // Action Mode fields
          actionMode: true,
          isMutation: true,
          actionStatus: 'pending', // 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'rejected'
          beforeData: previewData,
          afterData: null,
        }]);
      } else if (data.action_mode && data.blocked) {
        // Destructive operation blocked
        setCopilotMessages(prev => [...prev, {
          role: 'assistant',
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          question,
          sql: data.sql,
          tables_used: data.tables_used || [],
          error: data.error || 'Destructive operations (DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE) are not allowed in Action Mode.',
          dialect: data.dialect,
          execution: null,
          summary: null,
          chart_config: null,
          feedback: null,
          showTable: false,
          showChart: false,
          resultView: 'table',
          sqlExpanded: false,
          actionMode: true,
          isMutation: true,
          actionStatus: 'blocked',
        }]);
      } else {
        setCopilotMessages(prev => [...prev, {
        role: 'assistant',
        id: Date.now() + 1,
        question,
        sql: data.sql,
        tables_used: data.tables_used || [],
        error: data.error,
        dialect: data.dialect,
        execution: data.execution,
        summary: data.summary,
        chart_config: data.chart_config,
        feedback: null,
        showTable: true,
        showChart: !!data.chart_config,
        resultView: 'table', // 'table' | 'chart'
        sqlExpanded: false,
      }]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setCopilotMessages(prev => [...prev, {
        role: 'assistant',
        id: Date.now() + 1,
        error: err.response?.data?.detail || err.message,
        sql: null,
      }]);
    } finally {
      setCopilotLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopilotFeedback = async (msg, fb) => {
    setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msg.id ? { ...m, feedback: fb } : m));
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.submitAIFeedback({
        question: msg.question,
        feedback: fb,
        database: selectedDatabase,
        was_executed: false,
      });
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const handleCopySQL = (sql) => {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(sql).then(() => toast.success('SQL copied to clipboard!')).catch(() => fallbackCopy(sql));
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(sql);
    }
  };

  const fallbackCopy = (text) => {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.left = '-9999px';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try {
      document.execCommand('copy');
      toast.success('SQL copied to clipboard!');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Copy failed — please select and copy manually');
    }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  };

  const handlePasteSQL = (sql, question) => {
    // Use Zustand store to push query to the editor via App.jsx
    setPendingQuery(sql);
    // Track copilot origin so edits can be sent back as "gold" training examples
    setCopilotOrigin({ question: question || '', originalSql: sql, database: selectedDatabase });
    toast.success('SQL sent to editor!');
  };

  // ── Explain SQL ──
  const handleExplainSQL = async (msg) => {
    if (!msg.sql || explainLoading) return;
    setExplainLoading(msg.id);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.explainSQL({
        sql: msg.sql,
        db_type: getDbType(),
      });
      const explanation = res.data?.explanation || 'Could not generate explanation.';
      setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
        m.id === msg.id ? { ...m, explanation } : m
      ));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to explain SQL');
    } finally {
      setExplainLoading(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Action Mode: Confirm Execution ──
  const handleActionConfirm = async (msg) => {
    if (!msg.sql || msg.actionStatus !== 'pending') return;
    // Mark as loading
    setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
      m.id === msg.id ? { ...m, actionStatus: 'executing' } : m
    ));
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.actionExecute({
        sql: msg.sql,
        database: selectedDatabase,
        db_type: getDbType(),
        server_id: getServerId(),
      });
      const data = res.data;
      if (data.success) {
        setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
          m.id === msg.id ? {
            ...m,
            actionStatus: 'confirmed',
            execution: data.execution,
            afterData: data.after_data,
          } : m
        ));
        toast.success(`Action executed successfully — ${data.execution?.rows_affected || 0} row(s) affected`);
      } else {
        setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
          m.id === msg.id ? {
            ...m,
            actionStatus: 'error',
            error: data.error || 'Execution failed',
          } : m
        ));
        toast.error('Action execution failed: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
        m.id === msg.id ? {
          ...m,
          actionStatus: 'error',
          error: err.response?.data?.detail || err.message,
        } : m
      ));
      toast.error('Action execution failed');
    }
  };

  // ── Action Mode: Reject Execution ──
  const handleActionReject = (msg) => {
    setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
      m.id === msg.id ? { ...m, actionStatus: 'rejected' } : m
    ));
    toast('Action cancelled', { icon: '🚫' });
  };

  // ── Auto-Suggest Questions ──
  const loadSuggestedQuestions = async () => {
    if (!selectedDatabase || suggestLoading) return;
    setSuggestLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.suggestQuestions(selectedDatabase, getServerId());
      if (res.data?.suggestions) {
        setSuggestedQuestions(res.data.suggestions);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSuggestLoading(false);
  };

  // Load suggestions when database changes and catalog is ready
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDatabase && catalogReady && activeTab === 'copilot' && copilotMessages.length === 0) {
      loadSuggestedQuestions();
    }
  }, [selectedDatabase, catalogReady, activeTab]);

  const loadCopilotHistory = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getAIHistory(selectedDatabase || '', 20);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setCopilotHistory(res.data.history || []);
        setShowHistory(true);
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load history');
    }
  };

  const reuseHistoryQuestion = (q) => {
    setCopilotInput(q);
    setShowHistory(false);
  };

  const handleSendMessage = async () => {
    if (!inputValue.trim()) return;

    // Add user message
    addChatMessage({
      id: Date.now(),
      role: 'user',
      content: inputValue,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    });

    setInputValue('');
