src/components/DataLineage.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Network, Search, RefreshCw, AlertTriangle, Database, Layers, Clock,
  Workflow, LayoutDashboard, BookOpen, ArrowRight, ChevronDown, ChevronUp,
  X, ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Maximize2, Info, Shield, Target, Filter,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './DataLineage.css';

const NODE_COLORS = {
  column:   { bg: '#ede9fe', border: '#8b5cf6', text: '#6d28d9', icon: '●' },
  table:    { bg: '#dbeafe', border: '#3b82f6', text: '#1d4ed8', icon: '▦' },
  query:    { bg: '#fef3c7', border: '#f59e0b', text: '#b45309', icon: '?' },
  api:      { bg: '#d1fae5', border: '#10b981', text: '#047857', icon: '⚡' },
  scheduler:{ bg: '#fee2e2', border: '#ef4444', text: '#b91c1c', icon: '⏱' },
  pipeline: { bg: '#e0e7ff', border: '#6366f1', text: '#4338ca', icon: '⤳' },
  widget:   { bg: '#fce7f3', border: '#ec4899', text: '#be185d', icon: '📊' },
};

const NODE_ICONS = {
  column:   Target,
  table:    Database,
  query:    BookOpen,
  api:      Layers,
  scheduler:Clock,
  pipeline: Workflow,
  widget:   LayoutDashboard,
};

const SEVERITY_COLORS = {
  critical: { bg: '#fef2f2', border: '#ef4444', text: '#b91c1c', label: 'CRITICAL' },
  warning:  { bg: '#fffbeb', border: '#f59e0b', text: '#b45309', label: 'WARNING' },
  low:      { bg: '#f0fdf4', border: '#22c55e', text: '#15803d', label: 'LOW RISK' },
  safe:     { bg: '#f0f9ff', border: '#3b82f6', text: '#1d4ed8', label: 'SAFE' },
};

export default function DataLineage() {
  const [searchTable, setSearchTable] = useState('');
  const [searchColumn, setSearchColumn] = useState('');
  const [searchDb, setSearchDb] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [graph, setGraph] = useState(null);        // { nodes, edges, impact }
  const [impact, setImpact] = useState(null);       // impact analysis result
  const [impactLoading, setImpactLoading] = useState(false);
  const [tables, setTables] = useState([]);          // for autocomplete
  const [showTableDropdown, setShowTableDropdown] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('graph');  // graph | impact
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [pan, setPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [selectedNode, setSelectedNode] = useState(null);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('all');
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const isPanning = useRef(false);
  const panStart = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  // Load known table names for autocomplete (debounced)
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getLineageTables(searchDb);
        const data = res?.data ?? res;
        setTables(data?.tables || []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Failed to load lineage tables:', err?.message);
        setTables([]);
      }
    }, 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchDb]);

  const filteredTables = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchTable) return tables.slice(0, 20);
    return tables.filter(t => t.toLowerCase().includes(searchTable.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 20);
  }, [tables, searchTable]);

  // Scan lineage
  const handleScan = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!searchTable.trim()) {
      toast.error('Enter a table name to scan');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setGraph(null);
    setImpact(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.scanLineage(searchDb, searchTable.trim(), searchColumn.trim());
      const data = res?.data ?? res;
      if (data?.success) {
        setGraph(data);
        if (data.nodes.length === 0) {
          toast('No lineage found for this table', { icon: 'ℹ️' });
        } else {
          toast.success(`Found ${data.nodes.length} nodes, ${data.edges.length} edges`);
        }
      } else {
        toast.error(data?.detail || 'Scan failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || 'Scan failed');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [searchTable, searchColumn, searchDb]);

  // Impact analysis
  const handleImpact = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!searchTable.trim()) {
      toast.error('Enter a table name for impact analysis');
      return;
    }
    setImpactLoading(true);
    setImpact(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getImpactAnalysis(searchDb, searchTable.trim(), searchColumn.trim());
      const data = res?.data ?? res;
      if (data?.success) {
        setImpact(data);
        setActiveTab('impact');
      } else {
        toast.error(data?.detail || 'Impact analysis failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || 'Impact analysis failed');
    } finally {
      setImpactLoading(false);
    }
  }, [searchTable, searchColumn, searchDb]);

  // Compute node positions (force-directed-like layout by type tiers)
  const layout = useMemo(() => {
    if (!graph || !graph.nodes.length) return { positioned: [], edgePaths: [] };

    const byType = {};
    graph.nodes.forEach(n => {
      if (!byType[n.type]) byType[n.type] = [];
      byType[n.type].push(n);
    });

    const tierOrder = ['column', 'table', 'query', 'api', 'scheduler', 'pipeline', 'widget'];
    const positioned = [];
    let tierX = 60;

    tierOrder.forEach(type => {
      const items = byType[type] || [];
      if (!items.length) return;
      const colWidth = 220;
      items.forEach((node, i) => {
        positioned.push({
          ...node,
          x: tierX,
          y: 80 + i * 90,
          w: 200,
          h: 60,
        });
      });
      tierX += colWidth + 60;
    });

    // Build edge paths
    const nodeMap = {};
    positioned.forEach(n => { nodeMap[n.id] = n; });

    const edgePaths = (graph.edges || []).map(e => {
      const src = nodeMap[e.source];
      const tgt = nodeMap[e.target];
      if (!src || !tgt) return null;
      return {
        ...e,
        x1: src.x + src.w,
        y1: src.y + src.h / 2,
        x2: tgt.x,
        y2: tgt.y + tgt.h / 2,
      };
    }).filter(Boolean);

    return { positioned, edgePaths };
  }, [graph]);

  const filteredNodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (filterType === 'all') return layout.positioned;
    return layout.positioned.filter(n => n.type === filterType);
  }, [layout.positioned, filterType]);

  const filteredNodeIds = useMemo(() => new Set(filteredNodes.map(n => n.id)), [filteredNodes]);

  const filteredEdges = useMemo(() => {
    if (filterType === 'all') return layout.edgePaths;
    return layout.edgePaths.filter(e => filteredNodeIds.has(e.source) || filteredNodeIds.has(e.target));
  }, [layout.edgePaths, filterType, filteredNodeIds]);

  // Canvas dimensions
  const canvasWidth = useMemo(() => {
    if (!layout.positioned.length) return 800;
    return Math.max(800, Math.max(...layout.positioned.map(n => n.x + n.w)) + 100);
  }, [layout.positioned]);

  const canvasHeight = useMemo(() => {
    if (!layout.positioned.length) return 600;
    return Math.max(600, Math.max(...layout.positioned.map(n => n.y + n.h)) + 100);
  }, [layout.positioned]);

  // Pan handlers
  const handleMouseDown = e => {
    if (e.button === 0) {
      isPanning.current = true;
      panStart.current = { x: e.clientX - pan.x, y: e.clientY - pan.y };
    }
  };
  const handleMouseMove = e => {
    if (isPanning.current) {
      setPan({ x: e.clientX - panStart.current.x, y: e.clientY - panStart.current.y });
    }
  };
  const handleMouseUp = () => { isPanning.current = false; };

  return (
    <div className="lineage-container">
      {/* Top Bar */}
      <div className="lineage-header">
        <div className="lineage-title-row">
          <Network size={22} className="text-indigo-600" />
          <h2>Data Lineage & Impact Analysis</h2>
        </div>
        <p className="lineage-subtitle">
          Track how tables and columns flow through queries, APIs, scheduler jobs, pipelines, and dashboard widgets.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Search Controls */}
      <div className="lineage-search-bar">
        <div className="lineage-search-group">
          <label>Database</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g. mydb (optional)"
            value={searchDb}
            onChange={e => setSearchDb(e.target.value)}
            className="lineage-input"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="lineage-search-group" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <label>Table *</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g. users, orders"
            value={searchTable}
            onChange={e => { setSearchTable(e.target.value); setShowTableDropdown(true); }}
            onFocus={() => setShowTableDropdown(true)}
            onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowTableDropdown(false), 200)}
            className="lineage-input"
          />
          {showTableDropdown && filteredTables.length > 0 && (
            <div className="lineage-dropdown">
              {filteredTables.map(t => (
                <div
                  key={t}
                  className="lineage-dropdown-item"
                  onMouseDown={() => { setSearchTable(t); setShowTableDropdown(false); }}
                >
                  {t}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="lineage-search-group">
          <label>Column</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g. id, email (optional)"
            value={searchColumn}
            onChange={e => setSearchColumn(e.target.value)}
            className="lineage-input"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="lineage-search-actions">
          <button className="lineage-btn primary" onClick={handleScan} disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Search size={14} />}
            Scan Lineage
          </button>
          <button className="lineage-btn danger" onClick={handleImpact} disabled={impactLoading}>
            {impactLoading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <AlertTriangle size={14} />}
            Impact Analysis
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="lineage-tabs">
        <button
          className={`lineage-tab ${activeTab === 'graph' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('graph')}
        >
          <Network size={14} /> Lineage Graph
          {graph && <span className="lineage-badge">{graph.nodes?.length || 0}</span>}
        </button>
        <button
          className={`lineage-tab ${activeTab === 'impact' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('impact')}
        >
          <AlertTriangle size={14} /> Impact Report
          {impact && <span className={`lineage-badge ${impact.severity}`}>{impact.total_affected}</span>}
        </button>

        {/* Filter by type (graph tab only) */}
        {activeTab === 'graph' && graph && (
          <div className="lineage-type-filter">
            <Filter size={13} />
            {['all', 'table', 'query', 'api', 'scheduler', 'pipeline', 'widget'].map(t => (
              <button
                key={t}
                className={`lineage-filter-chip ${filterType === t ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setFilterType(t)}
                style={t !== 'all' ? { borderColor: NODE_COLORS[t]?.border } : {}}
              >
                {t === 'all' ? 'All' : t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Zoom controls */}
        {activeTab === 'graph' && graph && (
          <div className="lineage-zoom-controls">
            <button onClick={() => setZoom(z => Math.max(0.3, z - 0.1))} title="Zoom out"><ZoomOut size={14} /></button>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{Math.round(zoom * 100)}%</span>
            <button onClick={() => setZoom(z => Math.min(2, z + 0.1))} title="Zoom in"><ZoomIn size={14} /></button>
            <button onClick={() => { setZoom(1); setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 }); }} title="Reset"><Maximize2 size={14} /></button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Graph View */}
      {activeTab === 'graph' && (
        <div className="lineage-graph-area">
          {!graph && !loading && (
            <div className="lineage-empty">
              <Network size={48} className="text-gray-300" />
              <p>Enter a table name and click <strong>Scan Lineage</strong> to visualize the dependency graph.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {loading && (
            <div className="lineage-loading">
              <RefreshCw size={24} className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
              <p>Scanning all system tables for references...</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {graph && graph.nodes.length === 0 && !loading && (
            <div className="lineage-empty">
              <Info size={36} className="text-gray-400" />
              <p>No lineage found for <strong>{searchTable}</strong>. This table may not be referenced in any queries, APIs, or jobs.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {graph && graph.nodes.length > 0 && (
            <>
              {/* Impact Summary Strip */}
              <div className="lineage-impact-strip">
                {Object.entries(graph.impact || {}).map(([key, val]) => (
                  <div key={key} className="lineage-impact-chip">
                    <span className="count">{val}</span>
                    <span className="label">{key}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Graph Canvas */}
              <div
                className="lineage-canvas-wrapper"
                ref={canvasRef}
                onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
                onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
                onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
                onMouseLeave={handleMouseUp}
              >
                <svg
                  width={canvasWidth * zoom}
                  height={canvasHeight * zoom}
                  viewBox={`${-pan.x / zoom} ${-pan.y / zoom} ${canvasWidth} ${canvasHeight}`}
                  className="lineage-svg"
                >
                  <defs>
                    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto">
                      <polygon points="0 0, 8 3, 0 6" fill="#94a3b8" />
                    </marker>
                  </defs>

                  {/* Edges */}
                  {filteredEdges.map((e, i) => {
                    const dx = e.x2 - e.x1;
                    const cp = dx * 0.4;
                    return (
                      <g key={i}>
                        <path
                          d={`M${e.x1},${e.y1} C${e.x1 + cp},${e.y1} ${e.x2 - cp},${e.y2} ${e.x2},${e.y2}`}
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="#94a3b8"
                          strokeWidth="1.5"
                          markerEnd="url(#arrow)"
                          className="lineage-edge"
                        />
                        <text
                          x={(e.x1 + e.x2) / 2}
                          y={(e.y1 + e.y2) / 2 - 6}
                          fontSize="9"
                          fill="#94a3b8"
                          textAnchor="middle"
                        >
                          {e.relation}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  })}

                  {/* Nodes */}
                  {filteredNodes.map(node => {
                    const colors = NODE_COLORS[node.type] || NODE_COLORS.table;
                    const Icon = NODE_ICONS[node.type] || Database;
                    const isSelected = selectedNode?.id === node.id;
                    return (
                      <g
                        key={node.id}
                        className="lineage-node-g"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedNode(isSelected ? null : node)}
                        style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                      >
                        <rect
                          x={node.x} y={node.y}
                          width={node.w} height={node.h}
                          rx="10" ry="10"
                          fill={isSelected ? colors.border : colors.bg}
                          stroke={colors.border}
                          strokeWidth={isSelected ? 2.5 : 1.5}
                          className="lineage-node-rect"
                        />
                        <text
                          x={node.x + 34}
                          y={node.y + 24}
                          fontSize="11"
                          fontWeight="600"
                          fill={isSelected ? '#fff' : colors.text}
                        >
                          {node.label.length > 22 ? node.label.slice(0, 22) + '…' : node.label}
                        </text>
                        <text
                          x={node.x + 34}
                          y={node.y + 42}
                          fontSize="9"
                          fill={isSelected ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' : '#94a3b8'}
                        >
                          {node.type.toUpperCase()}
                          {node.meta?.database ? ` · ${node.meta.database}` : ''}
                        </text>
                        {/* Type icon circle */}
                        <circle
                          cx={node.x + 18} cy={node.y + 30}
                          r="12"
                          fill={isSelected ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : colors.border + '22'}
                          stroke={colors.border}
                          strokeWidth="1"
                        />
                        <text
                          x={node.x + 18}
                          y={node.y + 34}
                          fontSize="12"
                          textAnchor="middle"
                          fill={colors.border}
                        >
                          {colors.icon}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  })}
                </svg>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Node Detail Panel */}
          {selectedNode && (
            <div className="lineage-detail-panel">
              <div className="lineage-detail-header">
                <h4>{selectedNode.label}</h4>
                <button onClick={() => setSelectedNode(null)}><X size={14} /></button>
              </div>
              <div className="lineage-detail-body">
                <div className="detail-row"><span>Type</span><span className="detail-type-badge" style={{ background: NODE_COLORS[selectedNode.type]?.bg, color: NODE_COLORS[selectedNode.type]?.text }}>{selectedNode.type}</span></div>
                <div className="detail-row"><span>ID</span><span>{selectedNode.id}</span></div>
                {selectedNode.meta?.database && <div className="detail-row"><span>Database</span><span>{selectedNode.meta.database}</span></div>}
                {selectedNode.meta?.user && <div className="detail-row"><span>Owner</span><span>{selectedNode.meta.user}</span></div>}
                {selectedNode.meta?.owner && <div className="detail-row"><span>Owner</span><span>{selectedNode.meta.owner}</span></div>}
                {selectedNode.meta?.dashboard_id && <div className="detail-row"><span>Dashboard</span><span>#{selectedNode.meta.dashboard_id}</span></div>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Impact Tab */}
      {activeTab === 'impact' && (
        <div className="lineage-impact-area">
          {!impact && !impactLoading && (
            <div className="lineage-empty">
              <AlertTriangle size={48} className="text-gray-300" />
              <p>Enter a table name and click <strong>Impact Analysis</strong> to see what would break.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {impactLoading && (
            <div className="lineage-loading">
              <RefreshCw size={24} className="animate-spin text-red-500" />
              <p>Analyzing downstream impact...</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {impact && (
            <div className="impact-report">
              {/* Severity Banner */}
              <div
                className="impact-severity-banner"
                style={{
                  background: SEVERITY_COLORS[impact.severity]?.bg,
                  borderColor: SEVERITY_COLORS[impact.severity]?.border,
                  color: SEVERITY_COLORS[impact.severity]?.text,
                }}
              >
                <AlertTriangle size={20} />
                <div>
                  <strong>{SEVERITY_COLORS[impact.severity]?.label}</strong>
                  <p>{impact.message}</p>
                </div>
                <span className="impact-count">{impact.total_affected}</span>
              </div>

              {/* Target */}
              <div className="impact-target">
                <Shield size={16} />
                <span>
                  Target: <strong>{impact.target.table}</strong>
                  {impact.target.column && <> → <strong>{impact.target.column}</strong></>}
                  {impact.target.database && <span className="text-gray-400"> ({impact.target.database})</span>}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Affected categories */}
              {[
                { key: 'queries', label: 'Saved Queries', icon: BookOpen, color: '#f59e0b' },
                { key: 'apis', label: 'Custom APIs', icon: Layers, color: '#10b981' },
                { key: 'jobs', label: 'Scheduler Jobs', icon: Clock, color: '#ef4444' },
                { key: 'pipelines', label: 'Pipelines', icon: Workflow, color: '#6366f1' },
                { key: 'widgets', label: 'Dashboard Widgets', icon: LayoutDashboard, color: '#ec4899' },
              ].map(({ key, label, icon: Icon, color }) => {
                const items = impact.affected?.[key] || [];
                if (!items.length) return null;
                return (
                  <div key={key} className="impact-category">
                    <div className="impact-cat-header" style={{ borderLeftColor: color }}>
                      <Icon size={16} style={{ color }} />
                      <span>{label}</span>
                      <span className="impact-cat-count">{items.length}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="impact-cat-items">
                      {items.map((item, i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="impact-item">
                          <span className="impact-item-name">{item.name || item.title || `#${item.id}`}</span>
                          {item.owner && <span className="impact-item-meta">by {item.owner}</span>}
                          {item.user && <span className="impact-item-meta">by {item.user}</span>}
                          {item.database && <span className="impact-item-meta">{item.database}</span>}
                          {item.dashboard && <span className="impact-item-meta">Dashboard: {item.dashboard}</span>}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}

              {impact.total_affected === 0 && (
                <div className="impact-safe">
                  <Shield size={24} className="text-green-500" />
                  <p>No downstream dependencies found. This table/column can be safely modified.</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

          title="Connect to Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)"
        >
          <Database size={18} />
          <span>Cloud SQL</span>
        </button>
        <button

          title="Connect to BigQuery"
        >
          <Cloud size={18} />
          <span>BigQuery</span>
        </button>
        <button
          className={`selector-btn ${databaseType === 'mssql' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setDatabaseType('mssql')}
          title="Connect to MS SQL Server"
        >
          <Server size={18} />
          <span>MSSQL</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/DatabaseSelector.jsx

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Database, Loader, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useDatabaseOperations } from '../hooks/useDatabase';
import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';

export const DatabaseSelector = ({ onDatabaseSelect, databaseType = 'cloudsql', searchTerm = '' }) => {
  const { fetchDatabases } = useDatabaseOperations();
  const { databases, loadingDatabases, selectedDatabase, error } = useQueryStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDatabases(databaseType, searchTerm);
  }, [databaseType, searchTerm]);

  const handleSelectDatabase = (db) => {
    if (onDatabaseSelect) {
      onDatabaseSelect(db.name);
    }
  };

  // Filter databases based on search term
  const filteredDatabases = searchTerm 
    ? databases.filter(db => db.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()))
    : databases;

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col">
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="flex items-center mb-4">
          <Database size={20} className="text-blue-600 mr-2" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg text-gray-800">
            {databaseType === 'bigquery' ? 'Datasets' : 'Databases'}
          </h3>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded flex items-start">
            <AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600 mr-2 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-sm text-red-700">{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        {loadingDatabases ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
            <Loader className="animate-spin text-blue-600" size={24} />
          </div>
        ) : filteredDatabases.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">
            <p>No {databaseType === 'bigquery' ? 'datasets' : 'databases'} available</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2 p-4">
            {filteredDatabases.map((db) => (
              <button
                key={db.name}
                onClick={() => handleSelectDatabase(db)}
                className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded transition ${
                  selectedDatabase === db.name
                    ? 'bg-blue-100 border border-blue-400 text-blue-900'
                    : 'bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="font-medium text-sm">{db.name}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Size: {db.size || 'N/A'}</div>
              </button>
            ))}
```          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DatabaseSelector;




src/components/DashboardBuilder.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import {
  Plus, Save, Trash2, RefreshCw, X, LayoutDashboard,
  BarChart3, Table2, Hash, PieChart, Pencil, Eye, Globe,

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Constants
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const WIDGET_TYPES = [

const CHART_TYPES = [

const HEIGHT_OPTIONS = [

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DashboardBuilder Component
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export default function DashboardBuilder() {
  /* ── Sub-tab: 'dashboards' | 'embed' ───────────────────── */
  const [subTab, setSubTab] = useState('dashboards');

  /* ── Dashboard list ────────────────────────────────────── */
  const [dashboards, setDashboards] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(null);

  /* ── Current dashboard ─────────────────────────────────── */
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(false);
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [widgets, setWidgets] = useState([]);

  /* ── UI state ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingWidget, setEditingWidget] = useState(null);
  const [refreshingWidgets, setRefreshingWidgets] = useState(new Set());

  /* ── Drag-to-reorder state ─────────────────────────────── */
  const [dragIdx, setDragIdx] = useState(null);
  const [dragOverIdx, setDragOverIdx] = useState(null);

  /* ── Inline resize state ───────────────────────────────── */
  const [resizingId, setResizingId] = useState(null);

  /* ── Share modal ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  const [showShareModal, setShowShareModal] = useState(false);
  const [shareToken, setShareToken] = useState('');
  const [shareLoading, setShareLoading] = useState(false);

  /* ── Auto-refresh timer ────────────────────────────────── */
  const refreshTimer = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (refreshTimer.current) clearInterval(refreshTimer.current);
    if (autoRefresh > 0 && selectedId && widgets.length > 0) {
      refreshTimer.current = setInterval(() => {
        widgets.forEach(w => refreshWidget(w.id));
      }, autoRefresh * 1000);
    }
    return () => { if (refreshTimer.current) clearInterval(refreshTimer.current); };
  }, [autoRefresh, selectedId, widgets.length]);

  /* ── Load dashboards ───────────────────────────────────── */
  const loadDashboards = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.listDashboards();
      setDashboards(data.dashboards || []);
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load dashboards');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadDashboards(); }, [loadDashboards]);

  /* ── Select dashboard ──────────────────────────────────── */
  const selectDashboard = useCallback(async (id) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.getDashboard(id);
      const d = data.dashboard;
      setSelectedId(d.id);
      setName(d.name);
      setDescription(d.description);
      setIsPublic(d.is_public);
      setAutoRefresh(d.auto_refresh || 0);
      setWidgets(data.widgets || []);
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load dashboard');
    }
  }, []);

  /* ── New dashboard ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  const newDashboard = async () => {
    try {
      const body = { name: 'New Dashboard', description: '', is_public: false, auto_refresh: 0 };
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.createDashboard(body);
      setSelectedId(data.id);
      setName('New Dashboard');
      setDescription('');
      setIsPublic(false);
      setAutoRefresh(0);
      setWidgets([]);
      loadDashboards();
      toast.success('Dashboard created — now add widgets!');
      setShowAddModal(true);
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to create dashboard');
    }
  };

  /* ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const saveDashboard = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) { toast.error('Dashboard name required'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      // Include layout order in save
      const layout = widgets.map((w, i) => ({ id: w.id, order: i, width: w.width, height: w.height }));
      const body = { name, description, is_public: isPublic, auto_refresh: autoRefresh, layout };
      if (selectedId) {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateDashboard(selectedId, body);
        toast.success('Dashboard updated');
      } else {
        const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.createDashboard(body);
        setSelectedId(data.id);
        toast.success('Dashboard created');
      }
      loadDashboards();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Save failed');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  /* ── Delete ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const deleteDashboard = async () => {
    if (!selectedId) return;
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this dashboard and all widgets?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteDashboard(selectedId);
      toast.success('Deleted');
      setSelectedId(null);
      setName('');
      setDescription('');
      setIsPublic(false);
      setAutoRefresh(0);
      setWidgets([]);
      loadDashboards();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Delete failed');
    }
  };

  /* ── Widget CRUD ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  const addWidget = async (wdata) => {
    if (!selectedId) { toast.error('Save dashboard first'); return; }
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.addWidget(selectedId, wdata);
      toast.success('Widget added');
      selectDashboard(selectedId);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to add widget'); }
  };

  const updateWidget = async (widgetId, wdata) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.updateWidget(selectedId, widgetId, wdata);
      toast.success('Widget updated');
      selectDashboard(selectedId);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to update widget'); }
  };

  const deleteWidget = async (widgetId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Remove this widget?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteWidget(selectedId, widgetId);
      toast.success('Removed');
      setWidgets(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== widgetId));
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to remove widget'); }
  };

  const refreshWidget = async (widgetId) => {
    setRefreshingWidgets(prev => new Set(prev).add(widgetId));
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.refreshWidget(selectedId, widgetId);
      setWidgets(prev => prev.map(w =>
        w.id === widgetId ? { ...w, _liveData: data.data, _liveColumns: data.columns, _liveCount: data.row_count } : w
      ));
    } catch {
      toast.error('Refresh failed');
    } finally {
      setRefreshingWidgets(prev => { const s = new Set(prev); s.delete(widgetId); return s; });
    }
  };

  const refreshAll = () => widgets.forEach(w => refreshWidget(w.id));

  /* ── Inline resize (width / height) ────────────────────── */
  const resizeWidget = async (widgetId, field, delta) => {
    const w = widgets.find(x => x.id === widgetId);
    if (!w) return;
    let newVal;
    if (field === 'width') {
      const widths = [3, 4, 6, 8, 12];
      const idx = widths.indexOf(w.width || 6);
      const nIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(widths.length - 1, idx + delta));
      newVal = widths[nIdx];
    } else {
      const heights = [2, 3, 4, 6, 8];
      const idx = heights.indexOf(w.height || 4);
      const nIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(heights.length - 1, idx + delta));
      newVal = heights[nIdx];
    }
    // Optimistic update
    setWidgets(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === widgetId ? { ...x, [field]: newVal } : x));
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.updateWidget(selectedId, widgetId, { [field]: newVal });
    } catch { /* revert on error */ selectDashboard(selectedId); }
  };

  /* ── Drag to reorder ───────────────────────────────────── */
  const handleDragStart = (e, idx) => {
    setDragIdx(idx);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', idx);
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e, idx) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    setDragOverIdx(idx);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e, dropIdx) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (dragIdx === null || dragIdx === dropIdx) { setDragIdx(null); setDragOverIdx(null); return; }
    const reordered = [...widgets];
    const [moved] = reordered.splice(dragIdx, 1);
    reordered.splice(dropIdx, 0, moved);
    setWidgets(reordered);
    setDragIdx(null);
    setDragOverIdx(null);
    // Persist order by saving position_y
    reordered.forEach((w, i) => {
      sqlEditorAPI.updateWidget(selectedId, w.id, { position_y: i }).catch(() => {});
    });
    toast.success('Widget order updated');
  };

  const handleDragEnd = () => { setDragIdx(null); setDragOverIdx(null); };

  /* ── Share link — generate token ───────────────────────── */
  const shareDashboard = async () => {
    if (!selectedId) return;
    setShowShareModal(true);
    setShareLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.shareDashboard(selectedId);
      setShareToken(data.share_token || '');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to generate share link');
      setShowShareModal(false);
    } finally {
      setShareLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const copyShareLink = () => {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/?view=dashboard&token=${shareToken}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url);
    toast.success('View-only link copied!');
  };

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Render helpers
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  const renderWidgetContent = (w) => {
    const rows = w._liveData || (w.last_data ? (typeof w.last_data === 'string' ? tryParse(w.last_data) : w.last_data) : null);
    const cols = w._liveColumns || (rows && rows.length > 0 ? Object.keys(rows[0]) : []);

    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
      return <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', padding: 20 }}>No data — click refresh</div>;
    }

    // Number widget
    if (w.widget_type === 'number') {
      const val = rows[0] ? Object.values(rows[0])[0] : 0;
      const label = cols[0] || 'Value';
      return (
        <div className="w-number">
          <div className="big-val">{typeof val === 'number' ? val.toLocaleString() : val}</div>
          <div className="big-label">{label}</div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    // Table widget
    if (w.widget_type === 'table') {
      return (
        <table className="w-table">
          <thead><tr>{cols.map(c => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.slice(0, 200).map((r, i) => (
              <tr key={i}>{cols.map(c => <td key={c}>{r[c] != null ? String(r[c]) : ''}</td>)}</tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      );
    }

    // Chart widget
    if (w.widget_type === 'chart') {
      const cfg = w.chart_config || {};
      const labelCol = cfg.labelColumn || cols[0] || '';
      const valueCol = cfg.valueColumn || (cols.length > 1 ? cols[1] : cols[0]) || '';
      const chartType = w.chart_type || 'bar';

      const labels = rows.map(r => String(r[labelCol] || ''));
      const values = rows.map(r => parseFloat(r[valueCol]) || 0);
      const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);

      if (chartType === 'bar') {
        return (
          <div className="w-bar-chart" style={{ paddingBottom: 22 }}>
            {values.map((v, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="w-bar" style={{ height: `${(v / maxVal) * 100}%` }} title={`${labels[i]}: ${v}`}>
                <span className="w-bar-label">{labels[i]?.slice(0, 8)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (chartType === 'line') {
        const w2 = 500, h2 = 150;
        const pts = values.map((v, i) => {
          const x = (i / Math.max(values.length - 1, 1)) * (w2 - 20) + 10;
          const y = h2 - 10 - (v / maxVal) * (h2 - 30);
          return `${x},${y}`;
        });
        return (
          <svg className="w-line-chart" viewBox={`0 0 ${w2} ${h2}`} preserveAspectRatio="none">
            <polyline points={pts.join(' ')} fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth="2" />
            {pts.map((p, i) => {
              const [x, y] = p.split(',');
              return <circle key={i} cx={x} cy={y} r="3" fill="#3b82f6"><title>{labels[i]}: {values[i]}</title></circle>;
            })}
          </svg>
        );
      }

      if (chartType === 'pie') {
        const total = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1;
        const colors = ['#3b82f6','#ef4444','#16a34a','#f59e0b','#8b5cf6','#ec4899','#14b8a6','#f97316'];
        let acc = 0;
        return (
          <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', maxHeight: 200 }}>
            {values.map((v, i) => {
              const start = acc;
              acc += (v / total) * 360;
              const end = acc;
              const la = (end - start) > 180 ? 1 : 0;
              const sr = (Math.PI / 180) * (start - 90), er = (Math.PI / 180) * (end - 90);
              const x1 = 100 + 80 * Math.cos(sr), y1 = 100 + 80 * Math.sin(sr);
              const x2 = 100 + 80 * Math.cos(er), y2 = 100 + 80 * Math.sin(er);
              return (
                <path key={i}
                  d={`M100,100 L${x1},${y1} A80,80 0 ${la},1 ${x2},${y2} Z`}
                  fill={colors[i % colors.length]}
                  stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1"
                >
                  <title>{labels[i]}: {v} ({((v/total)*100).toFixed(1)}%)</title>
                </path>
              );
            })}
          </svg>
        );
      }
    }

    return <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12 }}>Unsupported type</div>;
  };

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Render
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  return (
    <div className="dash-root">
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="dash-toolbar">
        <LayoutDashboard size={22} style={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
        <h2>Dashboard Builder</h2>

        {/* Sub-tabs */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, background: '#f1f5f9', padding: 3, borderRadius: 8, marginLeft: 12 }}>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSubTab('dashboards')}
            style={{
              padding: '5px 14px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600,
              border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', transition: 'all .15s',
              background: subTab === 'dashboards' ? 'white' : 'transparent',
              color: subTab === 'dashboards' ? '#3b82f6' : '#64748b',
              boxShadow: subTab === 'dashboards' ? '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)' : 'none',
            }}
          >
            <LayoutDashboard size={13} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: -2 }} /> Dashboards
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSubTab('embed')}
            style={{
              padding: '5px 14px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600,
              border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', transition: 'all .15s',
              background: subTab === 'embed' ? 'white' : 'transparent',
              color: subTab === 'embed' ? '#3b82f6' : '#64748b',
              boxShadow: subTab === 'embed' ? '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)' : 'none',
            }}
          >
            <Code2 size={13} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: -2 }} /> Embed BI
          </button>
        </div>

        {subTab === 'dashboards' && (
          <div className="dash-actions">
            <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" onClick={newDashboard}><Plus size={14} /> New</button>
            <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-primary" onClick={saveDashboard} disabled={saving}>
              {saving ? <span className="dash-spinner" /> : <Save size={14} />} Save
            </button>
            {selectedId && (
              <>
                <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}><Plus size={14} /> Add Widget</button>
                <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" onClick={refreshAll}><RefreshCw size={14} /> Refresh All</button>
                <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" onClick={shareDashboard}><Share2 size={14} /> Share</button>
                <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-danger" onClick={deleteDashboard}><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {subTab === 'embed' ? (
        <EmbedManager />
      ) : (
      <>
      <div className="dash-body">
        {/* ── Left: Dashboard List ─────────────────────────── */}
        <div className="dash-list-panel">
          <div className="dash-list-header">
            <span>Dashboards ({dashboards.length})</span>
            <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" style={{ padding: '4px 8px' }} onClick={loadDashboards}><RefreshCw size={13} /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="dash-list-items">
            {loading ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20 }}><Loader size={20} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }} /></div>
            ) : dashboards.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 13 }}>No dashboards yet</div>
            ) : dashboards.map(d => (
              <div key={d.id} className={`dash-list-item ${selectedId === d.id ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => selectDashboard(d.id)}>
                <div className="d-name">{d.name} {d.is_public && <span className="public-badge"><Globe size={10} /> Public</span>}</div>
                <div className="d-meta">
                  <span>{d.widget_count || 0} widgets</span>
                  <span>{d.auto_refresh > 0 ? `${d.auto_refresh}s refresh` : 'Manual'}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Center: Grid ─────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div className="dash-grid-area">
          <div className="dash-grid-toolbar">
            <input
              value={name}
              onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Dashboard name…"
              style={{ border: 'none', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b', width: 240, background: 'transparent', outline: 'none' }}
            />
            <div style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b' }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={isPublic} onChange={e => setIsPublic(e.target.checked)} />
                Public
              </label>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                Auto-refresh:
                <select value={autoRefresh} onChange={e => setAutoRefresh(parseInt(e.target.value))} style={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 4px', fontSize: 12 }}>
                  <option value={0}>Off</option>
                  <option value={30}>30s</option>
                  <option value={60}>1m</option>
                  <option value={300}>5m</option>
                  <option value={600}>10m</option>
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="dash-grid">
            {widgets.length === 0 && (
              <div className="dash-empty">
                <LayoutDashboard size={48} />
                {selectedId ? (
                  <>
                    <p>This dashboard has no widgets yet</p>
                    <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}><Plus size={14} /> Add Your First Widget</button>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8', textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 1.8, marginTop: 8 }}>
                      <strong>How to use:</strong><br />
                      1. Click "Add Widget" → choose type (Chart, Table, or Number)<br />
                      2. Write a SQL query and pick the database<br />
                      3. For charts: set label &amp; value columns<br />
                      4. Click the <RefreshCw size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> button on each widget to load data
                    </div>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <p>Select a dashboard from the left, or create a new one</p>
                    <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-primary" onClick={newDashboard}><Plus size={14} /> Create New Dashboard</button>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {widgets.map((w, idx) => (
              <div
                key={w.id}
                className={`dash-widget ${dragOverIdx === idx ? 'drag-over' : ''} ${dragIdx === idx ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
                style={{
                  gridColumn: `span ${w.width || 6}`,
                  gridRow: `span ${Math.ceil((w.height || 4) / 2)}`,
                }}
                draggable
                onDragStart={(e) => handleDragStart(e, idx)}
                onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, idx)}
                onDrop={(e) => handleDrop(e, idx)}
                onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
              >
                <div className="dash-widget-header">
                  <span className="w-drag-handle" title="Drag to reorder"><GripVertical size={13} /></span>
                  <span className="w-title">{w.title || 'Untitled'}</span>
                  <div className="w-actions">
                    {/* Inline resize controls */}
                    <div className="w-resize-group">
                      <button onClick={() => resizeWidget(w.id, 'width', -1)} title="Narrower" className="resize-btn"><ChevronLeft size={11} /></button>
                      <span className="resize-label">{w.width || 6}</span>
                      <button onClick={() => resizeWidget(w.id, 'width', 1)} title="Wider" className="resize-btn"><ChevronRight size={11} /></button>
                      <span className="resize-sep">×</span>
                      <button onClick={() => resizeWidget(w.id, 'height', -1)} title="Shorter" className="resize-btn"><ChevronUp size={11} /></button>
                      <span className="resize-label">{w.height || 4}</span>
                      <button onClick={() => resizeWidget(w.id, 'height', 1)} title="Taller" className="resize-btn"><ChevronDown size={11} /></button>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={() => refreshWidget(w.id)} title="Refresh data">
                      {refreshingWidgets.has(w.id) ? <span className="dash-spinner" /> : <RefreshCw size={13} />}
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => { setEditingWidget(w); setShowAddModal(true); }} title="Edit"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                    <button onClick={() => deleteWidget(w.id)} title="Remove"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="dash-widget-body">
                  {renderWidgetContent(w)}
                </div>
                {/* Bottom-right resize corner handle */}
                <div
                  className="w-resize-corner"
                  title="Drag to resize"
                  onMouseDown={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setResizingId(w.id);
                    const startX = e.clientX, startY = e.clientY;
                    const startW = w.width || 6, startH = w.height || 4;
                    const onMove = (me) => {
                      const dx = me.clientX - startX;
                      const dy = me.clientY - startY;
                      const widths = [3, 4, 6, 8, 12];
                      const heights = [2, 3, 4, 6, 8];
                      const wSteps = Math.round(dx / 80);
                      const hSteps = Math.round(dy / 50);
                      const wIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(widths.length - 1, widths.indexOf(startW) + wSteps));
                      const hIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(heights.length - 1, heights.indexOf(startH) + hSteps));
                      setWidgets(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === w.id ? { ...x, width: widths[wIdx], height: heights[hIdx] } : x));
                    };
                    const onUp = () => {
                      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                      setResizingId(null);
                      // Persist
                      const updated = widgets.find(x => x.id === w.id);
                      // Re-read from state — we'll persist what's in DOM
                      const el = document.querySelector(`[data-widget-id="${w.id}"]`);
                      // Just save via API
                      setWidgets(prev => {
                        const cur = prev.find(x => x.id === w.id);
                        if (cur) sqlEditorAPI.updateWidget(selectedId, w.id, { width: cur.width, height: cur.height }).catch(() => {});
                        return prev;
                      });
                    };
                    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Add / Edit Widget Modal ─────────────────────────── */}
      {showAddModal && (
        <AddWidgetModal
          dashboardId={selectedId}
          editing={editingWidget}
          onClose={() => { setShowAddModal(false); setEditingWidget(null); }}
          onAdd={addWidget}
          onUpdate={updateWidget}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── Share Modal ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showShareModal && (
        <div className="dash-modal-overlay" onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setShowShareModal(false); }}>
          <div className="dash-modal" style={{ width: 480 }}>
            <div className="dash-modal-header">
              <h3><Share2 size={16} style={{ verticalAlign: -3, marginRight: 6 }} />Share Dashboard</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowShareModal(false)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#94a3b8' }}><X size={18} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="dash-modal-body">
              {shareLoading ? (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 30 }}><Loader size={24} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: '#3b82f6' }} /></div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569', marginBottom: 6, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '.5px' }}>View-Only Link</div>
                    <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#64748b', marginBottom: 10 }}>
                      Anyone with this link can view the dashboard but cannot edit it. Data refreshes live.
                    </p>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                      <input
                        readOnly
                        value={`${window.location.origin}/?view=dashboard&token=${shareToken}`}
                        style={{ flex: 1, padding: '9px 12px', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13, color: '#1e293b', background: '#f8fafc' }}
                        onClick={e => e.target.select()}
                      />
                      <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-primary" onClick={copyShareLink}><Copy size={14} /> Copy</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ background: '#eff6ff', padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12, color: '#1e40af' }}>
                    <strong>Tip:</strong> Mark the dashboard as "Public" and save to allow view-only access. The shared view auto-refreshes data.
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="dash-modal-footer">
              <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowShareModal(false)}>Close</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Add / Edit Widget Modal
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function AddWidgetModal({ dashboardId, editing, onClose, onAdd, onUpdate }) {
  const [widgetType, setWidgetType] = useState(editing?.widget_type || 'chart');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(editing?.title || '');
  const [queryText, setQueryText] = useState(editing?.query_text || '');
  const [databaseName, setDatabaseName] = useState(editing?.database_name || '');
  const [dbType, setDbType] = useState(editing?.db_type || 'cloudsql');
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState(editing?.chart_type || 'bar');
  const [chartConfig, setChartConfig] = useState(editing?.chart_config || {});
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(editing?.width || 6);
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(editing?.height || 4);
  const [refreshInterval, setRefreshInterval] = useState(editing?.refresh_interval || 0);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!queryText.trim()) { toast.error('SQL query required'); return; }
    if (!databaseName.trim()) { toast.error('Database required'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    const body = {
      widget_type: widgetType, title, query_text: queryText,
      database_name: databaseName, db_type: dbType,
      chart_type: chartType, chart_config: chartConfig,
      width, height, refresh_interval: refreshInterval,
    };
    try {
      if (editing) {
        await onUpdate(editing.id, body);
      } else {
        await onAdd(body);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch { /* handled upstream */ }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="dash-modal-overlay" onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div className="dash-modal">
        <div className="dash-modal-header">
          <h3>{editing ? 'Edit Widget' : 'Add Widget'}</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#94a3b8' }}><X size={18} /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="dash-modal-body">
          {/* Type selection */}
          <div className="cfg-group">
            <label className="cfg-label">Widget Type</label>
            <div className="wtype-cards">
              {WIDGET_TYPES.map(t => {
                const Icon = t.icon;
                return (
                  <div key={t.type} className={`wtype-card ${widgetType === t.type ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => setWidgetType(t.type)}>
                    <Icon size={20} />
                    {t.label}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="cfg-group">
            <label className="cfg-label">Title</label>
            <input className="cfg-input" value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="My Widget" />
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
            <div className="cfg-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <label className="cfg-label">DB Type</label>
              <select className="cfg-select" value={dbType} onChange={e => setDbType(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="cfg-group" style={{ flex: 2 }}>
              <label className="cfg-label">Database / Dataset</label>
              <input className="cfg-input" value={databaseName} onChange={e => setDatabaseName(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="cfg-group">
            <label className="cfg-label">SQL Query</label>
            <textarea className="cfg-textarea" rows={4} value={queryText} onChange={e => setQueryText(e.target.value)} placeholder="SELECT category, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM orders GROUP BY category" />
          </div>

          {widgetType === 'chart' && (
            <>
              <div className="cfg-group">
                <label className="cfg-label">Chart Type</label>
                <select className="cfg-select" value={chartType} onChange={e => setChartType(e.target.value)}>
                  {CHART_TYPES.map(c => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
                <div className="cfg-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <label className="cfg-label">Label Column</label>
                  <input className="cfg-input" value={chartConfig.labelColumn || ''} onChange={e => setChartConfig({ ...chartConfig, labelColumn: e.target.value })} placeholder="category" />
                </div>
                <div className="cfg-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <label className="cfg-label">Value Column</label>
                  <input className="cfg-input" value={chartConfig.valueColumn || ''} onChange={e => setChartConfig({ ...chartConfig, valueColumn: e.target.value })} placeholder="cnt" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Size controls with visual preview */}
          <div className="cfg-group">
            <label className="cfg-label">Widget Size</label>
            <div className="size-preview-container">
              <div className="size-control-row">
                <div className="size-control">
                  <label style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' }}>Width (cols of 12)</label>
                  <div className="size-buttons">
                    {WIDTH_OPTIONS.map(o => (
                      <button key={o.value} className={`size-btn ${width === o.value ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setWidth(o.value)}>{o.label}</button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="size-control">
                  <label style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' }}>Height</label>
                  <div className="size-buttons">
                    {HEIGHT_OPTIONS.map(o => (
                      <button key={o.value} className={`size-btn ${height === o.value ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setHeight(o.value)}>{o.label}</button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Visual size preview */}
              <div className="size-preview">
                <div className="size-preview-grid">
                  <div className="size-preview-widget" style={{ width: `${(width / 12) * 100}%`, height: `${(height / 8) * 100}%` }}>
                    {width}×{height}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="cfg-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label className="cfg-label">Auto Refresh</label>
            <select className="cfg-select" value={refreshInterval} onChange={e => setRefreshInterval(parseInt(e.target.value))}>
              <option value={0}>Off</option>
              <option value={30}>30s</option>
              <option value={60}>1m</option>
              <option value={300}>5m</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dash-modal-footer">
          <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
          <button className="dash-btn dash-btn-primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? <span className="dash-spinner" /> : <Save size={14} />} {editing ? 'Update' : 'Add Widget'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DashboardViewer — Read-only public view for shared links
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function DashboardViewer({ token }) {
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [widgets, setWidgets] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const refreshTimer = useRef(null);

  const loadSharedDashboard = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await sqlEditorAPI.getSharedDashboard(token);
      setDashboard(data.dashboard);
      setWidgets(data.widgets || []);
      setError('');
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Dashboard not found or link expired');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [token]);

  useEffect(() => { loadSharedDashboard(); }, [loadSharedDashboard]);

  // Auto-refresh all widgets
  useEffect(() => {
    if (refreshTimer.current) clearInterval(refreshTimer.current);
    const interval = dashboard?.auto_refresh || 60; // Default 60s for shared view
    if (widgets.length > 0) {
      refreshTimer.current = setInterval(() => {
        loadSharedDashboard();
      }, interval * 1000);
    }
    return () => { if (refreshTimer.current) clearInterval(refreshTimer.current); };
  }, [dashboard, widgets.length]);

  const renderViewerWidgetContent = (w) => {
    const rows = w.last_data ? (typeof w.last_data === 'string' ? tryParse(w.last_data) : w.last_data) : null;
    const cols = rows && rows.length > 0 ? Object.keys(rows[0]) : [];

    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
      return <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', padding: 20 }}>No data available</div>;
    }

    if (w.widget_type === 'number') {
      const val = rows[0] ? Object.values(rows[0])[0] : 0;
      const label = cols[0] || 'Value';
      return (
        <div className="w-number">
          <div className="big-val">{typeof val === 'number' ? val.toLocaleString() : val}</div>
          <div className="big-label">{label}</div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (w.widget_type === 'table') {
      return (
        <table className="w-table">
          <thead><tr>{cols.map(c => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.slice(0, 200).map((r, i) => (
              <tr key={i}>{cols.map(c => <td key={c}>{r[c] != null ? String(r[c]) : ''}</td>)}</tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      );
    }

    if (w.widget_type === 'chart') {
      const cfg = w.chart_config || {};
      const labelCol = cfg.labelColumn || cols[0] || '';
      const valueCol = cfg.valueColumn || (cols.length > 1 ? cols[1] : cols[0]) || '';
      const chartType = w.chart_type || 'bar';
      const labels = rows.map(r => String(r[labelCol] || ''));
      const values = rows.map(r => parseFloat(r[valueCol]) || 0);
      const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);

      if (chartType === 'bar') {
        return (
          <div className="w-bar-chart" style={{ paddingBottom: 22 }}>
            {values.map((v, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="w-bar" style={{ height: `${(v / maxVal) * 100}%` }} title={`${labels[i]}: ${v}`}>
                <span className="w-bar-label">{labels[i]?.slice(0, 8)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (chartType === 'line') {
        const w2 = 500, h2 = 150;
        const pts = values.map((v, i) => {
          const x = (i / Math.max(values.length - 1, 1)) * (w2 - 20) + 10;
          const y = h2 - 10 - (v / maxVal) * (h2 - 30);
          return `${x},${y}`;
        });
        return (
          <svg className="w-line-chart" viewBox={`0 0 ${w2} ${h2}`} preserveAspectRatio="none">
            <polyline points={pts.join(' ')} fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth="2" />
            {pts.map((p, i) => {
              const [x, y] = p.split(',');
              return <circle key={i} cx={x} cy={y} r="3" fill="#3b82f6"><title>{labels[i]}: {values[i]}</title></circle>;
            })}
          </svg>
        );
      }

      if (chartType === 'pie') {
        const total = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1;
        const colors = ['#3b82f6','#ef4444','#16a34a','#f59e0b','#8b5cf6','#ec4899','#14b8a6','#f97316'];
        let acc = 0;
        return (
          <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', maxHeight: 200 }}>
            {values.map((v, i) => {
              const start = acc;
              acc += (v / total) * 360;
              const end = acc;
              const la = (end - start) > 180 ? 1 : 0;
              const sr = (Math.PI / 180) * (start - 90), er = (Math.PI / 180) * (end - 90);
              const x1 = 100 + 80 * Math.cos(sr), y1 = 100 + 80 * Math.sin(sr);
              const x2 = 100 + 80 * Math.cos(er), y2 = 100 + 80 * Math.sin(er);
              return (
                <path key={i}
                  d={`M100,100 L${x1},${y1} A80,80 0 ${la},1 ${x2},${y2} Z`}
                  fill={colors[i % colors.length]}
                  stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1"
                >
                  <title>{labels[i]}: {v} ({((v/total)*100).toFixed(1)}%)</title>
                </path>
              );
            })}
          </svg>
        );
      }
    }

    return <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12 }}>Unsupported type</div>;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="dash-viewer-loading">
        <Loader size={36} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: '#3b82f6' }} />
        <p>Loading dashboard…</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="dash-viewer-error">
        <LayoutDashboard size={48} style={{ opacity: 0.3 }} />
        <h3>Dashboard Not Available</h3>
        <p>{error}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="dash-viewer-root">
      <div className="dash-viewer-header">
        <LayoutDashboard size={20} style={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
        <h2>{dashboard?.name || 'Dashboard'}</h2>
        <span className="viewer-badge"><Eye size={12} /> View Only</span>
        {dashboard?.description && <span className="viewer-desc">{dashboard.description}</span>}
        <div style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8' }}>
          Auto-refreshes every {dashboard?.auto_refresh || 60}s
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="dash-viewer-grid">
        {widgets.map(w => (
          <div
            key={w.id}
            className="dash-widget viewer-widget"
            style={{
              gridColumn: `span ${w.width || 6}`,
              gridRow: `span ${Math.ceil((w.height || 4) / 2)}`,
            }}
          >
            <div className="dash-widget-header">
              <span className="w-title">{w.title || 'Untitled'}</span>
              <div className="w-type-badge">{w.widget_type}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="dash-widget-body">
              {renderViewerWidgetContent(w)}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {widgets.length === 0 && (
          <div className="dash-empty">
            <LayoutDashboard size={48} />
            <p>This dashboard has no widgets yet</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function tryParse(str) {
  try { return JSON.parse(str); } catch { return null; }
}
