  }, [relForm.source_database, relForm.source_table, relForm.source_db_type]);

  // Target side - relationships
  useEffect(() => {
    if (relForm.target_database) {
      setTgtTablesLoading(true);
      fetchTableList(relForm.target_database, relForm.target_db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(relForm.target_db_type)).then((t) => { setTgtTableList(t); setTgtTablesLoading(false); });
    } else { setTgtTableList([]); }
  }, [relForm.target_database, relForm.target_db_type]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (relForm.target_database && relForm.target_table) {
      setTgtColumnsLoading(true);
      fetchColumnList(relForm.target_database, relForm.target_table, relForm.target_db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(relForm.target_db_type)).then((c) => { setTgtColumnList(c); setTgtColumnsLoading(false); });
    } else { setTgtColumnList([]); }
  }, [relForm.target_database, relForm.target_table, relForm.target_db_type]);

  // Builder tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (apiForm.database) {
      setBuilderTablesLoading(true);
      fetchTableList(apiForm.database, apiForm.db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(apiForm.db_type)).then((t) => { setBuilderTableList(t); setBuilderTablesLoading(false); });
    } else { setBuilderTableList([]); }
  }, [apiForm.database, apiForm.db_type]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (apiForm.database && apiForm.base_table) {
      setBuilderColumnsLoading(true);
      fetchColumnList(apiForm.database, apiForm.base_table, apiForm.db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(apiForm.db_type)).then((c) => { setBuilderColumnList(c); setBuilderColumnsLoading(false); });
    } else { setBuilderColumnList([]); }
  }, [apiForm.database, apiForm.base_table, apiForm.db_type]);

  // Auto-populate tester auth fields when selecting an API
  useEffect(() => {
    if (testApiId) {
      const api = customAPIs.find((a) => a.id === testApiId);
      if (api) {
        setTestAuthUser(api.auth_username || '');
        setTestAuthPass(api.auth_password || '');
        setTestEncrypt(!!api.encryption_enabled);
        setTestDecryptResponse(!!api.encryption_enabled);
      }
    }
  }, [testApiId, customAPIs]);

  // ── Handle Convert-to-API prefill from SQL Editor ──────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefillApi) return;
    const { query, database, columns, databaseType } = prefillApi;
    if (!database || !query) {
      onPrefillConsumed?.();
      return;
    }

    // Parse the query to extract table name
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.parseQuery(database, query, databaseType || 'cloudsql');
        const parsed = res.data;
        const tableName = parsed.table_name || '';
        const schemaName = parsed.schema_name || 'public';
        const selectCols = parsed.columns_used?.length > 0 ? parsed.columns_used : [];
        const actualCols = parsed.actual_columns || [];
        const parsedJoins = parsed.joins || [];
        const parsedWhere = parsed.where_clause || '';

        // Build relationships from parsed JOINs
        const autoRelationships = parsedJoins.map((j) => ({
          name: j.name || '',
          target_db_type: databaseType || 'cloudsql',
          target_database: database,
          target_table: j.target_table || '',
          target_column: j.target_column || '',
          source_database: database,
          source_table: tableName,
          source_column: j.source_column || '',
          join_type: j.join_type || 'INNER',
          raw_on_clause: j.raw_on_clause || '',
          alias: j.alias || '',
        }));

        // Generate a readable API name from table name
        const apiName = tableName
          ? tableName.replace(/_/g, '-').toLowerCase() + '-api'
          : 'my-api';

        const joinDesc = parsedJoins.length > 0
          ? ` (with ${parsedJoins.length} JOIN${parsedJoins.length > 1 ? 's' : ''})`
          : '';
        const whereDesc = parsedWhere ? ` | Filter: WHERE ${parsedWhere}` : '';

        setApiForm({
          name: apiName,
          description: `Auto-generated API from SQL query on ${database}.${tableName}${joinDesc}${whereDesc}`,
          database: database,
          db_type: databaseType || 'cloudsql',
          server_id: null,
          base_table: tableName,
          schema_name: schemaName,
          relationships: autoRelationships,
          function_layers: [],
          select_columns: selectCols,
          default_limit: 100,
          allowed_filters: actualCols.length > 0 ? actualCols : selectCols,
          allowed_sorts: actualCols.length > 0 ? actualCols : selectCols,
          enable_crud: true,
          auth_enabled: false,
          auth_username: '',
          auth_password: '',
          encryption_enabled: false,
          encryption_key: '',
          public_alias: tableName ? tableName.replace(/_/g, '-').toLowerCase() : '',
          base_filter: '',
          where_conditions: parsed.where_conditions || [],
          select_column_aliases: parsed.select_column_aliases || [],
          base_table_alias: parsed.base_table_alias || '',
          cache_ttl: 0,
        });
        setEditingApiId(null);
        setActiveTab('builder');

        const joinMsg = parsedJoins.length > 0
          ? ` ${parsedJoins.length} relationship${parsedJoins.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} (${parsedJoins.map(j => j.target_table).join(', ')}) auto-added!`
          : '';
        const whereMsg = (parsed.where_conditions || []).length > 0
          ? ` ${parsed.where_conditions.length} WHERE condition${parsed.where_conditions.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} added.`
          : '';
        const configMsg = !joinMsg && !whereMsg ? ' Configure auth, encryption & relationships as needed.' : '';
        toast.success(`Query parsed! Table "${tableName}" pre-filled in API Builder.${joinMsg}${whereMsg}${configMsg}`, { duration: 5000, icon: '⚡' });
      } catch (err) {
        // Fallback: just set database, let user fill the rest
        setApiForm((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          database: database,
          description: 'Auto-generated from SQL Editor query',
        }));
        setActiveTab('builder');
        toast.error('Could not parse query automatically. Please fill in the table details.');
      } finally {
        onPrefillConsumed?.();
      }
    })();
  }, [prefillApi]);

  const loadRelationships = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listRelationships();
      setRelationships(res.data.relationships || []);
    } catch { /* ignore on first load */ }
  };

  const loadCustomAPIs = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listCustomAPIs();
      setCustomAPIs(res.data.apis || []);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  // ── CRUD Tab handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCrudRead = async () => {
    if (!crudDb || !crudTable) return toast.error('Select database and table');
    setCrudLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = { type: crudServerId ? 'cloudsql' : databaseType, ...crudParams };
      if (crudServerId) params.server_id = crudServerId;
      if (!params.sort_by) delete params.sort_by;
      if (!params.filters) delete params.filters;
      if (!params.columns) delete params.columns;
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.crudRead(crudDb, crudTable, params);
      setCrudResult(res.data);
      toast.success(`${res.data.row_count} rows fetched`);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message);
    } finally {
      setCrudLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const copyCrudEndpoint = () => {
    const base = 'https://sqleditorapi.verizon.com';
    const dbTypeForUrl = crudServerId ? 'cloudsql' : databaseType;
    const url = `${base}/api/crud/${crudDb}/${crudTable}?type=${dbTypeForUrl}&limit=${crudParams.limit}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
    toast.success('API endpoint copied!');
  };

  // ── Relationship handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCreateRelationship = async () => {
    if (!relForm.name || !relForm.source_database || !relForm.source_table || !relForm.source_column ||
        !relForm.target_database || !relForm.target_table || !relForm.target_column) {
      return toast.error('Please fill all relationship fields');
    }
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.createRelationship(relForm);
      toast.success('Relationship created!');
      loadRelationships();
      setRelForm({ name: '', source_database: '', source_table: '', source_column: '',
        target_database: '', target_table: '', target_column: '',
        join_type: 'INNER', source_db_type: 'cloudsql', target_db_type: 'cloudsql' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRelationship = async (relId) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteRelationship(relId);
      toast.success('Relationship deleted');
      loadRelationships();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteRelationship = async (relId) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeRelationship(relId, { limit: 50 });
      setRelResult(res.data);
      toast.success(`${res.data.row_count} rows from joined query`);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message);
    }
  };

  // ── API Builder handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleGenerateKey = async () => {
    setGeneratingKey(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.generateEncryptionKey();
      setApiForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, encryption_key: res.data.key }));
      toast.success('Encryption key generated!');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message);
    } finally {
      setGeneratingKey(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveAPI = async () => {
    if (!apiForm.name || !apiForm.database || !apiForm.base_table) {
      return toast.error('Name, database, and base table are required');
    }
    
    // Auto-populate server_id from selectedServer if on a custom server
    const payload = { ...apiForm };
    if (selectedServer && !selectedServer.is_default) {
      payload.server_id = selectedServer.id;
    }
    
    try {
      if (editingApiId) {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateCustomAPI(editingApiId, payload);
        toast.success('API updated!');
      } else {
        await sqlEditorAPI.createCustomAPI(payload);
        toast.success('API created!');
      }
      loadCustomAPIs();
      resetApiForm();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleEditAPI = (api) => {
    setApiForm({
      name: api.name || '',
      description: api.description || '',
      database: api.database || '',
      db_type: api.db_type || 'cloudsql',
      server_id: api.server_id || null,
      base_table: api.base_table || '',
      schema_name: api.schema_name || 'public',
      relationships: api.relationships || [],
      function_layers: api.function_layers || [],
      select_columns: api.select_columns || [],
      default_limit: api.default_limit || 100,
      allowed_filters: api.allowed_filters || [],
      allowed_sorts: api.allowed_sorts || [],
      enable_crud: api.enable_crud !== false,
      auth_enabled: !!api.auth_enabled,
      auth_username: api.auth_username || '',
      auth_password: api.auth_password || '',
      encryption_enabled: !!api.encryption_enabled,
      encryption_key: api.encryption_key || '',
      public_alias: api.public_alias || '',
      base_filter: api.base_filter || '',
      where_conditions: api.where_conditions || [],
      cache_ttl: api.cache_ttl || 0,
    });
    setEditingApiId(api.id);
    setActiveTab('builder');
  };

  const handleDeleteAPI = async (apiId) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteCustomAPI(apiId);
      toast.success('API deleted');
      loadCustomAPIs();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    }
  };

  const resetApiForm = () => {
    setApiForm({
      name: '', description: '', database: '', db_type: 'cloudsql',
      base_table: '', schema_name: 'public', relationships: [],
      function_layers: [], select_columns: [], default_limit: 100,
      allowed_filters: [], allowed_sorts: [], enable_crud: true,
      auth_enabled: false, auth_username: '', auth_password: '',
      encryption_enabled: false, encryption_key: '',
      public_alias: '', base_filter: '', where_conditions: [],
      cache_ttl: 0,
    });
    setEditingApiId(null);
    setPreviewResult(null);
  };

  // ── Preview / Test API before saving ───────────────────────────
  const handlePreviewAPI = async () => {
    if (!apiForm.database || !apiForm.base_table) {
      toast.error('Please select a database and base table first');
      return;
    }
    setPreviewLoading(true);
    setPreviewResult(null);
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...apiForm,
        select_columns: apiForm.select_columns.filter(Boolean),
        allowed_filters: apiForm.allowed_filters.filter(Boolean),
        allowed_sorts: apiForm.allowed_sorts.filter(Boolean),
        relationships: apiForm.relationships.map(r => ({
          ...r,
          raw_on_clause: r.raw_on_clause || '',
        })),
        where_conditions: (apiForm.where_conditions || []).filter(
          wc => wc.column && wc.operator
        ),
      };
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.previewCustomAPI(payload, 20);
      setPreviewResult(res.data);
      if (res.data?.row_count === 0) {
        toast('Preview returned 0 rows', { icon: '\u2139\ufe0f' });
      } else {
        toast.success(`Preview: ${res.data.row_count} rows in ${res.data.execution_time_ms}ms`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Preview failed';
      toast.error(msg);
      setPreviewResult({ success: false, error: msg });
    } finally {
      setPreviewLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const addFunctionLayer = (template) => {
    setApiForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      function_layers: [
        ...prev.function_layers,
        { ...template, id: Date.now().toString(), order: prev.function_layers.length, enabled: true },
      ],
    }));
  };

  const removeFunctionLayer = (idx) => {
    setApiForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      function_layers: prev.function_layers.filter((_, i) => i !== idx),
    }));
  };

  const updateFunctionLayer = (idx, key, value) => {
    setApiForm((prev) => {
      const layers = [...prev.function_layers];
      if (key.startsWith('config.')) {
        const configKey = key.replace('config.', '');
        layers[idx] = { ...layers[idx], config: { ...layers[idx].config, [configKey]: value } };
      } else {
        layers[idx] = { ...layers[idx], [key]: value };
      }
      return { ...prev, function_layers: layers };
    });
  };

  // ── Tester handlers (enhanced with method, auth, encryption) ──────
  const handleTestAPI = async () => {
    if (!testApiId) return toast.error('Select an API to test');
    setTestLoading(true);
    setTestResult(null);
    setVerifyResult(null);

    const authCreds = (testAuthUser && testAuthPass) ? { username: testAuthUser, password: testAuthPass } : {};
    const selectedApi = customAPIs.find((a) => a.id === testApiId);
    const encKey = selectedApi?.encryption_key || '';

    try {
      let res;

      if (testMethod === 'GET') {
        const params = { ...testParams };
        if (!params.sort_by) delete params.sort_by;
        if (!params.filters) delete params.filters;
        // Add simple filters as query params
        testFilters.forEach((f) => {
          if (f.col && f.val) params[f.col] = f.val;
        });
        res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeCustomAPI(testApiId, params, authCreds);

      } else if (testMethod === 'POST') {
        let body;
        try { body = JSON.parse(testBody || '{}'); } catch { return toast.error('Invalid JSON in request body'); }
        
        if (useSearchMode) {
          res = await sqlEditorAPI.searchCustomAPI(testApiId, body, authCreds);
        } else {
          if (testEncrypt && encKey) {
            const encRes = await sqlEditorAPI.encryptData(encKey, body);
            body = { encrypted: true, payload: encRes.data.encrypted };
          }
          res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeCustomAPIPost(testApiId, body, authCreds);
        }

      } else if (testMethod === 'PUT') {
        let body;
        try { body = JSON.parse(testBody || '{}'); } catch { return toast.error('Invalid JSON in request body'); }
        if (testEncrypt && encKey) {
          const encRes = await sqlEditorAPI.encryptData(encKey, body);
          body = { encrypted: true, payload: encRes.data.encrypted };
        }
        res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeCustomAPIPut(testApiId, body, authCreds);

      } else if (testMethod === 'DELETE') {
        let body;
        try { body = JSON.parse(testBody || '{}'); } catch { return toast.error('Invalid JSON in request body'); }
        if (testEncrypt && encKey) {
          const encRes = await sqlEditorAPI.encryptData(encKey, body);
          body = { encrypted: true, payload: encRes.data.encrypted };
        }
        res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeCustomAPIDelete(testApiId, body, authCreds);
      }

      let data = res.data;

      // If response is encrypted, auto-decrypt it
      if (data?.encrypted && testDecryptResponse && encKey) {
        try {
          const decRes = await sqlEditorAPI.decryptData(encKey, data.payload);
          data = decRes.data.data;
        } catch {
          toast.error('Failed to decrypt response — showing raw encrypted data');
        }
      }

      setTestResult(data);
      const count = data?.row_count || data?.rows_inserted || data?.rows_updated || data?.rows_deleted || 0;
      toast.success(`${testMethod} completed — ${count} rows affected`);

    } catch (err) {
      const detail = err?.response?.data?.detail;
      if (err?.response?.status === 401) {
        toast.error('Authentication failed — check username/password');
      } else {
        toast.error(detail || err.message);
      }
    } finally {
      setTestLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLoadDocs = async () => {
    if (!testApiId) return;
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getCustomAPIDocs(testApiId);
      setApiDocs(res.data.documentation);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    }
  };

  const BASE_URL = 'https://sqleditorapi.verizon.com';

  // ── Verify handler — re-fetches data via GET after mutation ────────
  const handleVerify = async () => {
    if (!testApiId) return;
    setVerifyLoading(true);
    setVerifyResult(null);
    try {
      const authCreds = (testAuthUser && testAuthPass) ? { username: testAuthUser, password: testAuthPass } : {};
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeCustomAPI(testApiId, { limit: testParams.limit || 50 }, authCreds);
      setVerifyResult(res.data);
      toast.success(`Verified — ${res.data.row_count} rows`);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message);
    } finally {
      setVerifyLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Body templates for tester
  // ── Fetch table/column lists for inline JOINs ──────────────────────
  const fetchJoinTables = async (idx, dbType, database) => {
    if (!database) return;
    setJoinLists((prev) => ({ ...prev, [idx]: { ...(prev[idx] || {}), tLoading: true } }));
    const serverId = getServerIdFromDbType(dbType);
    const tables = await fetchTableList(database, dbType, serverId);
    setJoinLists((prev) => ({ ...prev, [idx]: { ...(prev[idx] || {}), tables, tLoading: false } }));
  };
  const fetchJoinColumns = async (idx, dbType, database, table) => {
    if (!database || !table) return;
    setJoinLists((prev) => ({ ...prev, [idx]: { ...(prev[idx] || {}), cLoading: true } }));
    const serverId = getServerIdFromDbType(dbType);
    const columns = await fetchColumnList(database, table, dbType, serverId);
    setJoinLists((prev) => ({ ...prev, [idx]: { ...(prev[idx] || {}), columns, cLoading: false } }));
  };
  const updateJoin = (idx, field, value) => {
    const updated = [...apiForm.relationships];
    updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], [field]: value };
    setApiForm({ ...apiForm, relationships: updated });
    // Auto-fetch when key fields change
    if (field === 'target_database' || field === 'target_db_type') {
      const db = field === 'target_database' ? value : updated[idx].target_database;
      const dt = field === 'target_db_type' ? value : updated[idx].target_db_type || apiForm.db_type;
      if (db) fetchJoinTables(idx, dt, db);
      // Clear downstream
      updated[idx].target_table = '';
      updated[idx].target_column = '';
      setApiForm({ ...apiForm, relationships: updated });
    }
    if (field === 'target_table') {
      const dt = updated[idx].target_db_type || apiForm.db_type;
      const db = updated[idx].target_database;
      if (db && value) fetchJoinColumns(idx, dt, db, value);
      updated[idx].target_column = '';
      setApiForm({ ...apiForm, relationships: updated });
    }
  };

  // ── Metrics fetching ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const openMetrics = async (api) => {
    setMetricsApiId(api.id);
    setMetricsApiName(api.name);
    setMetricsOpen(true);
    setMetricsTab('overview');
    setMetricsDateFrom('');
    setMetricsDateTo('');
    setMetricsHitsPage(0);
    await loadMetrics(api.id, '', '');
  };

  const loadMetrics = async (apiId, dateFrom, dateTo, page = 0) => {
    setMetricsLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = {};
      if (dateFrom) params.date_from = dateFrom;
      if (dateTo) params.date_to = dateTo;

      const [summaryRes, hitsRes] = await Promise.all([
        sqlEditorAPI.getApiMetricsSummary(apiId, params),
        sqlEditorAPI.getApiMetrics(apiId, { ...params, limit: 100, offset: page * 100 }),
      ]);
      setMetricsSummary(summaryRes.data);
      setMetricsHits(hitsRes.data.hits || []);
      setMetricsHitsTotal(hitsRes.data.total || 0);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load metrics', e);
      toast.error('Failed to load metrics');
    } finally {
      setMetricsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMetricsFilter = () => {
    setMetricsHitsPage(0);
    loadMetrics(metricsApiId, metricsDateFrom, metricsDateTo, 0);
  };

  const handleMetricsClear = () => {
    setMetricsDateFrom('');
    setMetricsDateTo('');
    setMetricsHitsPage(0);
    loadMetrics(metricsApiId, '', '', 0);
  };

  const handleMetricsPageChange = (newPage) => {
    setMetricsHitsPage(newPage);
    loadMetrics(metricsApiId, metricsDateFrom, metricsDateTo, newPage);
  };

  // ── Combined columns: base table + all joined tables ──────────
  const allBuilderColumns = React.useMemo(() => {
    const base = builderColumnList.map((c) => apiForm.base_table ? `${apiForm.base_table}.${c}` : c);
    const joined = [];
    apiForm.relationships.forEach((rel, idx) => {
      const jl = joinLists[idx] || {};
      const prefix = rel.alias || rel.target_table;
      if (jl.columns && prefix) {
        jl.columns.forEach((c) => joined.push(`${prefix}.${c}`));
      }
    });
    return [...base, ...joined];
  }, [builderColumnList, apiForm.relationships, apiForm.base_table, joinLists]);

  const getBodyTemplate = () => {
    const api = customAPIs.find((a) => a.id === testApiId);
    const cols = api?.select_columns || [];
    const sampleObj = {};
    
    if (testMethod === 'POST') {
      // For search mode, create filter template
      if (useSearchMode) {
        cols.slice(0, 2).forEach((c) => { sampleObj[c] = "value"; });
        return JSON.stringify(sampleObj, null, 2);
      }
      // For insert, create rows template
      cols.slice(0, 3).forEach((c) => { sampleObj[c] = "value"; });
      return JSON.stringify({ rows: [sampleObj] }, null, 2);
    } else if (testMethod === 'PUT') {
      const pkSample = cols.length > 0 ? { [cols[0]]: 1 } : { id: 1 };
      const updateSample = {};
      cols.slice(1, 3).forEach((c) => { updateSample[c] = "new_value"; });
      return JSON.stringify({ primary_key: pkSample, updates: updateSample }, null, 2);
    } else if (testMethod === 'DELETE') {
      const pkCol = cols.length > 0 ? cols[0] : "id";
      return JSON.stringify({ pk_column: pkCol, pk_values: [1, 2, 3] }, null, 2);
    }
    return '';
  };


  // ── Beautify JSON ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const beautifyJSON = () => {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(testBody);
      setTestBody(JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2));
      toast.success('JSON formatted');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Invalid JSON');
    }
  };
  // ── Copy helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const copyToClipboard = (text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast.success('Copied to clipboard!');
  };

  // ── Build full endpoint URLs ─────────────────────────────────────
  const getCrudEndpoint = () => `${BASE_URL}/api/crud/${crudDb}/${crudTable}?type=${databaseType}&limit=${crudParams.limit}`;
  const getRelEndpoint = (relId) => `${BASE_URL}/api/builder/relationships/${relId}/query?limit=50`;
  const getApiEndpoint = (apiId) => `${BASE_URL}/api/builder/apis/${apiId}/execute`;
  const getApiEndpointFull = () => {
    if (!testApiId) return '';
    const p = testParams;
    let url = `${BASE_URL}/api/builder/apis/${testApiId}`;
    
    if (testMethod === 'GET') {
      url += `/execute?limit=${p.limit}&offset=${p.offset}${p.sort_by ? '&sort_by=' + p.sort_by : ''}${p.sort_order ? '&sort_order=' + p.sort_order : ''}${p.filters ? '&filters=' + encodeURIComponent(p.filters) : ''}`;
      // Add simple filters as query params
      testFilters.forEach((f) => {
        if (f.col && f.val) url += `&${f.col}=${encodeURIComponent(f.val)}`;
      });
    } else if (testMethod === 'POST') {
      url += useSearchMode ? '/search' : '/execute';
    } else {
      url += '/execute';
    }
    
    return url;
  };

  // ── Render helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderDataTable = (result) => {
    if (!result || !result.data || result.data.length === 0) {
      return <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm p-4">No data</p>;
    }
    const cols = result.columns || Object.keys(result.data[0]);
    return (
      <div className="api-result-table-wrap">
        <table className="api-result-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>{cols.map((c) => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}</tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {result.data.map((row, i) => (
              <tr key={i}>{cols.map((c) => <td key={c}>{row[c] != null ? String(row[c]) : <span className="text-gray-500">NULL</span>}</td>)}</tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Render JSON view of any result
  const renderJsonView = (result) => {
    if (!result) return null;
    return (
      <div className="json-result">
        <pre>{JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}</pre>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Render a simple JSON result (for POST/PUT/DELETE responses)
  const renderJsonResult = (result) => {
    if (!result) return null;
    return (
      <div className="json-result">
        <pre>{JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}</pre>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // View toggle bar
  const renderViewToggle = (mode, setMode) => (
    <div className="view-toggle">
      <button className={`view-toggle-btn ${mode === 'table' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setMode('table')}>
        <Table2 size={12} /> Table
      </button>
      <button className={`view-toggle-btn ${mode === 'json' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setMode('json')}>
        <Code size={12} /> JSON
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  // Render result with view toggle
  const renderResultWithToggle = (result, viewMode, setViewMode) => {
    if (!result) return null;
    const hasData = result.data && result.data.length > 0;
    return (
      <>
        {renderViewToggle(viewMode, setViewMode)}
        {viewMode === 'table' && hasData ? renderDataTable(result) : renderJsonView(result)}
      </>
    );
  };

  // ── Code Snippet Generator ──────────────────────────────────────
  const toPythonValue = (jsonStr) =>
    jsonStr.replace(/: true/g, ': True').replace(/: false/g, ': False').replace(/: null/g, ': None');

  const generateCodeSnippets = (url, method, body, authUser, authPass) => {
    const hasAuth = !!(authUser && authPass);
    let authHeaderVal = '';
    try { authHeaderVal = hasAuth ? btoa(`${authUser}:${authPass}`) : ''; } catch { authHeaderVal = '<base64-encode-failed>'; }

    const bodyStr = body || '';
    let bodyPretty = '';
    try { bodyPretty = body ? JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(body), null, 4) : ''; } catch { bodyPretty = bodyStr; }
    const hasBody = method !== 'GET' && !!bodyStr;

    // Headers (with auth for curl/js/node — Python uses auth= param)
    const headersWithAuth = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    if (hasAuth) headersWithAuth['Authorization'] = `Basic ${authHeaderVal}`;
    const headersNoAuth = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };

    const headersWithAuthJson = JSON.stringify(headersWithAuth, null, 4);
    const headersNoAuthJson = JSON.stringify(headersNoAuth, null, 4);

    // ── cURL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    let curl = `curl -X ${method} "${url}"`;
    curl += ` \\\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json"`;
    if (hasAuth) curl += ` \\\n  -H "Authorization: Basic ${authHeaderVal}"`;
    if (hasBody) curl += ` \\\n  -d '${bodyStr.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}'`;

    // ── JavaScript (Fetch) ────────────────────────────────────────
    let javascript = `fetch("${url}", {\n  method: "${method}",\n  headers: ${headersWithAuthJson.replace(/\n/g, '\n  ')}`;
    if (hasBody) javascript += `,\n  body: JSON.stringify(${bodyPretty.replace(/\n/g, '\n  ')})`;
    javascript += `\n})\n  .then(response => response.json())\n  .then(data => console.log(data))\n  .catch(error => console.error("Error:", error));`;

    // ── Python (requests) ─────────────────────────────────────────
    // Python uses auth= param for Basic Auth, so keep Authorization out of headers
    const pyHeaders = toPythonValue(headersNoAuthJson).replace(/"/g, "'");
    let python = `import requests\n\nurl = "${url}"\nheaders = ${pyHeaders}`;
    if (hasAuth) python += `\n\n# Basic Auth (requests encodes this automatically)\nauth = ("${authUser}", "${authPass}")`;
    if (hasBody) python += `\n\npayload = ${toPythonValue(bodyPretty)}`;
    python += `\n\nresponse = requests.${method.toLowerCase()}(\n    url,\n    headers=headers`;
    if (hasAuth) python += `,\n    auth=auth`;
    if (hasBody) python += `,\n    json=payload`;
    python += `\n)\n\nprint(response.status_code)\nprint(response.json())`;

    // ── Node.js (axios) ───────────────────────────────────────────
    let nodejs = `const axios = require('axios');\n\nconst config = {\n  method: '${method.toLowerCase()}',\n  url: '${url}',\n  headers: ${headersWithAuthJson.replace(/\n/g, '\n  ')}`;
    if (hasBody) nodejs += `,\n  data: ${bodyPretty.replace(/\n/g, '\n  ')}`;
    nodejs += `\n};\n\naxios(config)\n  .then(response => {\n    console.log(response.data);\n  })\n  .catch(error => {\n    console.error(error.message);\n  });`;

    return { curl, javascript, python, nodejs };
  };

  const SNIPPET_LANGS = [
    { id: 'curl', label: 'cURL', color: '#b45309' },
    { id: 'javascript', label: 'JavaScript', color: '#eab308' },
    { id: 'python', label: 'Python', color: '#3b82f6' },
    { id: 'nodejs', label: 'Node.js', color: '#10b981' },
  ];

  const renderCodeSnippets = (url, method, body, authUser, authPass) => {
    if (!url) return null;
    const snippets = generateCodeSnippets(url, method, body, authUser, authPass);
    return (
      <div className="code-snippets-section">
        <div className="code-snippets-header">
          <h4><Code size={16} /> Ready-to-Use Code</h4>
          <div className="snippet-lang-tabs">
            {SNIPPET_LANGS.map((lang) => (
              <button
                key={lang.id}
                className={`snippet-lang-tab ${snippetLang === lang.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
                style={snippetLang === lang.id ? { borderBottomColor: lang.color, color: lang.color } : {}}
                onClick={() => setSnippetLang(lang.id)}
              >
                {lang.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="snippet-code-block">
          <div className="snippet-code-actions">
            <span className="snippet-lang-label" style={{ color: SNIPPET_LANGS.find(l => l.id === snippetLang)?.color }}>
              {SNIPPET_LANGS.find(l => l.id === snippetLang)?.label}
            </span>
            <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(snippets[snippetLang])}>
              <Copy size={10} /> Copy
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre className={`snippet-code snippet-${snippetLang}`}>{snippets[snippetLang]}</pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Endpoint URL display component
  const renderEndpointUrl = (url, label = 'Endpoint') => (
    <div className="endpoint-url-bar">
      <span className="endpoint-label">{label}:</span>
      <code className="endpoint-url-text">{url}</code>
      <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(url)}>
        <Copy size={10} /> Copy
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  // Docs payload examples
  const renderPayloadDocs = (apiCfg) => {
    if (!apiCfg) return null;
    const baseUrl = `${BASE_URL}/api/builder/apis/${apiCfg.id || testApiId}/execute`;
    const table = apiCfg.base_table || apiCfg.base_table;
    const cols = apiCfg.columns_exposed && apiCfg.columns_exposed.length > 0 && apiCfg.columns_exposed[0] !== '*'
      ? apiCfg.columns_exposed : ['column1', 'column2'];
    const pk = 'id';

    const examples = [
      {
        method: 'GET',
        desc: 'Fetch rows with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination',
        url: `${baseUrl}?limit=10&offset=0&sort_by=${cols[0]}&sort_order=asc`,
        body: null,
        curl: `curl -X GET "${baseUrl}?limit=10&sort_by=${cols[0]}&sort_order=asc"${apiCfg.auth_enabled ? ' -H "Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>"' : ''}`,
      },
      {
        method: 'POST',
        desc: 'Insert new rows into the table',
        url: baseUrl,
        body: JSON.stringify({ rows: [Object.fromEntries(cols.map(c => [c, 'value']))] }, null, 2),
        curl: `curl -X POST "${baseUrl}" -H "Content-Type: application/json"${apiCfg.auth_enabled ? ' -H "Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>"' : ''} -d '${JSON.stringify({ rows: [Object.fromEntries(cols.map(c => [c, 'value']))] })}'`,
      },
      {
        method: 'PUT',
        desc: 'Update an existing row by primary key',
        url: baseUrl,
        body: JSON.stringify({ primary_key: { [pk]: 1 }, updates: { [cols[0]]: 'new_value' } }, null, 2),
        curl: `curl -X PUT "${baseUrl}" -H "Content-Type: application/json"${apiCfg.auth_enabled ? ' -H "Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>"' : ''} -d '${JSON.stringify({ primary_key: { [pk]: 1 }, updates: { [cols[0]]: 'new_value' } })}'`,
      },
      {
        method: 'DELETE',
        desc: 'Delete rows by primary key values',
        url: baseUrl,
        body: JSON.stringify({ pk_column: pk, pk_values: [1, 2, 3] }, null, 2),
        curl: `curl -X DELETE "${baseUrl}" -H "Content-Type: application/json"${apiCfg.auth_enabled ? ' -H "Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>"' : ''} -d '${JSON.stringify({ pk_column: pk, pk_values: [1, 2, 3] })}'`,
      },
    ];

    const methodsAllowed = apiCfg.methods || (apiCfg.crud_enabled !== false ? ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE'] : ['GET']);

    return (
      <div className="payload-docs">
        <h4><Code size={16} /> Payload Examples</h4>
        {examples.filter(e => methodsAllowed.includes(e.method)).map((ex) => (
          <div key={ex.method} className="payload-example">
            <div className="payload-header">
              <span className={`badge method-badge-${ex.method.toLowerCase()}`}>{ex.method}</span>
              <span className="payload-desc">{ex.desc}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="payload-url">
              <span className="payload-label">URL:</span>
              <code>{ex.url}</code>
              <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(ex.url)}><Copy size={10} /></button>
            </div>
            {ex.body && (
              <div className="payload-body">
                <div className="payload-body-header">
                  <span className="payload-label">Request Body:</span>
                  <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(ex.body)}><Copy size={10} /> Copy</button>
                </div>
                <pre className="payload-code">{ex.body}</pre>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="payload-curl">
              <div className="payload-body-header">
                <span className="payload-label">cURL:</span>
                <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(ex.curl)}><Copy size={10} /> Copy</button>
              </div>
              <pre className="payload-code curl-code">{ex.curl}</pre>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  };


  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <div className="api-builder">
      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="api-tabs">
        {TABS.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              className={`api-tab ${activeTab === tab.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
            >
              <Icon size={16} />
              {tab.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ─── CRUD Tab ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'crud' && (
        <div className="api-panel">
          <h3 className="panel-title"><Table2 size={18} /> Dynamic Table API</h3>
          <p className="panel-desc">Access any table via REST API: <code>/api/crud/&#123;database&#125;/&#123;table&#125;</code></p>

          <div className="form-row">
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Database / Dataset</label>
              <SearchableDropdown
                value={crudDb}
                onChange={setCrudDb}
                options={getDbList(crudDbType)}
                placeholder="Select database..."
                loading={dbListLoading}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Table</label>
              <SearchableDropdown
                value={crudTable}
                onChange={setCrudTable}
                options={crudTableList}
                placeholder="Select table..."
                loading={crudTablesLoading}
                disabled={!crudDb}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Limit</label>
              <input type="number" value={crudParams.limit} onChange={(e) => setCrudParams({...crudParams, limit: Number(e.target.value)})} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Offset</label>
              <input type="number" value={crudParams.offset} onChange={(e) => setCrudParams({...crudParams, offset: Number(e.target.value)})} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="form-row">
            <div className="form-group flex-2">
              <label>Columns (comma-separated, blank = all)</label>
              <input value={crudParams.columns} onChange={(e) => setCrudParams({...crudParams, columns: e.target.value})} placeholder="id, name, email" />
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Sort by</label>
              <SearchableDropdown
                value={crudParams.sort_by}
                onChange={(v) => setCrudParams({...crudParams, sort_by: v})}
                options={crudColumnList}
                placeholder="column..."
                loading={crudColumnsLoading}
                allowFreeText
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Order</label>
              <select value={crudParams.sort_order} onChange={(e) => setCrudParams({...crudParams, sort_order: e.target.value})}>
                <option value="asc">ASC</option>
                <option value="desc">DESC</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="form-row">
            <div className="form-group flex-2">
              <label>Filters (JSON)</label>
              <input value={crudParams.filters} onChange={(e) => setCrudParams({...crudParams, filters: e.target.value})}
                placeholder='[{"col":"status","op":"eq","val":"active"}]' />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="action-bar">
            <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCrudRead} disabled={crudLoading}>
              <Play size={14} /> {crudLoading ? 'Loading...' : 'GET (Read)'}
            </button>
            <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={copyCrudEndpoint}>
              <Copy size={14} /> Copy Endpoint
            </button>
          </div>

          {crudDb && crudTable && renderEndpointUrl(getCrudEndpoint(), 'GET Endpoint')}

          {crudResult && (
            <div className="result-section">
              <div className="result-meta">
                <span>{crudResult.row_count} rows</span>
                <span>{crudResult.execution_time_ms}ms</span>
                <span className="endpoint-badge">{crudResult.endpoint}</span>
              </div>
              {renderResultWithToggle(crudResult, crudViewMode, setCrudViewMode)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Relationships Tab ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'relationships' && (
        <div className="api-panel">
          <h3 className="panel-title"><Link2 size={18} /> Table Relationships</h3>
          <p className="panel-desc">Define joins between tables — same database or cross-database (Cloud SQL ↔ BigQuery)</p>

          <div className="rel-form">
            <div className="form-row">
              <div className="form-group flex-2">
                <label>Relationship Name</label>
                <input value={relForm.name} onChange={(e) => setRelForm({...relForm, name: e.target.value})} placeholder="e.g. users_orders" />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>Join Type</label>
                <select value={relForm.join_type} onChange={(e) => setRelForm({...relForm, join_type: e.target.value})}>
                  <option value="INNER">INNER JOIN</option>
                  <option value="LEFT">LEFT JOIN</option>
                  <option value="RIGHT">RIGHT JOIN</option>
                  <option value="FULL">FULL JOIN</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="rel-tables">
              <div className="rel-side">
                <h4>Source Table</h4>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>DB Type</label>
                  <select value={relForm.source_db_type} onChange={(e) => setRelForm({...relForm, source_db_type: e.target.value, source_database: '', source_table: '', source_column: ''})}>
                    <option value="cloudsql">Cloud SQL</option>
                    <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                    {servers.filter(s => !s.is_default && s.connected).map(s => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Database</label>
                  <SearchableDropdown
                    value={relForm.source_database}
                    onChange={(v) => setRelForm({...relForm, source_database: v, source_table: '', source_column: ''})}
                    options={getDbList(relForm.source_db_type)}
                    placeholder="Select database..."
                    loading={dbListLoading}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Table</label>
                  <SearchableDropdown
                    value={relForm.source_table}
                    onChange={(v) => setRelForm({...relForm, source_table: v, source_column: ''})}
                    options={srcTableList}
                    placeholder="Select table..."
                    loading={srcTablesLoading}
                    disabled={!relForm.source_database}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Join Column</label>
                  <SearchableDropdown
                    value={relForm.source_column}
                    onChange={(v) => setRelForm({...relForm, source_column: v})}
                    options={srcColumnList}
                    placeholder="Select column..."
                    loading={srcColumnsLoading}
                    disabled={!relForm.source_table}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="rel-arrow"><ArrowRight size={24} /></div>

              <div className="rel-side">
                <h4>Target Table</h4>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>DB Type</label>
                  <select value={relForm.target_db_type} onChange={(e) => setRelForm({...relForm, target_db_type: e.target.value, target_database: '', target_table: '', target_column: ''})}>
                    <option value="cloudsql">Cloud SQL</option>
                    <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                    {servers.filter(s => !s.is_default && s.connected).map(s => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Database</label>
                  <SearchableDropdown
                    value={relForm.target_database}
                    onChange={(v) => setRelForm({...relForm, target_database: v, target_table: '', target_column: ''})}
                    options={getDbList(relForm.target_db_type)}
                    placeholder="Select database..."
                    loading={dbListLoading}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Table</label>
                  <SearchableDropdown
                    value={relForm.target_table}
                    onChange={(v) => setRelForm({...relForm, target_table: v, target_column: ''})}
                    options={tgtTableList}
                    placeholder="Select table..."
                    loading={tgtTablesLoading}
                    disabled={!relForm.target_database}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Join Column</label>
                  <SearchableDropdown
                    value={relForm.target_column}
                    onChange={(v) => setRelForm({...relForm, target_column: v})}
                    options={tgtColumnList}
                    placeholder="Select column..."
                    loading={tgtColumnsLoading}
                    disabled={!relForm.target_table}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateRelationship}>
              <Plus size={14} /> Create Relationship
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Saved relationships */}
          {relationships.length > 0 && (
            <div className="saved-list">
              <h4>Saved Relationships ({relationships.length})</h4>
              {relationships.map((rel) => (
                <div key={rel.id} className="saved-item">
                  <div className="saved-item-info">
                    <strong>{rel.name}</strong>
                    <span className="badge">{rel.join_type}</span>
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                      {rel.source_database}.{rel.source_table}.{rel.source_column}
                      {' \u2192 '}
                      {rel.target_database}.{rel.target_table}.{rel.target_column}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="saved-item-actions">
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(getRelEndpoint(rel.id))}>
                      <Copy size={12} /> URL
                    </button>
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={() => handleExecuteRelationship(rel.id)}>
                      <Play size={12} /> Run
                    </button>
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => handleDeleteRelationship(rel.id)}>
                      <Trash2 size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {relResult && (
            <div className="result-section">
              <div className="result-meta">
                <span>{relResult.row_count} rows</span>
                <span>{relResult.execution_time_ms}ms</span>
              </div>
              {renderResultWithToggle(relResult, relViewMode, setRelViewMode)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── API Builder Tab ───────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'builder' && (
        <div className="api-panel">
          <h3 className="panel-title"><Layers size={18} /> Custom API Builder</h3>
          <p className="panel-desc">Create reusable API endpoints with relationships, filters, and function layers</p>

          <div className="builder-form">
            <div className="form-row">
              <div className="form-group flex-2">
                <label>API Name *</label>
                <input value={apiForm.name} onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, name: e.target.value})} placeholder="e.g. active-users-api" />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group flex-2">
                <label>Description</label>
                <input value={apiForm.description} onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, description: e.target.value})} placeholder="What this API does" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>DB Type</label>
                <select value={apiForm.db_type} onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, db_type: e.target.value, database: '', base_table: ''})}>
                  <option value="cloudsql">Cloud SQL</option>
                  <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                  {servers.filter(s => !s.is_default && s.connected).map(s => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>Database *</label>
                <SearchableDropdown
                  value={apiForm.database}
                  onChange={(v) => setApiForm({...apiForm, database: v, base_table: ''})}
                  options={getDbList(apiForm.db_type)}
                  placeholder="Select database..."
                  loading={dbListLoading}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>Base Table *</label>
                <SearchableDropdown
                  value={apiForm.base_table}
                  onChange={(v) => setApiForm({...apiForm, base_table: v})}
                  options={builderTableList}
                  placeholder="Select table..."
                  loading={builderTablesLoading}
                  disabled={!apiForm.database}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>Schema</label>
                <input value={apiForm.schema_name} onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, schema_name: e.target.value})} placeholder="public" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <div className="form-group flex-2">
                <label>Select Columns (click to add, blank = all)</label>
                <SearchableDropdown
                  value=""
                  onChange={(v) => {
                    if (v && !apiForm.select_columns.includes(v)) {
                      setApiForm({...apiForm, select_columns: [...apiForm.select_columns, v]});
                    }
                  }}
                  options={[...builderColumnList, ...allBuilderColumns.filter(c => c.includes('.'))].filter((c) => !apiForm.select_columns.includes(c))}
                  placeholder={apiForm.select_columns.length ? `${apiForm.select_columns.length} selected` : 'All columns (base + joined)'}
                  loading={builderColumnsLoading}
                  disabled={!apiForm.base_table}
                />
                {apiForm.select_columns.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="selected-tags">
                    {apiForm.select_columns.map((col) => (
                      <span key={col} className="tag">
                        {col}
                        <button onClick={() => setApiForm({...apiForm, select_columns: apiForm.select_columns.filter((c) => c !== col)})}><X size={10} /></button>
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>Default Limit</label>
                <input type="number" value={apiForm.default_limit}
                  onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, default_limit: Number(e.target.value)})} />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>Cache TTL (seconds) <span style={{fontSize:'0.75rem',color:'#64748b'}}>0 = disabled</span></label>
                <input type="number" min="0" value={apiForm.cache_ttl}
                  onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, cache_ttl: Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value))})} 
                  placeholder="0" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <div className="form-group flex-2">
                <label>Allowed Filter Columns (click to add)</label>
                <SearchableDropdown
                  value=""
                  onChange={(v) => {
                    if (v && !apiForm.allowed_filters.includes(v)) {
                      setApiForm({...apiForm, allowed_filters: [...apiForm.allowed_filters, v]});
                    }
                  }}
                  options={[...builderColumnList, ...allBuilderColumns.filter(c => c.includes('.'))].filter((c) => !apiForm.allowed_filters.includes(c))}
                  placeholder={apiForm.allowed_filters.length ? `${apiForm.allowed_filters.length} filters` : 'Select columns (base + joined)...'}
                  loading={builderColumnsLoading}
                  disabled={!apiForm.base_table}
                />
                {apiForm.allowed_filters.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="selected-tags">
                    {apiForm.allowed_filters.map((col) => (
                      <span key={col} className="tag">
                        {col}
                        <button onClick={() => setApiForm({...apiForm, allowed_filters: apiForm.allowed_filters.filter((c) => c !== col)})}><X size={10} /></button>
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="form-group flex-2">
                <label>Allowed Sort Columns (click to add)</label>
                <SearchableDropdown
                  value=""
                  onChange={(v) => {
                    if (v && !apiForm.allowed_sorts.includes(v)) {
                      setApiForm({...apiForm, allowed_sorts: [...apiForm.allowed_sorts, v]});
                    }
                  }}
                  options={[...builderColumnList, ...allBuilderColumns.filter(c => c.includes('.'))].filter((c) => !apiForm.allowed_sorts.includes(c))}
                  placeholder={apiForm.allowed_sorts.length ? `${apiForm.allowed_sorts.length} sort cols` : 'Select columns (base + joined)...'}
                  loading={builderColumnsLoading}
                  disabled={!apiForm.base_table}
                />
                {apiForm.allowed_sorts.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="selected-tags">
                    {apiForm.allowed_sorts.map((col) => (
                      <span key={col} className="tag">
                        {col}
                        <button onClick={() => setApiForm({...apiForm, allowed_sorts: apiForm.allowed_sorts.filter((c) => c !== col)})}><X size={10} /></button>
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ── WHERE Conditions (permanent filters) ─────── */}
            <div className="function-layers-section">
              <h4><Filter size={16} /> WHERE Conditions (permanent filters)</h4>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: 8 }}>
                These conditions are always applied to every API call. Supports LIKE, =, !=, &gt;, &lt;, IN, IS NULL, etc.
              </span>

              {(apiForm.where_conditions || []).map((wc, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginBottom: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  {/* Column selector */}
                  <div style={{ flex: 2 }}>
                    <SearchableDropdown
                      value={wc.column || ''}
                      onChange={(v) => {
                        const updated = [...(apiForm.where_conditions || [])];
                        updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], column: v };
                        setApiForm({ ...apiForm, where_conditions: updated });
                      }}
                      options={builderColumnList}
                      placeholder="Column..."
                      loading={builderColumnsLoading}
                      disabled={!apiForm.base_table}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Operator selector */}
                  <select
                    value={wc.operator || '='}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const updated = [...(apiForm.where_conditions || [])];
                      updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], operator: e.target.value };
                      setApiForm({ ...apiForm, where_conditions: updated });
                    }}
                    style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100, padding: '6px 8px', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #d1d5db', background: '#fff', color: '#1e293b', fontSize: 12 }}
                  >
                    <option value="=">=  (equals)</option>
                    <option value="!=">!=  (not equal)</option>
                    <option value="LIKE">LIKE</option>
                    <option value="NOT LIKE">NOT LIKE</option>
                    <option value="ILIKE">ILIKE (case-insensitive)</option>
                    <option value=">">&gt;  (greater than)</option>
                    <option value="<">&lt;  (less than)</option>
                    <option value=">=">&gt;=</option>
                    <option value="<=">&lt;=</option>
                    <option value="IN">IN</option>
                    <option value="NOT IN">NOT IN</option>
                    <option value="IS NULL">IS NULL</option>
                    <option value="IS NOT NULL">IS NOT NULL</option>
                  </select>

                  {/* Value input — hidden for IS NULL / IS NOT NULL */}
                  {!['IS NULL', 'IS NOT NULL'].includes(wc.operator) && (
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={wc.value || ''}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const updated = [...(apiForm.where_conditions || [])];
                        updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], value: e.target.value };
                        setApiForm({ ...apiForm, where_conditions: updated });
                      }}
                      placeholder={
                        wc.operator === 'LIKE' || wc.operator === 'NOT LIKE' || wc.operator === 'ILIKE'
                          ? '%value%'
                          : wc.operator === 'IN' || wc.operator === 'NOT IN'
                            ? 'val1, val2, val3'
                            : 'Value...'
                      }
                      style={{ flex: 2, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12, color:"black" }}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* Remove button */}
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-xs"
                    style={{ color: '#ef4444', background: 'transparent', border: 'none', padding: 4 }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      const updated = (apiForm.where_conditions || []).filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
                      setApiForm({ ...apiForm, where_conditions: updated });
                    }}
                    title="Remove condition"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={14} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}

              {/* Add condition button */}
              <button
                className="btn btn-xs btn-outline"
                style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
                onClick={() => setApiForm({
                  ...apiForm,
                  where_conditions: [...(apiForm.where_conditions || []), { column: '', operator: '=', value: '' }],
                })}
              >
                <Plus size={12} /> Add WHERE Condition
              </button>

              {/* Advanced: raw base_filter toggle */}
              {(apiForm.base_filter || '').trim() ? (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                  <label style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8' }}>Advanced — Raw WHERE (applied in addition to above)</label>
                  <textarea
                    value={apiForm.base_filter || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, base_filter: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="e.g. status = 'active' AND region = 'US'"
                    rows={2}
                    style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12, width: '100%', marginTop: 4 }}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            {/* ── Relationships / JOINs ────────────────────── */}
            <div className="function-layers-section">
              <h4><Link2 size={16} /> Relationships / JOINs (optional)</h4>
              
              {/* Import from saved relationships */}
              {relationships.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  <label style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: 4, display: 'block' }}>Import from Saved Relationships</label>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    {relationships
                      .filter((r) => !apiForm.relationships.some((ar) => ar.name === r.name))
                      .map((rel) => (
                        <button key={rel.id} className="btn btn-xs btn-outline"
                          onClick={() => {
                            const newRel = {
                              name: rel.name,
                              target_db_type: rel.target_db_type || 'cloudsql',
                              target_database: rel.target_database,
                              target_table: rel.target_table,
                              target_column: rel.target_column,
                              source_column: rel.source_column,
                              join_type: rel.join_type,
                              alias: rel.alias || '',
                            };
                            setApiForm({
                              ...apiForm,
                              relationships: [...apiForm.relationships, newRel],
                            });
                          }}
                        >
                          <Plus size={10} /> {rel.name} ({rel.join_type})
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    {relationships.filter((r) => !apiForm.relationships.some((ar) => ar.name === r.name)).length === 0 && (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' }}>All saved relationships already added</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              
              {/* Add new relationship inline */}
              <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
                onClick={() => setApiForm({
                  ...apiForm,
                  relationships: [...apiForm.relationships, {
                    name: '', target_db_type: apiForm.db_type,
                    target_database: apiForm.database, target_table: '', target_column: '',
                    source_table: '', source_column: '', join_type: 'INNER', raw_on_clause: '', alias: '',
                  }],
                })}
              >
                <Plus size={12} /> Add JOIN
              </button>
              
              {apiForm.relationships.map((rel, idx) => {
                const jl = joinLists[idx] || {};
                return (
                <div key={idx} className="layer-card">
                  <div className="layer-header">
                    <span className="badge">{rel.join_type} JOIN</span>
                    <strong>{rel.name || `Join #${idx + 1}`}</strong>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', marginLeft: 4 }}>
                      {rel.target_table ? `\u2192 ${rel.target_database || ''}.${rel.target_table}` : ''}
                      {rel.alias ? ` AS ${rel.alias}` : ''}
                    </span>
                    <button className="btn-icon" onClick={() => {
                      const updated = [...apiForm.relationships];
                      updated.splice(idx, 1);
                      setApiForm({ ...apiForm, relationships: updated });
                      // Clean up joinLists for this index
                      const newLists = { ...joinLists };
                      delete newLists[idx];
                      setJoinLists(newLists);
                    }}><X size={14} /></button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="layer-config">
                    {/* Row 1: Name + Alias + Join Type */}
                    <div className="form-row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 2 }}>
                        <label>Name</label>
                        <input value={rel.name}
                          onChange={(e) => updateJoin(idx, 'name', e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="e.g. user_orders"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Alias</label>
                        <input value={rel.alias || ''}
                          onChange={(e) => updateJoin(idx, 'alias', e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="e.g. inc_mgr"
                          style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12 }}
                        />
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#94a3b8' }}>Required when same table is joined multiple times</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Join Type</label>
                        <select value={rel.join_type}
                          onChange={(e) => updateJoin(idx, 'join_type', e.target.value)}
                        >
                          <option value="INNER">INNER JOIN</option>
                          <option value="LEFT">LEFT JOIN</option>
                          <option value="RIGHT">RIGHT JOIN</option>
                          <option value="FULL">FULL JOIN</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Row 2: Source Column — or raw ON clause if function-based */}
                    {rel.raw_on_clause ? (
                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label>ON Clause (function-based — from original query)</label>
                        <input
                          value={rel.raw_on_clause}
                          onChange={(e) => updateJoin(idx, 'raw_on_clause', e.target.value)}
                          style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12, background: '#eff6ff', color: '#1e293b' }}
                        />
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#94a3b8' }}>Complex ON clause using functions — edit carefully or clear to use column selectors</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (<>
                    <div className="form-row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Source Table</label>
                        <input
                          value={rel.source_table || ''}
                          onChange={(e) => updateJoin(idx, 'source_table', e.target.value)}
                          placeholder={apiForm.base_table || 'base table (default)'}
                          style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12 }}
                        />
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#94a3b8' }}>Leave blank to use base table. Set for chained JOINs (A→B→C).</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Source Column</label>
                        <SearchableDropdown
                          value={rel.source_column}
                          onChange={(v) => updateJoin(idx, 'source_column', v)}
                          options={builderColumnList}
                          placeholder="Select join column..."
                          loading={builderColumnsLoading}
                          allowFreeText
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Row 3: Target DB Type + Target Database */}
                    <div className="form-row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Target DB Type</label>
                        <select value={rel.target_db_type || apiForm.db_type}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            updateJoin(idx, 'target_db_type', e.target.value);
                          }}
                        >
                          <option value="cloudsql">Cloud SQL</option>
                          <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                          {servers.filter(s => !s.is_default && s.connected).map(s => (
                            <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </div>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 2 }}>
                        <label>Target Database</label>
                        <SearchableDropdown
                          value={rel.target_database}
                          onChange={(v) => updateJoin(idx, 'target_database', v)}
                          options={getDbList(rel.target_db_type || apiForm.db_type)}
                          placeholder="Select database..."
                          loading={dbListLoading}
                          allowFreeText
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Row 4: Target Table + Target Column */}
                    <div className="form-row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Target Table</label>
                        <SearchableDropdown
                          value={rel.target_table}
                          onChange={(v) => updateJoin(idx, 'target_table', v)}
                          options={jl.tables || []}
                          placeholder="Select table..."
                          loading={jl.tLoading || false}
                          disabled={!rel.target_database}
                          allowFreeText
                          onFocus={() => {
                            if (rel.target_database && (!jl.tables || jl.tables.length === 0)) {
                              fetchJoinTables(idx, rel.target_db_type || apiForm.db_type, rel.target_database);
                            }
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="form-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <label>Target Column</label>
                        <SearchableDropdown
                          value={rel.target_column}
                          onChange={(v) => updateJoin(idx, 'target_column', v)}
                          options={jl.columns || []}
                          placeholder="Select column..."
                          loading={jl.cLoading || false}
                          disabled={!rel.target_table}
                          allowFreeText
                          onFocus={() => {
                            if (rel.target_database && rel.target_table && (!jl.columns || jl.columns.length === 0)) {
                              fetchJoinColumns(idx, rel.target_db_type || apiForm.db_type, rel.target_database, rel.target_table);
                            }
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    </>)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                );
              })}

              {apiForm.relationships.length === 0 && (
                <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 4 }}>No JOINs added. API will query the base table only.</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Function Layers */}
            <div className="function-layers-section">
              <h4><Zap size={16} /> Function Layers (optional)</h4>
              <div className="layer-templates">
                {LAYER_TEMPLATES.map((tpl, i) => (
                  <button key={i} className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => addFunctionLayer(tpl)}>
                    <Plus size={12} /> {tpl.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              {apiForm.function_layers.map((layer, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="layer-card">
                  <div className="layer-header">
                    <span className="badge">{layer.type}</span>
                    <strong>{layer.name}</strong>
                    <button className="btn-icon" onClick={() => removeFunctionLayer(idx)}><X size={14} /></button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="layer-config">
                    {Object.entries(layer.config).map(([key, val]) => (
                      <div key={key} className="form-group">
                        <label>{key}</label>
                        {key === 'column' || key === 'group_by' || key === 'agg_column' ? (
                          <SearchableDropdown
                            value={val}
                            onChange={(v) => updateFunctionLayer(idx, `config.${key}`, v)}
                            options={builderColumnList}
                            placeholder="Select column..."
                            loading={builderColumnsLoading}
                            allowFreeText
                          />
                        ) : key === 'action' ? (
                          <select value={val} onChange={(e) => updateFunctionLayer(idx, `config.${key}`, e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="lowercase">Lowercase</option>
                            <option value="uppercase">Uppercase</option>
                            <option value="trim">Trim</option>
                            <option value="mask">Mask PII</option>
                            <option value="hash">Hash</option>
                          </select>
                        ) : key === 'operator' ? (
                          <select value={val} onChange={(e) => updateFunctionLayer(idx, `config.${key}`, e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="eq">Equals</option>
                            <option value="neq">Not Equals</option>
                            <option value="gt">Greater Than</option>
                            <option value="lt">Less Than</option>
                            <option value="contains">Contains</option>
                          </select>
                        ) : key === 'agg_func' ? (
                          <select value={val} onChange={(e) => updateFunctionLayer(idx, `config.${key}`, e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="count">Count</option>
                            <option value="sum">Sum</option>
                            <option value="avg">Average</option>
                            <option value="min">Min</option>
                            <option value="max">Max</option>
                          </select>
                        ) : (
                          <input value={val} onChange={(e) => updateFunctionLayer(idx, `config.${key}`, e.target.value)} placeholder={key} />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* ── Security & Authentication Section ─────────────── */}
            <div className="security-section">
              <h4><Shield size={16} /> API Options & Security (optional)</h4>

              <div className="form-row">
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="toggle-label">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={apiForm.enable_crud}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, enable_crud: e.target.checked})}
                    />
                    <Zap size={14} /> Enable CRUD (POST / PUT / DELETE)
                  </label>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="toggle-label">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={apiForm.auth_enabled}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, auth_enabled: e.target.checked})}
