                    />
                    <Lock size={14} /> Enable Basic Auth
                  </label>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="toggle-label">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={apiForm.encryption_enabled}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, encryption_enabled: e.target.checked})}
                    />
                    <Key size={14} /> Enable Payload Encryption
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Public Alias */}
              <div className="form-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                <div className="form-group flex-2">
                  <label><Globe size={12} /> Public API Alias <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontWeight: 400, fontSize: 11 }}>(optional — creates a clean URL)</span></label>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <input
                      value={apiForm.public_alias}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, public_alias: e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, '-')})}
                      placeholder="e.g. users, active-orders, products"
                      style={{ flex: 1 }}
                    />
                    {apiForm.public_alias && (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#059669', fontFamily: 'monospace', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                        /api/data/{apiForm.public_alias}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {apiForm.auth_enabled && (
                <div className="form-row auth-fields">
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>Username</label>
                    <input
                      value={apiForm.auth_username}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, auth_username: e.target.value})}
                      placeholder="API username"
                      autoComplete="off"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>Password</label>
                    <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                      <input
                        type={showAuthPass ? 'text' : 'password'}
                        value={apiForm.auth_password}
                        onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, auth_password: e.target.value})}
                        placeholder="API password"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        style={{ paddingRight: 36 }}
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setShowAuthPass(!showAuthPass)}
                        style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 6, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4, color: '#64748b' }}
                        title={showAuthPass ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                      >
                        {showAuthPass ? <EyeOff size={14} /> : <Eye size={14} />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {apiForm.encryption_enabled && (
                <div className="form-row encryption-fields">
                  <div className="form-group flex-2">
                    <label>Encryption Key (Fernet)</label>
                    <div className="input-with-btn">
                      <input
                        value={apiForm.encryption_key}
                        onChange={(e) => setApiForm({...apiForm, encryption_key: e.target.value})}
                        placeholder="Auto-generated on save if blank"
                        readOnly
                      />
                      <button
                        className="btn btn-sm btn-outline"
                        onClick={handleGenerateKey}
                        disabled={generatingKey}
                      >
                        <Key size={12} /> {generatingKey ? 'Generating...' : apiForm.encryption_key ? 'Regenerate Key' : 'Generate Key'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    {apiForm.encryption_key && (
                      <div className="key-actions">
                        <button
                          className="btn btn-sm btn-outline copy-key-btn"
                          onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(apiForm.encryption_key); toast.success('Key copied!'); }}
                        >
                          <Copy size={12} /> Copy Key
                        </button>
                        <span className="key-hint">Share this key with your API consumers for decryption</span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {!apiForm.encryption_key && (
                      <span className="key-hint">A key will be auto-generated when you save, or click Generate Key now</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="action-bar">
              <button
                className="btn btn-success"
                onClick={handlePreviewAPI}
                disabled={previewLoading || !apiForm.database || !apiForm.base_table}
                title="Test this API configuration with a GET request before saving"
              >
                {previewLoading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="spin" /> : <Play size={14} />}
                {previewLoading ? 'Testing...' : 'Test API'}
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleSaveAPI}>
                <Save size={14} /> {editingApiId ? 'Update API' : 'Create API'}
              </button>
              {editingApiId && (
                <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={resetApiForm}>
                  <X size={14} /> Cancel Edit
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* ── Preview Results Panel ────────────────────────────── */}
            {previewResult && (
              <div className="preview-panel">
                <div className="preview-header">
                  <div className="preview-title">
                    <Eye size={14} />
                    <span>Preview Results</span>
                    {previewResult.success && (
                      <>
                        <span className="badge badge-green">{previewResult.row_count} rows</span>
                        <span className="badge">{previewResult.execution_time_ms}ms</span>
                        <span className="badge badge-blue">{previewResult.database}</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="preview-actions">
                    {previewResult.success && (
                      <>
                        <button
                          className={`btn btn-xs ${previewViewMode === 'table' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'}`}
                          onClick={() => setPreviewViewMode('table')}
                        >
                          <Table2 size={12} /> Table
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className={`btn btn-xs ${previewViewMode === 'json' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'}`}
                          onClick={() => setPreviewViewMode('json')}
                        >
                          <Code size={12} /> JSON
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="btn btn-xs btn-outline"
                          onClick={() => {
                            navigator.clipboard.writeText(previewResult.query_generated || '');
                            toast.success('SQL copied');
                          }}
                          title="Copy generated SQL"
                        >
                          <Copy size={12} /> SQL
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}
                    <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => setPreviewResult(null)}>
                      <X size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {previewResult.error && (
                  <div className="preview-error">
                    <AlertCircle size={14} /> {previewResult.error}
                  </div>
                )}

                {previewResult.success && previewViewMode === 'json' && (
                  <div className="preview-body">
                    <pre className="preview-json">{JSON.stringify(previewResult.data, null, 2)}</pre>
                  </div>
                )}

                {previewResult.success && previewViewMode === 'table' && previewResult.columns?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="preview-body">
                    <div className="preview-table-wrapper">
                      <table className="preview-table">
                        <thead>
                          <tr>{previewResult.columns.map(c => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}</tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {previewResult.data.map((row, i) => (
                            <tr key={i}>
                              {previewResult.columns.map(c => (
                                <td key={c}>{row[c] === null ? <span className="null-val">NULL</span> : String(row[c])}</td>
                              ))}
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                    {previewResult.query_generated && (
                      <details className="preview-sql-details">
                        <summary>Generated SQL</summary>
                        <pre>{previewResult.query_generated}</pre>
                      </details>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Saved APIs list */}
          {customAPIs.length > 0 && (
            <div className="saved-list">
              <h4>Your APIs ({customAPIs.length})</h4>
              {customAPIs.map((api) => (
                <div key={api.id} className="saved-item">
                  <div className="saved-item-info">
                    <strong>{api.name}</strong>
                    <span className="badge">{api.db_type}</span>
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">{api.database}.{api.base_table}</span>
                    {api.public_alias && (
                      <span className="badge badge-green"><Globe size={10} /> /api/data/{api.public_alias}</span>
                    )}
                    {api.function_layers?.length > 0 && (
                      <span className="badge badge-purple">{api.function_layers.length} layers</span>
                    )}
                    {api.auth_enabled && (
                      <span className="badge badge-yellow"><Lock size={10} /> Auth</span>
                    )}
                    {api.encryption_enabled && (
                      <span className="badge badge-blue"><Shield size={10} /> Encrypted</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="saved-item-actions">
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(getApiEndpoint(api.id))}>
                      <Copy size={12} /> URL
                    </button>
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => handleEditAPI(api)}>
                      <Settings size={12} /> Edit
                    </button>
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={() => { setTestApiId(api.id); setActiveTab('tester'); }}>
                      <Play size={12} /> Test
                    </button>
                    <button className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => handleDeleteAPI(api.id)}>
                      <Trash2 size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Logic Flow Builder Tab ────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'logic' && (
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
          <LogicFlowBuilder onSaved={(flow) => toast.success(`Flow "${flow.name}" saved`)} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── API Tester Tab ────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'tester' && (
        <div className="api-panel">
          <h3 className="panel-title"><Play size={18} /> API Tester</h3>
          <p className="panel-desc">Test your custom APIs — GET, POST, PUT, DELETE with auth & encryption</p>

          {/* API Selection + Method */}
          <div className="form-row">
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>HTTP Method</label>
              <div className="method-selector">
                {HTTP_METHODS.map((m) => (
                  <button
                    key={m}
                    className={`method-btn method-${m.toLowerCase()} ${testMethod === m ? 'active' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setTestMethod(m);
                      if (m !== 'GET' && !testBody) setTestBody(getBodyTemplate());
                    }}
                  >
                    {m}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="form-group flex-2">
              <label>Select API</label>
              <select value={testApiId} onChange={(e) => { setTestApiId(e.target.value); setApiDocs(null); setTestResult(null); setVerifyResult(null); }}>
                <option value="">-- Select an API --</option>
                {customAPIs.map((api) => (
                  <option key={api.id} value={api.id}>
                    {api.name} ({api.database}.{api.base_table})
                    {api.auth_enabled ? ' 🔒' : ''}
                    {api.encryption_enabled ? ' 🛡' : ''}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* GET-specific params */}
          {testMethod === 'GET' && (
            <>
              <div className="form-row">
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Limit</label>
                  <input type="number" value={testParams.limit} onChange={(e) => setTestParams({...testParams, limit: Number(e.target.value)})} />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Offset</label>
                  <input type="number" value={testParams.offset} onChange={(e) => setTestParams({...testParams, offset: Number(e.target.value)})} />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Sort by</label>
                  <input value={testParams.sort_by} onChange={(e) => setTestParams({...testParams, sort_by: e.target.value})} placeholder="column" />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Order</label>
                  <select value={testParams.sort_order} onChange={(e) => setTestParams({...testParams, sort_order: e.target.value})}>
                    <option value="asc">ASC</option>
                    <option value="desc">DESC</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Simple Filters */}
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>
                  Simple Filters (Query Params)
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-xs btn-outline"
                    style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
                    onClick={() => setTestFilters([...testFilters, { col: '', val: '' }])}
                  >
                    <Plus size={10} /> Add Filter
                  </button>
                </label>
                {testFilters.map((f, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="filter-row" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                    <input
                      style={{ flex: 1 }}
                      placeholder="Column (e.g., eid)"
                      value={f.col}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const updated = [...testFilters];
                        updated[i].col = e.target.value;
                        setTestFilters(updated);
                      }}
                    />
                    <input
                      style={{ flex: 1 }}
                      placeholder="Value"
                      value={f.val}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const updated = [...testFilters];
                        updated[i].val = e.target.value;
                        setTestFilters(updated);
                      }}
                    />
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-xs btn-outline"
                      onClick={() => setTestFilters(testFilters.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))}
                    >
                      <X size={10} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <small style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Adds ?column=value to URL (equality filter)</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-row">
                <div className="form-group flex-2">
                  <label>Advanced Filters (JSON)</label>
                  <input value={testParams.filters} onChange={(e) => setTestParams({...testParams, filters: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder='[{"col":"status","op":"eq","val":"active"}]' />
                  <small style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Supports operators: eq, like, gt, lt</small>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* POST / PUT / DELETE request body */}
          {testMethod !== 'GET' && (
            <>
              {/* Search Mode Toggle for POST */}
              {testMethod === 'POST' && (
                <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={useSearchMode}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setUseSearchMode(e.target.checked);
                        setTestBody(getBodyTemplate());
                      }}
                    />
                    <span>Search/Filter Mode (use /search endpoint)</span>
                  </label>
                  <small style={{ color: '#64748b', marginLeft: 24 }}>
                    {useSearchMode ? 'POST body will filter data (e.g., {"eid":"123"})' : 'POST body will insert rows'}
                  </small>
                </div>
              )}
              
              <div className="form-row">
                <div className="form-group flex-2">
                  <label>
                    Request Body (JSON)
                    <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
                      onClick={() => setTestBody(getBodyTemplate())}>
                      <RefreshCw size={10} /> Template
                    </button>
                    <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
                      onClick={beautifyJSON}>
                      <AlignLeft size={10} /> Beautify
                    </button>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    className="request-body-input"
                    value={testBody}
                    onChange={(e) => setTestBody(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={`JSON body for ${testMethod} request...`}
                    rows={6}
                    spellCheck={false}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Auth & Encryption section */}
          <div className="tester-security">
            <div className="form-row">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label><Lock size={12} /> Auth Username</label>
                <input value={testAuthUser} onChange={(e) => setTestAuthUser(e.target.value)} placeholder="username" autoComplete="off" />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label><Lock size={12} /> Auth Password</label>
                <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                  <input type={showTestPass ? 'text' : 'password'} value={testAuthPass} onChange={(e) => setTestAuthPass(e.target.value)} placeholder="password" autoComplete="off" style={{ paddingRight: 36, width: '100%' }} />
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowTestPass(!showTestPass)} style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 6, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4, color: '#64748b' }} title={showTestPass ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}>
                    {showTestPass ? <EyeOff size={14} /> : <Eye size={14} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {testMethod !== 'GET' && (
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="toggle-label">
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={testEncrypt} onChange={(e) => setTestEncrypt(e.target.checked)} />
                    <Shield size={12} /> Encrypt Request
                  </label>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="toggle-label">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={testDecryptResponse} onChange={(e) => setTestDecryptResponse(e.target.checked)} />
                  <Unlock size={12} /> Decrypt Response
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="action-bar">
            <button
              className={`btn btn-primary method-btn-action method-${testMethod.toLowerCase()}`}
              onClick={handleTestAPI}
              disabled={testLoading || !testApiId}
            >
              {testMethod === 'GET' && <Play size={14} />}
              {testMethod === 'POST' && <Send size={14} />}
              {testMethod === 'PUT' && <Pencil size={14} />}
              {testMethod === 'DELETE' && <Trash size={14} />}
              {testLoading ? 'Running...' : `${testMethod} Execute`}
            </button>
            <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={handleLoadDocs} disabled={!testApiId}>
              <FileText size={14} /> View Docs
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Endpoint URL display */}
          {testApiId && renderEndpointUrl(getApiEndpointFull(), `${testMethod} Endpoint`)}

          {/* Code Snippets */}
          {testApiId && renderCodeSnippets(
            getApiEndpointFull(),
            testMethod,
            testMethod !== 'GET' ? testBody : null,
            testAuthUser,
            testAuthPass
          )}

          {/* API Documentation */}
          {apiDocs && (
            <div className="api-docs">
              <h4><FileText size={16} /> API Documentation</h4>
              <div className="docs-content">
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Name:</span> <span>{apiDocs.api_name}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Description:</span> <span>{apiDocs.description || '\u2014'}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row">
                  <span className="doc-label">Methods:</span>
                  <span>
                    {(apiDocs.methods || [apiDocs.method || 'GET']).map((m) => (
                      <span key={m} className={`badge method-badge-${m.toLowerCase()}`} style={{ marginRight: 4 }}>{m}</span>
                    ))}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="doc-row">
                  <span className="doc-label">URL:</span>
                  <code>{apiDocs.base_url}</code>
                  <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }} onClick={() => copyToClipboard(`${BASE_URL}${apiDocs.base_url}`)}>
                    <Copy size={10} /> Copy
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Database:</span> <span>{apiDocs.database} ({apiDocs.db_type})</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Base Table:</span> <span>{apiDocs.base_table}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Columns:</span> <span>{(apiDocs.columns_exposed || []).join(', ') || '*'}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Filterable:</span> <span>{(apiDocs.filterable_columns || []).join(', ') || 'any'}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Sortable:</span> <span>{(apiDocs.sortable_columns || []).join(', ') || 'any'}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Default Limit:</span> <span>{apiDocs.default_limit}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">CRUD Enabled:</span> <span>{apiDocs.crud_enabled ? 'Yes' : 'Read-only'}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Auth:</span> <span>{apiDocs.auth_enabled ? '\u2705 Basic Auth Required' : '\u274c No Auth'}</span></div>
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Encryption:</span> <span>{apiDocs.encryption_enabled ? '\u2705 Fernet Encryption' : '\u274c Not Encrypted'}</span></div>
                {apiDocs.relationships?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Joins:</span>
                    <span>{apiDocs.relationships.map(r => `${r.type} ${r.source} \u2192 ${r.target}`).join('; ')}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {apiDocs.function_layers?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Layers:</span>
                    <span>{apiDocs.function_layers.map(l => `${l.name} (${l.type})`).join(', ')}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="doc-row"><span className="doc-label">Example:</span> <code>{apiDocs.example_url}</code></div>
              </div>

              {/* Payload Examples Section */}
              {renderPayloadDocs(apiDocs)}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Test Results */}
          {testResult && (
            <div className="result-section">
              <div className="result-meta">
                <span className={`badge method-badge-${testMethod.toLowerCase()}`}>{testMethod}</span>
                {testResult.api_name && <span className="badge badge-green">{testResult.api_name}</span>}
                {testResult.row_count != null && <span>{testResult.row_count} rows</span>}
                {testResult.rows_inserted != null && <span>{testResult.rows_inserted} inserted</span>}
                {testResult.rows_updated != null && <span>{testResult.rows_updated} updated</span>}
                {testResult.rows_deleted != null && <span>{testResult.rows_deleted} deleted</span>}
                {testResult.execution_time_ms != null && <span>{testResult.execution_time_ms}ms</span>}
                {testResult.encrypted && <span className="badge badge-blue"><Shield size={10} /> Encrypted</span>}
              </div>
              {testResult.query_generated && (
                <details className="query-preview">
                  <summary>Generated SQL</summary>
                  <code>{testResult.query_generated}</code>
                </details>
              )}

              {/* For GET — show table/json toggle */}
              {testResult.data && testResult.data.length > 0 ? (
                renderResultWithToggle(testResult, resultViewMode, setResultViewMode)
              ) : (
                <>
                  {renderJsonResult(testResult)}
                  {/* Verify button for mutation responses */}
                  {testMethod !== 'GET' && (
                    <div className="verify-section">
                      <button className="btn btn-primary verify-btn" onClick={handleVerify} disabled={verifyLoading}>
                        <Eye size={14} /> {verifyLoading ? 'Verifying...' : 'Verify \u2014 View Updated Data'}
                      </button>
                      <span className="verify-hint">Runs a GET request to fetch the latest data from the table</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}

              {/* Verify result */}
              {verifyResult && (
                <div className="verify-result">
                  <h4><Check size={16} /> Verified Data ({verifyResult.row_count} rows, {verifyResult.execution_time_ms}ms)</h4>
                  {renderResultWithToggle(verifyResult, resultViewMode, setResultViewMode)}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Created APIs Tab ──────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'created' && (
        <div className="api-panel">
          <h3 className="panel-title"><List size={18} /> Created APIs ({customAPIs.length})</h3>
          <p className="panel-desc">All your saved API endpoints — persistent across restarts. Test, copy URLs, or manage.</p>

          {customAPIs.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 40, color: '#94a3b8' }}>
              <Layers size={48} style={{ marginBottom: 12, opacity: 0.3 }} />
              <p>No APIs created yet. Go to <strong>API Builder</strong> tab to create one.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="created-apis-list">
              {customAPIs.map((api) => (
                <div key={api.id} className="created-api-card">
                  <div className="created-api-header">
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <Database size={16} style={{ color: '#3b82f6', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                      <strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{api.name}</strong>
                      <span className="badge">{api.db_type}</span>
                      {api.auth_enabled && <span className="badge badge-yellow"><Lock size={10} /> Auth</span>}
                      {api.encryption_enabled && <span className="badge badge-blue"><Shield size={10} /> Encrypted</span>}
                      {api.enable_crud && <span className="badge badge-green">CRUD</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => handleEditAPI(api)} title="Edit">
                        <Settings size={12} /> Edit
                      </button>
                      <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => openMetrics(api)} title="View Metrics" style={{ color: '#8b5cf6', borderColor: '#8b5cf6' }}>
                        <BarChart3 size={12} /> Metrics
                      </button>
                      <button className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={() => { setTestApiId(api.id); setActiveTab('tester'); }} title="Test in Tester">
                        <Play size={12} /> Test
                      </button>
                      <button className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => handleDeleteAPI(api.id)} title="Delete">
                        <Trash2 size={12} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {api.description && (
                    <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', margin: '6px 0 0', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{api.description}</p>
                  )}

                  <div className="created-api-details">
                    <div className="created-api-detail-row">
                      <span className="detail-label">Table:</span>
                      <span className="detail-value">{api.database}.{api.base_table}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="created-api-detail-row">
                      <span className="detail-label">Internal URL:</span>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <code className="detail-url">{BASE_URL}/api/builder/apis/{api.id}/execute</code>
                        <button className="btn-icon-sm" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(`${BASE_URL}/api/builder/apis/${api.id}/execute`)} title="Copy">
                          <Copy size={11} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {api.public_alias && (
                      <div className="created-api-detail-row public-url-row">
                        <span className="detail-label"><Globe size={11} /> Public URL:</span>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <code className="detail-url public">{BASE_URL}/api/data/{api.public_alias}</code>
                          <button className="btn-icon-sm" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(`${BASE_URL}/api/data/${api.public_alias}`)} title="Copy Public URL">
                            <Copy size={11} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {!api.public_alias && (
                      <div className="created-api-detail-row">
                        <span className="detail-label"><Globe size={11} /> Public URL:</span>
                        <button className="btn btn-xs btn-outline" onClick={() => handleEditAPI(api)} style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '2px 8px' }}>
                          + Set Alias
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="created-api-meta">
                    <span>ID: {api.id}</span>
                    <span>Limit: {api.default_limit}</span>
                    {api.relationships?.length > 0 && <span>{api.relationships.length} join(s)</span>}
                    {api.function_layers?.length > 0 && <span>{api.function_layers.length} layer(s)</span>}
                    <span>Created: {api.created_at ? new Date(api.created_at).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ═══════════  API METRICS MODAL  ═══════════════════════════════════ */}
      {metricsOpen && (
        <div className="metrics-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setMetricsOpen(false)}>
          <div className="metrics-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="metrics-modal-header">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                <BarChart3 size={22} style={{ color: '#3b82f6' }} />
                <div>
                  <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, color: '#1e293b' }}>API Metrics</h2>
                  <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8' }}>{metricsApiName}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button className="btn-icon" onClick={() => setMetricsOpen(false)}><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>

            {/* Date Filter Bar */}
            <div className="metrics-filter-bar">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flex: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <Calendar size={14} style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                <input type="date" value={metricsDateFrom} onChange={(e) => setMetricsDateFrom(e.target.value)}
                  className="metrics-date-input" placeholder="From" />
                <span style={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: 12 }}>to</span>
                <input type="date" value={metricsDateTo} onChange={(e) => setMetricsDateTo(e.target.value)}
                  className="metrics-date-input" placeholder="To" />
                <button className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={handleMetricsFilter}
                  style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 12px' }}>
                  <Filter size={12} /> Apply
                </button>
                {(metricsDateFrom || metricsDateTo) && (
                  <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={handleMetricsClear}
                    style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 12px' }}>
                    <XCircle size={12} /> Clear
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              {/* Tab toggles */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                {[
                  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: Activity },
                  { id: 'hits', label: 'Hit Log', icon: Clock },
                  { id: 'callers', label: 'Callers', icon: Users },
                ].map((t) => (
                  <button key={t.id}
                    className={`btn btn-sm ${metricsTab === t.id ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'}`}
                    style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px' }}
                    onClick={() => setMetricsTab(t.id)}
                  >
                    <t.icon size={12} /> {t.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Content */}
            <div className="metrics-modal-body">
              {metricsLoading ? (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60, color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  <RefreshCw size={32} className="spin" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
                  <p>Loading metrics...</p>
                </div>
              ) : !metricsSummary ? (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60, color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  <Activity size={48} style={{ marginBottom: 12, opacity: 0.3 }} />
                  <p>No metrics data available</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {/* ─── OVERVIEW TAB ────────────────────────────── */}
                  {metricsTab === 'overview' && (
                    <div className="metrics-overview">
                      {/* Summary Cards */}
                      <div className="metrics-cards-grid">
                        <div className="metric-card">
                          <div className="metric-card-icon" style={{ background: '#3b82f620', color: '#3b82f6' }}><Activity size={20} /></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-value">{metricsSummary.summary?.total_hits || 0}</div>
                          <div className="metric-card-label">Total Hits</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="metric-card">
                          <div className="metric-card-icon" style={{ background: '#10b98120', color: '#10b981' }}><Users size={20} /></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-value">{metricsSummary.summary?.unique_callers || 0}</div>
                          <div className="metric-card-label">Unique Callers</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="metric-card">
                          <div className="metric-card-icon" style={{ background: '#f59e0b20', color: '#f59e0b' }}><Clock size={20} /></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-value">{metricsSummary.summary?.avg_response_ms || 0}<span className="metric-card-unit">ms</span></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-label">Avg Response Time</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="metric-card">
                          <div className="metric-card-icon" style={{ background: '#8b5cf620', color: '#8b5cf6' }}><TrendingUp size={20} /></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-value">{metricsSummary.summary?.total_rows_served || 0}</div>
                          <div className="metric-card-label">Total Rows Served</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="metric-card">
                          <div className="metric-card-icon" style={{ background: '#10b98120', color: '#10b981' }}><Check size={20} /></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-value">{metricsSummary.summary?.success_count || 0}</div>
                          <div className="metric-card-label">Success (2xx)</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="metric-card">
                          <div className="metric-card-icon" style={{ background: '#ef444420', color: '#ef4444' }}><AlertCircle size={20} /></div>
                          <div className="metric-card-value">{metricsSummary.summary?.error_count || 0}</div>
                          <div className="metric-card-label">Errors (4xx/5xx)</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Response Time Stats */}
                      <div className="metrics-section">
                        <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 10, fontSize: 14 }}><Clock size={14} /> Response Time Breakdown</h4>
                        <div className="metrics-time-grid">
                          <div className="metric-time-item"><span className="metric-time-label">Min</span><span className="metric-time-val">{metricsSummary.summary?.min_response_ms || 0} ms</span></div>
                          <div className="metric-time-item"><span className="metric-time-label">P50</span><span className="metric-time-val">{metricsSummary.summary?.p50_response_ms || 0} ms</span></div>
                          <div className="metric-time-item"><span className="metric-time-label">Avg</span><span className="metric-time-val highlight">{metricsSummary.summary?.avg_response_ms || 0} ms</span></div>
                          <div className="metric-time-item"><span className="metric-time-label">P95</span><span className="metric-time-val">{metricsSummary.summary?.p95_response_ms || 0} ms</span></div>
                          <div className="metric-time-item"><span className="metric-time-label">Max</span><span className="metric-time-val">{metricsSummary.summary?.max_response_ms || 0} ms</span></div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Daily Hits Chart */}
                      {metricsSummary.daily && metricsSummary.daily.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="metrics-section">
                          <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 10, fontSize: 14 }}><BarChart3 size={14} /> Daily Hits</h4>
                          <div className="metrics-chart">
                            {(() => {
                              const maxHits = Math.max(...metricsSummary.daily.map(d => d.hits), 1);
                              return metricsSummary.daily.map((d, i) => (
                                <div key={i} className="chart-bar-wrapper" title={`${d.day}: ${d.hits} hits, avg ${d.avg_ms}ms`}>
                                  <div className="chart-bar"
                                    style={{ height: `${Math.max((d.hits / maxHits) * 100, 4)}%` }}
                                  >
                                    <span className="chart-bar-value">{d.hits}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  <span className="chart-bar-label">{d.day?.slice(5) || ''}</span>
                                </div>
                              ));
                            })()}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Hourly Usage Pattern */}
                      {metricsSummary.by_hour && metricsSummary.by_hour.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="metrics-section">
                          <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 10, fontSize: 14 }}><Clock size={14} /> Hourly Usage Pattern</h4>
                          <div className="metrics-chart hourly">
                            {(() => {
                              const maxH = Math.max(...metricsSummary.by_hour.map(h => h.hits), 1);
                              const hours = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => {
                                const found = metricsSummary.by_hour.find(h => h.hour === i);
                                return { hour: i, hits: found ? found.hits : 0 };
                              });
                              return hours.map((h) => (
                                <div key={h.hour} className="chart-bar-wrapper hourly" title={`${h.hour}:00 — ${h.hits} hits`}>
                                  <div className="chart-bar hourly"
                                    style={{ height: `${Math.max((h.hits / maxH) * 100, 2)}%`,
                                             background: h.hits > 0 ? '#3b82f6' : '#1e293b' }}
                                  />
                                  <span className="chart-bar-label hourly">{h.hour}</span>
                                </div>
                              ));
                            })()}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Method breakdown + Status codes side-by-side */}
                      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16 }}>
                        {metricsSummary.by_method && metricsSummary.by_method.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="metrics-section">
                            <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 8, fontSize: 14 }}>By Method</h4>
                            {metricsSummary.by_method.map((m, i) => (
                              <div key={i} className="metrics-breakdown-row">
                                <span className={`badge method-${m.method?.toLowerCase()}`}>{m.method}</span>
                                <div className="metrics-breakdown-bar-wrapper">
                                  <div className="metrics-breakdown-bar" style={{ width: `${(m.hits / (metricsSummary.summary?.total_hits || 1)) * 100}%` }} />
                                </div>
                                <span className="metrics-breakdown-count">{m.hits}</span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {metricsSummary.by_status && metricsSummary.by_status.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="metrics-section">
                            <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 8, fontSize: 14 }}>By Status Code</h4>
                            {metricsSummary.by_status.map((s, i) => (
                              <div key={i} className="metrics-breakdown-row">
                                <span className={`badge ${s.status_code >= 200 && s.status_code < 300 ? 'badge-green' : s.status_code >= 400 ? 'badge-red' : ''}`}>{s.status_code}</span>
                                <div className="metrics-breakdown-bar-wrapper">
                                  <div className="metrics-breakdown-bar" style={{ width: `${(s.hits / (metricsSummary.summary?.total_hits || 1)) * 100}%`, background: s.status_code >= 400 ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981' }} />
                                </div>
                                <span className="metrics-breakdown-count">{s.hits}</span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* First / Last Hit */}
                      <div className="metrics-section" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 20, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                        <div><span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12 }}>First Hit:</span> <span style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{metricsSummary.summary?.first_hit ? new Date(metricsSummary.summary.first_hit).toLocaleString() : 'N/A'}</span></div>
                        <div><span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12 }}>Last Hit:</span> <span style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{metricsSummary.summary?.last_hit ? new Date(metricsSummary.summary.last_hit).toLocaleString() : 'N/A'}</span></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* ─── HITS LOG TAB ───────────────────────────── */}
                  {metricsTab === 'hits' && (
                    <div className="metrics-hits">
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
                        <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 12 }}>Showing {metricsHits.length} of {metricsHitsTotal} hits</span>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={metricsHitsPage === 0}
                            onClick={() => handleMetricsPageChange(metricsHitsPage - 1)} style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '3px 8px' }}>
                            ← Prev
                          </button>
                          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 8px' }}>Page {metricsHitsPage + 1}</span>
                          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline"
                            disabled={(metricsHitsPage + 1) * 100 >= metricsHitsTotal}
                            onClick={() => handleMetricsPageChange(metricsHitsPage + 1)} style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '3px 8px' }}>
                            Next →
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="metrics-table-wrapper">
                        <table className="metrics-table">
                          <thead>
                            <tr>
                              <th>Timestamp</th>
                              <th>Method</th>
                              <th>Status</th>
                              <th>Time (ms)</th>
                              <th>Rows</th>
                              <th>Caller IP</th>
                              <th>User Agent</th>
                              <th>Error</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            {metricsHits.length === 0 ? (
                              <tr><td colSpan={8} style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#64748b', padding: 30 }}>No hits recorded</td></tr>
                            ) : metricsHits.map((h, i) => (
                              <tr key={h.id || i} className={h.status_code >= 400 ? 'error-row' : ''}>
                                <td className="mono">{h.hit_timestamp ? new Date(h.hit_timestamp).toLocaleString() : ''}</td>
                                <td><span className={`badge method-${h.method?.toLowerCase()}`}>{h.method}</span></td>
                                <td><span className={`badge ${h.status_code >= 200 && h.status_code < 300 ? 'badge-green' : 'badge-red'}`}>{h.status_code}</span></td>
                                <td className="mono">{h.response_time_ms}</td>
                                <td>{h.row_count}</td>
                                <td className="mono">{h.caller_ip}</td>
                                <td className="ua-cell" title={h.user_agent}>{h.user_agent?.slice(0, 50)}{h.user_agent?.length > 50 ? '…' : ''}</td>
                                <td className="error-cell">{h.error_message || '—'}</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* ─── CALLERS TAB ────────────────────────────── */}
                  {metricsTab === 'callers' && (
                    <div className="metrics-callers">
                      {/* Top Callers */}
                      <div className="metrics-section">
                        <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 10, fontSize: 14 }}><Users size={14} /> Top Callers by IP</h4>
                        <div className="metrics-table-wrapper">
                          <table className="metrics-table">
                            <thead>
                              <tr><th>Caller IP</th><th>Hits</th><th>Last Seen</th><th>Share</th></tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                              {(metricsSummary.top_callers || []).map((c, i) => (
                                <tr key={i}>
                                  <td className="mono">{c.caller_ip || '(unknown)'}</td>
                                  <td><strong>{c.hits}</strong></td>
                                  <td className="mono">{c.last_seen ? new Date(c.last_seen).toLocaleString() : ''}</td>
                                  <td>
                                    <div className="metrics-breakdown-bar-wrapper" style={{ width: 100 }}>
                                      <div className="metrics-breakdown-bar" style={{ width: `${(c.hits / (metricsSummary.summary?.total_hits || 1)) * 100}%` }} />
                                    </div>
                                  </td>
                                </tr>
                              ))}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Top User Agents */}
                      <div className="metrics-section">
                        <h4 style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: 10, fontSize: 14 }}><Globe size={14} /> Top User Agents</h4>
                        <div className="metrics-table-wrapper">
                          <table className="metrics-table">
                            <thead>
                              <tr><th>User Agent</th><th>Hits</th></tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                              {(metricsSummary.top_agents || []).map((a, i) => (
                                <tr key={i}>
                                  <td className="ua-cell" title={a.user_agent}>{a.user_agent?.slice(0, 80) || '(empty)'}{a.user_agent?.length > 80 ? '…' : ''}</td>
                                  <td><strong>{a.hits}</strong></td>
                                </tr>
                              ))}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/AITrainingDashboard.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Brain, Search, RefreshCw, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Trash2, Edit3, Save,
  X, Check, AlertTriangle, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, Filter, Download,
  ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight, BookOpen, Plus, Database,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './AITrainingDashboard.css';

export default function AITrainingDashboard() {
  // ── Training examples state ────────────────────────────────────────
  const [examples, setExamples] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(50);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({});
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [feedbackFilter, setFeedbackFilter] = useState('');
  const [editedFilter, setEditedFilter] = useState('');
  const [dbFilter, setDbFilter] = useState('');
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const [editData, setEditData] = useState({});

  // ── Glossary state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('training'); // 'training' | 'glossary'
  const [glossary, setGlossary] = useState([]);
  const [glossaryLoading, setGlossaryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [newTerm, setNewTerm] = useState({ term: '', definition: '', sql_expression: '', database: '*' });
  const [showAddTerm, setShowAddTerm] = useState(false);

  // ── Debounce search ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { setSearchQuery(searchInput); setPage(1); }, 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchInput]);

  useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [feedbackFilter, editedFilter, dbFilter, pageSize]);

  // ── Load training data ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadTraining = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = { page, page_size: pageSize };
      if (searchQuery) params.search = searchQuery;
      if (feedbackFilter) params.feedback = feedbackFilter;
      if (editedFilter) params.was_edited = editedFilter;
      if (dbFilter) params.database = dbFilter;
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getTrainingData(params);
      const data = res.data;
      setExamples(data.examples || []);
      setTotal(data.total || 0);
      setTotalPages(data.total_pages || 1);
      setStats(data.stats || {});
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load training data');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [page, pageSize, searchQuery, feedbackFilter, editedFilter, dbFilter]);

  useEffect(() => { loadTraining(); }, [loadTraining]);

  // ── Load glossary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadGlossary = async () => {
    setGlossaryLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getGlossary('', 'default');
      setGlossary(res.data?.glossary || []);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load glossary'); }
    setGlossaryLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { if (activeTab === 'glossary') loadGlossary(); }, [activeTab]);

  // ── Training actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleEdit = (ex) => {
    setEditingId(ex.id);
    setEditData({ nl_question: ex.nl_question, edited_sql: ex.edited_sql || ex.generated_sql, feedback: ex.feedback });
  };

  const handleSave = async (id) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.updateTrainingExample(id, editData);
      toast.success('Example updated');
      setEditingId(null);
      loadTraining();
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to update'); }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this training example?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteTrainingExample(id);
      toast.success('Example deleted');
      loadTraining();
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to delete'); }
  };

  const handleMarkGood = async (id) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.updateTrainingExample(id, { feedback: 'good' });
      toast.success('Marked as good');
      loadTraining();
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to update'); }
  };

  // ── Glossary actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleAddTerm = async () => {
    if (!newTerm.term || !newTerm.definition) { toast.error('Term and definition required'); return; }
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.addGlossaryTerm({
        term: newTerm.term,
        definition: newTerm.definition,
        sql_expression: newTerm.sql_expression,
        database: newTerm.database || '*',
        server_id: 'default',
      });
      toast.success(`Term "${newTerm.term}" added`);
      setNewTerm({ term: '', definition: '', sql_expression: '', database: '*' });
      setShowAddTerm(false);
      loadGlossary();
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to add term'); }
  };

  const handleDeleteTerm = async (id) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this glossary term?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteGlossaryTerm(id);
      toast.success('Term deleted');
      loadGlossary();
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to delete term'); }
  };

  // ── Export training data ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const exportTraining = () => {
    const headers = ['ID', 'User', 'Database', 'Question', 'Generated SQL', 'Edited SQL', 'Feedback', 'Was Edited', 'Created'];
    const rows = examples.map(e => [
      e.id, e.user_id, e.database_name, `"${(e.nl_question || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${(e.generated_sql || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`, `"${(e.edited_sql || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      e.feedback, e.was_edited, e.created_at,
    ]);
    const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = `ai_training_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
    a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast.success('Exported training data');
  };

  const goToPage = (p) => setPage(Math.max(1, Math.min(p, totalPages)));
  const hasFilters = searchQuery || feedbackFilter || editedFilter || dbFilter;

  return (
    <div className="ai-training-dashboard">
      {/* ── Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="aitd-header">
        <div className="aitd-title">
          <Brain size={22} />
          <h2>AI Training Dashboard</h2>
        </div>
        <div className="aitd-tabs">
          <button className={`aitd-tab ${activeTab === 'training' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setActiveTab('training')}>
            <Brain size={14} /> Training Examples
          </button>
          <button className={`aitd-tab ${activeTab === 'glossary' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setActiveTab('glossary')}>
            <BookOpen size={14} /> Business Glossary
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ════════════ TRAINING TAB ════════════ */}
      {activeTab === 'training' && (
        <>
          {/* Stats Cards */}
          <div className="aitd-stats">
            <div className="aitd-stat"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{(stats.total || 0).toLocaleString()}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">Total</span></div>
            <div className="aitd-stat good"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{stats.good || 0}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">Good</span></div>
            <div className="aitd-stat edited"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{stats.edited || 0}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">Edited</span></div>
            <div className="aitd-stat bad"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{stats.bad || 0}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">Bad</span></div>
            <div className="aitd-stat corrected"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{stats.user_corrected || 0}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">User Corrected</span></div>
            <div className="aitd-stat"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{stats.unique_users || 0}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">Users</span></div>
            <div className="aitd-stat"><span className="aitd-stat-val">{stats.unique_databases || 0}</span><span className="aitd-stat-label">Databases</span></div>
          </div>

          {/* Controls */}
          <div className="aitd-controls">
            <div className="aitd-search">
              <Search size={14} />
              <input placeholder="Search questions, SQL..." value={searchInput} onChange={e => setSearchInput(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <select value={feedbackFilter} onChange={e => setFeedbackFilter(e.target.value)} className="aitd-select">
              <option value="">All Feedback</option>
              <option value="good">Good</option>
              <option value="edited">Edited</option>
              <option value="bad">Bad</option>
            </select>
            <select value={editedFilter} onChange={e => setEditedFilter(e.target.value)} className="aitd-select">
              <option value="">All Types</option>
              <option value="true">User Corrected</option>
              <option value="false">AI Generated</option>
            </select>
            <select value={pageSize} onChange={e => setPageSize(Number(e.target.value))} className="aitd-select" style={{ width: 75 }}>
              <option value={25}>25</option>
              <option value={50}>50</option>
              <option value={100}>100</option>
            </select>
            {hasFilters && (
              <button className="aitd-btn aitd-btn-clear" onClick={() => { setSearchInput(''); setFeedbackFilter(''); setEditedFilter(''); setDbFilter(''); }}>
                <X size={12} /> Clear
              </button>
            )}
            <button className="aitd-btn" onClick={loadTraining} disabled={loading}>
              <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? 'spin' : ''} /> Refresh
            </button>
            <button className="aitd-btn" onClick={exportTraining}>
              <Download size={14} /> Export
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Table */}
          <div className="aitd-table-container">
            <div className="aitd-table-scroll">
              <table className="aitd-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th style={{ width: 40 }}>#</th>
                    <th style={{ width: 80 }}>User</th>
                    <th style={{ width: 90 }}>Database</th>
                    <th style={{ minWidth: 200 }}>Question</th>
                    <th style={{ minWidth: 200 }}>SQL</th>
                    <th style={{ width: 80 }}>Feedback</th>
                    <th style={{ width: 65 }}>Edited</th>
                    <th style={{ width: 130 }}>Date</th>
                    <th style={{ width: 100 }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {examples.map(ex => (
                    <tr key={ex.id} className={`aitd-row ${ex.was_edited ? 'row-edited' : ''} ${ex.feedback === 'good' ? 'row-good' : ''} ${ex.feedback === 'bad' ? 'row-bad' : ''}`}>
                      <td className="aitd-id">{ex.id}</td>
                      <td className="aitd-user">{ex.user_id || '-'}</td>
                      <td className="aitd-db">{ex.database_name || '-'}</td>
                      <td className="aitd-question">
                        {editingId === ex.id ? (
                          <textarea value={editData.nl_question} onChange={e => setEditData(d => ({ ...d, nl_question: e.target.value }))} rows={2} className="aitd-edit-input" />
                        ) : (
                          <span title={ex.nl_question}>{ex.nl_question}</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="aitd-sql">
                        {editingId === ex.id ? (
                          <textarea value={editData.edited_sql} onChange={e => setEditData(d => ({ ...d, edited_sql: e.target.value }))} rows={3} className="aitd-edit-input aitd-edit-sql" />
                        ) : (
                          <pre title={ex.edited_sql || ex.generated_sql}>
                            {ex.was_edited && ex.edited_sql ? (
                              <><span className="aitd-corrected-badge">corrected</span>{ex.edited_sql.slice(0, 120)}</>
                            ) : (
                              (ex.generated_sql || '').slice(0, 120)
                            )}
                            {(ex.edited_sql || ex.generated_sql || '').length > 120 ? '…' : ''}
                          </pre>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {ex.feedback ? (
                          <span className={`aitd-feedback-badge fb-${ex.feedback}`}>{ex.feedback}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="aitd-feedback-badge fb-none">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>{ex.was_edited ? <Check size={14} className="aitd-check" /> : '—'}</td>
                      <td className="aitd-date">{ex.created_at ? new Date(ex.created_at).toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                      <td className="aitd-actions">
                        {editingId === ex.id ? (
                          <>
                            <button className="aitd-action-btn save" onClick={() => handleSave(ex.id)} title="Save"><Save size={13} /></button>
                            <button className="aitd-action-btn" onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} title="Cancel"><X size={13} /></button>
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <button className="aitd-action-btn" onClick={() => handleEdit(ex)} title="Edit"><Edit3 size={13} /></button>
                            <button className="aitd-action-btn good" onClick={() => handleMarkGood(ex.id)} title="Mark as good"><ThumbsUp size={13} /></button>
                            <button className="aitd-action-btn danger" onClick={() => handleDelete(ex.id)} title="Delete"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {examples.length === 0 && !loading && (
                    <tr><td colSpan={9} className="aitd-empty">No training examples found</td></tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination */}
            {totalPages > 1 && (
              <div className="aitd-pagination">
                <span className="aitd-page-info">Page {page} of {totalPages} ({total.toLocaleString()} total)</span>
                <div className="aitd-page-buttons">
                  <button className="aitd-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(1)} disabled={page === 1}><ChevronsLeft size={14} /></button>
                  <button className="aitd-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(page - 1)} disabled={page === 1}><ChevronLeft size={14} /></button>
                  <span className="aitd-page-current">{page}</span>
                  <button className="aitd-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(page + 1)} disabled={page === totalPages}><ChevronRight size={14} /></button>
                  <button className="aitd-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(totalPages)} disabled={page === totalPages}><ChevronsRight size={14} /></button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* ════════════ GLOSSARY TAB ════════════ */}
      {activeTab === 'glossary' && (
        <div className="aitd-glossary">
          <div className="aitd-glossary-header">
            <h3><BookOpen size={16} /> Business Glossary</h3>
            <p className="aitd-glossary-desc">Define business terms so the AI generates more accurate SQL. Terms are automatically injected into the AI prompt.</p>
            <button className="aitd-btn aitd-btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowAddTerm(true)}>
              <Plus size={14} /> Add Term
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Add Term Form */}
          {showAddTerm && (
            <div className="aitd-add-term">
              <div className="aitd-add-term-row">
                <input placeholder="Term (e.g., revenue)" value={newTerm.term} onChange={e => setNewTerm(t => ({ ...t, term: e.target.value }))} className="aitd-input" />
                <input placeholder="Database (* = all)" value={newTerm.database} onChange={e => setNewTerm(t => ({ ...t, database: e.target.value }))} className="aitd-input" style={{ width: 140 }} />
              </div>
              <input placeholder='Definition (e.g., "total_amount minus refunds")' value={newTerm.definition} onChange={e => setNewTerm(t => ({ ...t, definition: e.target.value }))} className="aitd-input" />
              <input placeholder='SQL expression (e.g., total_amount - refund_amount)' value={newTerm.sql_expression} onChange={e => setNewTerm(t => ({ ...t, sql_expression: e.target.value }))} className="aitd-input" />
              <div className="aitd-add-term-actions">
                <button className="aitd-btn aitd-btn-primary" onClick={handleAddTerm}><Save size={14} /> Save</button>
                <button className="aitd-btn" onClick={() => setShowAddTerm(false)}><X size={14} /> Cancel</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Glossary Table */}
          {glossaryLoading ? (
            <div className="aitd-loading"><RefreshCw size={16} className="spin" /> Loading glossary...</div>
          ) : glossary.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="aitd-glossary-empty">
              <BookOpen size={32} />
              <p>No business terms defined yet.</p>
              <p className="aitd-hint">Add terms like "revenue", "active user", "churn rate" with their SQL definitions.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="aitd-glossary-list">
              {glossary.map(g => (
                <div key={g.id} className="aitd-glossary-card">
                  <div className="aitd-glossary-card-header">
                    <span className="aitd-glossary-term">{g.term}</span>
                    <span className="aitd-glossary-db"><Database size={10} /> {g.database_name === '*' ? 'All databases' : g.database_name}</span>
                    <button className="aitd-action-btn danger" onClick={() => handleDeleteTerm(g.id)} title="Delete"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="aitd-glossary-def">{g.definition}</div>
                  {g.sql_expression && <div className="aitd-glossary-sql"><code>{g.sql_expression}</code></div>}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

}

  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1e293b;
}
.aitd-stat-label {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}
.aitd-stat.good { border-left: 3px solid #22c55e; }
.aitd-stat.good .aitd-stat-val { color: #16a34a; }

  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 200px;
  max-width: 320px;
}

  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  flex: 1;

}

  padding: 6px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #475569;
  background: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.aitd-btn {
  display: flex;
