src/components/steps/TransformStep.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { Plus, Trash2, ChevronUp, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';

// ── Operation type definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
const OP_TYPES = [
  { value: 'filter',     label: 'Filter rows' },
  { value: 'rename',     label: 'Rename field' },
  { value: 'add_field',  label: 'Add / compute field' },
  { value: 'remove_field', label: 'Remove field' },
  { value: 'sort',       label: 'Sort' },
  { value: 'limit',      label: 'Limit rows' },
  { value: 'offset',     label: 'Offset rows' },
  { value: 'unique',     label: 'Unique / dedupe' },
  { value: 'group_by',   label: 'Group By & Aggregate' },
  { value: 'pick_fields', label: 'Pick fields' },
];

const FILTER_OPERATORS = ['==', '!=', '>', '<', '>=', '<=', 'contains', 'starts_with', 'ends_with', 'is_empty', 'is_not_empty'];
const AGG_FUNCS = ['count', 'sum', 'avg', 'min', 'max'];

// ── Individual operation config UI ────────────────────────────────────
function OperationFields({ op, onChange }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...op, [key]: value });
  }

  switch (op.type) {
    case 'filter':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-row" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 80 }}>
            <label className="lfb-label">Field</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 130, flex: 'none' }}>
            <label className="lfb-label">Operator</label>
            <select className="lfb-select" value={op.operator || '=='} onChange={(e) => set('operator', e.target.value)} style={{ width: '100%' }}>
              {FILTER_OPERATORS.map((o) => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          {!['is_empty', 'is_not_empty'].includes(op.operator) && (
            <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 80 }}>
              <label className="lfb-label">Value</label>
              <input className="lfb-input" value={op.value || ''} onChange={(e) => set('value', e.target.value)} placeholder="value or {{var}}" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );

    case 'rename':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-row">
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">From</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.from || ''} onChange={(e) => set('from', e.target.value)} placeholder="old_name" />
          </div>
          <div style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-end', paddingBottom: 6, color: '#64748b' }}>→</div>
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">To</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.to || ''} onChange={(e) => set('to', e.target.value)} placeholder="new_name" />
          </div>
        </div>
      );

    case 'add_field':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-row">
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">New Field Name</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">Value / Expression</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.value || ''} onChange={(e) => set('value', e.target.value)} placeholder="{{item.price}} * 1.1" />
          </div>
        </div>
      );

    case 'remove_field':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Field to Remove</label>
          <input className="lfb-input" value={op.field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name" />
        </div>
      );

    case 'sort':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-row">
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">Sort Field</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 100, flex: 'none' }}>
            <label className="lfb-label">Direction</label>
            <select className="lfb-select" value={op.direction || 'asc'} onChange={(e) => set('direction', e.target.value)} style={{ width: '100%' }}>
              <option value="asc">ASC</option>
              <option value="desc">DESC</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      );

    case 'limit':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Count</label>
          <input className="lfb-input" type="number" min="1" value={op.count || ''} onChange={(e) => set('count', parseInt(e.target.value) || '')} placeholder="10" />
        </div>
      );

    case 'offset':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Offset Count</label>
          <input className="lfb-input" type="number" min="0" value={op.count || ''} onChange={(e) => set('count', parseInt(e.target.value) || '')} placeholder="0" />
        </div>
      );

    case 'unique':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Unique By Field</label>
          <input className="lfb-input" value={op.field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name (leave blank for all fields)" />
        </div>
      );

    case 'group_by':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-row" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">Group By Field</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="lfb-field-group">
            <label className="lfb-label">Aggregate Field</label>
            <input className="lfb-input" value={op.agg_field || ''} onChange={(e) => set('agg_field', e.target.value)} placeholder="field_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 90, flex: 'none' }}>
            <label className="lfb-label">Function</label>
            <select className="lfb-select" value={op.agg_func || 'count'} onChange={(e) => set('agg_func', e.target.value)} style={{ width: '100%' }}>
              {AGG_FUNCS.map((f) => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      );

    case 'pick_fields':
      return (
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Fields (comma-separated)</label>
          <input className="lfb-input" value={op.fields || ''} onChange={(e) => set('fields', e.target.value)} placeholder="id, name, email" />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Only these fields will appear in the output</span>
        </div>
      );

    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ── TransformStep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig)
export default function TransformStep({ config = {}, onChange }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  function addOperation() {
    const ops = config.operations || [];
    set('operations', [...ops, { id: 'op' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5), type: 'filter', field: '', operator: '==', value: '' }]);
  }

  function updateOperation(index, updated) {
    const ops = (config.operations || []).map((op, i) => (i === index ? updated : op));
    set('operations', ops);
  }

  function removeOperation(index) {
    const ops = (config.operations || []).filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    set('operations', ops);
  }

  function moveOperation(index, direction) {
    const ops = [...(config.operations || [])];
    const target = index + direction;
    if (target < 0 || target >= ops.length) return;
    [ops[index], ops[target]] = [ops[target], ops[index]];
    set('operations', ops);
  }

  const operations = config.operations || [];

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Source + Bind row */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Source Variable</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="result"
            value={config.source || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('source', e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Bind Result To</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="result"
            value={config.bind_result_to || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('bind_result_to', e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="lfb-divider" />

      {/* Operations list */}
      <label className="lfb-label" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
        Operations ({operations.length})
      </label>

      {operations.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          No operations yet. Add one below.
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="lfb-ops-list">
        {operations.map((op, index) => (
          <div key={op.id || index} className="lfb-op-item">
            <div className="lfb-op-header">
              <select
                className="lfb-select"
                value={op.type || 'filter'}
                onChange={(e) => updateOperation(index, { ...op, type: e.target.value })}
                style={{ fontSize: 12 }}
              >
                {OP_TYPES.map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>
                    {t.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <div className="lfb-op-controls">
                <button
                  className="lfb-icon-btn"
                  onClick={() => moveOperation(index, -1)}
                  disabled={index === 0}
                  title="Move up"
                  type="button"
                >
                  <ChevronUp size={13} />
                </button>
                <button
                  className="lfb-icon-btn"
                  onClick={() => moveOperation(index, 1)}
                  disabled={index === operations.length - 1}
                  title="Move down"
                  type="button"
                >
                  <ChevronDown size={13} />
                </button>
                <button
                  className="lfb-icon-btn danger"
                  onClick={() => removeOperation(index)}
                  title="Remove operation"
                  type="button"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={12} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <OperationFields op={op} onChange={(updated) => updateOperation(index, updated)} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <button className="lfb-kv-add-btn" type="button" onClick={addOperation}>
        <Plus size={12} />
        Add Operation
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}




src/components/steps/SQLQueryStep.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Database, Table2, ChevronDown, RefreshCw, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import apiClient from '../../services/api';

// ── SQLQueryStep ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig)
export default function SQLQueryStep({ config = {}, onChange }) {
  const [databases, setDatabases]   = useState([]);
  const [tables, setTables]         = useState([]);
  const [loadingDbs, setLoadingDbs] = useState(false);
  const [loadingTbls, setLoadingTbls] = useState(false);
  const [dbOpen, setDbOpen]         = useState(false);
  const [tblOpen, setTblOpen]       = useState(false);
  const [servers, setServers]       = useState([]);

  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  const dbType   = config.db_type  || 'cloudsql';
  const database = config.database || '';

  // Load servers list for mssql dropdown
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dbType === 'mssql') {
      apiClient.get('/api/servers')
        .then((r) => setServers(r.data.servers || []))
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [dbType]);

  // Load databases
  async function loadDatabases() {
    setLoadingDbs(true);
    setDatabases([]);
    try {
      if (dbType === 'mssql' && config.server_id) {
        const r = await apiClient.get(`/api/servers/${config.server_id}/databases`);
        setDatabases((r.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name || d));
      } else {
        const r = await apiClient.get('/api/databases', { params: { type: dbType } });
        setDatabases((r.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name || d));
      }
    } catch { /* silent */ }
    finally { setLoadingDbs(false); }
  }

  // Load tables when database changes
  async function loadTables(db) {
    if (!db || db.startsWith('{{')) { setTables([]); return; }
    setLoadingTbls(true);
    setTables([]);
    try {
      if (dbType === 'mssql' && config.server_id) {
        const r = await apiClient.get(`/api/servers/${config.server_id}/databases/${db}/tables`);
        setTables((r.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name || t));
      } else {
        const r = await apiClient.get('/api/tables', { params: { database: db, type: dbType } });
        setTables((r.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name || t));
      }
    } catch { /* silent */ }
    finally { setLoadingTbls(false); }
  }

  // Click a table → insert SELECT snippet into query
  function insertTableQuery(tableName) {
    const snippet = `SELECT * FROM ${tableName} LIMIT 100`;
    set('query', config.query ? config.query + '\n' + snippet : snippet);
    setTblOpen(false);
  }

  // Click a db → set it + load tables
  function selectDatabase(db) {
    set('database', db);
    setDbOpen(false);
    loadTables(db);
  }

  const showServerId = dbType === 'mssql';

  return (
    <div>
      {/* DB Type + Server */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 150, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Database Type</label>
          <select
            className="lfb-select"
            value={dbType}
            onChange={(e) => { set('db_type', e.target.value); setDatabases([]); setTables([]); }}
            style={{ width: '100%' }}
          >
            <option value="cloudsql">Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)</option>
            <option value="mssql">MS SQL Server</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {showServerId && (
          <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <label className="lfb-label">Server</label>
            {servers.length > 0 ? (
              <select
                className="lfb-select"
                value={config.server_id || ''}
                onChange={(e) => set('server_id', e.target.value)}
                style={{ width: '100%' }}
              >
                <option value="">— pick server —</option>
                {servers.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name || s.host}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            ) : (
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder="server-id"
                value={config.server_id || ''}
                onChange={(e) => set('server_id', e.target.value)}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Database picker */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
          <span><Database size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 4 }} />Database</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
            style={{ padding: '1px 6px', fontSize: 10 }}
            onClick={() => { loadDatabases(); setDbOpen((v) => !v); }}
            title="Browse databases"
          >
            {loadingDbs ? <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 10, height: 10 }} /> : <ChevronDown size={10} />}
            Browse
          </button>
        </label>
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="my_database or {{params.database}}"
          value={database}
          onChange={(e) => { set('database', e.target.value); if (e.target.value && !e.target.value.startsWith('{{')) loadTables(e.target.value); }}
        />
        {/* DB dropdown list */}
        {dbOpen && databases.length > 0 && (
          <div className="lfb-picker-dropdown">
            {databases.map((db) => (
              <div key={db} className="lfb-picker-item" onClick={() => selectDatabase(db)}>
                <Database size={11} style={{ marginRight: 6, opacity: 0.6 }} />
                {db}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        {dbOpen && !loadingDbs && databases.length === 0 && (
          <div className="lfb-picker-empty">No databases found</div>
        )}
        <span className="lfb-hint">Use {'{{params.database}}'} for a dynamic database param</span>
      </div>

      {/* Table picker */}
      {database && !database.startsWith('{{') && (
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <span><Table2 size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 4 }} />Tables</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="lfb-btn lfb-btn-ghost"
              style={{ padding: '1px 6px', fontSize: 10 }}
              onClick={() => { loadTables(database); setTblOpen((v) => !v); }}
              title="Browse tables"
            >
              {loadingTbls ? <span className="lfb-spinner" style={{ width: 10, height: 10 }} /> : <RefreshCw size={10} />}
              Load Tables
            </button>
          </label>
          {tblOpen && tables.length > 0 && (
            <div className="lfb-picker-dropdown">
              {tables.map((tbl) => (
                <div key={tbl} className="lfb-picker-item" style={{ justifyContent: 'space-between' }}
                  onClick={() => insertTableQuery(tbl)}>
                  <span><Table2 size={11} style={{ marginRight: 6, opacity: 0.6 }} />{tbl}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569' }}>
                    <Plus size={10} style={{ display: 'inline' }} /> Insert
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {tblOpen && !loadingTbls && tables.length === 0 && (
            <div className="lfb-picker-empty">No tables found — check database name</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SQL query */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">SQL Query</label>
        <textarea
          className="lfb-textarea mono"
          placeholder={`SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE id = {{params.id}}`}
          value={config.query || ''}
          onChange={(e) => set('query', e.target.value)}
          rows={5}
          spellCheck={false}
        />
        <span className="lfb-hint">
          Use {'{{params.name}}'} for input params · {'{{variable}}'} for prior step results · Click a table above to insert SELECT
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Bind result + Row limit */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Bind Result To</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="result"
            value={config.bind_result_to || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('bind_result_to', e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Variable name — reference as {'{{result}}'}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 100, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Row Limit</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            type="number"
            min="1"
            placeholder="none"
            value={config.row_limit != null ? config.row_limit : ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('row_limit', e.target.value === '' ? null : parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/steps/ReturnStep.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

// ── ReturnStep ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig)
export default function ReturnStep({ config = {}, onChange }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  // Extra fields stored as array of { key, value } for editing
  const extraRows = (() => {
    if (config._extraRows) return config._extraRows;
    const extra = config.extra;
    if (!extra) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(extra)) return extra;
    return Object.entries(extra).map(([k, v]) => ({ key: k, value: v }));
  })();

  function serializeExtra(rows) {
    const obj = {};
    rows.forEach((r) => {
      if (r.key.trim()) obj[r.key.trim()] = r.value;
    });
    return obj;
  }

  function addExtraField() {
    const next = [...extraRows, { key: '', value: '' }];
    onChange({ ...config, _extraRows: next, extra: serializeExtra(next) });
  }

  function updateExtraField(index, field, value) {
    const next = extraRows.map((r, i) => (i === index ? { ...r, [field]: value } : r));
    onChange({ ...config, _extraRows: next, extra: serializeExtra(next) });
  }

  function removeExtraField(index) {
    const next = extraRows.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    onChange({ ...config, _extraRows: next, extra: serializeExtra(next) });
  }

  // Build preview JSON
  const previewObj = {
    status_code: config.status_code || 200,
    message: config.message || 'Success',
    data: config.data || '{{result}}',
    ...(extraRows.reduce((acc, r) => {
      if (r.key.trim()) acc[r.key.trim()] = r.value || '...';
      return acc;
    }, {})),
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Status code + Data row */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 110, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Status Code</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            type="number"
            min="100"
            max="599"
            placeholder="200"
            value={config.status_code != null ? config.status_code : ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('status_code', parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 200)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Data (response body)</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="{{result}}"
            value={config.data || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('data', e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">This is the response body — typically {'{{result}}'} or a specific variable</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Message */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Message</label>
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="Success"
          value={config.message || ''}
          onChange={(e) => set('message', e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Extra fields */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Extra Top-Level Fields</label>
        <div className="lfb-kv-editor">
          {extraRows.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 26px', gap: 6, marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', fontWeight: 700 }}>KEY</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', fontWeight: 700 }}>VALUE</span>
              <span />
            </div>
          )}
          {extraRows.map((row, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="lfb-kv-row">
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder="field_name"
                value={row.key}
                onChange={(e) => updateExtraField(index, 'key', e.target.value)}
              />
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder="value or {{var}}"
                value={row.value}
                onChange={(e) => updateExtraField(index, 'value', e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                className="lfb-icon-btn danger"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => removeExtraField(index)}
                title="Remove field"
              >
                <Trash2 size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button className="lfb-kv-add-btn" type="button" onClick={addExtraField}>
            <Plus size={12} />
            Add Field
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Preview */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Response Shape Preview</label>
        <div className="lfb-preview-box">
          {JSON.stringify(previewObj, null, 2)}
        </div>
        <span className="lfb-hint">Approximate shape — {'{{variables}}'} are resolved at runtime</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}




src/components/steps/MergeStep.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

const STRATEGIES = [
  {
    value: 'concat',
    label: 'Concat',
    description: 'Append all source arrays into one flat list. Best for combining rows from multiple queries.',
  },
  {
    value: 'zip',
    label: 'Zip',
    description: 'Pair rows by index — row 0 from source A merges with row 0 from source B, etc.',
  },
  {
    value: 'dict',
    label: 'Dict',
    description: 'Combine into a dictionary keyed by source variable name. Good for wrapping multiple results.',
  },
];

// ── MergeStep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig)
export default function MergeStep({ config = {}, onChange }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  // Sources: stored as array of strings
  const sources = (() => {
    if (Array.isArray(config.sources)) return config.sources;
    if (typeof config.sources === 'string' && config.sources) return config.sources.split(',').map((s) => s.trim());
    return [];
  })();

  function addSource() {
    set('sources', [...sources, '']);
  }

  function updateSource(index, value) {
    const next = sources.map((s, i) => (i === index ? value : s));
    set('sources', next);
  }

  function removeSource(index) {
    set('sources', sources.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  const selectedStrategy = STRATEGIES.find((s) => s.value === (config.strategy || 'concat'));

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Sources */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Source Variables</label>
        <div className="lfb-kv-editor">
          {sources.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569', marginBottom: 6 }}>
              No sources added yet. Add the variable names to merge.
            </div>
          )}
          {sources.map((src, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="lfb-kv-row">
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder="variable_name"
                value={src}
                onChange={(e) => updateSource(index, e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                className="lfb-icon-btn danger"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => removeSource(index)}
                title="Remove source"
              >
                <Trash2 size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button className="lfb-kv-add-btn" type="button" onClick={addSource}>
            <Plus size={12} />
            Add Source
          </button>
        </div>
        <span className="lfb-hint">
          Enter the variable names (e.g. <code style={{ color: '#7dd3fc' }}>result</code>,{' '}
          <code style={{ color: '#7dd3fc' }}>http_result</code>) to merge
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Bind result to */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Bind Result To</label>
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="merged"
          value={config.bind_result_to || ''}
          onChange={(e) => set('bind_result_to', e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Strategy */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Merge Strategy</label>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {STRATEGIES.map((s) => {
            const isSelected = (config.strategy || 'concat') === s.value;
            return (
              <button
                key={s.value}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => set('strategy', s.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: '1px solid',
                  borderColor: isSelected ? '#3b82f6' : '#334155',
                  background: isSelected ? '#1e3a5f' : '#0f172a',
                  color: isSelected ? '#60a5fa' : '#94a3b8',
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s',
                }}
              >
                {s.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {selectedStrategy && (
          <span className="lfb-hint" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
            {selectedStrategy.description}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


src/components/steps/LoopStep.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import StepSequencer from '../StepSequencer';

const MAX_LOOP_DEPTH = 2;

// ── LoopStep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig), depth
export default function LoopStep({ config = {}, onChange, depth = 0 }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  function handleSubStepsChange(sub_steps) {
    onChange({ ...config, sub_steps });
  }

  const tooDeep = depth >= MAX_LOOP_DEPTH;

  return (
    <div>
      {tooDeep && (
        <div className="lfb-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={14} />
          Warning: Deep loop nesting (depth {depth}) can impact performance. Consider restructuring.
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Iterate over + item variable row */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Iterate Over</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="result"
            value={config.iterate_over || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('iterate_over', e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Variable name containing the array to loop over</span>
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 140, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Item Variable</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="item"
            value={config.item_variable || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('item_variable', e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Use {'{{item}}'} in sub-steps</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bind result to */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Bind Result To</label>
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="processed"
          value={config.bind_result_to || ''}
          onChange={(e) => set('bind_result_to', e.target.value)}
        />
        <span className="lfb-hint">Collects the output of each loop iteration into this variable</span>
      </div>

      <div className="lfb-divider" />

      {/* Sub steps */}
      <label className="lfb-label" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>Sub Steps (executed for each item)</label>
      <div className="lfb-sequencer nested">
        <StepSequencer
          steps={config.sub_steps || []}
          onChange={handleSubStepsChange}
          depth={depth + 1}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}





src/components/steps/HTTPCallStep.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

const HTTP_METHODS = ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH'];
const BODY_METHODS = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH']);

// ── HTTPCallStep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig)
export default function HTTPCallStep({ config = {}, onChange }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  // Headers are stored as an array of { key, value } for easy editing
  const headerRows = (() => {
    const h = config.headers;
    if (!h) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(h)) return h;
    // Convert object form to array
    return Object.entries(h).map(([k, v]) => ({ key: k, value: v }));
  })();

  function serializeHeaders(rows) {
    // Store as object
    const obj = {};
    rows.forEach((r) => {
      if (r.key.trim()) obj[r.key.trim()] = r.value;
    });
    return obj;
  }

  function addHeader() {
    const next = [...headerRows, { key: '', value: '' }];
    set('headers', serializeHeaders(next));
    // keep internal array form in sync by storing array directly so edits work
    onChange({ ...config, _headerRows: next, headers: serializeHeaders(next) });
  }

  function updateHeader(index, field, value) {
    const next = headerRows.map((r, i) => (i === index ? { ...r, [field]: value } : r));
    onChange({ ...config, _headerRows: next, headers: serializeHeaders(next) });
  }

  function removeHeader(index) {
    const next = headerRows.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    onChange({ ...config, _headerRows: next, headers: serializeHeaders(next) });
  }

  // Resolve display rows — prefer _headerRows if present (editing state)
  const displayRows = config._headerRows || headerRows;
  const showBody = BODY_METHODS.has(config.method || 'GET');

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Method + URL row */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 100, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Method</label>
          <select
            className="lfb-select"
            value={config.method || 'GET'}
            onChange={(e) => set('method', e.target.value)}
            style={{ width: '100%' }}
          >
            {HTTP_METHODS.map((m) => <option key={m} value={m}>{m}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">URL</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="https://api.example.com/{{params.path}}"
            value={config.url || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('url', e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Supports {'{{variable}}'} interpolation</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Headers */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Headers</label>
        <div className="lfb-kv-editor">
          {displayRows.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 26px', gap: 6, marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', fontWeight: 700 }}>KEY</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#475569', fontWeight: 700 }}>VALUE</span>
              <span />
            </div>
          )}
          {displayRows.map((row, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="lfb-kv-row">
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder="Header-Name"
                value={row.key}
                onChange={(e) => updateHeader(index, 'key', e.target.value)}
              />
              <input
                className="lfb-input"
                placeholder="value"
                value={row.value}
                onChange={(e) => updateHeader(index, 'value', e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                className="lfb-icon-btn danger"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => removeHeader(index)}
                title="Remove header"
              >
                <Trash2 size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button className="lfb-kv-add-btn" type="button" onClick={addHeader}>
            <Plus size={12} />
            Add Header
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Body — only for POST/PUT/PATCH */}
      {showBody && (
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Request Body (JSON)</label>
          <textarea
            className="lfb-textarea mono"
            placeholder={'{\n  "key": "{{params.value}}"\n}'}
            value={config.body || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('body', e.target.value)}
            rows={5}
            spellCheck={false}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Use {'{{variable}}'} for dynamic values</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bind result + Timeout row */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group">
          <label className="lfb-label">Bind Result To</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="http_result"
            value={config.bind_result_to || ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('bind_result_to', e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="lfb-hint">Stores the parsed JSON response body</span>
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 110, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">Timeout (s)</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            type="number"
            min="1"
            max="300"
            placeholder="30"
            value={config.timeout != null ? config.timeout : ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('timeout', e.target.value === '' ? null : parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

// ── ErrorHandlerStep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig)
export default function ErrorHandlerStep({ config = {}, onChange }) {
  function set(key, value) {
    onChange({ ...config, [key]: value });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 8,
          padding: '8px 12px',
          background: '#450a0a',
          border: '1px solid #7f1d1d',
          borderRadius: 6,
          fontSize: 12,
          color: '#fca5a5',
          marginBottom: 12,
        }}
      >
        <AlertTriangle size={14} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
        This step defines how the flow responds when an error occurs. It overrides the default 500 error.
      </div>

      {/* Status code */}
      <div className="lfb-field-row">
        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 120, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">HTTP Status Code</label>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            type="number"
            min="400"
            max="599"
            placeholder="500"
            value={config.status_code != null ? config.status_code : ''}
            onChange={(e) => set('status_code', parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 500)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="lfb-field-group" style={{ width: 140, flex: 'none' }}>
          <label className="lfb-label">On Error Behavior</label>
          <select
            className="lfb-select"
            value={config.on_error || 'stop'}
            onChange={(e) => set('on_error', e.target.value)}
            style={{ width: '100%' }}
          >
            <option value="stop">Stop execution</option>
            <option value="continue">Continue to next step</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Error message */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">Error Message</label>
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="{{error.message}}"
          value={config.message || ''}
          onChange={(e) => set('message', e.target.value)}
        />
        <span className="lfb-hint">
          Use {'{{error.message}}'} to include the original error, {'{{error.step}}'} for the failed step name
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Info about on_error behavior */}
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '8px 12px',
          background: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #334155',
          borderRadius: 6,
          fontSize: 11,
          color: '#64748b',
        }}
      >
        {(config.on_error || 'stop') === 'stop'
          ? 'The flow will stop at this step and return the error response immediately.'
          : 'The flow will continue to the next step even if this step encountered an error. The error is captured in {{error}}.'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}





src/components/steps/ConditionStep.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { GitBranch } from 'lucide-react';
import ExpressionBuilder from '../ExpressionBuilder';
// StepSequencer is imported lazily to avoid circular dep at module parse time
import StepSequencer from '../StepSequencer';

const MAX_DEPTH = 3;

// ── ConditionStep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props: config, onChange(newConfig), depth
export default function ConditionStep({ config = {}, onChange, depth = 0 }) {
  function handleExpressionChange(expression) {
    onChange({ ...config, expression });
  }

  function handleThenChange(then_steps) {
    onChange({ ...config, then_steps });
  }

  function handleElseChange(else_steps) {
    onChange({ ...config, else_steps });
  }

  const nestingBlocked = depth >= MAX_DEPTH;

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Expression */}
      <div className="lfb-field-group">
        <label className="lfb-label">
          <GitBranch size={11} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 4 }} />
          Condition Expression
        </label>
        <ExpressionBuilder
          value={config.expression || { left: '', operator: '==', right: '' }}
          onChange={handleExpressionChange}
          context={[]}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="lfb-divider" />

      {/* THEN branch */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div className="lfb-branch-label then">
          <GitBranch size={12} />
          THEN
        </div>
        {nestingBlocked ? (
          <div className="lfb-warning">
            Maximum nesting depth ({MAX_DEPTH}) reached. Cannot add nested steps.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="lfb-sequencer nested">
            <StepSequencer
              steps={config.then_steps || []}
              onChange={handleThenChange}
              depth={depth + 1}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="lfb-divider" />

      {/* ELSE branch */}
      <div>
        <div className="lfb-branch-label else">
          <GitBranch size={12} />
          ELSE
        </div>
        {nestingBlocked ? (
          <div className="lfb-warning">
            Maximum nesting depth ({MAX_DEPTH}) reached. Cannot add nested steps.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="lfb-sequencer nested">
            <StepSequencer
              steps={config.else_steps || []}
              onChange={handleElseChange}
              depth={depth + 1}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE path=scripts/export_dataset.py encoding=utf8 size=6564 orig_bytes=6564 sha256=3af77d6dc86dece3799cb6041a9076881aebde9753911c9039c0308143473cd5 ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
export_dataset.py — Export human-approved G-code diffs to JSONL training dataset.

Reads all approved gcode_diffs from PostgreSQL where embedded_in_vector=true
and used_in_training=false, formats them in Alpaca/ShareGPT JSONL format
for LoRA fine-tuning, and writes to the output directory.

Usage:
    python scripts/export_dataset.py --output ./data/training --min-edits 1

Requirements:
    pip install psycopg2-binary python-dotenv
"""

import os
import json
import argparse
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

try:
    import psycopg2
    import psycopg2.extras
except ImportError:
    print("ERROR: psycopg2-binary not installed. Run: pip install psycopg2-binary")
    exit(1)

try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
    load_dotenv()
except ImportError:
    pass   # dotenv optional

DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/manufacturing_ai")


def build_instruction(row: dict) -> str:
    """Build the instruction prompt from part metadata."""
    parts = ["Generate CNC G-code for the following part:"]
    if row.get("part_name"):      parts.append(f"Part Name: {row['part_name']}")
    if row.get("part_number"):    parts.append(f"Part Number: {row['part_number']}")
    if row.get("revision"):       parts.append(f"Revision: {row['revision']}")
    if row.get("material"):       parts.append(f"Material: {row['material']}")
    if row.get("machine_type"):   parts.append(f"Machine: {row['machine_type']}")

    if row.get("generated_plan_json"):
        plan = row["generated_plan_json"]
        if isinstance(plan, dict) and "operations" in plan:
            ops = plan["operations"]
            parts.append(f"\nProcess Plan ({len(ops)} operations):")
            for op in ops[:6]:   # cap at 6 to avoid token explosion
                parts.append(
                    f"  OP{op.get('opNumber', '?')}: {op.get('name', '')} — "
                    f"Tool: {op.get('tool', {}).get('type', '?')} "
                    f"Ø{op.get('tool', {}).get('diameter', '?')}mm, "
                    f"S{op.get('cuttingParams', {}).get('spindleSpeed', '?')} "
                    f"F{op.get('cuttingParams', {}).get('feedRate', '?')}"
                )

    if row.get("edit_reason"):
        parts.append(f"\nEngineer Preference: {row['edit_reason']}")

    return "\n".join(parts)


def build_alpaca_sample(row: dict) -> dict:
    """Format as Alpaca instruction-response pair."""
    return {
        "instruction": build_instruction(row),
        "input":       "",
        "output":      row["approved_gcode"],
        "metadata": {
            "diff_id":        str(row["id"]),
            "part_number":    row.get("part_number"),
            "material":       row.get("material"),
            "lines_added":    row.get("lines_added", 0),
            "lines_removed":  row.get("lines_removed", 0),
            "quality_rating": row.get("quality_rating"),
            "geometry_hash":  row.get("part_geometry_hash"),
            "approved_at":    str(row.get("approved_at")),
        }
    }


def build_sharegpt_sample(row: dict) -> dict:
    """Format as ShareGPT conversation pair."""
    system_msg = (
        "You are an expert CNC programmer. Generate machine-ready Fanuc/Haas G-code "
        "based on the part description and process plan. Output ONLY the G-code, "
        "starting with % and ending with %."
    )
    return {
        "system": system_msg,
        "conversations": [
            {"from": "human",  "value": build_instruction(row)},
            {"from": "gpt",    "value": row["approved_gcode"]},
        ],
        "metadata": {
            "diff_id":     str(row["id"]),
            "part_number": row.get("part_number"),
            "material":    row.get("material"),
        }
    }


def export_dataset(
    output_dir: str,
    min_edits: int = 1,
    format: str = "alpaca",
    mark_used: bool = True,
) -> dict:
    conn = psycopg2.connect(DATABASE_URL)
    cur  = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=psycopg2.extras.RealDictCursor)

    cur.execute("""
        SELECT id, approved_at, part_number, part_name, revision, material, machine_type,
               part_geometry_hash, generated_gcode, generated_plan_json, approved_gcode,
               edit_reason, lines_added, lines_removed, quality_rating
        FROM gcode_diffs
        WHERE approved_gcode IS NOT NULL
          AND used_in_training = false
          AND (lines_added + lines_removed) >= %s
        ORDER BY approved_at
    """, (min_edits,))

    rows = cur.fetchall()

    if not rows:
        print("No new approved diffs to export.")
        conn.close()
        return {"exported": 0}

    out_path = Path(output_dir)
    out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename  = out_path / f"gcode_diffs_{timestamp}_{format}.jsonl"
    ids       = []

    with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in rows:
            sample = build_alpaca_sample(row) if format == "alpaca" else build_sharegpt_sample(row)
            f.write(json.dumps(sample, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            ids.append(str(row["id"]))

    # Mark as used
    if mark_used and ids:
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE gcode_diffs SET used_in_training = true WHERE id = ANY(%s::uuid[])",
            (ids,)
        )
        conn.commit()

    cur.close()
    conn.close()

    checksum = hashlib.sha256(open(filename, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    print(f"Exported {len(rows)} samples → {filename}")
    print(f"SHA-256: {checksum}")

    return {
        "exported":  len(rows),
        "file":      str(filename),
        "format":    format,
        "checksum":  checksum,
        "diff_ids":  ids,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Export G-code diff dataset for LoRA training")
    parser.add_argument("--output",    default="./data/training",  help="Output directory")
    parser.add_argument("--min-edits", default=1,  type=int,       help="Minimum lines changed to include")
    parser.add_argument("--format",    default="alpaca", choices=["alpaca", "sharegpt"])
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run",   action="store_true",        help="Export but don't mark as used")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    result = export_dataset(
        output_dir=args.output,
        min_edits=args.min_edits,
        format=args.format,
        mark_used=not args.dry_run,
    )
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

=== FILE path=scripts/train_lora.py encoding=utf8 size=14914 orig_bytes=14914 sha256=e4065370e0ab97f9b5804f95ab8d62a8c4d88c37ed9a6dac3a7af553f1d1de2c ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
train_lora.py — Offline LoRA Fine-Tuning Pipeline for G-Code Generation
=========================================================================
Reads exported JSONL datasets (from export_dataset.py), runs LoRA fine-tuning
on a local Qwen2.5-Coder or DeepSeek-Coder model, saves the adapter weights,
and optionally hot-reloads the Ollama inference engine with the new adapter.

Requirements (On-Prem only):
    pip install torch transformers peft accelerate datasets trl bitsandbytes
    # Optional for faster training:
    pip install unsloth

Usage:
    python scripts/train_lora.py \\
        --data ./data/training/gcode_diffs_*.jsonl \\
        --base-model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct \\
        --output ./models/lora_adapters/gcode_v1 \\
        --epochs 3 \\
        --batch-size 2

Environment:
    DATABASE_URL    — PostgreSQL URL for job status updates
    LOCAL_LLM_URL   — Ollama API URL for hot reload
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import glob
import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

# ─── Soft dependency check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def check_deps():
    missing = []
    for pkg in ["torch", "transformers", "peft", "datasets", "trl"]:
        try:
            __import__(pkg)
        except ImportError:
            missing.append(pkg)
    if missing:
        print(f"ERROR: Missing packages: {', '.join(missing)}")
        print("Install with: pip install torch transformers peft datasets trl bitsandbytes accelerate")
        sys.exit(1)

# ─── Job Tracker (PostgreSQL) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
class JobTracker:
    def __init__(self, db_url: str):
        self.db_url = db_url
        self.job_id = None
        try:
            import psycopg2
            self.conn = psycopg2.connect(db_url)
        except Exception:
            self.conn = None

    def start(self, base_model: str, dataset_size: int, num_epochs: int) -> str:
        if not self.conn:
            return "local"
        try:
            cur = self.conn.cursor()
            cur.execute(
                """INSERT INTO training_jobs (status, base_model, dataset_size, num_epochs, started_at)
                   VALUES ('RUNNING', %s, %s, %s, now()) RETURNING id""",
                (base_model, dataset_size, num_epochs)
            )
            self.job_id = str(cur.fetchone()[0])
            self.conn.commit()
            print(f"[TrainLoRA] Job ID: {self.job_id}")
            return self.job_id
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[TrainLoRA] DB job tracking error: {e}")
            return "local"

    def update(self, status: str, loss: float = None, error: str = None, adapter_path: str = None):
        if not self.conn or not self.job_id:
            return
        try:
            cur = self.conn.cursor()
            updates = ["status = %s"]
            vals    = [status]
            if status in ("COMPLETE", "FAILED"):
                updates.append("completed_at = now()")
            if loss is not None:
                updates.append("loss_final = %s"); vals.append(loss)
            if error:
                updates.append("error_message = %s"); vals.append(error[:2000])
            if adapter_path:
                updates.append("adapter_path = %s"); vals.append(adapter_path)
            vals.append(self.job_id)
            cur.execute(f"UPDATE training_jobs SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id = %s::uuid", vals)
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[TrainLoRA] DB update error: {e}")


# ─── Dataset Loader ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def load_jsonl_files(patterns: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    records = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        for path in glob.glob(pattern):
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    line = line.strip()
                    if line:
                        records.append(json.loads(line))
    return records


def format_alpaca_prompt(sample: dict) -> str:
    """Convert Alpaca sample to single training string."""
    instruction = sample.get("instruction", "")
    inp         = sample.get("input", "")
    output      = sample.get("output", "")
    if inp:
        return f"### Instruction:\n{instruction}\n\n### Input:\n{inp}\n\n### Response:\n{output}"
    return f"### Instruction:\n{instruction}\n\n### Response:\n{output}"


def format_sharegpt_prompt(sample: dict, tokenizer) -> list[dict]:
    """Return conversation list for chat_template formatting."""
    messages = []
    if sample.get("system"):
        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": sample["system"]})
    for turn in sample.get("conversations", []):
        role = "user" if turn["from"] == "human" else "assistant"
        messages.append({"role": role, "content": turn["value"]})
    return messages


# ─── Main Training Loop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def train(
    data_patterns:  list[str],
    base_model:     str,
    output_dir:     str,
    num_epochs:     int = 3,
    batch_size:     int = 2,
    grad_accum:     int = 4,
    max_seq_len:    int = 2048,
    lora_rank:      int = 16,
    lora_alpha:     int = 32,
    lora_dropout:   float = 0.05,
    learning_rate:  float = 2e-4,
    use_4bit:       bool = True,
    db_url:         str = None,
):
    check_deps()

    import torch
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM, BitsAndBytesConfig, TrainingArguments
    from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model, TaskType
    from datasets import Dataset
    from trl import SFTTrainer

    tracker = JobTracker(db_url or os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", ""))

    print(f"[TrainLoRA] Loading dataset from: {data_patterns}")
    records = load_jsonl_files(data_patterns)
    if not records:
        print("ERROR: No training data found. Run export_dataset.py first.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"[TrainLoRA] {len(records)} training samples loaded")
    job_id = tracker.start(base_model, len(records), num_epochs)

    # Determine format
    fmt = "sharegpt" if "conversations" in records[0] else "alpaca"
    print(f"[TrainLoRA] Dataset format: {fmt}")

    try:
        # ── Tokenizer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        print(f"[TrainLoRA] Loading tokenizer: {base_model}")
        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(base_model, trust_remote_code=True)
        tokenizer.pad_token    = tokenizer.eos_token
        tokenizer.padding_side = "right"

        # ── Model with optional 4-bit quantization ─────────────────────────────
        bnb_config = None
        if use_4bit and torch.cuda.is_available():
            bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(
                load_in_4bit=True,
                bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
                bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
                bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,
            )

        print(f"[TrainLoRA] Loading base model: {base_model} (4-bit={use_4bit})")
        model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
            base_model,
            quantization_config=bnb_config,
            device_map="auto",
            trust_remote_code=True,
            torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        )
        model.config.use_cache = False

        # ── LoRA Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        lora_config = LoraConfig(
            task_type=TaskType.CAUSAL_LM,
            r=lora_rank,
            lora_alpha=lora_alpha,
            lora_dropout=lora_dropout,
            target_modules=["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "o_proj", "gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj"],
            bias="none",
        )
        model = get_peft_model(model, lora_config)
        model.print_trainable_parameters()

        # ── Format Dataset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        if fmt == "alpaca":
            texts = [format_alpaca_prompt(r) for r in records]
            hf_dataset = Dataset.from_dict({"text": texts})
        else:
            # ShareGPT: apply chat template
            def apply_chat(sample):
                msgs    = format_sharegpt_prompt(sample, tokenizer)
                text    = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False)
                return {"text": text}
            hf_dataset = Dataset.from_list(records).map(apply_chat, remove_columns=records[0].keys())

        # ── Training Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        out_path = Path(output_dir)
        out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        args = TrainingArguments(
            output_dir=str(out_path),
            num_train_epochs=num_epochs,
            per_device_train_batch_size=batch_size,
            gradient_accumulation_steps=grad_accum,
            learning_rate=learning_rate,
            fp16=not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
            bf16=torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
            logging_steps=10,
            save_steps=100,
            save_total_limit=2,
            warmup_ratio=0.05,
            lr_scheduler_type="cosine",
            report_to="none",
            dataloader_num_workers=0,
        )

        trainer = SFTTrainer(
            model=model,
            args=args,
            train_dataset=hf_dataset,
            dataset_text_field="text",
            max_seq_length=max_seq_len,
            tokenizer=tokenizer,
        )

        print("[TrainLoRA] Starting training…")
        train_result = trainer.train()
        final_loss = train_result.training_loss

        # ── Save Adapter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        adapter_path = str(out_path / "final_adapter")
        trainer.model.save_pretrained(adapter_path)
        tokenizer.save_pretrained(adapter_path)

        # Write manifest
        manifest = {
            "base_model":    base_model,
            "adapter_path":  adapter_path,
            "dataset_size":  len(records),
            "num_epochs":    num_epochs,
            "final_loss":    final_loss,
            "lora_rank":     lora_rank,
            "trained_at":    datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "job_id":        job_id,
        }
        with open(out_path / "manifest.json", "w") as f:
            json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2)

        print(f"[TrainLoRA] Training complete. Loss: {final_loss:.4f}")
        print(f"[TrainLoRA] Adapter saved: {adapter_path}")

        tracker.update("COMPLETE", loss=final_loss, adapter_path=adapter_path)
        return manifest

    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        tb = traceback.format_exc()
        print(f"[TrainLoRA] ERROR: {e}\n{tb}")
        tracker.update("FAILED", error=str(e))
        sys.exit(1)


# ─── Ollama Hot Reload ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def ollama_reload(base_model: str, adapter_path: str, ollama_url: str):
    """
    Creates an Ollama Modelfile that references the base model + LoRA adapter,
    then calls `ollama create` to register it as a new model variant.
    """
    import subprocess
    modelfile_content = f"""FROM {base_model}
ADAPTER {adapter_path}
PARAMETER temperature 0.1
PARAMETER num_ctx 4096
SYSTEM You are an expert CNC programmer. Generate machine-ready Fanuc/Haas G-code. Output ONLY G-code.
"""
    modelfile_path = Path(adapter_path) / "Modelfile"
    modelfile_path.write_text(modelfile_content)

    model_name = f"gcode-lora-{int(time.time())}"
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["ollama", "create", model_name, "-f", str(modelfile_path)],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if result.returncode == 0:
        print(f"[TrainLoRA] Ollama model registered: {model_name}")
        return model_name
    else:
        print(f"[TrainLoRA] Ollama reload failed: {result.stderr}")
        return None


# ─── Entry Point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="LoRA fine-tuning on human-approved G-code diffs")
    parser.add_argument("--data",       nargs="+", required=True,                      help="JSONL file patterns")
    parser.add_argument("--base-model", default="Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct",      help="HuggingFace base model ID")
    parser.add_argument("--output",     default="./models/lora_adapters/gcode_lora",   help="Output directory for adapter")
    parser.add_argument("--epochs",     default=3,   type=int)

    parser.add_argument("--grad-accum", default=4,   type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--rank",       default=16,  type=int,   help="LoRA rank")
    parser.add_argument("--lr",         default=2e-4, type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--no-4bit",    action="store_true",     help="Disable 4-bit quantization")
    parser.add_argument("--ollama-reload", action="store_true",  help="Register adapter with Ollama after training")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    manifest = train(
        data_patterns=args.data,
        base_model=args.base_model,
        output_dir=args.output,
        num_epochs=args.epochs,

        lora_rank=args.rank,
        learning_rate=args.lr,
        use_4bit=not args.no_4bit,
    )

    if args.ollama_reload:
        ollama_url = os.environ.get("LOCAL_LLM_URL", "http://localhost:11434")
        ollama_reload(args.base_model, manifest["adapter_path"], ollama_url)

-- Manufacturing RAG Database Schema
-- PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Documents Table
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  filename        TEXT NOT NULL,
  original_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
  category        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN (
                    'DRAWING_2D','INSPECTION_FIR','FINANCIAL_PO_INVOICE',
                    'STORES_FG','TOOLING_MATERIAL','GENERAL')),
  mime_type       TEXT,
  file_size       BIGINT,
  storage_path    TEXT NOT NULL,
  storage_bucket  TEXT NOT NULL,
  page_count      INT,
  status          TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','processing','indexed','error')),
  error_message   TEXT,

  -- ── Structured metadata fields (optional, user-supplied + auto-extracted) ──
  doc_title       TEXT,                     -- Human-readable title
  description     TEXT,                     -- Free-text description
  part_name       TEXT,                     -- Part / assembly name
  part_number     TEXT,                     -- Exact part number e.g. DWG-A901
  revision        TEXT,                     -- Revision code e.g. REV3, B, 02
  developed_date  DATE,                     -- Date drawn / developed
  customer_name   TEXT,                     -- Customer / client name
  issue_details   TEXT,                     -- Known issues / NCRs / deviations
  auto_extracted  JSONB DEFAULT '{}',       -- Fields extracted via LLM/regex from content

  metadata        JSONB DEFAULT '{}',       -- Catch-all for future extensibility
  source_path     TEXT,
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Chunks Table (Dense + Sparse Indexing)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  document_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  chunk_index   INT NOT NULL,
  content       TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_type  TEXT DEFAULT 'text' CHECK (content_type IN ('text','table','image_caption','ocr','metadata_header')),
  page_number   INT,
  sheet_name    TEXT,
  bounding_box  JSONB,
  embedding     vector(1024),
  sparse_vector JSONB,
  bm25_tokens   TSVECTOR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', unaccent(content))) STORED,
  metadata      JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Indexes
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_document_id   ON chunks(document_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_embedding      ON chunks USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_bm25           ON chunks USING gin(bm25_tokens);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_content_trgm   ON chunks USING gin(content gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_content_type   ON chunks(content_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_category    ON documents(category);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_status      ON documents(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_part_number ON documents(part_number);   -- exact match filter
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_revision    ON documents(revision);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_part_name   ON documents USING gin(to_tsvector('english', unaccent(COALESCE(part_name,''))));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_metadata    ON documents USING gin(metadata);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_auto_extracted ON documents USING gin(auto_extracted);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Auto-update updated_at
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER documents_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON documents
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Hybrid Search RRF Function
-- Supports optional pre-filter by part_number and category
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hybrid_search(
  query_embedding   vector(1024),
  query_text        TEXT,
  match_count       INT DEFAULT 20,
  rrf_k             INT DEFAULT 60,
  filter_category   TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  filter_part_number TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  chunk_id     UUID,
  document_id  UUID,
  content      TEXT,
  page_number  INT,
  content_type TEXT,
  rrf_score    FLOAT,
  dense_rank   INT,
  sparse_rank  INT
) AS $$
WITH filtered_chunks AS (
  -- Pre-filter by document metadata before expensive vector ops
  SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.content, c.page_number, c.content_type, c.embedding, c.bm25_tokens
  FROM chunks c
  JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
  WHERE
    (filter_category IS NULL   OR d.category    = filter_category)
    AND (filter_part_number IS NULL OR d.part_number = filter_part_number)
    AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL
),
dense AS (
  SELECT id, document_id, content, page_number, content_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY embedding <=> query_embedding) AS rank
  FROM filtered_chunks
  ORDER BY embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count * 2
),
sparse AS (
  SELECT id, document_id, content, page_number, content_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(bm25_tokens, query) DESC) AS rank
  FROM filtered_chunks,
       plainto_tsquery('english', unaccent(query_text)) AS query
  WHERE bm25_tokens @@ query
  ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(bm25_tokens, query) DESC
  LIMIT match_count * 2
),
fused AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(d.id, s.id) AS id,
    COALESCE(d.document_id, s.document_id) AS document_id,
    COALESCE(d.content, s.content) AS content,
    COALESCE(d.page_number, s.page_number) AS page_number,
    COALESCE(d.content_type, s.content_type) AS content_type,
    COALESCE(1.0/(rrf_k + d.rank), 0) + COALESCE(1.0/(rrf_k + s.rank), 0) AS rrf_score,
    COALESCE(d.rank::INT, 9999) AS dense_rank,
    COALESCE(s.rank::INT, 9999) AS sparse_rank
  FROM dense d FULL OUTER JOIN sparse s ON d.id = s.id
)
SELECT id AS chunk_id, document_id, content, page_number, content_type,
       rrf_score, dense_rank, sparse_rank
FROM fused
ORDER BY rrf_score DESC
LIMIT match_count;
$$ LANGUAGE sql;

-- Phase 3 Schema: Feedback Engine, RBAC, Audit Logging, DNC Machine Registry
-- Run after init.sql: psql -U postgres -d manufacturing_ai -f phase3_schema.sql

-- ─── Users & Sessions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('ADMIN', 'PROGRAMMER', 'QUALITY_INSPECTOR', 'OPERATOR');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email         TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  role          user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPERATOR',
  department    TEXT,
  is_active     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_login    TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
  id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  ip_address TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_token   ON sessions(token_hash);

describe("autoExtractFromText — stateful regex bug", () => {
  // BUG: The module-level regexes use the 'g' flag with exec().
  // After a successful match, lastIndex is advanced. Subsequent calls
  // where the match position is BEFORE the stale lastIndex miss the match.

  it("correctly extracts from two consecutive calls with different text positions", () => {
    // Call 1: match is near the END of the string (advances lastIndex far)
    const textA = "Long text with many words here then DWG-A001 at position 36";
    const resultA = autoExtractFromText(textA, {});
    expect(resultA.partNumber).toBe("DWG-A001");

    // Call 2: match is at the START of the string (before stale lastIndex)
    // This FAILS with the bug — the regex starts from old lastIndex, misses DWG-B002
    const textB = "DWG-B002 is referenced in the BOM.";
    const resultB = autoExtractFromText(textB, {});
    expect(resultB.partNumber).toBe("DWG-B002"); // FAILS if regex 'g' flag bug is present
  });

  it("extracts correctly on every call regardless of prior call history", () => {
    const texts = [
      { text: "ABCD-123 at end of string pad pad pad", expected: "ABCD-123" },
      { text: "EFGH-456 is at start", expected: "EFGH-456" },
      { text: "middle IJKL-789 appears here", expected: "IJKL-789" },
    ];

    for (const { text, expected } of texts) {
      const result = autoExtractFromText(text, {});
      expect(result.partNumber, `Failed for text: "${text}"`).toBe(expected);
    }
  });
});

describe("buildMetadataHeaderChunk", () => {
