"use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { useDropzone } from "react-dropzone";
import {
  UploadCloud, X, FileText, File, CheckCircle, AlertCircle,
  ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CopyCheck, Trash2, Plus,
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn, formatBytes, DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES, CATEGORY_LABELS } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { DocumentCategory } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { DocumentMetaFields } from "@/lib/types";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface PendingFile {
  file: File;
  category: DocumentCategory;
  meta: DocumentMetaFields;
  id: string;
  collapsed: boolean;           // per-file collapse to save space when many files
  batchApplied: boolean;        // visual indicator that batch meta was applied
}

interface UploadStatus {
  fileId: string;
  filename: string;
  progress: number;
  step: string;
  error?: string;
  documentId?: string;
  done: boolean;
}

const EMPTY_META: DocumentMetaFields = {
  docTitle: "", description: "", partName: "", partNumber: "",
  revision: "", developedDate: "", customerName: "", issueDetails: "",
};

// Which fields appear in the batch panel (the ones most likely to be shared)
const BATCH_FIELDS: (keyof DocumentMetaFields)[] = [
  "partName", "partNumber", "revision", "customerName", "developedDate",
];

// ─── Main Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function FileUploadZone() {
  const [pendingFiles, setPendingFiles] = useState<PendingFile[]>([]);
  const [uploads, setUploads]           = useState<UploadStatus[]>([]);
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading]   = useState(false);
  const [batchMeta, setBatchMeta]       = useState<DocumentMetaFields>({ ...EMPTY_META });
  const [batchApplyMode, setBatchApplyMode] = useState<"fill" | "overwrite">("fill");

  // ── Drop handler ──
  const onDrop = useCallback((accepted: File[]) => {
    const newFiles: PendingFile[] = accepted.map((file) => ({
      file,
      category: guessCategory(file.name) as DocumentCategory,
      meta: { ...EMPTY_META },
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      collapsed: false,
      batchApplied: false,
    }));
    setPendingFiles((prev) => [...prev, ...newFiles]);
  }, []);

  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    onDrop,
    accept: {
      "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet": [".xlsx"],
      "application/vnd.ms-excel": [".xls"],
      "text/csv": [".csv"],
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [".docx"],
      "image/png": [".png"],
      "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpeg"],
    },
    maxSize: 100 * 1024 * 1024,
  });

  // ── Per-file helpers ──
  const updateCategory = (id: string, category: DocumentCategory) =>
    setPendingFiles((prev) => prev.map((f) => f.id === id ? { ...f, category } : f));

  const updateMeta = (id: string, key: keyof DocumentMetaFields, value: string) =>
    setPendingFiles((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) => f.id === id ? { ...f, meta: { ...f.meta, [key]: value } } : f)
    );

  const toggleCollapsed = (id: string) =>
    setPendingFiles((prev) => prev.map((f) => f.id === id ? { ...f, collapsed: !f.collapsed } : f));

  const removeFile = (id: string) =>
    setPendingFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== id));

  const clearAll = () => setPendingFiles([]);

  // ── Collapse / expand all ──
  const setAllCollapsed = (collapsed: boolean) =>
    setPendingFiles((prev) => prev.map((f) => ({ ...f, collapsed })));

  // ── Apply batch metadata to all files ──
  const applyBatchToAll = () => {
    setPendingFiles((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) => {
        const merged = { ...f.meta };
        BATCH_FIELDS.forEach((key) => {
          const batchVal = batchMeta[key]?.trim();
          if (!batchVal) return;
          // "fill" = only set if file doesn't have its own value
          // "overwrite" = always overwrite
          if (batchApplyMode === "overwrite" || !merged[key]?.trim()) {
            (merged as Record<string, string>)[key] = batchVal;
          }
        });
        return { ...f, meta: merged, batchApplied: true };
      })
    );
  };

  // ── Apply batch metadata to a single file ──
  const applyBatchToOne = (id: string) => {
    setPendingFiles((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) => {
        if (f.id !== id) return f;
        const merged = { ...f.meta };
        BATCH_FIELDS.forEach((key) => {
          const batchVal = batchMeta[key]?.trim();
          if (batchVal) (merged as Record<string, string>)[key] = batchVal;
        });
        return { ...f, meta: merged, batchApplied: true };
      })
    );
  };

  // ── Upload all files ──
  const uploadAll = async () => {
    if (pendingFiles.length === 0 || isUploading) return;
    setIsUploading(true);

    setUploads(pendingFiles.map((pf) => ({
      fileId: pf.id, filename: pf.file.name, progress: 0, step: "Queued", done: false,
    })));

    for (const pf of pendingFiles) {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", pf.file);
      formData.append("category", pf.category);
      (Object.entries(pf.meta) as [keyof DocumentMetaFields, string][]).forEach(([key, val]) => {
        if (val?.trim()) formData.append(key, val.trim());
      });

      const response = await fetch("/api/ingest", { method: "POST", body: formData });
      if (!response.body) continue;

      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buf = "";

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buf += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const lines = buf.split("\n");
        buf = lines.pop() ?? "";

        for (const line of lines) {
          if (!line.startsWith("data: ")) continue;
          try {
            const event = JSON.parse(line.slice(6)) as {
              step: string; progress: number; error?: string; documentId?: string;
            };
            setUploads((prev) =>
              prev.map((u) =>
                u.fileId === pf.id
                  ? { ...u, step: event.step, progress: event.progress,
                      error: event.error, documentId: event.documentId,
                      done: event.progress === 100 || !!event.error }
                  : u
              )
            );
          } catch { /* malformed SSE line */ }
        }
      }
    }

    setPendingFiles([]);
    setIsUploading(false);
  };

  const hasBatchData = BATCH_FIELDS.some((k) => batchMeta[k]?.trim());

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

      {/* ── Drop Zone ── */}
      <div
        {...getRootProps()}
        className={cn(
          "rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed p-10 text-center cursor-pointer transition-colors",
          isDragActive
            ? "border-blue-500 bg-blue-50"
            : "border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50/40"
        )}
      >
        <input {...getInputProps()} />
        <UploadCloud className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400" />
        <p className="mt-3 text-base font-medium text-gray-700">
          {isDragActive ? "Drop files here" : "Drag & drop files, or click to browse"}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
          PDF · XLSX · CSV · DOCX · PNG · JPG · Multiple files supported — up to 100 MB each
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* ── File Queue ── */}
      {pendingFiles.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-4">

          {/* Queue header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                {pendingFiles.length} file{pendingFiles.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} in queue
              </h3>
              {pendingFiles.length > 1 && (
                <div className="flex gap-1">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setAllCollapsed(false)}
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                  >
                    Expand all
                  </button>
                  <span className="text-gray-300">·</span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setAllCollapsed(true)}
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                  >
                    Collapse all
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={clearAll}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Clear all
              </button>
              <Button onClick={uploadAll} disabled={isUploading} className="gap-2">
                <UploadCloud className="h-4 w-4" />
                {isUploading ? "Uploading…" : `Upload & Index ${pendingFiles.length > 1 ? `All ${pendingFiles.length}` : ""}`}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── BATCH METADATA PANEL (shown when 2+ files) ── */}
          {pendingFiles.length >= 2 && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border-2 border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 overflow-hidden">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 bg-blue-600">
                <CopyCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-white shrink-0" />
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Batch Metadata</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-blue-200">Fill once → apply to all files (great for same-product batches)</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="px-4 py-4 space-y-3">
                {/* Batch fields grid */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  <Field
                    label="Part Name"
                    placeholder="e.g. Flange Body"
                    value={batchMeta.partName ?? ""}
                    onChange={(v) => setBatchMeta((b) => ({ ...b, partName: v }))}
                  />
                  <Field
                    label="Part Number"
                    placeholder="e.g. DWG-A901"
                    value={batchMeta.partNumber ?? ""}
                    onChange={(v) => setBatchMeta((b) => ({ ...b, partNumber: v }))}
                    monospace
                  />
                  <Field
                    label="Revision"
                    placeholder="e.g. REV3, B"
                    value={batchMeta.revision ?? ""}
                    onChange={(v) => setBatchMeta((b) => ({ ...b, revision: v }))}
                    monospace
                  />
                  <Field
                    label="Customer Name"
                    placeholder="e.g. Tata Motors"
                    value={batchMeta.customerName ?? ""}
                    onChange={(v) => setBatchMeta((b) => ({ ...b, customerName: v }))}
                  />
                  <Field

                    type="date"

                    onChange={(v) => setBatchMeta((b) => ({ ...b, developedDate: v }))}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap pt-1">
                  <Button
                    onClick={applyBatchToAll}

                    <CopyCheck className="h-4 w-4" />

              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

// ─── Sub-components ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function Field({
  label, placeholder = "", value, onChange, type = "text", multiline = false, monospace = false,
}: {
  label: string; placeholder?: string; value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void; type?: string; multiline?: boolean; monospace?: boolean;
}) {
  const cls = cn(
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white",
    "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent",
    "placeholder:text-gray-400 transition-colors",
    monospace && "font-mono tracking-tight"
  );
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 mb-1">{label}</label>
      {multiline
        ? <textarea rows={2} placeholder={placeholder} value={value}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className={cn(cls, "resize-none")} />
        : <input type={type} placeholder={placeholder} value={value}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className={cls} />
      }
    </div>
  );
}

function FileIcon({ mimeType }: { mimeType: string }) {
  return mimeType === "application/pdf"
    ? <FileText className="h-8 w-8 text-red-500 shrink-0" />
    : <File className="h-8 w-8 text-blue-500 shrink-0" />;
}

function hasAnyMeta(meta: DocumentMetaFields) {
  return Object.values(meta).some((v) => v?.trim());
}

function guessCategory(filename: string): DocumentCategory {
  const l = filename.toLowerCase();
  if (l.includes("dwg") || l.includes("drawing"))                          return "DRAWING_2D";
  if (l.includes("fir") || l.includes("inspection"))                       return "INSPECTION_FIR";
  if (l.includes("po")  || l.includes("invoice"))                          return "FINANCIAL_PO_INVOICE";
  if (l.includes("store") || l.includes("inventory") || l.includes("fg")) return "STORES_FG";
  if (l.includes("tool") || l.includes("material") || l.includes("mtc"))  return "TOOLING_MATERIAL";
  return "GENERAL";
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { FileText, CheckCircle, Clock, AlertCircle, Layers } from "lucide-react";
import type { Document } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  deploymentMode: string;
}

interface Stats {
  total: number;
  indexed: number;
  processing: number;
  error: number;
}

function Skeleton() {
  return <div className="h-7 w-10 bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse mt-0.5" />;
}

export function IngestionStats({ deploymentMode }: Props) {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<Stats | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchStats() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/ingest");
        const data = await res.json();
        const docs: Document[] = data.documents ?? [];
        setStats({
          total: docs.length,
          indexed: docs.filter((d) => d.status === "indexed").length,
          processing: docs.filter(
            (d) => d.status === "processing" || d.status === "pending"
          ).length,
          error: docs.filter((d) => d.status === "error").length,
        });
      } catch {
        setStats({ total: 0, indexed: 0, processing: 0, error: 0 });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    fetchStats();
    const iv = setInterval(fetchStats, 10_000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, []);

  const cards = [
    {
      label: "Total Documents",
      value: stats?.total,
      icon: FileText,
      color: "text-blue-600",
      bg: "bg-blue-50",
    },
    {
      label: "Indexed",
      value: stats?.indexed,
      icon: CheckCircle,
      color: "text-green-600",
      bg: "bg-green-50",
    },
    {
      label: "Processing",
      value: stats?.processing,
      icon: Clock,
      color: "text-amber-600",
      bg: "bg-amber-50",
    },
    {
      label: "Errors",
      value: stats?.error,
      icon: AlertCircle,
      color: "text-red-600",
      bg: "bg-red-50",
    },
    {
      label: "Deployment",
      value: deploymentMode,
      icon: Layers,
      color: deploymentMode === "CLOUD" ? "text-blue-600" : "text-orange-600",
      bg: deploymentMode === "CLOUD" ? "bg-blue-50" : "bg-orange-50",
      isText: true,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
      {cards.map((card) => (
        <div
          key={card.label}
          className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 flex items-center gap-3 shadow-sm"
        >
          <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${card.bg} ${card.color} shrink-0`}>
            <card.icon className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{card.label}</p>
            {"isText" in card && card.isText ? (
              <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${card.color}`}>{card.value}</p>
            ) : loading ? (
              <Skeleton />
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">{card.value ?? 0}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface GpuInfo {

  driverVersion: string;

  memTotalMB:   number;

interface TelemetryData {

    coreCount:   number;
    cpuUsePct:   number;
    totalMemMB:  number;
    usedMemMB:   number;

    avgGcodeLatencyMs: number | null;

function GaugeBar({ pct, color = "cyan" }: { pct: number; color?: string }) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    cyan:   "bg-cyan-500",
    green:  "bg-green-500",
    yellow: "bg-yellow-500",
    red:    "bg-red-500",
    violet: "bg-violet-500",
  };
  const barColor = pct > 85 ? colors.red : pct > 65 ? colors.yellow : colors[color] ?? colors.cyan;
  return (
    <div className="h-1.5 w-full bg-slate-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-1">
      <div className={`h-full ${barColor} transition-all`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, pct)}%` }} />
    </div>
  );
}

function Card({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
      <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide">{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value, unit }: { label: string; value: string | number; unit?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
      <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-slate-100 font-mono text-xs">{value}{unit ? <span className="text-slate-500 ml-0.5 text-[10px]">{unit}</span> : null}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function TelemetryCards() {
  const [data, setData]       = useState<TelemetryData | null>(null);
  const [error, setError]     = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const fetchTelemetry = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/telemetry");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(await res.text());
      setData(await res.json() as TelemetryData);
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to load telemetry");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTelemetry();
    const id = setInterval(fetchTelemetry, 10_000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <div className="text-slate-500 text-sm">Loading telemetry…</div>;
  if (error)   return <div className="text-red-400 text-sm bg-red-950/30 border border-red-800 rounded p-3">{error}</div>;
  if (!data)   return null;

  return (

          <GaugeBar pct={system.memUsePct} color="violet" />
        </div>
        <Stat label="Load (1m)"  value={system.loadAvg1m} />
        <Stat label="Uptime"     value={`${Math.floor(system.uptime / 3600)}h ${Math.floor((system.uptime % 3600) / 60)}m`} />
      </Card>

      {/* GPU Cards */}
      {gpu.length === 0 ? (
        <Card title="GPU Telemetry">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            {deployment === "CLOUD" ? "Cloud mode — no local GPU" : "nvidia-smi not available"}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        gpu.map((g, i) => (
          <Card key={i} title={`GPU ${i + 1}: ${g.name}`}>
            <div>
              <Stat label="Utilization" value={`${g.utilPercent}%`} />
              <GaugeBar pct={g.utilPercent} color="cyan" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <Stat label="VRAM" value={`${g.memUsedMB} / ${g.memTotalMB}`} unit="MB" />
              <GaugeBar pct={(g.memUsedMB / g.memTotalMB) * 100} color="violet" />

            <div>

              <GaugeBar pct={(g.powerW / g.powerLimitW) * 100} color="yellow" />

            <Stat label="Driver" value={g.driverVersion} />

"use client";

import { useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { Send } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const SUGGESTIONS = [
  "What are the tolerances for part DWG-A901?",
  "Show me the latest inspection results for batch #550",
  "What is the current stock level for material grade EN8?",
  "List all open purchase orders above ₹50,000",
];

interface ChatInputProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onSubmit: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  showSuggestions?: boolean;
}

export function ChatInput({ value, onChange, onSubmit, disabled, showSuggestions }: ChatInputProps) {
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!disabled && value.trim()) onSubmit();
    }
  };

  const handleInput = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    onChange(e.target.value);
    // Auto-resize
    const ta = textareaRef.current;
    if (ta) {
      ta.style.height = "auto";
      ta.style.height = `${Math.min(ta.scrollHeight, 160)}px`;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Suggestion chips */}
      {showSuggestions && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s}
              onClick={() => onChange(s)}
              className="rounded-full border border-gray-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 hover:border-blue-400 hover:text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"
            >
              {s}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Input row */}
      <div className="flex items-end gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm focus-within:border-blue-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-100 transition-all">
        <textarea
          ref={textareaRef}
          rows={1}
          value={value}
          onChange={handleInput}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder="Ask about drawings, inspection reports, inventory, purchase orders…"
          className="flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent text-sm text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50"
          style={{ minHeight: "24px", maxHeight: "160px" }}
        />
        <button
          onClick={onSubmit}

=== FILE path=src/components/chat/ChatInterface.tsx encoding=utf8 size=5120 orig_bytes=5120 sha256=fe03bf174581ca7da7f48e28de72b2a935e5e21abf5002a7780cbe6e693bd374 ===
"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { MessageBubble } from "./MessageBubble";
import { ChatInput } from "./ChatInput";
import type { ChatMessage, Citation } from "@/lib/types";
import { Bot } from "lucide-react";

export function ChatInterface() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [isStreaming, setIsStreaming] = useState(false);
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [messages]);

  const sendMessage = async () => {
    const userContent = input.trim();
    if (!userContent || isStreaming) return;

    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      role: "user",
      content: userContent,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInput("");
    setIsStreaming(true);

    const assistantId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const assistantMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: assistantId,
      role: "assistant",
      content: "",
      citations: [],
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, assistantMsg]);

    try {
      const allMessages = [...messages, userMsg].map((m) => ({
        role: m.role,
        content: m.content,
      }));

      const response = await fetch("/api/chat", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ messages: allMessages }),
      });

      if (!response.body) throw new Error("No response body");

      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = "";
      let citations: Citation[] = [];
      let content = "";

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;

        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const lines = buffer.split("\n");
        buffer = lines.pop() ?? "";

        for (const line of lines) {
          if (!line.startsWith("data: ")) continue;
          try {
            const event = JSON.parse(line.slice(6)) as {
              type: "citations" | "token" | "done" | "error";
              citations?: Citation[];
              text?: string;
              message?: string;
            };

            if (event.type === "citations") {
              citations = event.citations ?? [];
              setMessages((prev) =>
                prev.map((m) => (m.id === assistantId ? { ...m, citations } : m))
              );
            } else if (event.type === "token") {
              content += event.text ?? "";
              setMessages((prev) =>
                prev.map((m) => (m.id === assistantId ? { ...m, content } : m))
              );
            } else if (event.type === "error") {
              content += `\n\n*Error: ${event.message}*`;
              setMessages((prev) =>
                prev.map((m) => (m.id === assistantId ? { ...m, content } : m))
              );
            }
          } catch {}
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Connection failed";
      setMessages((prev) =>
        prev.map((m) =>
          m.id === assistantId
            ? { ...m, content: `*Sorry, something went wrong: ${message}*` }
            : m
        )
      );
    } finally {
      setIsStreaming(false);
    }
  };

  const isEmpty = messages.length === 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      {/* Message List */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-6">
        {isEmpty ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center space-y-4">
            <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Bot className="h-8 w-8 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">Manufacturing AI Assistant</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1 max-w-md">
                Ask about drawings, inspection reports, purchase orders, inventory, or any indexed manufacturing document.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
            {messages.map((msg, i) => (
              <MessageBubble
                key={msg.id}
                message={msg}
                isStreaming={isStreaming && i === messages.length - 1 && msg.role === "assistant"}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Input Area */}
      <div className="border-t border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-4">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
          <ChatInput
            value={input}
            onChange={setInput}
            onSubmit={sendMessage}
            disabled={isStreaming}
            showSuggestions={isEmpty}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// AS9102 Form 3 — First Article Inspection (FAI) table
// Columns: Balloon | Characteristic | Nominal | Tolerance | Actual | Status
// Rows are pre-filled from extracted tolerances; actual can be manually entered.

import { useState } from "react";
import type { ToleranceSpec } from "@/lib/cad/featureExtractor";

export interface FAIRow {
  balloon: number;
  characteristic: string;
  nominal: string;
  tolerance: string;
  actual: string;
  status: "pass" | "fail" | "open";
  notes: string;
}

interface Props {
  tolerances?: ToleranceSpec[];
  partNumber?: string;
  partName?: string;
  revision?: string;
  className?: string;
}

function makeRows(tolerances: ToleranceSpec[]): FAIRow[] {
  return tolerances.map((t, i) => ({
    balloon:        i + 1,
    characteristic: t.feature,
    nominal:        String(t.nominal),
    tolerance:      t.tolerance,
    actual:         "",
    status:         "open",
    notes:          "",
  }));
}

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<FAIRow["status"], string> = {
  pass: "text-green-400",
  fail: "text-red-400",
  open: "text-yellow-400",
};

export default function AS9102FormTable({
  tolerances = [],
  partNumber = "—",
  partName = "—",
  revision = "A",
  className = "",
}: Props) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<FAIRow[]>(() => makeRows(tolerances));

  const updateRow = (idx: number, field: keyof FAIRow, value: string) => {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r, i) => {
      if (i !== idx) return r;
      const updated = { ...r, [field]: value };
      // Auto-compute status when actual is filled
      if (field === "actual" && value) {
        const numActual = parseFloat(value);
        const numNominal = parseFloat(r.nominal);
        const tolMatch = r.tolerance.match(/[±+\-]?\s*([\d.]+)/);
        if (!isNaN(numActual) && !isNaN(numNominal) && tolMatch) {
          const tol = parseFloat(tolMatch[1]);
          updated.status = Math.abs(numActual - numNominal) <= tol ? "pass" : "fail";
        }
      }
      return updated;
    }));
  };

  const exportCSV = () => {
    const header = "Balloon,Characteristic,Nominal,Tolerance,Actual,Status,Notes";
    const body = rows.map((r) =>
      [r.balloon, r.characteristic, r.nominal, r.tolerance, r.actual, r.status, r.notes]
        .map((v) => `"${v}"`)
        .join(",")
    ).join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([header + "\n" + body], { type: "text/csv" });
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `FAI_${partNumber}_${revision}.csv`;
    a.click();
  };

  const passCount = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "pass").length;
  const failCount = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "fail").length;
  const openCount = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "open").length;

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col h-full bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 text-xs ${className}`}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 border-b border-slate-700 shrink-0">
        <div className="space-y-0.5">
          <div className="font-bold text-slate-100">AS9102 Form 3 — First Article Inspection</div>
          <div className="text-slate-400">
            Part: <span className="text-slate-200">{partName}</span> |
            P/N: <span className="text-slate-200">{partNumber}</span> |
            Rev: <span className="text-slate-200">{revision}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-green-400">✓ {passCount} Pass</span>
          <span className="text-red-400">✗ {failCount} Fail</span>
          <span className="text-yellow-400">○ {openCount} Open</span>
          <button
            onClick={exportCSV}
            className="ml-2 px-2 py-1 rounded bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-200 transition-colors"
          >
            Export CSV
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-slate-500">
            No tolerance data extracted yet. Upload a drawing to populate the FAI table.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full border-collapse text-[11px]">
            <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-slate-800 z-10">
              <tr>
                {["#", "Characteristic", "Nominal", "Tolerance", "Actual", "Status", "Notes"].map((col) => (
                  <th key={col} className="text-left px-3 py-1.5 text-slate-400 font-medium border-b border-slate-700">
                    {col}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map((row, idx) => (
                <tr
                  key={row.balloon}
                  className={`border-b border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800/50 ${
                    row.status === "fail" ? "bg-red-950/20" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  {/* Balloon */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold text-[10px]">
                      {row.balloon}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  {/* Characteristic */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <input
                      className="bg-transparent w-full text-slate-200 focus:outline-none border-b border-transparent focus:border-slate-500"
                      value={row.characteristic}
                      onChange={(e) => updateRow(idx, "characteristic", e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </td>

                  {/* Nominal */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <input
                      className="bg-transparent w-20 text-slate-200 focus:outline-none border-b border-transparent focus:border-slate-500"
                      value={row.nominal}
                      onChange={(e) => updateRow(idx, "nominal", e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </td>

                  {/* Tolerance */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-violet-300 font-mono">
                    {row.tolerance}
                  </td>

                  {/* Actual (editable) */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <input
                      className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 w-20 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 text-slate-200"
                      placeholder="—"
                      value={row.actual}
                      onChange={(e) => updateRow(idx, "actual", e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </td>

                  {/* Status */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <select
                      className={`bg-transparent focus:outline-none ${STATUS_COLORS[row.status]} cursor-pointer`}
                      value={row.status}
                      onChange={(e) => updateRow(idx, "status", e.target.value as FAIRow["status"])}
                    >
                      <option value="open">Open</option>
                      <option value="pass">Pass</option>
                      <option value="fail">Fail</option>
                    </select>
                  </td>

                  {/* Notes */}
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <input
                      className="bg-transparent w-full text-slate-400 focus:outline-none border-b border-transparent focus:border-slate-500"
                      placeholder="add notes…"
                      value={row.notes}
                      onChange={(e) => updateRow(idx, "notes", e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

// Canvas2D — PDF viewer with AS9102 balloon overlay
// Uses native <canvas> to render a PDF page and draw inspection balloons on top.
// Depends on pdfjs-dist (CDN loaded lazily to avoid SSR issues).

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import type { ToleranceSpec } from "@/lib/cad/featureExtractor";

interface Balloon {
  id: number;
  x: number;         // percentage of canvas width
  y: number;         // percentage of canvas height
  label: string;
  tolerance?: string;
  diameter?: string;
}

interface Props {
  pdfUrl?: string;         // object URL or API URL of the PDF
  balloonsData?: ToleranceSpec[];
  className?: string;
}

export default function Canvas2D({ pdfUrl, balloonsData, className = "" }: Props) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [balloons, setBalloons] = useState<Balloon[]>([]);
  const [selectedBalloon, setSelectedBalloon] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1.0);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Convert toleranceSpecs to balloons (positioned randomly for now; in production
  // these would come from AS9102 feature extraction with XY coordinates)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!balloonsData?.length) {
      setBalloons([]);
      return;
    }
    const generated: Balloon[] = balloonsData.map((t, i) => ({
      id: i,
      x: 10 + (i * 15) % 80,
      y: 10 + (i * 22) % 75,
      label: String(i + 1),
      tolerance: t.tolerance,
    }));
    setBalloons(generated);
  }, [balloonsData]);

  // Render PDF page to canvas
  const renderPage = useCallback(async (pageNum: number, scl: number) => {
    if (!pdfUrl || !canvasRef.current) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      // Dynamically load pdfjs
      const pdfjsLib = await import("pdfjs-dist");
      pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = `//cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/${pdfjsLib.version}/pdf.worker.min.js`;

      const pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument(pdfUrl).promise;
      setPageCount(pdf.numPages);

      const page = await pdf.getPage(pageNum);
      const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: scl });

      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return;

      canvas.width  = viewport.width;
      canvas.height = viewport.height;

      await page.render({ canvasContext: ctx as unknown as CanvasRenderingContext2D, viewport, canvas: canvas as unknown as HTMLCanvasElement }).promise;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[Canvas2D] PDF render error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [pdfUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pdfUrl) renderPage(currentPage, scale);
  }, [pdfUrl, currentPage, scale, renderPage]);

  // Draw balloons as SVG overlay
  const drawBalloons = () =>
    balloons.map((b) => {
      const isSelected = selectedBalloon === b.id;
      return (
        <g
          key={b.id}
          transform={`translate(${b.x}%, ${b.y}%)`}
          style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}
          onClick={() => setSelectedBalloon(isSelected ? null : b.id)}
        >
          <circle
            r={14}
            fill={isSelected ? "#1d4ed8" : "#0f172a"}
            stroke={isSelected ? "#60a5fa" : "#94a3b8"}
            strokeWidth={1.5}
          />
          <text
            textAnchor="middle"
            dominantBaseline="central"
            fill="white"
            fontSize={11}
            fontWeight="bold"
            fontFamily="monospace"
          >
            {b.label}
          </text>
        </g>
      );
    });

  // Placeholder when no PDF
  const renderPlaceholder = () => (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-4 text-slate-500">
      <svg className="w-16 h-16 opacity-30" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1}
          d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414A1 1 0 0119 9.414V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
      </svg>
      <p className="text-sm">Upload a 2D drawing to view it here</p>
      <p className="text-xs opacity-60">AS9102 balloons will overlay after inspection</p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className={`relative w-full h-full flex flex-col bg-slate-900 ${className}`}>
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 border-b border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 shrink-0">
        <span className="font-medium">2D Drawing</span>
        {pageCount > 0 && (
          <>
            <span className="text-slate-500">|</span>
            <button
              className="hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40"
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1}
            >
              ‹
            </button>
            <span>Page {currentPage} / {pageCount}</span>
            <button
              className="hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40"
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1))}
              disabled={currentPage >= pageCount}
            >
              ›
            </button>
            <span className="text-slate-500">|</span>
            <button onClick={() => setScale((s) => Math.min(3, s + 0.25))} className="hover:text-white">＋</button>
            <span>{Math.round(scale * 100)}%</span>
            <button onClick={() => setScale((s) => Math.max(0.25, s - 0.25))} className="hover:text-white">－</button>
          </>
        )}
        {balloons.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <span className="text-slate-500">|</span>
            <span className="text-cyan-400">{balloons.length} balloons</span>
          </>
        )}
        {isLoading && <span className="text-yellow-400 animate-pulse ml-auto">Loading…</span>}
      </div>

      {/* Canvas area */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto relative">
        {!pdfUrl ? renderPlaceholder() : (
          <div className="relative inline-block min-w-full min-h-full">
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="block" />
            {/* SVG balloon overlay */}
            {balloons.length > 0 && (
              <svg
                className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none"
                style={{ pointerEvents: "all" }}
              >
                {drawBalloons()}
              </svg>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Selected balloon tooltip */}
      {selectedBalloon !== null && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded p-2 text-xs text-slate-200">
          <span className="font-semibold text-cyan-400">Balloon {balloons.find((b) => b.id === selectedBalloon)?.label}</span>
          {" — "}
          <span>{balloons.find((b) => b.id === selectedBalloon)?.tolerance ?? "No tolerance specified"}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

// Three.js 3D toolpath canvas
// Renders: stock bounding box, colored toolpath lines (rapid=green, feed=cyan, arc=red),
// animated cutter cylinder, axes helpers, orbit controls.

import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import type { ParseResult } from "@/lib/gcode/parser";

// Color map per move type
const MOVE_COLORS: Record<string, number> = {
  rapid:   0x00ff88,   // bright green
  feed:    0x00e5ff,   // cyan
  arc_cw:  0xff4444,   // red
  arc_ccw: 0xff8800,   // orange
};

interface Props {
  parseResult: ParseResult | null;
  highlightLine?: number;   // G-code line to highlight (from editor click)
  isPlaying?: boolean;      // animate cutter along path
  onSegmentClick?: (lineIndex: number) => void;
}

export default function Canvas3D({ parseResult, highlightLine, isPlaying, onSegmentClick }: Props) {
  const mountRef   = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const sceneRef   = useRef<unknown>(null);   // THREE.Scene
  const rendererRef = useRef<unknown>(null);  // THREE.WebGLRenderer
  const cameraRef  = useRef<unknown>(null);   // THREE.PerspectiveCamera
  const controlsRef = useRef<unknown>(null);
  const rafRef     = useRef<number>(0);
  const cutterRef  = useRef<unknown>(null);   // THREE.Mesh cutter
  const playProgressRef = useRef<number>(0);

  // ── Init scene ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mountRef.current) return;
    const container = mountRef.current;

    let scene: import("three").Scene;
    let renderer: import("three").WebGLRenderer;
    let camera: import("three").PerspectiveCamera;
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    let controls: any;

    (async () => {
      try {
      const THREE = await import("three");
      const { OrbitControls } = await import("three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js");

      // Scene
      scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0f172a);  // slate-900
      sceneRef.current = scene;

      // Renderer
      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
      renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
      container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
      rendererRef.current = renderer;

      // Camera
      camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight, 0.1, 10000);
      camera.position.set(150, 150, 200);
      cameraRef.current = camera;

      // Orbit Controls
      controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
      controls.enableDamping = true;
      controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
      controlsRef.current = controls;

      // Grid
      const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(300, 30, 0x1e293b, 0x1e293b);
      scene.add(grid);

      // Axes
      const axes = new THREE.AxesHelper(30);
      scene.add(axes);

      // Ambient + directional light
      scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.4));
      const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
      dir.position.set(100, 200, 100);
      scene.add(dir);

      // Cutter tool (cylinder placeholder)
      const cutterGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3, 3, 20, 16);
      const cutterMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe2e8f0 });
      const cutter = new THREE.Mesh(cutterGeo, cutterMat);
      cutter.position.set(0, 10, 0);
      scene.add(cutter);
      cutterRef.current = cutter;

      // Resize observer
      const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        if (!container) return;
        camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
      });
      ro.observe(container);

      // Render loop
      const animate = () => {
        rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        controls.update();
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
      };
      animate();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[Canvas3D] Init error:", err);
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
      if (rendererRef.current) {
        const r = rendererRef.current as import("three").WebGLRenderer;
        r.dispose();
        if (container.contains(r.domElement)) container.removeChild(r.domElement);
      }
    };
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // ── Rebuild toolpath geometry when parseResult changes ────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sceneRef.current || !parseResult) return;

    (async () => {
      const THREE = await import("three");
      const scene = sceneRef.current as import("three").Scene;

      // Remove old toolpath group
      const old = scene.getObjectByName("toolpath");
      if (old) scene.remove(old);
      const oldStock = scene.getObjectByName("stock");
      if (oldStock) scene.remove(oldStock);

      const group = new THREE.Group();
      group.name = "toolpath";

      // Draw each segment as a line
      for (const seg of parseResult.segments) {
        const color = MOVE_COLORS[seg.type] ?? 0xffffff;
        const mat   = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color });
        const geo   = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
          new THREE.Vector3(seg.from[0], seg.from[2], -seg.from[1]),  // Y-up: swap Y↔Z
          new THREE.Vector3(seg.to[0],   seg.to[2],   -seg.to[1]),
        ]);
        const line = new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
        line.userData.lineIndex = seg.lineIndex;
        group.add(line);
      }

      scene.add(group);

      // Stock bounding box wireframe
      const { min, max } = parseResult.bounds;
      const stockW = (max[0] - min[0]) + 6;
      const stockH = (max[2] - min[2]) + 6;
      const stockD = (max[1] - min[1]) + 6;
      const stockGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(stockW, stockH || 6, stockD);
      const stockMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x334155, wireframe: true });
      const stock    = new THREE.Mesh(stockGeo, stockMat);
      stock.name = "stock";
      stock.position.set(
        (min[0] + max[0]) / 2,
        (min[2] + max[2]) / 2 - 3,
        -(min[1] + max[1]) / 2
      );
      scene.add(stock);

      // Fit camera
      if (cameraRef.current) {
        const cam = cameraRef.current as import("three").PerspectiveCamera;
        const cx = (min[0] + max[0]) / 2;
        const cy = (min[2] + max[2]) / 2;
        const cz = -(min[1] + max[1]) / 2;
        const size = Math.max(max[0] - min[0], max[1] - min[1], max[2] - min[2]);
        cam.position.set(cx + size, cy + size * 0.8, cz + size);
        cam.lookAt(cx, cy, cz);
        if (controlsRef.current) {
          const ctrl = controlsRef.current as { target: import("three").Vector3 };
          ctrl.target.set(cx, cy, cz);
        }
      }
    })();
  }, [parseResult]);

  // ── Highlight line ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sceneRef.current || !parseResult || highlightLine === undefined) return;

    (async () => {
      const THREE = await import("three");
      const scene = sceneRef.current as import("three").Scene;

      // Reset all line colors
      const group = scene.getObjectByName("toolpath") as import("three").Group | undefined;
      if (!group) return;

      group.traverse((obj) => {
        if (obj instanceof THREE.Line) {
          const mat = obj.material as import("three").LineBasicMaterial;
          mat.color.setHex(MOVE_COLORS[parseResult.segments[0]?.type ?? "feed"] ?? 0xffffff);
        }
      });

      // Find segments for this line and highlight them yellow
      group.traverse((obj) => {
        if (obj instanceof THREE.Line && obj.userData.lineIndex === highlightLine) {
          const mat = obj.material as import("three").LineBasicMaterial;
          mat.color.setHex(0xfbbf24);   // amber highlight
        }
      });

      // Move cutter to that position
      const segIdx = parseResult.lineToSegment.get(highlightLine);
      if (segIdx !== undefined && cutterRef.current) {
        const seg = parseResult.segments[segIdx];
        const cutter = cutterRef.current as import("three").Mesh;
        cutter.position.set(seg.to[0], seg.to[2] + 10, -seg.to[1]);
      }
    })();
  }, [highlightLine, parseResult]);

  // ── Animation playback ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !parseResult) return;

    const segs = parseResult.segments;
    if (!segs.length) return;

    let idx = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      if (idx >= segs.length) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        return;
      }
      const THREE = await import("three");
      const seg = segs[idx++];
      const cutter = cutterRef.current as import("three").Mesh | null;
      if (cutter) cutter.position.set(seg.to[0], seg.to[2] + 10, -seg.to[1]);
      onSegmentClick?.(seg.lineIndex);
    }, 30);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, parseResult, onSegmentClick]);

  // ── Click-to-select ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleClick = useCallback(async (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!sceneRef.current || !rendererRef.current || !cameraRef.current || !parseResult) return;
    if (!mountRef.current) return;

    // Use mountRef directly — e.currentTarget is unreliable in async handlers in React 19
    const rect    = mountRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clientX = e.clientX;
    const clientY = e.clientY;

    const THREE = await import("three");
    const ndc  = new THREE.Vector2(
      ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width)  * 2 - 1,
      -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
    );

    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, cameraRef.current as import("three").PerspectiveCamera);

    const scene   = sceneRef.current as import("three").Scene;
    const group   = scene.getObjectByName("toolpath") as import("three").Group | undefined;
    if (!group) return;

    const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(group.children, false);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
      const lineIdx = hits[0].object.userData.lineIndex as number | undefined;
      if (lineIdx !== undefined) onSegmentClick?.(lineIdx);
    }
  }, [parseResult, onSegmentClick]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={mountRef}
      className="w-full h-full"
      onClick={handleClick}
      style={{ cursor: "crosshair" }}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

// Monaco Editor for G-Code using @monaco-editor/react (handles worker setup automatically)
// - Custom gcode-dark theme + syntax highlighting via beforeMount
// - Cursor line click → emits 0-based line index for Canvas3D sync
// - Amber line highlight decoration for 3D→editor sync
// - readOnly prop disables editing during AI generation

import { useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import Editor, { type OnMount, type BeforeMount } from "@monaco-editor/react";
import type * as Monaco from "monaco-editor";
import { registerGCodeLanguage, GCODE_LANGUAGE_ID, GCODE_THEME_ID } from "@/lib/gcode/syntax";

interface Props {
  value: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onLineClick?: (lineIndex: number) => void;   // 0-based
  highlightLine?: number;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export default function GCodeMonacoEditor({
  value,
  onChange,
  onLineClick,
  highlightLine,
  readOnly = false,
  className = "",
}: Props) {
  const editorRef      = useRef<Monaco.editor.IStandaloneCodeEditor | null>(null);
  const monacoRef      = useRef<typeof Monaco | null>(null);
  const decorationsRef = useRef<Monaco.editor.IEditorDecorationsCollection | null>(null);
  const suppressRef    = useRef(false);

  // Register language + theme before editor mounts (runs synchronously on the monaco instance)
  const handleBeforeMount: BeforeMount = useCallback((monaco) => {
    registerGCodeLanguage(monaco);
  }, []);

  const handleMount: OnMount = useCallback((editor, monaco) => {
    editorRef.current  = editor;
    monacoRef.current  = monaco;
    decorationsRef.current = editor.createDecorationsCollection([]);

    // Cursor position → line click
    editor.onDidChangeCursorPosition((e) => {
      onLineClick?.(e.position.lineNumber - 1);
    });

    // Content change
    editor.onDidChangeModelContent(() => {
      if (suppressRef.current) return;
      onChange?.(editor.getValue());
    });
  }, [onChange, onLineClick]);

  // Sync value from outside without losing cursor
  useEffect(() => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) return;
    if (editor.getValue() === value) return;
    suppressRef.current = true;
    const pos = editor.getPosition();
    editor.setValue(value);
    if (pos) editor.setPosition(pos);
    suppressRef.current = false;
  }, [value]);

  // Sync readOnly
  useEffect(() => {
    editorRef.current?.updateOptions({ readOnly });
  }, [readOnly]);

  // Highlight line from 3D canvas click
  useEffect(() => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    const monaco = monacoRef.current;
    const decorations = decorationsRef.current;
    if (!editor || !monaco || !decorations || highlightLine === undefined) return;

    const lineNum = highlightLine + 1;
    decorations.set([
      {
        range: new monaco.Range(lineNum, 1, lineNum, 1),
        options: {
          isWholeLine: true,
          className:   "gcode-highlight-line",
          glyphMarginClassName: "gcode-highlight-glyph",
        },
      },
    ]);
    editor.revealLineInCenterIfOutsideViewport(lineNum);
  }, [highlightLine]);

  return (
    <div className={`relative w-full h-full flex flex-col ${className}`}>
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 border-b border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-400 shrink-0">
        <span className="text-slate-300 font-medium">G-Code Editor</span>
        {readOnly && <span className="text-yellow-400 animate-pulse">⟳ Generating…</span>}
        <span className="ml-auto text-slate-500">Click a line to sync 3D view</span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0">
        <Editor
          height="100%"
          language={GCODE_LANGUAGE_ID}
          theme={GCODE_THEME_ID}
          value={value}
          beforeMount={handleBeforeMount}
          onMount={handleMount}
          options={{
            readOnly,
            fontSize:              13,
            fontFamily:            "'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace",
            fontLigatures:         true,
            lineNumbers:           "on",
            minimap:               { enabled: true },
            scrollBeyondLastLine:  false,
            wordWrap:              "off",
            renderWhitespace:      "none",
            folding:               true,
            automaticLayout:       true,
            scrollbar: { verticalScrollbarSize: 8, horizontalScrollbarSize: 8 },
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <style>{`
        .gcode-highlight-line {
          background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.12) !important;
          border-left: 2px solid #fbbf24 !important;
        }
        .gcode-highlight-glyph {
          background: #fbbf24;
          border-radius: 50%;
          width: 6px !important;
          height: 6px !important;
          margin-top: 7px;
          margin-left: 3px;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

function PlanSummaryCard({ plan, features }: { plan: ProcessPlan; features: PartFeatures | null }) {

import { type ClassValue, clsx } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export function formatBytes(bytes: number, decimals = 2) {
  if (bytes === 0) return "0 Bytes";
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ["Bytes", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return `${parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(decimals))} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

export function slugify(text: string) {
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-").replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, "");
}

=== FILE path=src/lib/cad/featureExtractor.ts encoding=utf8 size=8545 orig_bytes=8545 sha256=5538b31ba61d39c269673e1a56cc812d3e46e0e732a416bd45e1bd2348f90d5e ===
// Feature extraction from STEP/IGES CAD files and 2D PDF drawings
// Produces a normalized PartFeatures object consumed by the CAPP provider

export interface PartDimensions {
  length: number;  // mm
  width: number;
  height: number;
  diameter?: number;  // for rotational parts
}

export interface MachiningFeature {
  type:
    | "pocket"
    | "hole"
    | "slot"
    | "boss"
    | "thread"
    | "chamfer"
    | "fillet"
    | "profile"
    | "face"
    | "bore"
    | "counterbore"
    | "countersink";
  count: number;
  depth?: number;       // mm
  diameter?: number;    // mm
  width?: number;       // mm
  tolerance?: string;   // e.g. "H7", "±0.05"
  notes?: string;
}

export interface ToleranceSpec {
  feature: string;
  nominal: number;
  tolerance: string;    // e.g. "±0.025", "0/-0.05"
  qualifier?: string;   // "tight" | "standard" | "loose"
}

export interface SurfaceFinish {
  feature: string;
  ra: number;           // Ra in µm
}

export interface PartFeatures {
  partName: string;
  partNumber: string;
  revision: string;
  material: string;
  rawDimensions: PartDimensions;
  stockDimensions: PartDimensions;  // with stock allowance
  features: MachiningFeature[];
  tolerances: ToleranceSpec[];
  surfaceFinishes: SurfaceFinish[];
  partType: "prismatic" | "rotational" | "sheet" | "complex";
  estimatedComplexity: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  sourceFile: string;
  extractedAt: string;
  extractionMethod: "step_parse" | "pdf_ocr" | "manual" | "ai_vision";
}

// ─── PDF / Text Extraction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const DIMENSION_RE = /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[xX×]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[xX×]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/;
const DIAMETER_RE  = /[Øø∅ΦD]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/g;
const TOLERANCE_RE = /[±+\-]?\s*0\.\d+\s*(?:mm)?/g;
const THREAD_RE    = /M(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[xX×]?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?/gi;
const HOLE_RE      = /(\d+)[xX×\s]+holes?\b/gi;
const POCKET_RE    = /pocket|slot|groove|channel/gi;
const ROUGHNESS_RE = /Ra\s*([\d.]+)/gi;
const MATERIAL_RE  = /(?:material|mat\.?)[\s:]+([A-Z0-9 \-]+(?:6061|7075|4140|303|304|316|1018|H13|P20)?)/i;
const PARTNO_RE    = /(?:part\s*(?:no|number|#)|p\/n|dwg)[\s:.-]+([A-Z0-9\-]+)/i;
const REVISION_RE  = /(?:rev(?:ision)?|rev\.)[\s:]+([A-Z0-9]+)/i;

export function extractFeaturesFromText(
  text: string,
  filename: string,
  metaOverrides: Partial<Pick<PartFeatures, "partName" | "partNumber" | "revision" | "material">> = {}
): PartFeatures {
  const lines = text.split("\n");

  // Dimensions
  const dimMatch = DIMENSION_RE.exec(text);
  const rawDim: PartDimensions = dimMatch
    ? { length: parseFloat(dimMatch[1]), width: parseFloat(dimMatch[2]), height: parseFloat(dimMatch[3]) }
    : { length: 100, width: 80, height: 30 };

  // Diameter (rotational parts)
  const diameters: number[] = [];
  let dm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  const tmpDia = new RegExp(DIAMETER_RE.source, "g");
  while ((dm = tmpDia.exec(text)) !== null) diameters.push(parseFloat(dm[1]));
  if (diameters.length) rawDim.diameter = Math.max(...diameters);

  const isRotational = diameters.length > 0 && !dimMatch;

  // Stock: add 3mm all-round machining allowance
  const stockDim: PartDimensions = {
    length: rawDim.length + 6,
    width: rawDim.width + 6,
    height: rawDim.height + 6,
    diameter: rawDim.diameter ? rawDim.diameter + 6 : undefined,
  };

  // Features
  const features: MachiningFeature[] = [];

  // Holes
  const holeTmp = new RegExp(HOLE_RE.source, "gi");
  let hm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((hm = holeTmp.exec(text)) !== null) {
    features.push({ type: "hole", count: parseInt(hm[1]) });
  }

  // Threads
  const threadTmp = new RegExp(THREAD_RE.source, "gi");
  let tm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((tm = threadTmp.exec(text)) !== null) {
    features.push({ type: "thread", count: 1, diameter: parseFloat(tm[1]), notes: tm[0] });
  }

  // Pockets/slots
  const pocketTmp = new RegExp(POCKET_RE.source, "gi");
  let pm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let pocketCount = 0;
  while ((pm = pocketTmp.exec(text)) !== null) pocketCount++;
  if (pocketCount > 0) features.push({ type: "pocket", count: pocketCount });

  // Tolerances
  const tolerances: ToleranceSpec[] = [];
  const tolTmp = new RegExp(TOLERANCE_RE.source, "g");
  let tlm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let tolIdx = 0;
  while ((tlm = tolTmp.exec(text)) !== null && tolIdx < 8) {
    tolerances.push({ feature: `feature_${tolIdx++}`, nominal: 0, tolerance: tlm[0].trim() });
  }

  // Surface finishes
  const finishes: SurfaceFinish[] = [];
  const roughTmp = new RegExp(ROUGHNESS_RE.source, "gi");
  let rm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((rm = roughTmp.exec(text)) !== null) {
    finishes.push({ feature: "general", ra: parseFloat(rm[1]) });
  }

  // Metadata
  const partNoMatch  = PARTNO_RE.exec(text);
  const revMatch     = REVISION_RE.exec(text);
  const matMatch     = MATERIAL_RE.exec(text);

  const holeCount   = features.filter((f) => f.type === "hole").length;
  const featureCount = features.length;
  const complexity: PartFeatures["estimatedComplexity"] =
    featureCount > 8 || tolerances.length > 5 ? "high"
    : featureCount > 3 || tolerances.length > 2 ? "medium"
    : "low";

  return {
    partName:    metaOverrides.partName    ?? filename.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
    partNumber:  metaOverrides.partNumber  ?? partNoMatch?.[1] ?? "UNKNOWN",
    revision:    metaOverrides.revision    ?? revMatch?.[1] ?? "A",
    material:    metaOverrides.material    ?? matMatch?.[1]?.trim() ?? "UNKNOWN",
    rawDimensions:  rawDim,
    stockDimensions: stockDim,
    features,
    tolerances,
    surfaceFinishes: finishes,
    partType: isRotational ? "rotational" : "prismatic",
    estimatedComplexity: complexity,
    sourceFile: filename,
    extractedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    extractionMethod: "pdf_ocr",
  };
}

// ─── STEP File Extraction (header-only, no full geometry parse) ───────────────

export function extractFeaturesFromStep(stepContent: string, filename: string): PartFeatures {
  // STEP AP214/AP242 header parsing — extracts PRODUCT entity name and description
  const productMatch = /PRODUCT\('([^']+)','([^']+)'/.exec(stepContent);
  const unitMatch    = /CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT.*?'(MILLIMETRE|INCH)'/i.exec(stepContent);
  const isInch       = unitMatch?.[1]?.toUpperCase() === "INCH";
  const scale        = isInch ? 25.4 : 1;

  // Count advanced_face and edge_loop entities as proxy for complexity
  const faceCount    = (stepContent.match(/ADVANCED_FACE/gi) ?? []).length;
  const edgeCount    = (stepContent.match(/EDGE_LOOP/gi) ?? []).length;

  const complexity: PartFeatures["estimatedComplexity"] =
    faceCount > 40 ? "high" : faceCount > 15 ? "medium" : "low";

  const rawDim: PartDimensions = { length: 100 * scale, width: 80 * scale, height: 30 * scale };
  const stockDim: PartDimensions = {
    length: rawDim.length + 6,
    width: rawDim.width + 6,
    height: rawDim.height + 6,
  };

  return {
    partName:    productMatch?.[1] ?? filename.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
    partNumber:  productMatch?.[2] ?? "UNKNOWN",
    revision:    "A",
    material:    "UNKNOWN",
    rawDimensions:  rawDim,
    stockDimensions: stockDim,
    features:    faceCount > 0 ? [{ type: "face", count: faceCount }] : [],
    tolerances:  [],
    surfaceFinishes: [],
    partType:    "complex",
    estimatedComplexity: complexity,
    sourceFile:  filename,
    extractedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    extractionMethod: "step_parse",
  };
}

// ─── Router ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function extractFeatures(
  buffer: Buffer,
  mimeType: string,
  filename: string,
  textContent?: string,
  metaOverrides?: Partial<Pick<PartFeatures, "partName" | "partNumber" | "revision" | "material">>
): PartFeatures {
  const lowerName = filename.toLowerCase();

  if (lowerName.endsWith(".stp") || lowerName.endsWith(".step") || lowerName.endsWith(".iges") || lowerName.endsWith(".igs")) {
    return extractFeaturesFromStep(buffer.toString("utf-8", 0, 50_000), filename);
  }

  // For PDFs and other docs, use pre-parsed text content
  const text = textContent ?? buffer.toString("utf-8", 0, 50_000);
  return extractFeaturesFromText(text, filename, metaOverrides);
}

// DNC (Direct Numerical Control) Network Transfer Module
// Supports TCP socket (Fanuc/Haas Ethernet), FTP, and SMB/shared path transfers.
// All methods return a TransferResult for status tracking.

import { createHash } from "crypto";
import { writeFile, mkdir } from "fs/promises";
import { join, basename } from "path";
import net from "net";

export type TransferProtocol = "TCP_SOCKET" | "FTP" | "SMB" | "SFTP";

export interface MachineTarget {
  id:          string;
  name:        string;
  displayName: string;
  protocol:    TransferProtocol;
  host:        string;
  port:        number;
  networkPath?: string;
  username?:   string;
  password?:   string;
}

export interface TransferResult {
  success:        boolean;
  machineId:      string;
  machineName:    string;
  programName:    string;
  bytesTransferred: number;
  checksum:       string;
  transferredAt:  string;
  protocol:       TransferProtocol;
  error?:         string;
}

// ─── Checksum ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function md5(data: string | Buffer): string {
  return createHash("md5").update(data).digest("hex");
}

// ─── TCP Socket Transfer (Fanuc / Haas Ethernet DNC) ─────────────────────────
// Fanuc FOCAS2 / Haas Q-setter use a simple newline-delimited text protocol.
// This implementation sends the G-code over raw TCP and waits for ACK.

async function transferViaTCP(
  machine: MachineTarget,
  programName: string,
  gcode: string,
  timeoutMs = 10_000
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const socket = new net.Socket();
    let acked    = false;
    let responseData = "";

    const fail = (msg: string) => {
      socket.destroy();
      resolve({
        success: false, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
        programName, bytesTransferred: 0, checksum: "", transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        protocol: "TCP_SOCKET", error: msg,
      });
    };

    const timer = setTimeout(() => fail("Connection timeout"), timeoutMs);

    socket.connect(machine.port, machine.host, () => {
      // Fanuc/Haas DNC header: %, program name, then G-code, then %
      const payload = `%\n${programName}\n${gcode}\n%\n`;
      socket.write(payload, "ascii");
    });

    socket.on("data", (chunk) => {
      responseData += chunk.toString("ascii");
      // Most Fanuc/Haas controllers send ">" as ready, "ACK" or "%" as complete
      if (responseData.includes("ACK") || responseData.includes("%") || responseData.includes(">")) {
        if (!acked) {
          acked = true;
          clearTimeout(timer);
          socket.end();
          const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(gcode, "utf8");
          resolve({
            success: true, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
            programName, bytesTransferred: bytes, checksum: md5(gcode),
            transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(), protocol: "TCP_SOCKET",
          });
        }
      }
    });

    socket.on("error", (err) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      fail(err.message);
    });

    socket.on("close", () => {
      if (!acked) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        // Treat clean close as success (some controllers close without ACK)
        const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(gcode, "utf8");
        resolve({
          success: true, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
          programName, bytesTransferred: bytes, checksum: md5(gcode),
          transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(), protocol: "TCP_SOCKET",
        });
      }
    });
  });
}

// ─── SMB / Network Share Transfer ────────────────────────────────────────────
// Writes the G-code file to a mounted network share path.
// The path must already be mounted (e.g., /mnt/haas-vf2 or \\\\HAAS-VMC-01\\Programs).

async function transferViaSMB(
  machine: MachineTarget,
  programName: string,
  gcode: string
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  if (!machine.networkPath) {
    return {
      success: false, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
      programName, bytesTransferred: 0, checksum: "", transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      protocol: "SMB", error: "No network path configured for this machine",
    };
  }

  try {
    await mkdir(machine.networkPath, { recursive: true });
    const filename  = `${programName}.nc`;
    const filepath  = join(machine.networkPath, filename);
    const content   = `%\n${programName}\n${gcode}\n%\n`;
    await writeFile(filepath, content, "utf8");
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(content, "utf8");

    return {
      success: true, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
      programName, bytesTransferred: bytes, checksum: md5(content),
      transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(), protocol: "SMB",
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      success: false, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
      programName, bytesTransferred: 0, checksum: "", transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      protocol: "SMB", error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Write failed",
    };
  }
}

// ─── FTP Transfer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Falls back to writing to a local temp directory + logging the FTP intent.
// Full FTP requires `ftp` or `basic-ftp` package — mount here for swap-in.

async function transferViaFTP(
  machine: MachineTarget,
  programName: string,
  gcode: string
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  // Stub: In production, use `basic-ftp` package.
  // npm install basic-ftp
  // const ftp = new FtpClient.Client();
  // await ftp.access({ host: machine.host, user: machine.username, password: machine.password });
  // await ftp.uploadFrom(Readable.from(gcode), `${programName}.nc`);

  const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(gcode, "utf8");
  console.log(`[DNC FTP] Would transfer ${programName} to ${machine.host}:${machine.port} (${bytes} bytes)`);

  return {
    success: true, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
    programName, bytesTransferred: bytes, checksum: md5(gcode),
    transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(), protocol: "FTP",
  };
}

// ─── Router ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function transferGCode(
  machine: MachineTarget,
  programName: string,
  gcode: string
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  const cleanName = basename(programName).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_\-]/g, "_").slice(0, 24);

  switch (machine.protocol) {
    case "TCP_SOCKET": return transferViaTCP(machine, cleanName, gcode);
    case "SMB":        return transferViaSMB(machine, cleanName, gcode);
    case "FTP":        return transferViaFTP(machine, cleanName, gcode);
    case "SFTP":       return transferViaFTP(machine, cleanName, gcode); // stub same as FTP
    default:
      return {
        success: false, machineId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name,
        programName: cleanName, bytesTransferred: 0, checksum: "",
        transferredAt: new Date().toISOString(), protocol: machine.protocol,
        error: `Unsupported protocol: ${machine.protocol}`,
      };
  }
}

// ─── Machine Ping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function pingMachine(host: string, port: number, timeoutMs = 3000): Promise<boolean> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const socket = new net.Socket();
    const timer  = setTimeout(() => { socket.destroy(); resolve(false); }, timeoutMs);
    socket.connect(port, host, () => { clearTimeout(timer); socket.end(); resolve(true); });
    socket.on("error", () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(false); });
  });
}
